companyDescription:
Established in 1890, Boart Longyear is the world’s leading innovative provider of drilling services, manufacturer of productivity-driven drilling equipment and performance tooling, and developer of orebody-data technology, which is revolutionizing the future of mineral development. 

People are the Company’s key assets, and it is understood the best ideas result from collaboration between individuals with diverse backgrounds, opinions, and perspectives. Boart Longyear is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, fostering environments free from discrimination and harassment, where everyone feels safe and empowered to share their ideas and opinions. 

With a rich heritage spanning over 135 years, the Company continues to build value for customers worldwide. Boart Longyear is headquartered in the US capital city of Salt Lake City, Utah. The Company operates in 26 countries, with approximately 6,000 employees as of the end of 2023.
descriptionHtml:
Established in 1890, Boart Longyear is the world’s leading provider of innovative, safe, and productivity-driven drilling equipment and tooling. With a primary focus on mining and exploration activities spanning a wide range of commodities - including copper, gold, nickel, zinc, uranium, and other metals and minerals - the Company also supports activities in the energy, oil sands exploration, and environmental sectors.

Boart Longyear's Drilling Products division delivers advanced research and development capabilities and holds hundreds of patented designs to manufacture, market, and service reliable drill rigs, innovative drill string products, rugged performance tooling, durable drilling consumables, and high-quality parts for customers worldwide. These products are engineered to meet the evolving needs of the global drilling industry, offering maximum performance, reliability, and safety in the most demanding conditions.

Job Overview

The QlikView Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting Business Intelligence (BI) and analytics solutions using QlikView, Qlik Sense, and Qlik Cloud. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in data warehousing, ETL, data modeling, reporting, and dashboard development, with the ability to quickly adopt new technologies and deliver scalable BI solutions that meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain QlikView, Qlik Sense, and Qlik Cloud applications and dashboards.
  • Analyze source system data and build efficient data models and load scripts.
  • Work closely with business users and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into BI solutions.
  • Develop visualizations, reports, and dashboards that provide meaningful business insights.
  • Optimize application performance through efficient scripting, data modeling, and UI design.
  • Create and maintain Section Access and security models.
  • Strong understanding of business processes and operational workflows.
  • Ability to translate business process requirements into actionable technical and reporting solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to applications, reports, and data loads.
  • Document application designs, data models, and technical specifications.
  • Support testing, deployment, and user acceptance activities.
  • Train and support end users and promote the adoption of BI solutions.
  • Participate in SDLC activities and contribute to reusable frameworks and best practices.
  • All other reasonable duties as assigned

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Data Warehouse concepts including Databases, Data Modeling, ETL, Reporting, and Analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with QlikView, Qlik Sense, and Qlik Cloud.
  • Knowledge of QlikView Section Access, Set Analysis, and QlikView Publisher for application security and distribution.
  • Working knowledge of NPrinting for automated report generation and distribution.
  • Experience with SQL/PLSQL and relational databases.
  • Exposure to ETL tools, OLAP/MOLAP technologies, and data modeling tools.
  • Experience with JavaScript or VBScript for Qlik extensions is a plus.
  • Experience with QlikView Publisher and NPrinting.
  • Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) experience is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working in Agile and SDLC-based development environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 5+ years of overall IT experience
    • 5+ years of QlikView, Qlik Sense, and/or Qlik Cloud development experience
    • 5+ years of SQL/PLSQL experience
    • 3+ years of Data Warehousing and ETL experience
    • Languages: English required. Additional languages are a plus.

    Physical and Environmental Conditions

    • Work Environment: Primarily an office-based environment with regular use of computers and other standard office equipment. The role may require occasional meetings or work in other company locations and collaboration with employees across different functions and geographic regions.
    • Lifting Requirements: This position is primarily sedentary and does not routinely require lifting. Occasional lifting or carrying of light office materials or equipment may be required.

    Our People

    At Boart Longyear, people are our most important asset. We recognize that the best ideas emerge through collaboration among individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That is why we are committed to fostering diverse, inclusive teams and work environments free from discrimination and harassment—spaces where everyone can contribute and be heard.

    Our Vision

    To create products and solutions that empower the exploration and extraction of minerals to enable life and prosperity.

    Our Values

    Our Success As a Business Depends On How We Operate. The How Is The Distinctive Way In Which We Conduct Our Business, Guided By Our Values Of

    • Integrity
    • Health & Safety
    • Teamwork & Diversity
    • Customer Focus
    • Sustainability

    At Boart Longyear, we innovate, we lead, and we grow together. Sound like your kind of team? Apply now.

descriptionHtml:
HarmonyTech Inc. is seeking a talented and self-motivated Mid-Level Power BI Developer to design, develop, enhance, and support enterprise business intelligence, data analytics, and reporting solutions for a client.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, SQL, DAX, Power Query, data modeling, ETL, data transformation, dashboards, and data visualization. This role will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into secure, reliable, and high-performing reporting and analytics solutions.

This position requires full-time onsite work from HarmonyTech's office in Fairfax, Virginia. Remote work is not available.

Candidates must be U.S. citizens and may not hold dual citizenship with another country. The selected candidate must also meet applicable federal personnel security and onboarding requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, metrics, visualizations, and data models
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, DAX measures, calculated columns, and Power Query transformations
  • Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into technical, reporting, and analytics solutions
  • Design and optimize data models, relationships, and complex data transformations
  • Integrate Power BI solutions with databases, files, applications, and other enterprise data sources
  • Validate data accuracy and troubleshoot ETL pipelines, transformations, data connectors, data-quality issues, and performance problems
  • Publish and maintain reports through Power BI Service, including workspace management and scheduled data refreshes
  • Optimize reports, dashboards, queries, and data models for performance and maintainability
  • Implement appropriate data security and access controls, including row-level security (RLS)
  • Collaborate with product owners, subject-matter experts, data teams, developers, and other business and technical stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle
  • Participate in solution design, development, testing, implementation, and production support
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including specifications, data models, scripts, workflows, and user guidance
  • Develop reporting solutions consistent with applicable Section 508 accessibility requirements
  • Follow established development, security, source-control, documentation, and solution-management standards

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 7+ years of overall IT, data, analytics, application development, or business intelligence experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Power BI development experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL, DAX, and Power Query
  • Experience developing interactive dashboards, reports, visualizations, metrics, and data models
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, data modeling, data relationships, and business intelligence concepts
  • Experience with ETL, data transformation, data preparation, pipelines, and connectors
  • Experience integrating Power BI with multiple databases and enterprise data sources
  • Experience with Power BI Service, performance optimization, scheduled refreshes, troubleshooting, and data validation
  • Knowledge of data security, access controls, and row-level security (RLS)
  • Ability to translate business requirements into effective technical and analytics solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to data quality and accuracy
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical teams
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and must not hold dual citizenship with another country

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting federal government, financial services, or other regulated environments
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Automate and SharePoint Online
  • Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and cloud-based data and analytics solutions
  • Experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, automation, or scripting
  • Familiarity with GitHub, JIRA, ServiceNow, or DBeaver
  • Experience with source control and established software development lifecycle practices
  • Knowledge of Section 508 accessibility requirements
  • Familiarity with federal information security, privacy, data governance, or compliance requirements
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale business intelligence, reporting, data analytics, or automation solutions

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field preferred

About HarmonyTech

We have been delivering information technology services and solutions across the federal government and commercial clients for over a decade. Our employees are the most important assets of our company because they deliver value and care for our clients. We are a company of passionate technologists, constantly evolving in our understanding and application of technology to best fulfill our clients' mission needs. We operate under a flat and efficient organizational structure to ensure our hand-picked consultants have the flexibility to take risks and be innovative. We typically work in small, agile teams as we design and develop solutions to address our clients' business challenges. Our success is measured with every satisfied customer and employee.

Why you want to join us

  • You have a passion for solving our customers' complex business problems
  • Awesome learning and professional development opportunities
  • A culture built on teamwork and excellence

Benefits

HarmonyTech offers a highly competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Short/Long Term Disability Coverage
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Referral Bonus

companyDescription:
Brady Corporation is an international manufacturer and marketer of complete solutions that identify and protect people, products and places. Brady’s products help customers increase safety, security, productivity and performance and include high-performance labels, signs, safety devices, printing systems and software. 

Founded in 1914, the Company has a diverse customer base in electronics, telecommunications, manufacturing, electrical, construction, medical, aerospace and a variety of other industries.  

Brady is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin and as of July 31, 2021, employed approximately 5,700 people in its worldwide businesses.  Brady’s fiscal 2021 sales were approximately $1.14 billion. Brady stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol BRC. More information is available on the Internet at www.bradycorp.com.
descriptionHtml:
What We Need

We're looking for a talented and experienced Lead BI Developer to join our team! In this role, you'll be a key player in transforming business needs into powerful reporting and analytics solutions. You'll partner closely with our Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Operations teams, leveraging your expertise to design, develop, implement, and transform business requirements into powerful, scalable, and high-performing applications. You will be a technical expert responsible for guiding the design, development, and support of our enterprise reporting and visualization solutions.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with business analysts and functional stakeholders across diverse departments to understand reporting and analytics requirements; lead solution design, create mock-ups, and translate needs into scalable reporting models and intuitive visualizations.
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable semantic models, data layers, and reporting architectures adhering to enterprise best practices and governance standards.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain data transformation and load scripts, orchestrating Implement and manage granular data access security, including Role-Level Security (RLS) in Power BI or Section Access in QlikView.
  • Provide ongoing enhancements and production support; proactively troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve data bottlenecks, refresh failures, and calculation latencies with a sense of urgency.
  • Lead code reviews, enforce coding and architectural standards, and mentor junior-to-mid-level developers to foster technical excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Participate in our Scrum process, taking end-to-end ownership of Jira user stories from conception through to production rollout.

What You Will Need To Be Successful

  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in BI reporting, visualization design, data modeling, and end-to-end dashboard implementation.
  • Advanced expertise in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, Dataflows, Service administration) OR QlikView / Qlik Sense (Load Scripting, QVD generation, Set Analysis, QMC administration).
  • Strong proficiency in data modeling, semantic layers, and data warehousing concepts (e.g., star schemas, link tables).
  • Demonstrated experience implementing row-level/section access security and managing tenant/workspace governance.
  • Strong SQL skills with demonstrated experience connecting to and integrating diverse enterprise data sources (e.g., SAP, SQL Server, relational databases, and flat files).
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic, capable of working effectively both independently and as a technical lead of a team.
  • Strong communication skills, ability to communicate well with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

About Us

Who we are:

Brady Corporation is a global industrial technology leader dedicated to making workplaces safer, more productive, and more connected. Backed by a 110+ year legacy of reliability and innovation, we have entered an exciting era of transformation and growth, powered by more than 10,000 team members serving customers across 40+ countries. Following our acquisition of Honeywell's Productivity Solutions and Services business in August 2026, Brady brings together trusted leadership in safety, materials science, and identification with advanced mobile computing, scanning, and automation.

We Help Organizations Make Work Safer, More Productive, And More Connected By Transforming Everyday Critical Information Into Actionable Intelligence. Our End-to-end Platform Unites Two Powerful Pillars

  • Identification Solutions: High-performance labels, safety signs, engineered materials, and rugged industrial printing systems.
  • Intelligent Productivity Solutions: Industry-leading mobile computers, barcode/RFID scanners, specialized software, voice automation, and workflow services.

From aerospace, healthcare, and laboratories to manufacturing plants, retail, data centers, and global transportation and logistics hubs, we empower customers to identify, protect, track, and optimize the people, assets, and processes that keep the world running.

Why Work At Brady

A career at Brady means working for a global company that has thrived for over 100 years, and whose innovative spirit drives our future growth.

Brady offers competitive pay and great benefits, supported by a culture that encourages collaboration and innovation. We strive to foster an inclusive workplace where diverse talent can learn, grow, and succeed. And with deeply rooted values, no matter where you work at Brady, you'll feel connected to the community through our charitable contributions and opportunities to give back.

Our headquarters are in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, but we have more than 70 locations globally, giving our employees the opportunity to work with colleagues around the world.

Our Benefits

  • Comprehensive insurance coverage starting on your first day of employment, including medical, dental, and vision
  • Generous 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Opportunity to participate in incentive programs for all full-time employees
  • Family planning benefits including paid parental leave, fertility coverage, adoption and surrogacy assistance
  • Education reimbursement opportunities
  • Scholarship program for children of Brady employees
  • A variety of Employee Resource Groups to provide you with unique networking, development, and volunteer opportunities
  • Employee Assistance Program and related wellness programs (mental and behavioral health, family counseling, financial management)
  • Dress-for-your-day dress code
  • Charitable contributions matched through Brady's Matching Gift program

Job Title: BI Developer and Reporting Analyst
Reports To: The BI Developer and Reporting Analyst will report to IT Supervisor/Manager, IT Director, or equivalent leadership.

Job Overview:
The BI Developer & Reporting Analyst designs, develops, and supports scalable reporting and analytics solutions that enable informed business and operational decision-making. The role partners with technical and non-technical stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish consistent metrics, and translate complex data into accurate, actionable insights. Using SQL, Microsoft Power BI, SharePoint, AWS QuickSight, and related data platforms, the position integrates and validates data from multiple sources; develops dashboards, reports, and semantic models; resolves data and reporting issues; and improves reporting performance and automation. The role also supports data quality, security, governance, documentation, and visualization standards while recommending enhancements to the BI environment for SPS clients and internal stakeholders.
The position is expected to deliver accurate, timely, understandable reporting and analytics while maintaining appropriate data quality, confidentiality, and service standards.

Duties and Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations for business and operational stakeholders.
• Extract, cleanse, validate, and manipulate data from multiple sources to ensure reporting accuracy and integrity.
• Use SharePoint, Microsoft Power BI, and AWS QuickSight to build user-friendly reporting solutions and data views.
• Partner with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, define metrics, and translate business needs into technical deliverables.
• Analyze trends, performance results, and operational data to identify insights and support decision-making.
• Ensure reports are delivered on time, are easy to interpret, and meet audience needs across multiple functions.
• Troubleshoot reporting issues, resolve data discrepancies, and recommend process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency.
• Maintain documentation for report logic, data sources, calculations, and distribution processes.
• Support ongoing enhancements to reporting tools, governance, and data visualization standards; recommend tools, systems, or databases that could strengthen the BI program for SPS clients and stakeholders.
• Support report and dashboard quality assurance, appropriate access controls, and consistent use of approved metrics and definitions.
• Communicate findings, limitations, risks, and recommended actions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Test and validate reports, dashboards, calculations, and data outputs before publication and following updates to help ensure results are accurate, consistent, and aligned with business requirements.
• Monitor data refreshes and report performance, investigate recurring failures or slow-running reports, and coordinate with relevant technical teams to resolve underlying issues.
• Support report publishing, distribution, and appropriate user access; gather stakeholder feedback and provide guidance that helps users interpret and effectively use available reporting solutions.

Competencies:
• Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to translate business questions and reporting needs into accurate, practical data solutions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information and data insights in clear, accessible language.
• Data storytelling and visualization skills, including the ability to summarize trends, risks, and recommended actions for stakeholders.
• Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Commitment to data accuracy, confidentiality, documentation, governance, and responsible handling of client, operational, and financial information.
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Service-oriented approach, responsiveness, and professional stakeholder management.
• Continuous-improvement mindset, with an interest in automation, reusable reporting solutions, and reporting efficiency.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 3 to 5 years of experience in report writing, business intelligence, or data analytics roles.
• At least 2 to 3 years of hands-on Power BI and SQL experience, with intermediate to advanced SQL proficiency, including joins, aggregations, stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting data discrepancies.
• Power BI data-modeling experience, including Power Query, DAX, semantic models, measures, calculated columns, and report-performance optimization.
• Experience manipulating and analyzing large datasets from multiple systems and sources.
• Strong Excel and data-management skills.
• Ability to define and maintain KPI and metrics dictionaries to ensure consistent definitions across reports and stakeholder groups.
• Experience with report and dashboard governance, including version control, access management, row-level security, quality assurance, and documentation.
• Understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance requirements, particularly where client, operational, or financial data is involved.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate work within established timelines.
• Ability to work assigned hours determined by the manager and adhere to applicable company policies and procedures.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Strong working knowledge of SharePoint and AWS QuickSight.
• Experience with data warehousing or cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Snowflake, SQL Server, Dataverse, or similar platforms.
• Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts, data pipelines, data integration, and data-transformation processes.
• Experience enabling self-service analytics by training business users, creating reusable templates, and helping stakeholders interpret dashboards.
• Experience with Agile, project intake, or requirements management, such as user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog prioritization, or report-request workflows.
• Experience supporting multiple business stakeholders or client groups with tailored reporting needs.
• Understanding of data governance, data quality, and reporting controls.
• Experience working in cross-functional environments with operations, IT, and business teams.
• Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate or AWS analytics or QuickSight-related training.

Physical Demands:
• Ability to sit for extended periods while performing computer-based work, participating in meetings, and reviewing reports or other documentation.
• Ability to use a computer, keyboard, mouse, telephone, and other standard office equipment, including repetitive hand and wrist movements.
• Ability to see and review information on computer screens and in printed materials, including close vision, distance vision as needed, and the ability to adjust focus.
• Ability to distinguish colors and differences in color, shades, brightness, and contrast when reviewing charts, dashboards, reports, and other visual information.
• Ability to hear and understand spoken information in person, over the telephone, and during virtual meetings, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Ability to communicate verbally in a clear and understandable manner in person, over the telephone, and during virtual meetings.
• Ability to read, comprehend, analyze, and accurately enter detailed numerical and written information.
• Ability to occasionally stand, walk, or move within an office or client site as business needs require.

Travel: Local travel may be required up to 10% of the time.

Other Duties:
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.
  • Paid Time Off: Full time: Minimum of 80 hours/calendar year. Part time/temporary: Minimum of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked. PTO amounts may increase based on tenure and/or the assigned account.  PTO allows employees to take approved time off for any reason.
  • Bonuses: Are available for employee and client referrals for current employees.

descriptionHtml:
Advanced Power Business Intelligence Developer, Research

Reports To: Lead, Product Development

ProSight Financial Association is a non-profit industry organization that helps banks and credit unions drive sustainable growth with a strong foundation of risk, compliance and fraud management. ProSight was formed in 2024 from the merger of BAI and RMA, trusted industry organizations with over a century of experience serving financial services leaders. We help leaders act with confidence by offering industry-leading insights, training, events, analytics, tools and resources. Our work creates positive ripple effects throughout financial services organizations and ultimately helps consumers, businesses and communities thrive.

The ProSight IT team partners with its functional business associates to define the company’s technology strategy, deliver innovative applications and continuously improve its internal and customer-facing technology assets. We are seeking an Advanced Data Warehouse / Power BI Developer who has a broad understanding of data warehouse and interactive visualization development for external / customer facing consumption. A successful candidate must have an affinity towards user experience (UX), superior DW, SQL, DAX, and data modeling development skills and be a self-motivated, critical thinker.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Azure Fabric and other interactive visualization tools to create compelling and intuitive user experiences for an external audience in custom and secure portals. The experience will include reports, interactive dashboards and other functionalities.
  • Provide application development, support, and model building to be used for Analytics work by the research department. Provide models for external users.
  • Utilize and set up Microsoft Azure Fabric environment and then educate others across the organization on Fabric tools use and advantages.
  • Analyze data sources, aggregation tables, explore different levers withing Fabric for performance improvements.
  • Perform analysis, design, develop, and maintain systems and subsystems, as it pertains to back-end databases.
  • As needed: create data models, advanced SQL queries and Stored Procedures; update and/or create reports/dashboards.
  • Work closely with business partners and stakeholders to determine and document business and functional requirements, translating those into detailed technical specifications and running code.
  • Responsible for the documentation of and adherence to current development standards; to seek opportunities to utilize current or additional applications to create process improvements.
  • Coordinate and support testing activities (including development of test cases and scheduling of test events with key IT staff and users) for changes and releases (both internal and vendor based) to web applications supported by the ProSight IT applications group.
  • Be able to identify and solve problems on your own, with minimal supervision.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to utilize current or innovative technical solutions to improve business processes and/or products that provide additional revenue, cost savings or efficiency gains.
  • Create Solution/Application Architecture recommendations.
  • Develop and implement deployment plans for promotion of application code through all environments.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field required.
  • 8+ years professional experience required.
  • 7+ years in data warehouse / business intelligence space required.
  • 7+ years SQL development required.
  • 1+ years of on-the-job Azure Fabric experience required.
  • Power BI embedded experience required. This experience must target external private audiences, not internal and/or public reports.
  • Custom Web Dashboard development experience required.
  • SSIS experience preferred.
  • Python and .NET skills would be highly preferred.
  • Experience with Agile software development methodologies required,
  • This individual must be highly motivated, self-directed, and possess solid execution and follow-up skills.
  • The ability to probe beyond the surface of the requested data to get valuable (actionable) information is essential.
  • Detail-oriented but understands broader impacts of projects and tasks.
  • The ability to expand on the original request/question to deliver the data/answer and the information on how it relates on a larger scale.
  • Must be able to check and validate the results of their own and other’s work.
  • Adjust quickly to changing priorities as directed.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Needs to possess a strong analytical, quantitative and objective outlook.
  • Excellent people skills are also necessary since this position may interact with all levels of resources across the entire organization.

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $140,000. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, job-related knowledge and market considerations. This role is eligible for an annual incentive plan based on business results and individual performance. ProSight offers an outstanding benefits package with comprehensive insurance coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible paid time off, hybrid and remote working models, tuition reimbursement and the ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

  • Produces reports and analytics that facilitate evidence-based clinical, financial, and operational decisions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in information science, computer science or related field.
  • At least five (5) years of data analysis, query design, and reporting experience.
  • Experience with reporting solutions using Power BI, MS SQL Server, Azure, Advanced Analytics
  • Experience with reports, dashboards, scorecards using Power BI and MDX in a data warehousing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering and using relational databases.
  • Ability to perform detailed data analysis (i.e. determine the structure, content, and quality of the data through examination of source systems and data samples).
  • Good visual aesthetic sense relative to report development and presentation to the user.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and customer facing skills
  • Must have a strong customer service orientation and excellent organizational skills.
  • Experience developing sophisticated reports against complex data sets.
  • Ability to read other’s SQL queries and make changes/updates as necessary
  • Experience with diagnosing and resolving errors in complex reports.
  • Strong analytical, multi-tasking and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in data ingestion, quality cleanup, and multi source data integration to support analytics and reporting.
  • Familiarity with emerging healthcare delivery models and key performance indicators related to subscriptions, application usage, and system throughput.

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Developer plays a key role in owning and advancing the organization’s BI, analytics, and data warehousing platforms, with a strong focus on Power BI, SSIS Packages and Oracle BI (OBIEE/OAS/OAC) technologies. This role is instrumental in enabling a unified, trusted data environment that empowers business users with actionable insights and supports strategic decision-making.

Working closely with the Senior BI Architect and cross-functional IT teams, the Senior BI Developer will lead the design, development, and optimization of dashboards, reports, and data models that support OAS BI Enterprise platform as well as existing SSIS packages and job within the Power BI. This includes enhancing existing BI platforms, supporting data warehouse initiatives, and ensuring seamless integration with ERP and other enterprise systems.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and a proactive mindset to drive innovation and continuous improvement in the BI landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports in Oracle BI (OBIEE/OAS) to meet evolving business needs.
  • Support existing Power BI dashboards, monitor jobs on SQL server agents and enhance SSIS packages.
  • Support the day-to-day operations of Business Intelligence and all related systems, collaborating with IT support teams, to ensure timely and reliable business operations.
  • Monitor and optimize BI platform performance and ensure data quality across all reporting environments.
  • Collaborate with BI Architects to design logical and physical analytical data models for both transactional and analytical databases, based on data requirements gathered from the business.
  • Partner with business Data Stewards and IT Developers to implement and maintain data governance across systems and processes.
  • Create and maintain data dictionaries and data lineage documentation, resolving data anomalies (data quality issues and ambiguous data definitions), and establishing data integrity checks and controls.
  • Develop, monitor, and maintain efficient ETL processes to ensure timely and accurate data delivery; troubleshoot and resolve issues related to source system extracts, data mapping and loading.
  • Assists business subject matter experts (SMEs) in self-service reports and meaningful analytics.
  • Manage and execute production change requests related to Business Intelligence and Reporting platforms, ensuring proper documentation and minimal disruption.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to inform BI strategy and platform enhancements.
  • Participate in BI platform upgrades, migrations, and performance tuning initiatives to ensure scalability and reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in Information Technology, with a focus on Business Intelligence development.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Business Intelligence Applications (OBIA) in an Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) environment.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI or a comparable enterprise BI platform.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including building and maintaining data integration processes.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience working with Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).
  • Proven experience in logical and physical data modeling for data warehouses and data marts.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience resolving complex issues within ODI and related BI tools.
  • Demonstrated experience in Sales and Finance reporting, including the development of cubes, dashboards, and KPIs for these business domains.
  • Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and scripting languages used in ETL development and maintenance.
  • Familiarity with IT systems and business processes in a manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with business leaders and subject matter experts.
  • Good working knowing knowledge and experience in a Unix or Linux environment.

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Supply Chain
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business partners to analyze external data sources (e.g., Point-of-Sale, market data) for insights into product category performance and positioning.
  • Experience with Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Services (PBCS), Hyperion Planning, and Essbase.
  • Strong database knowledge, Oracle, SQL Database
  • Familiarity with AI tools for BI analytics

About Us

 About Us:

For over 35 years, TERREPOWER (formerly BBB Industries) has been a leader in sustainable manufacturing, driving the circular economy by extending the life of essential products in the automotive and industrial markets.

Founded in 1987 in Daphne, Alabama by the Bigler family, TERREPOWER began as a small regional remanufacturer of starters and alternators. Our commitment to quality and innovation quickly earned us a reputation as a trusted name in the automotive industry.

Recognizing new challenges and opportunities, in 2019 we set our sights on EV battery upcycling-addressing one of the industry’s most pressing issues. Our engineering team pioneered solutions to extend EV battery life, pushing the boundaries of sustainable innovation.

Recognizing that demand for solar panels would exceed availability and 100,000 tons of waste would potentially go into landfills by 2035, our team searched for an innovative way to upcycle solar panels. With an eye on the future, we developed ways to upcycle solar panels.

Rooted in family and community values, we’re proud to have second-generation employees contributing to our legacy. Backed by Clearlake Capital, we’ve expanded our footprint into Europe with facilities in Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany and Poland. We now sustainably manufacture and supply an assortment of nondiscretionary repair parts across more than 90 countries.

As we move forward under the TERREPOWER name, we remain committed to the same values that have always defined us: entrepreneurship, teamwork, customer-centered, sustainability, safety.

Why Join Us?

When you join our team, you become part of a company that is redefining how essential products are made, reused and repurposed to reduce waste and maximize resources.

Here’s What Sets Us Apart

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Every day, your work will contribute to extending the useful life of essential products, keeping vehicles on the road and critical systems running.
  • Innovative Mindset – We encourage creative problem-solving and bold ideas to push the boundaries of what is possible.
  • Global Reach, Local Impact – With operations in North America and Europe, we have a global presence but remain deeply connected to the communities we serve.
  • Growth & Development – Whether you’re on the production floor, in engineering, or part of our corporate team, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities.
  • A Culture of Collaboration – Rooted in teamwork and shared values, our employees work together to tackle challenges and drive meaningful change.

TERREPOWER is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, pregnancy, age, veteran status, religion, national origin, genetic information, disability unrelated to the ability to perform a job, sexual orientation, or transgender status to the extent protected by law. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success.

Responsibilities



-  Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports in Oracle BI (OBIEE/OAS) to meet evolving business needs. 
-  Support existing Power BI dashboards, monitor jobs on SQL server agents and enhance SSIS packages. 
-  Support the day-to-day operations of Business Intelligence and all related systems, collaborating with IT support teams, to ensure timely and reliable business operations. 
-  Monitor and optimize BI platform performance and ensure data quality across all reporting environments. 
-  Collaborate with BI Architects to design logical and physical analytical data models for both transactional and analytical databases, based on data requirements gathered from the business. 
-  Partner with business Data Stewards and IT Developers to implement and maintain data governance across systems and processes. 
-  Create and maintain data dictionaries and data lineage documentation, resolving data anomalies (data quality issues and ambiguous data definitions), and establishing data integrity checks and controls. 
-  Develop, monitor, and maintain efficient ETL processes to ensure timely and accurate data delivery; troubleshoot and resolve issues related to source system extracts, data mapping and loading. 
-  Assists business subject matter experts (SMEs) in self-service reports and meaningful analytics. 
-  Manage and execute production change requests related to Business Intelligence and Reporting platforms, ensuring proper documentation and minimal disruption. 
-  Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to inform BI strategy and platform enhancements. 
-  Participate in BI platform upgrades, migrations, and performance tuning initiatives to ensure scalability and reliability. 

Minimum Qualifications



-  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
-  Minimum 7 years of experience in Information Technology, with a focus on Business Intelligence development. 
-  At least 3 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Business Intelligence Applications (OBIA) in an Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) environment. 
-  Minimum 2 years of experience developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI or a comparable enterprise BI platform. 
-  Minimum 3 years of experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including building and maintaining data integration processes. 
-  Minimum 3 years of experience working with Oracle Analytics Server (OAS). 
-  Proven experience in logical and physical data modeling for data warehouses and data marts. 
-  Strong troubleshooting skills and experience resolving complex issues within ODI and related BI tools. 
-  Demonstrated experience in Sales and Finance reporting, including the development of cubes, dashboards, and KPIs for these business domains. 
-  Proficiency in SQL, PL/SQL, and scripting languages used in ETL development and maintenance. 
-  Familiarity with IT systems and business processes in a manufacturing environment. 
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with business leaders and subject matter experts. 
-  Good working knowing knowledge and experience in a Unix or Linux environment. 

Preferred Education And Experience



-  Experience with Oracle E-Business Suite Financials and Supply Chain 
-  Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business partners to analyze external data sources (e.g., Point-of-Sale, market data) for insights into product category performance and positioning. 
-  Experience with Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Services (PBCS), Hyperion Planning, and Essbase.

The Business Intelligence Developer is a member of the Enterprise Data & Reporting (EDR) team responsible for developing, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise reporting and business intelligence solutions. This role works closely with Business Intelligence Analysts, senior Business Intelligence Developers, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver reporting solutions that enable data-driven decision making throughout the Bank.

The Business Intelligence Developer is primarily responsible for developing Power BI reports, semantic models, paginated reports, SQL queries, and other reporting assets while learning enterprise standards, best practices, and reporting methodologies. This role contributes to reporting initiatives and production support activities under the guidance of senior team members.

Accountabilities:

Responsibilities/Duties/Function/Tasks:


  • Review documented report specifications and seek clarification when requirements are unclear.
  • Develop, test, and deploy Power BI reports, dashboards, and datasets based on business requirements.
  • Build and enhance Power BI semantic models utilizing established dimensional modeling standards.
  • Develop DAX measures, calculated columns, KPIs, and visualizations to support business reporting needs.
  • Use Power Query (M) to extract, transform, cleanse, and prepare data from enterprise systems.
  • Develop and support SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and other reporting-related database objects.
  • Build and enhance paginated reports using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).
  • Perform unit testing and data validation to ensure accuracy and completeness of reporting solutions.
  • Investigate and resolve standard production reporting issues and data discrepancies.
  • Support QA and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence Analysts, business stakeholders, and technical teams to understand reporting requirements and deliver reporting solutions.
  • Participate in report design discussions and contribute technical recommendations.
  • Follow established development standards, coding practices, and documentation requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews and development team knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation in accordance with Enterprise Data & Reporting standards.
  • Support business users with report-related questions and troubleshooting activities.
  • Continuously develop technical skills related to Power BI, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, and Business Intelligence technologies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of experience in SQL development, reporting, business intelligence, or data analytics.
  • 1+ years of experience developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSRS, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, or similar development tools.
  • Experience supporting reporting or analytics solutions preferred.
  • Exposure to software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SQL development and database concepts.
  • Understanding of relational databases and data modeling fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Knowledge of DAX and Power Query (M) fundamentals.
  • Understanding of business intelligence and reporting concepts.
  • Understanding of source control and deployment processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and business teams.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and develop technical expertise.
  • Commitment to delivering high-quality reporting solutions.


Compensation Range:

Annual Salary: $72,750.00 - $86,391.00

This salary range represents the Bank's good faith and reasonable estimate of possible compensation at the time of hire. Offer to be determined by selected applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills & abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. This role is also eligible to participate in the Bank’s annual incentive plan.

As part of our competitive Total Rewards package, the Bank offers 11 paid holidays, 5 weeks of PTO and a work culture that values work/life balance. Most roles are eligible for our hybrid work schedule. The Business Intelligence Developer III is responsible for leading the design, the development, and the maintenance of BI solutions that help the organization make data-driven decisions. Lead the design, development and maintenance of BI and analytics solutions that transform data into insights through interactive reports, dashboards and self-service reporting capabilities.

Performs complex analysis including reviewing multiple data sets and data relationships to support research and business decisions.

Works in concert with other data practitioners and business teams to understand business requirements and translating those requirements into developing value-add BI/Analytics solutions.

Develops and enforce implementation of standards and best practices involved in BI solutions development and delivery.

Leads data related projects involving cross functional teams.

Supports the data through its life cycle utilizing DataOps practices and data governance principles that ensure data quality, integrity, stewardship, security, literacy and adoption.

Works with Data Engineering/Architecture teams by identifying opportunities to expand data sets and business intelligence tools to include additional data. Assists with data lineage and coding to support this function.

Summary

Balfour Beatty is seeking a Power BI Senior Developer to join our team in Dallas, TX. The Power BI Senior Developer builds and maintains the Power BI reports, apps, and dashboards. Works directly with business units to define requirements, model the data, and deliver reports through design, development, testing, and acceptance, with minimal supervision. Supports the company’s Power Platform environment and helps Power Platform users follow citizen developer guidelines.

This is a hybrid position that requires working in the office three days per week and working from home two days per week.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and deploy Power BI reports, apps, and dashboards for Accounting, Finance, Risk, HR, Payroll, and Operations. Manage access to reports and apps.
  • Develop semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, and Power Query (M) transformations that perform well and scale.
  • Work with business users and analysts to define reporting requirements, KPIs, and technical specifications; recommend design changes and communicate status to stakeholders and managers.
  • Support the Power Platform environment, including Power Apps to write back from Power BI reports. Ensure Power Platform users follow citizen developer guidelines.
  • Work with Architecture & Integration team members to connect, shape, and refresh data from source systems, including gateway and scheduled refresh configuration.
  • Create unit, regression, and user acceptance tests; validate report data against source systems; lead acceptance testing of completed projects.
  • Respond to business inquiries, tune report performance, train business users, and maintain technical documentation
  • Perform additional technology support tasks assigned by IT leadership to support business operations and user needs

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university
  • Minimum of 5 years of Power BI report and dashboard development experience
  • Strong proficiency in DAX and Power Query (M).
  • Significant experience in relational database design and development, including advanced SQL.
  • Experience in dimensional (star-schema) data modeling.
  • Modeling skills to represent requirements in graphical forms to augment textual representations.
  • Experience with Power BI Service administration: workspaces, gateways, scheduled refresh, and row-level security.
  • Able to manage multiple deadlines, prioritize multiple projects, and provide status reports on open projects.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) and citizen developer governance.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
  • Experience with ETL/ELT tooling and enterprise data warehouses.
  • Experience reporting on Accounting, Finance, HR, or Payroll data.
  • Construction domain experience (project cost tracking, change orders, commitments, schedules etc.) and/or exposure to tools such as Procore, Primavera P6, and JD Edwards

Soft Skills

  • Communicates clearly with business users and technical teams, including presenting data and findings.
  • Works effectively in a team environment and collaborates across departments.
  • Plans and prioritizes work independently and meets deadlines.
  • Acts with integrity in support of the Company, IT values, and employees, with a constant focus on meeting or exceeding customer requirements and expectations.

Balfour Beatty is an equal opportunity employer that recognizes the value of a diverse workforce. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state or local law.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0251799

Business Intelligence Engineer

The Opportunity:

Do you thrive by using your analytical expertise to convert large datasets into meaningful insights? We are seeking a data-driven individual who will use their data engineering, modeling, and analytical ability to provide innovative solutions for some of Booz Allen’s most pressing questions.

As an internal-facing data analyst, you will work in a data-rich environment from various enterprise datasets, specifically focusing on pipeline, relationship management, and financial systems. We are seeking a motivated analyst who will increase the capabilities of our team from a reporting perspective. You will combine strong technical expertise in data modeling and analytics with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business intelligence. You will also possess strong communication skills, as this position involves discussions with company leadership in identifying trends and measuring performance. Due to the nature of work performed within this facility, U.S. citizenship is required.

What You’ll Work On:

  • Serve as a business intelligence engineer and data analyst for the company's opportunity pipeline and CRM system.
  • Gather valuable insights and trends to help users better understand their pipelines related to opportunities, contacts, and lead generation for proper bid and resourcing decisions.
  • Create new dashboards and reports using Power BI and Tableau.
  • Utilize knowledge of statistical concepts and their application to the role, including regression models, probability distributions, Monte Carlo simulations, and more.
  • Design and maintain scalable data models to support reporting, dashboards, and other advanced analytical needs.
  • Build and optimize datasets within Databricks using SQL, Spark, Python, or other syntax involving complex tools.
  • Leverage Agentforce and other applicable AI tools for automated solutions.
  • Utilize strong technical expertise in data lake or warehouse architecture to optimize cloud storage and pipeline performance.
  • Automate manual processes to allow for simplistic interpretation of analysis, not limited to key performance indicators and trends.


Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data modeling, analytics, or business intelligence
  • 3+ years of experience with Power BI and Tableau dashboard
  • Experience with SQL or Data Bricks when conducting analysis
  • Knowledge of relational databases and dimensional modeling
  • Knowledge of data engineering syntax and application
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Ability to simply communicate complex data concepts with senior leadership
  • Possession of excellent communication and presentation skills


Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

Job Summary

Monti, Inc., a highly regarded US manufacturer of world-class components for the electrical industry, is seeking a BI Developer to join our team on-site at our Cincinnati headquarters. Reporting to the Head of Data and BI, the BI Developer will collaborate with leaders across the organization to design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions that drive business performance. This includes building data models, dashboards, and reports in Power BI and partnering with key stakeholders to turn data from across our manufacturing business into meaningful insights for decision-making.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Power BI developer with strong SQL and data modeling skills who enjoys figuring out how data connects and explaining what it means to non-technical colleagues.

Why This Role

You'll be the third member of our small, growing data team. That means a real voice in shaping how the data function at Monti is built: the tools we use, the standards we set, and how the rest of the company works with data. It also means variety. You'll take on many different kinds of projects and work with people in nearly every part of the company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Development: Build, publish, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and data models, using DAX and SQL to turn data from across the business into clear, reliable insights.
  • Data Integration: Learn Monti's data sources and how they link together, and bring data from multiple systems into well-structured models.
  • Modernization: Help improve existing Excel, Access, and VBA reporting, and move it into Power BI where it makes sense.
  • Automation: Identify manual processes that can be automated with tools such as Power Automate or Python.
  • Data Analysis: Work with stakeholders to understand their questions and data needs, and present findings clearly through reports and presentations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across departments to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshooting and Performance: Debug report and data errors, and continuously improve the performance and reliability of BI reports.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear, detailed documentation of reports, data models, and BI processes.
  • Training and Support: Support and train end users so they can use BI reports and tools with confidence.
  • Team Building: Contribute ideas and standards that shape how Monti's data team works as it grows.

What Success Looks Like In The First 90 Days

  • You understand Monti's data and can see how different sources link together.
  • You are creating and publishing Power BI reports that provide meaningful insight to the Monti team.
  • You can debug report errors and provide clear, detailed documentation for the reports you build.
  • You communicate comfortably with colleagues across the company about data questions and issues.

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in BI development or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience building and publishing reports in Power BI.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data modeling (e.g., star schemas, relationships).
  • Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts and relational databases.

Technical Skills

  • Power BI, including DAX and Power Query.
  • Strong Excel skills, plus experience with Access and VBA.
  • Solid understanding of data visualization best practices.
  • Ability to integrate data from various sources, including APIs.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation.
  • Experience with Power Automate.
  • Experience working with manufacturing or operational data.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and data insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a small team.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for data accuracy and clarity.
  • Curious and adaptable, and excited to take on a wide variety of projects.

Monti, inc. is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities     



- Data Modeling & Analytics

- Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.
- Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
- Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.
- Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.
- Reporting & Visualization

- Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.
- Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.
- Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.
- Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.
- Data Engineering & Automation

- Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.
- Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.
- Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.
- Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.
- Governance & Quality

- Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.
- Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.
- Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
- Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.
- Collaboration

- Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.
- Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.
- Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.
Qualifications



- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.
- 3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.
- Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.
- Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.
- Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.
- Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
- Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
- Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.
- Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.
- Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.
- Knowledge of API development and integrations.
- Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.
- Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.

POSITION OVERVIEW: The Sr. BI Developer will be responsible for creating and supporting a self-service reporting model for Finance and Accounting. This role will use SQL queries to transform and consolidate information from multiple operational databases, publish cleaned data as semantic models in Power BI, and support downstream report builders with guidance on DAX, visualization best practices, and workspace administration. As a senior-level role, this position is expected to operate independently with minimal supervision.

A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:

Self-Service Reporting Model Development

  • Writing SQL queries to transform and consolidate Finance and Accounting data from multiple operational databases
  • Analyzing complex data scenarios and trace data through systems to understand sources, dependencies, and downstream reporting impacts
  • Understanding the meaning behind the data and how it can be used to create reliable business insights
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data quality through system design, process improvement, and reporting model structure

Power BI Semantic Model Publishing and Administration

  • Developing, publishing, and supporting semantic models through Power BI workspaces
  • Supporting workspace administration, data model organization, and downstream report development standards
  • Communicating how semantic models should be used to develop business insights and consistent reporting outputs

Training, Communication, and Independent Problem Solving

  • Teaching DAX, visualization best practices, and workspace administration to report builders
  • Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Applying a high level of attention to detail and logic-based problem solving when reviewing, building, and supporting reporting solutions
  • Performing other finance systems, reporting, data, or accounting system duties as warranted or directed

PREFERRED EDUCATION/LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, data analytics, business administration, or a related field preferred
  • Relevant Microsoft, Power BI, SQL, data analytics, or reporting certifications are preferred

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience in business intelligence, data analytics, finance systems, accounting systems, financial reporting, or related roles
  • Expertise with accounting data, particularly financial reporting and project accounting data
  • Expertise with Power BI, DAX, semantic models, and workspace administration
  • Expertise with MS SQL, including query development, data transformation, consolidation, and troubleshooting across multiple databases

IDEALLY, YOU SHOULD ALSO HAVE:

  • Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, reporting needs, and operational database structures
  • Experience working with ERP, accounting, or project accounting systems and the underlying data structures that support financial and operational reporting
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, data lake, data warehouse, or related cloud-based data platform concepts
  • Working knowledge of data governance practices, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, quality controls, and reporting consistency standards
  • Ability to evaluate data quality issues and recommend system or process improvements that improve reporting reliability
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, logic-based problem-solving capabilities and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Ability to teach, coach, and support report builders on DAX, visualization standards, and Power BI workspace practices

Organization
