Position Overview

Responsible for providing end-to-end reporting and analytical services to internal business partners and leadership. Develops and leads

integrated solutions and effectively applies both business knowledge and technical expertise to design, develop, and implement Business

Intelligence BI solutions, databases, data warehouses, data marts, interfaces, custom programming, complex reports, and analysis. Provides

technical expertise in the architecture and development of integrated data and business process improvement solutions for functional areas

through the use of technology in support of Sutter Health.

Education

Job Description:

Equivalent experience will be accepted in lieu of the required degree or diploma.

  • Bachelor's in Applied Statistics, Computer Analytics, Computer, or related field

Typical Experience

  • 8 years recent relevant experience

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting regulated, highly available, or enterprise-scale environments.
  • Communicating with non-technical stakeholders and translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Experience using Power BI and Tableau to analyze data, develop interactive dashboards, and create visual reports that support informed decision-making.
  • Experience using Smartsheet to manage projects, track tasks, monitor deadlines, and create reports and dashboards for team collaboration and decision-making.
  • Experience assessing technical applications for potential acquisition, including evaluating functionality, business value, integration requirements, and organizational fit.
  • Advanced SQL, ETL, databases, data warehouses, and architecture
  • Leads technical implementations and BI solutions

Skills And Knowledge

  • In-depth experience in architecting/solution design using technology experience in data management.
  • In-depth experience in developing and implementing Business Intelligence solutions (reports, metrics, dashboards, and scorecards) as typically acquired in 6+ years.
  • Advanced experience working with databases (e.g. SQL Server) and large datasets is required.
  • Experience with (e.g. Finance, HR, Clinical) data is required, preferably in the healthcare industry.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access is required.
  • Demonstrated experience and/or expertise with SQL Server Reporting Services or other BI applications, and using advanced Excel features and techniques are required.
  • Experience working with a variety of information systems and data files, including large and complex files; analyzing file structure, using and creating file layouts, transforming raw data into finished products, e.g. trending and reports is required.
  • Problem and issue resolution experience.
  • Project Management experience.
  • Familiarity with various types of sources of health care information, including coding & billing, reimbursement and finance data files.
  • Knowledge in the development of business intelligence and reporting solutions.
  • Solid understanding of Data Warehouse methodology, Dimensional modeling in data analysis, including preparing reports, and data presentation.
  • Knowledge and experience with VISIO or other flowcharting tools.
  • Background in advanced web analytics.
  • Advanced skill in the principles of data management including logical and physical data modeling, relational database design, and design and development of System-wide metadata.
  • Ability to learn new applications/software systems effectively and efficiently.
  • Ability to translate data into Management reports and presentations.
  • Ability to take a problem, requirement, or strategy; research solution and take from concept to implementation for desired outcomes.
  • Comfortable interacting with individuals/groups at various organizational levels.
  • Collaboration and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • The ability to effectively establish priorities and meet deadlines when receiving work from more than one person.
  • The incumbent must be able to work with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to work with, train, and coach other team members and colleagues.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to provide constructive feedback to team members to support continuous improvement.
  • Organization skills; ability to prioritize multiple activities and objectives in a rapidly changing environment, and deliver quality service.
  • Knowledge of health care operations and structure, general requirements in an integrated delivery system, and use of information system applications in a health insurance or health care environment.
  • Prior demonstrated success in progressively responsible positions in health care or managed care industry with results-oriented skills.
  • Ability to be involved in multiple projects at the same time.
  • Ability to lead, communicate and interact with all levels of the organization, including senior management, to provide recommendations and influence decision-making.
  • Required skills include ability to build collaborative working relationships with diverse individuals and organizations; analytical and problem solving skills; ability to operate independently, confidentially, and to garner confidence from leadership, entities, vendors and consultant staff.
  • Experience in managing multiple, simultaneous, complex projects.

We are searching for an experienced Engineer, Business Intelligence at our Headquarters facility.

Hyundai MOBIS Parts America

We think creatively and keep challenging ourselves to help create a new future and eventually make humankind’s dreams a reality. Ready for the challenge?

Who We Are

Tomorrow's most advanced automotive technology is being envisioned today at MOBIS Parts America (MPA). A subsidiary of Hyundai MOBIS, we are a top leading automotive parts supplier. MPA provides after-sales service parts support for Hyundai Motors, Kia Motors, and Genesis. In addition to the distribution of genuine service parts, the MPA Accessories division develops accessories for Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis - which are installed on new vehicles in the United States and Canada.

Description

Job Purpose

The Power BI Reporting Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise business intelligence and reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI. This role transforms business requirements into interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making across MPA and affiliated organizations.

The engineer will work closely with business users, data engineers, database administrators, and IT teams to ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives.

Key Accountabilities

  • Report & Dashboard Development
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Create interactive visualizations, scorecards, and executive dashboards.
  • Develop reusable report templates and visualization standards.
  • Optimize report performance and user experience.
  • Support enterprise reporting initiatives across departments.
  • Data Modeling & Analytics
  • Design and maintain Power BI semantic models.
  • Develop star schema and dimensional models for reporting.
  • Create DAX measures, calculations, KPIs, and business logic.
  • Implement row-level security (RLS) and data access controls.
  • Support self-service BI and governed analytics solutions.
  • Business Requirements & User Support
  • Gather and analyze reporting requirements from business stakeholders.
  • Convert business processes and KPIs into reporting solutions.
  • Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Provide end-user training and documentation.
  • Serve as a liaison between business teams and technical teams.
  • Reporting Governance & Standards
  • Establish reporting standards and dashboard design guidelines.
  • Ensure consistency of KPIs and business definitions.
  • Maintain metadata and report inventory documentation.
  • Support enterprise data governance initiatives.
  • Reduce duplication of reports and datasets.
  • Monitoring & Support
  • Monitor report usage, adoption, and performance.
  • Troubleshoot report failures and refresh issues.
  • Resolve production incidents and root causes.
  • Support business users and executive stakeholders.
  • Maintain SLA and operational support standards.

Work Schedule And Travel Requirements

  • Monday - Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Flexible Schedule at the discretion and approval of Manager
  • No Travel Required

Experience Requirements

 Required Qualifications

  • 4 - 7 years ofBusiness Intelligence or Reporting experience, Required
  • 3 - 5 years ofPower BI development experience, Required
  • Strong experience with DAX and data modeling.
  • Experience building executive and operational dashboards.
  • Experience working with Azure-based data platforms.
  • Experience migrating reports from legacy reporting tools to Power BI.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse (EDW) environments.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree inComputer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field, Required

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs)

  • Data Modeling & Analytics
  • DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
  • Power Query (M Language)
  • Data Modeling
  • Semantic Models
  • Star Schema / Dimensional Modeling
  • KPI Design and Analytics
  • Data Sources & Databases
  • Azure SQL Database
  • MS Access
  • SQL Server
  • AS/400 DB2
  • Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Excel and CSV Data Sources
  • Query Languages
  • SQL, T-SQL, DAX, Power Query (M)
  • Azure & Integration
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
  • On-Premises Data Gateway
  • Azure Active Directory (Entra ID)

Competencies

Analytical Thinking

Gathers, evaluates, and interprets information to understand issues, identify root causes, and make sound decisions. Applies logical reasoning, critical thinking, and objective analysis to solve problems, assess risks and opportunities, and develop effective solutions that support business and organizational goals.

Communication Skills

Clearly and effectively exchanges information, ideas, and expectations with others through verbal, written, and interpersonal communication. Communicates in a manner that promotes understanding, builds relationships, and supports collaboration across teams and stakeholders. Demonstrates active listening, adapts messages to the audience, and ensures information is conveyed accurately, professionally, and respectfully.

Functional Knowledge

The understanding and application of the specialized knowledge, principles, processes, tools, and best practices required to perform effectively within a specific functional area. Demonstrates expertise in job-related responsibilities and applies technical or professional knowledge to solve problems, improve performance, ensure compliance, and support business objectives. Continuously develops and maintains functional expertise to adapt to evolving business needs, industry trends, and organizational requirements.

Job Impact

The degree to which an individual’s work contributes to organizational objectives, operational effectiveness, and overall business success. Demonstrates an understanding of how actions, decisions, and performance influence team, department, and company results. Focuses on delivering meaningful outcomes, creating value, and ensuring work efforts positively affect customers, stakeholders, and business performance.

Problem Solving

Identifies issues, analyzes situations, and develops effective solutions that address root causes and support business objectives. Applies critical thinking, sound judgment, and a systematic approach to evaluate information, consider alternatives, and implement practical actions. Proactively anticipates challenges, resolves obstacles, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes, performance, and results.

 Hyundai MOBIS Parts America 

We think creatively and keep challenging ourselves to help create a new future and eventually make humankind’s dreams a reality. Ready for the challenge?

Who We Are

Tomorrow's most advanced automotive technology is being envisioned today at MOBIS Parts America (MPA). A subsidiary of Hyundai MOBIS, we are a top leading automotive parts supplier. MPA provides after-sales service parts support for Hyundai Motors, Kia Motors, and Genesis. In addition to the distribution of genuine service parts, the MPA Accessories division develops accessories for Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis - which are installed on new vehicles in the United States and Canada.

Description

Job Purpose

The Power BI Reporting Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise business intelligence and reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI. This role transforms business requirements into interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making across MPA and affiliated organizations.

The engineer will work closely with business users, data engineers, database administrators, and IT teams to ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives.

-  Optimize report performance and user experience. 
-  Support enterprise reporting initiatives across departments.

descriptionHtml:
AVER is seeking an experienced Senior Power BI Developer with deep hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise business intelligence solutions, interactive dashboards, and custom reporting applications. The ideal candidate brings advanced Power BI development skills, strong SQL expertise, and experience integrating and transforming complex datasets from multiple enterprise systems, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and cloud-based data platforms. This role requires a versatile, technically proficient developer who can work across data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, reporting architecture, and database integration to deliver scalable, high-performing analytics and reporting solutions. Experience with Python, AWS, Azure, Databricks, and Microsoft Power Platform is highly valued, along with the ability to modernize legacy reporting solutions and improve access to mission-critical information. Join a collaborative team that values AVER's mission, focus, and culture of delivering exceptional client service with great people and transformative technology solutions that ensure Government mission success.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, interactive reports, semantic models, and custom reporting solutions supporting complex business and operational requirements.
  • Develop advanced Power BI reports using DAX, Power Query (M), Power BI Desktop, and Power BI Service, including complex calculations, measures, data transformations, and visualizations.
  • Design and optimize Power BI semantic models, including relationships, star schemas, dimensional modeling, and performance optimization.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and database interactions across Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and other relational database platforms.
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple enterprise systems, relational databases, APIs, cloud data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse environments.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes using SQL, Python, Power Query, and other data integration technologies to support reporting and analytics.
  • Create customized, user-friendly dashboards and reporting interfaces that consolidate data from disparate sources into actionable business and operational insights.
  • Develop paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), as required.
  • Leverage Python for data processing, scripting, automation, data validation, and integration with enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Integrate Power BI with Microsoft SharePoint, Power Apps, Power Automate, and other enterprise applications to improve reporting accessibility and automate business processes.
  • Develop reporting solutions that access cloud-based analytics platforms, including AWS Redshift, Databricks, and Azure-based data environments.
  • Configure and manage Power BI workspaces, datasets, data refresh schedules, gateways, deployment pipelines, and reporting environments.
  • Implement data security and governance controls, including row-level security (RLS), workspace permissions, and role-based access.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize complex reporting, database, data transformation, and performance issues.
  • Support modernization of legacy reporting applications, including migration to Power BI and integration with modern enterprise data platforms.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, database administrators, application developers, and stakeholders to translate complex reporting requirements into scalable BI solutions.
  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI-enabled analytics, Microsoft Fabric, and emerging technologies to enhance reporting, automation, and business intelligence capabilities.
  • Participate in requirements gathering, technical design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support of enterprise BI solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance, recommend BI best practices, and support the delivery of reliable, maintainable reporting solutions aligned with customer requirements.


Education Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.


Experience Requirements:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting development, database development, or related technical disciplines, including significant hands-on Power BI development experience
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query (M), and semantic data modeling
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining complex enterprise dashboards, interactive reports, and custom reporting solutions
  • Advanced SQL development expertise, including complex queries, joins, CTEs, stored procedures, views, data manipulation, and query performance optimization
  • Hands-on experience working with Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle databases, including familiarity with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Strong understanding of relational database structures, dimensional data modeling, star schemas, data relationships, and enterprise reporting architecture
  • Experience integrating Power BI with multiple enterprise databases, APIs, external data sources, and cloud-based data environments
  • Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, and automated data refresh solutions
  • Hands-on Python experience for data processing, scripting, automation, data validation, or integration with reporting and analytics platforms
  • Experience optimizing Power BI performance, including DAX calculations, semantic models, query execution, and data refresh processes
  • Knowledge of Power BI security, workspace administration, access controls, and data governance practices
  • Experience gathering and translating business and operational reporting requirements into technical specifications and functional BI solutions
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across complex enterprise data environments
  • Ability to collaborate with technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users to deliver reliable, scalable reporting solutions


Desired Requirements:

  • Experience with Power BI Report Builder, paginated reports, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)
  • Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Azure Data Factory, or other enterprise ETL/ELT technologies
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, and related analytics capabilities
  • Experience integrating Power BI with AWS Redshift, Databricks, Azure SQL, cloud data warehouses, data lakes, or lakehouse architectures
  • Advanced Oracle PL/SQL development experience, including stored procedures, functions, packages, and database performance tuning
  • Experience using Python libraries such as Pandas or PySpark for data transformation, automation, and analytics
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and integration with Power BI
  • Experience integrating reports and dashboards with SharePoint Online, Teams, or custom enterprise applications
  • Familiarity with Power BI Embedded, REST APIs, and development of customer-facing reporting solutions.
  • Experience with .NET/C#, Java, JavaScript, HTML, or CSS to support custom reporting interfaces, embedded analytics, and application integration
  • Familiarity with AWS or Azure cloud services and enterprise data integration architectures
  • Experience with Git, version control, deployment pipelines, and CI/CD practices for BI development
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, Microsoft Copilot, predictive analytics, or emerging AI technologies
  • Experience modernizing legacy reporting systems and migrating enterprise reporting solutions to Power BI
  • Previous experience supporting federal government customers or mission-critical enterprise applications


Location:

  • Springfield, VA
  • REMOTE- MUST live in commutable distance to customer site.


Security Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a government Public Trust clearance
  • U.S. citizenship required to support the government customer


Compensation Package:

At AVER, we believe our people are the foundation of our success and are committed to providing meaningful work, competitive compensation, and a supportive environment where employees can grow while making a direct impact on critical Government missions. AVER offers a competitive total compensation package designed to support our employees both professionally and personally. Eligible employees receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health and wellness coverage, paid time off and holidays, retirement benefits, and opportunities for career growth

Target Salary: $150,000–$170,000/year

AVER, LLC is a Data & Digital Transformation company that delivers exceptional client service with great people and transformative technology solutions to enable Government mission success. We provide customers with specialized technical skills and deep subject matter expertise focused on Homeland Security, Biometrics, Law Enforcement, and Healthcare domains to meet the complex mission challenges of today and tomorrow. We are a verified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that strives to provide a customer-centric experience by building trusted partnerships with our clients and people.

AVER is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

descriptionHtml:
At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

Job Description

The Senior Analytics Developer, reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Northwestern Medicine is looking for a data driven, business-minded; results oriented Senior Analytics Developer to join our team. The Senior Analytics Developer uncovers insights that drive strategy and optimal decision making for the executive team and leaders across the organization. In this role, you will be charged with understanding the ‘who, what, and whys’ of our business - working cross-functionally to realize the value of NM’s data assets.

Northwestern Medicine Information Services drives innovative, high-value solutions to transform health care.

We are committed to supporting the relentless pursuit of better medicine by providing exceptional service to our patients and guests as well as internal clients across the organization. To ensure excellence, our team goes to extraordinary lengths to ensure that our systems work together seamlessly.

Northwestern Medicine understands that technology plays an integral role in shaping the future of health care. Information Services strategically supports the organization by:

  • Leveraging AI, automation and rollout of advanced cyber controls that support digital transformation strategies
  • Implementing advanced technologies in clinical and administrative areas
  • Furthering development of the end user support model to help enhance modern infrastructure

Responsibilities:

To succeed in this role, you must be innately curious, deeply analytical, highly driven, and a strong communicator. Some of those qualities include but are not limited to:

  • Be a Data Champion! Effective analysis is only possible with good data - be an advocate of data accessibility, accuracy and quality.
  • Be Curious! Find data nuggets, trends and other analytical goodies that help support our mission, vision, and values and advance our department as a whole.
  • Be a Team Player! Collaboration is what makes us great – come prepared to work with a diverse cross-section of technical and business professionals.
  • The Senior Analytics Developer is responsible for delivering data warehouse and analytic solutions by writing ETL packages, developing visualizations, performing data and statistical analyses, and administering systems to deliver information to the health system.¿
  • Serves as a functional and content expert of pipelines to synthesize raw data into actionable information.
  • Applies knowledge of relational database skills including advanced SQL knowledge and the ability to create complex queries and stored procedures.
  • Assists with the design and development of information delivery components including dashboards, reports, and cubes.
  • Assists with ETL design and development including data analysis, source-target mapping, quality profiling, change data capture, program performance.
  • Evaluates data quality and interprets results in a clear, concise manner.
  • Develops documentation on requirements, decisions, design, modifications, and any associated maintenance.¿
  • Owns analytics projects and is accountable for collaborating with the business to gather and execute on requirements, which exceed customer expectations.
  • Works collaboratively with and supports multi-departments efforts and projects.
  • Shares skills, experience, knowledge, and expertise with staff on analytic tools and solutions and serves as subject matter expert within the department.
  • Participates and contributes to overall training development, maintenance, and facilitate trainings both internally and externally as needed.
  • Performs other duties and functions as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Experience:

  • Four or more years of experience in a role querying and/or analyzing data
  • Experience using the Microsoft stack (SSRS, SSMS, SSIS, SSAS)
  • Experience using SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and reporting
  • Strong knowledge of relational database skills including advanced SQL knowledge and the ability to create complex queries and stored procedures
  • Experience sharing skills, experience, knowledge, and expertise with junior level staff on analytic tools and solutions and serve as subject matter expert within team and department
  • Previous experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience with report writing and data visualization tools such as:¿ Tableau, Crystal Reports,¿SSRS, Microsoft Power BI, etc.¿
  • Experience in all areas of development including analysis, design, development and support with particular emphasis on structured programming¿¿

Behavioral Attributes:

  • Independently work with business users to gather and scope requirements and recommend analytical solutions to meet business needs
  • Demonstrated competency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and/or Access
  • Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple-priorities
  • Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills

Preferred:

  • Experience developing, designing and supporting applications and relational databases¿
  • Previous experience working with Epic Clarity data
  • Previous healthcare experience, ideally with a health system
  • Experience using a software package for statistical analysis (R, Python, etc.)

Additional Information

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

Successful outcomes start and finish with eNGINE.


eNGINE is hiring a Senior Power BI Developer who goes beyond building dashboards — someone who deeply understands the full BI stack, from raw data to the final visualization layer. In this role, you will take ownership of semantic model design, data integrity, and reporting performance across the organization. You will be a trusted voice when things break and a creative force when building something new.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize advanced Power BI reports and dashboards using complex DAX measures and calculations.
  • Architect and maintain semantic models that ensure metric consistency and a single source of truth across all reporting.
  • Own the full BI layer — Data, Semantic, and Visualization — to drive data integrity end-to-end.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot report performance issues, including slow-loading visuals, query bottlenecks, and capacity constraints.
  • Respond to and resolve critical incidents in Microsoft Fabric or Power BI Premium capacity environments.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable, scalable BI solutions.
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and architectural decisions to support team knowledge-sharing.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve BI processes, tooling, and personal skillset.


Required Qualifications:

  • Expert-level Power BI development experience, including complex DAX formulas, calculated tables, and measures.
  • Deep knowledge of semantic (data) model design — including table relationships, star schema architecture, aggregations, and role-level security.
  • Strong understanding of the three BI layers: Data layer (ingestion/transformation), Semantic layer (business logic), and Visualization layer (reporting).
  • Experience optimizing report and model performance through query folding, aggregations, and incremental refresh.
  • Advanced SQL skills across one or more platforms (e.g., SQL Server, Azure SQL, Synapse, Databricks).
  • Ability to write, debug, and optimize complex queries, stored procedures, and views.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI Premium capacity management.
  • Familiarity with troubleshooting Fabric/capacity alerts, including resource contention, refresh failures, and gateway issues.
  • Comfortable working in high-urgency situations and triaging production incidents with a calm, structured approach.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouses, Pipelines, Notebooks, or Direct Lake mode).
  • Familiarity with Power Query / M language for data transformation.
  • Exposure to Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, or Databricks.
  • Experience working in Agile or scrum-based development environments.
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain a complex data model to a non-technical executive clearly and confidently.


No C2C, relocation, or sponsorship.


For finer details on how eNGINE can impact your career, apply today!

POSITION SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Senior Manager of AI & Business Intelligence, the Sr Engineer - BI will play a critical role in establishing and scaling a Business Intelligence Center of Excellence (CoE).

This role is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering enterprise BI solutions while defining the standards, data models, and practices that enable scalable, governed analytics across the organization.

This individual will be highly hands-on in the near term (80–90% development), delivering critical dashboards, data models, and reporting solutions. Over time, the role will evolve toward a broader leadership focus (approximately 70/30), driving standardization, governance, and alignment across BI and analytics teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution with a systems mindset—building solutions that are not only effective in the moment, but reusable, scalable, and aligned to long-term enterprise data strategy.

This position is onsite in Springfield, Missouri.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and define, standardize, and document enterprise KPIs and business metrics.
  • Design and develop scalable, governed BI solutions, including Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and enterprise reporting assets.
  • Build BI solutions in a way that establishes reusable patterns, standardized logic, and scalable data models for broader organizational use.
  • Own and evolve semantic models and reusable data structures, ensuring consistency across reporting and analytics.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to build and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines and data models (e.g., Snowflake, dbt).
  • Drive improvements in data quality, consistency, and governance across BI workflows.
  • Enforce BI development standards, naming conventions, and best practices.
  • Optimize BI platform performance, including query efficiency, model design, and cost management.
  • Influence and guide partner analytics teams toward standardized, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  • Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, data engineering, and analytics teams to ensure alignment and scalability.
  • Support business users through training, documentation, and enablement of self-service analytics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability of BI assets.
  • Operate effectively in ambiguous or evolving data environments, driving incremental improvement and structure.
  • ALL OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum Degree Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4+ years of experience in BI development, analytics, or data engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and enterprise data modeling (required).
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI and DAX (required).
  • Experience building semantic layers, reusable data models, and scalable reporting frameworks.
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks (preferred).
  • Experience with dbt or similar transformation tools (preferred).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version-controlled analytics workflows (e.g., GitLab, Azure DevOps).
  • Experience working across multiple business domains and stakeholder groups.
  • Retail, distribution, or supply chain experience is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITY:

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, and BI architecture.
  • Proven ability to define and standardize business metrics across teams.
  • Deep understanding of data pipelines, data quality, and governance principles.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across decentralized teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
  • Ability to balance hands-on technical execution with strategic thinking.
  • Highly organized with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience operating in low-maturity or evolving data environments.
  • Continuous learner focused on improving systems, processes, and team capabilities.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • N/A

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Regularly sits and works on a computer.

Occasionally stands and walks.

Seldom/never lifts up to 50 lbs.

INDEPENDENT JUDGEMENT:

Performs duties within scope of general company policies, procedures, and objectives. Analyzes problems and performs needs assessments. Uses judgment in adapting broad guidelines to achieve desired result. Regular exercise of independent judgment within accepted practices. Makes recommendations that affect policies, procedures, and practices.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Avanza is seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer (Power BI) to design, develop, and support reliable business intelligence solutions for our federal clients. This hands-on position requires deep Power BI expertise backed by a strong foundation in data and analytics. The successful candidate can turn complex source data and ambiguous business questions into accurate, high-performing reports that clients trust for decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Translate client questions into clear reporting requirements, performance metrics, and solution designs.
  • Own delivery of BI solutions from source-data assessment and integration through model and report development, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Create intuitive, accessible dashboards and reports that help users explore information and understand performance.
  • Reconcile reporting results to authoritative sources, validate calculations, investigate discrepancies, and resolve data-quality issues before release.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot production reports, refreshes, and performance; implement enhancements as business needs evolve.
  • Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, developers, and consultants to resolve dependencies and integrate BI solutions into client processes.
  • Maintain documentation of data sources, metric definitions, business rules, and changes; support and train end users.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related field, including at least 3 years of substantial hands-on Power BI development.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver and support production BI solutions using complex data from multiple sources.
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, including the ability to question assumptions, investigate anomalies, and explain findings.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience with financial management, budgeting, or federal government clients is preferred, not required.

Microsoft Power BI & Analytics Engineering Skills

  • Advanced proficiency with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic model design, report authoring, publishing, and sharing.
  • Advanced DAX skills (measures, filter context, time intelligence, and efficient calculations) and proficiency with Power Query (M).
  • Strong SQL and relational data skills, including dimensional/star-schema modeling, data granularity, relationships, and integration of databases, Excel, SharePoint, and API-based sources.
  • Ability to optimize model and report performance using techniques and tools such as Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio, query diagnostics, and appropriate storage and refresh strategies.
  • Experience administering production solutions, including workspaces, scheduled refresh, gateways, row-level security, access permissions, and deployment practices.
  • Familiarity with Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, Git/Azure DevOps, or Tabular Editor is a plus; Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification is also a plus.

Work Authorization Requirement

  • Due to federal contract requirements, applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.

Location

  • This is a hybrid role. Employees must reside within a commutable distance of our headquarters in Arlington, VA.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, performance bonus, and benefits package.
  • Healthcare - Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Contribution
  • Disability Insurance - Short Term and Long Term
  • Group Life Insurance including Accidental Death & Dismemberment
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) - Vacation and Sick Time
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact analytics, automation, and emerging technology initiatives.
  • Work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with a talented team.
  • Professional growth and advancement opportunities.

We're not just caregivers and staff - we're your friends and neighbors, offering expertise, kind words and compassionate care when and where you need them. We are dedicated to providing you with the best medical care possible.

The University of Vermont Medical Center, along with the Robert Larner M.D. College of Medicine The University of Vermont and College of Nursing and Health Sciences, is one of 138 academic medical centers in the country. Through The University of Vermont Health Network and collaborative relationships throughout Vermont and northern New York, we are able to provide the highest quality care, informed by academic research, to patients throughout our region.

The UVM Medical Center, along with its three founding organizations, The University of Vermont College of Medicine and College of Nursing and Health Sciences, share a rich history dating back to the 1800s.

The UVM Medical Center is committed to the development of an Integrated Delivery System which provides high value health care to the communities we serve and enhances our academic mission. Our mission is to improve the health of the people in the communities we serve by integrating patient care, education, and research in a caring environment.

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or similar cloud data platforms for BI connectivity.
  • Experience training end users or colleagues on Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
  • Experience managing Power BI environment governance.
  • Experience working in agile product delivery preferred.

For more information about Centric Brands, please visit www.centricbrands.com.

About Us

 Why It's Exciting to Work at Centric Brands

Centric Brands is where data meets style. We are a leading lifestyle brand collective — designing, sourcing, marketing, and selling high-quality products across kids, men's and women's apparel, accessories, beauty, and entertainment. Our portfolio spans some of the most recognized licensed and owned brands in fashion, and our products reach consumers through virtually every major retailer and e-commerce channel in North America.

Behind every product decision — what to design, where to source it, how to price it, and when to ship it — is data. As a Senior BI Developer at Centric Brands, your dashboards won't sit unused in a folder; they will be opened every morning by merchandisers, planners, supply chain leaders, and executives making multi-million-dollar decisions about the brands people love and wear. Here's what makes this role genuinely exciting:

  • Real impact, real audience — Your work is visible at the top. BI at Centric is an executive priority, not a back-office function. You will present to and build for senior leadership.
  • A modern stack in motion — We are actively migrating to a cloud-first analytics stack built on Snowflake and Sigma, layered over SAP enterprise data. You will help shape the front-end analytics experience for the whole company — not maintain someone else's legacy reports.
  • An industry with texture — Fashion and consumer brands generate some of the most interesting data problems in business: seasonality, trend forecasting, licensing economics, omnichannel retail, and global supply chains.
  • Growth built in — You'll join a collaborative Data & Analytics team that invests in its people — including paid training and certification support in emerging tools like Sigma.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include

We are seeking an experienced front-end Business Intelligence Developer to design, build, and optimize the dashboards, reports, and semantic models that power decision-making across Centric Brands. You will work at the intersection of our SAP enterprise systems, our Snowflake cloud data platform, and our visualization layer (Power BI today, with Sigma rapidly expanding). This is a hands-on builder role for someone who takes pride in analytics products that are fast, trusted, and genuinely used.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain executive- and operational-level dashboards and reports in Power BI, and increasingly in Sigma, serving merchandising, planning, finance, supply chain, and sales teams.
  • Build and optimize robust semantic models and datasets — DAX measures, star-schema data models, row-level security, and performance tuning for large datasets.
  • Write advanced SQL against Snowflake to shape, validate, and optimize data for reporting; partner with data engineering on ELT patterns and warehouse design.
  • Work with SAP-sourced data (ECC/S4, BW, or similar), understanding core enterprise structures across sales, inventory, and finance to translate them into business-friendly analytics.
  • Gather requirements directly from business stakeholders, translate ambiguous asks into clear specifications, and iterate quickly with end users.
  • Establish and champion BI standards: naming conventions, design systems, documentation, version control, and certified datasets.
  • Troubleshoot data quality issues end-to-end, from source system to dashboard, and own the credibility of the numbers.
  • Mentor analysts and business power users; help lead our adoption of Sigma for self-service analytics on Snowflake.

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have

Must-Have Qualifications Experience

  • 5–7+ years of proven, hands-on BI development experience delivering production dashboards and data models in an enterprise environment.
  • 3+ years of deep Power BI development: advanced DAX, Power Query (M), composite models, incremental refresh, deployment pipelines, and workspace/governance administration.
  • 2+ years working with Snowflake (or an equivalent cloud data warehouse with recent Snowflake experience): advanced SQL, query optimization, and an understanding of warehouse cost/performance behavior.
  • Hands-on experience working with SAP data as a reporting source — e.g., SAP ECC or S/4HANA tables, SAP BW/BW4HANA extractors, or SAP data replicated into a cloud warehouse — including familiarity with core SD/MM/FI data structures.

Demonstrated Skills

  • A portfolio of shipped dashboards you can walk us through: the business problem, the model behind it, the performance decisions you made, and the adoption it achieved.
  • Expert-level SQL — able to profile unfamiliar data, debug discrepancies to the row level, and refactor slow queries.
  • Dimensional modeling fluency (Kimball-style star schemas) and the judgment to know when to push logic upstream versus into the semantic layer.
  • Strong data visualization craft: layout, color, and interaction choices that make complex retail and supply chain data instantly readable.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication — comfortable presenting to directors and VPs, and translating between business language and technical design.
  • Rigorous habits around testing, validation, documentation, and version control.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Sigma — Sigma Computing experience — hands-on Sigma development is a strong plus, but not required. If you bring deep Power BI + Snowflake + SAP skills, we will train you on Sigma and support you through certification. Curiosity and willingness to become our Sigma expert are what matter.
  • Experience in apparel, retail, CPG, or wholesale/licensing businesses — familiarity with concepts like sell-in/sell-through, open-to-buy, markdowns, and seasonal planning.
  • Python or dbt experience for data transformation and testing.
  • Experience with Power BI administration at the tenant level (capacities, gateways, usage monitoring).
  • Exposure to SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experience supporting a BI tool migration or self-service analytics rollout.
  • Familiarity with Azure data services (ADF, Synapse) or Fivetran/Matillion-style ELT tooling.

Certifications Preferred (any of the following)

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) — strongly preferred.
  • SnowPro Core Certification (Snowflake).
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600).
  • Sigma Computing certification (we will sponsor this for the right candidate).
  • SAP certification (e.g., SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud) is a plus.

Equivalent demonstrated expertise is welcomed in place of formal certifications.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

In return, we provide an industry-competitive salary, along with a comprehensive benefits plan (medical, dental, vision) that includes a matching 401(k), Summer Fridays, generous PTO, merchandise discounts, excellent career development opportunities, and a work environment that reflects our industry leadership. Our social impact program, Centric Cares, focuses on volunteerism to make a difference in communities we live and work in and o ur D&I committee is shaping the future of diversity, equity and inclusion at Centric Brands through workshops, resources and inspiring conversation.

At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent.

Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.

Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams .

descriptionHtml:
Senior Power BI Developer and Data Analyst

On Site - Scottsdale, AZ

About Cornerstone Advisors

Cornerstone Advisors is a nationally recognized management and technology consulting firm serving banks, credit unions, and financial services organizations across the United States. For more than two decades, we have partnered with executive leadership teams to solve complex business challenges, optimize operations, and deliver innovative strategies that drive measurable results. Our culture is built on collaboration, integrity, innovation, and a commitment to helping both our clients and our employees succeed.

About The Role

The Senior Power BI Developer and Data Analyst serves as Cornerstone Advisors' lead Business Intelligence professional, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise Business Intelligence solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights supporting strategic decision-making across the organization.

This role partners closely with executive leadership, consulting teams, and business stakeholders to understand organizational objectives and translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions. Leveraging expertise in Microsoft Power BI, SQL Server, Azure data technologies, cloud analytics, and modern Business Intelligence practices, the Senior Power BI Developer and Data Analyst delivers secure, scalable, and high-performing reporting solutions that improve operational performance, enhance client delivery, and support organizational growth.

As the organization's Business Intelligence subject matter expert, this position establishes enterprise reporting standards, promotes data governance best practices, advances analytics capabilities, and provides technical leadership for Microsoft's modern analytics platform to ensure enterprise data is trusted, accessible, and actionable.

Qualifications

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous enhancement of enterprise Business Intelligence solutions utilizing Microsoft Power BI.
  • Design and maintain scalable semantic models, dimensional data models, and enterprise datasets that support consistent reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL databases, and Azure-based data integration solutions supporting enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Build executive dashboards, operational scorecards, KPI reporting, and self-service reporting capabilities that enable informed business decisions.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, operational efficiencies, customer insights, business opportunities, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Develop advanced analytical models using forecasting, trend analysis, customer segmentation, regression analysis, and predictive analytics techniques to support strategic planning.
  • Partner with executive leadership, consultants, and business stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish key performance indicators (KPIs), and translate business objectives into scalable Business Intelligence solutions.
  • Develop and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, DAX measures, calculated columns, Power Query transformations, and reusable reporting components.
  • Administer and optimize the Microsoft Power BI Service environment, including workspace governance, semantic models, deployment pipelines, gateway management, security administration, and report lifecycle management.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise reporting standards, data governance policies, Row-Level Security (RLS), documentation, metadata, and quality assurance processes that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
  • Support reporting, analytics, and integrations involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 and other enterprise applications.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and modernize Business Intelligence capabilities through scalable technologies and best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging Microsoft technologies—including Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, AI-assisted analytics, Microsoft Copilot, and cloud data platforms—and recommend practical solutions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and subject matter expertise to analysts, developers, consultants, and project teams while promoting Business Intelligence best practices throughout the organization.

Knowledge And Skills

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft Power BI architecture, semantic modeling, DAX optimization, Power Query, and enterprise reporting best practices.
  • Advanced understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and enterprise data architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure data services and cloud analytics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Microsoft's modern analytics ecosystem.
  • Advanced understanding of statistical analysis, predictive analytics, forecasting methodologies, and business performance measurement.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, information security, metadata management, and Business Intelligence lifecycle management.
  • Understanding of Agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex analytical concepts effectively to executive leadership, consultants, clients, and non-technical stakeholders.

PROBLEM SOLVING / ANALYSIS

Independently analyzes and resolves highly complex business and technical challenges by evaluating multiple data sources, identifying trends and opportunities, resolving data quality issues, and designing scalable Business Intelligence solutions. Exercises sound judgment when balancing competing priorities, selecting analytical methodologies, and recommending technology solutions that support long-term organizational objectives.

BUSINESS IMPACT AND SCOPE

This position directly influences strategic decision-making by delivering timely, accurate, and actionable Business Intelligence to executive leadership, consulting teams, and internal business partners. Decisions made within this role impact organizational performance, client delivery, financial reporting, resource planning, technology investments, and enterprise reporting standards. The Senior Power BI Developer and Data Analyst serves as a key contributor to the firm's overall data strategy and Business Intelligence maturity.

COMMUNICATION AND COLLABORATION

Collaborates extensively with executive leadership, consultants, business units, technology teams, and external vendors to understand business priorities, define reporting requirements, and deliver innovative analytical solutions. Communicates complex findings through executive dashboards, visualizations, presentations, and written recommendations that enable informed business decisions and improve organizational performance.

INFLUENCE RESPONSIBILITY / LEVEL OF INTERACTION

Serves as Cornerstone Advisors' trusted advisor for Business Intelligence initiatives by influencing enterprise reporting standards, dashboard design, data governance practices, and analytical methodologies. Builds strong cross-functional partnerships while promoting a culture of data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and innovation.

Technical Skills

REQUIRED SKILLS & ESSENTIAL QUALITIES

Required

  • Microsoft Power BI (advanced dashboard development, semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, Row-Level Security)
  • Power BI Service Administration
  • Microsoft SQL Server
  • Advanced T-SQL
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure SQL
  • Enterprise Data Modeling
  • Data Warehouse Design
  • ETL/ELT Development
  • Statistical Analysis
  • Predictive Analytics
  • Performance Optimization
  • Data Visualization Best Practices
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel

Preferred

  • Microsoft Fabric
  • OneLake
  • Azure Databricks
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Python
  • R
  • Git
  • Azure DevOps
  • Tableau
  • Looker
  • Microsoft Copilot and AI-assisted analytics

Education & Experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics, or related technical roles.
  • Minimum of 3 years designing and developing enterprise Power BI solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise semantic models, data warehouses, and scalable reporting environments.
  • Advanced experience developing optimized T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects.
  • Experience developing cloud-based data integration solutions utilizing Microsoft Azure technologies.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
  • Certified Analytics Professional (CAP)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Experience within financial services, community banking, fintech, or management consulting.
  • Experience implementing enterprise reporting governance and self-service Business Intelligence programs.
  • Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence capabilities within Business Intelligence platforms.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead or subject matter expert on enterprise analytics initiatives.

Other Duties

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

EEO STATEMENT

Cornerstone Advisors provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

POSITION OVERVIEW: The Sr. BI Developer will be responsible for creating and supporting a self-service reporting model for Finance and Accounting. This role will use SQL queries to transform and consolidate information from multiple operational databases, publish cleaned data as semantic models in Power BI, and support downstream report builders with guidance on DAX, visualization best practices, and workspace administration. As a senior-level role, this position is expected to operate independently with minimal supervision.

A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:

Self-Service Reporting Model Development

  • Writing SQL queries to transform and consolidate Finance and Accounting data from multiple operational databases
  • Analyzing complex data scenarios and trace data through systems to understand sources, dependencies, and downstream reporting impacts
  • Understanding the meaning behind the data and how it can be used to create reliable business insights
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data quality through system design, process improvement, and reporting model structure

Power BI Semantic Model Publishing and Administration

  • Developing, publishing, and supporting semantic models through Power BI workspaces
  • Supporting workspace administration, data model organization, and downstream report development standards
  • Communicating how semantic models should be used to develop business insights and consistent reporting outputs

Training, Communication, and Independent Problem Solving

  • Teaching DAX, visualization best practices, and workspace administration to report builders
  • Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Applying a high level of attention to detail and logic-based problem solving when reviewing, building, and supporting reporting solutions
  • Performing other finance systems, reporting, data, or accounting system duties as warranted or directed

PREFERRED EDUCATION/LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, data analytics, business administration, or a related field preferred
  • Relevant Microsoft, Power BI, SQL, data analytics, or reporting certifications are preferred

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of relevant work experience in business intelligence, data analytics, finance systems, accounting systems, financial reporting, or related roles
  • Expertise with accounting data, particularly financial reporting and project accounting data
  • Expertise with Power BI, DAX, semantic models, and workspace administration
  • Expertise with MS SQL, including query development, data transformation, consolidation, and troubleshooting across multiple databases

IDEALLY, YOU SHOULD ALSO HAVE:

  • Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, reporting needs, and operational database structures
  • Experience working with ERP, accounting, or project accounting systems and the underlying data structures that support financial and operational reporting
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, data lake, data warehouse, or related cloud-based data platform concepts
  • Working knowledge of data governance practices, including data definitions, ownership, lineage, quality controls, and reporting consistency standards
  • Ability to evaluate data quality issues and recommend system or process improvements that improve reporting reliability
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, logic-based problem-solving capabilities and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Ability to teach, coach, and support report builders on DAX, visualization standards, and Power BI workspace practices

Job Summary

The Business Intelligence (BI) Reporting Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting in support of data-driven decision making across the organization This role will partner closely with business stakeholders and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable solutions that achieve strategic objectives. The BI Reporting Developer will design and develop reports using Power BI and Power BI Report Builder using SQL queries, published datasets, and DAX. This role will also play a lead role in strategic projects as needed. Performs other projects and duties as assigned.

Essential Functions, Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Work with various business units on requests that require data analysis, business analysis and documentation of processes.
  • Optimize report performance and design to improve usability and encourage enterprise-scale adoption.
  • Gather business requirements and translate into technical requirements for the development teams.
  • Dig deep into various systems using SQL queries to validate that the requested data exists and can be accessed.
  • Upon discovery of data, document process and work with development team and other BI Developers to integrate into reporting systems.
  • Act as a mentor for other BI Developers that are heavy business focused and provide technical expertise to the team with SQL and data analysis.
  • Support report deployment, testing, and promotion through development, UAT, QA, and production environments.
  • Documents process and findings and provide updates to stakeholders.
  • Performs custom report or application development on an as-needed basis.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Competencies

  • Strong proficiency with SQL queries required. Familiarity with MDX and/or DAX preferred.
  • Familiarity with Visual Studio & Microsoft programming languages preferred.
  • Proficient with using Excel for basic data quality and data validation checks, with strong data analysis skills.
  • Ability to communicate with technical and non-technical users. Ability to present and discuss technical information in a way that establishes rapport, persuades others, and gains understanding from non-technical audiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate with internal customers at all levels.
  • Experience working within banking, financial services, lending, risk management, or other regulated industries preferred.
  • Excellent initiative, innovative thinking skills, and the ability to analyze details and place them into the big picture.

Industry And Work Experience

  • 5 years of experience in a business intelligence and/or data analytics environment required.
  • 2-5 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, or reporting solutions required.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience required.

Academic

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Business, or a related field required.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Walton Enterprises is seeking a skilled, highly motivated and entrepreneurial individual to join the team as a Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence. The ideal teammate will have the demonstrated ability to transform complex enterprise data into actionable insights through advanced SQL, data modeling, and business intelligence solutions while collaborating with stakeholders to support informed decision-making.


About the Position

The Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence builds and maintains the analytics and visualization layer used by Walton Enterprises teams to support data-informed decisions. This position transforms raw enterprise data into governed metrics, curated data models, production dashboards, and reusable self-service reporting tools. The role partners with business stakeholders, software engineering, and infrastructure teams to ensure analytics are accurate, secure, actionable, and aligned with business needs.


Please note: We are unable to sponsor employment visas for this position, including OPT and CPT authorizations.

What you will do

In this role, you will develop and maintain business intelligence solutions that make enterprise data accessible, reliable, and actionable. You will partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, design reporting solutions, establish consistent data definitions, and support self-service analytics across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries against the enterprise data warehouse to source, join, and validate data for analysis.
  • Design and maintain curated data models, views, and a governed semantic layer that makes enterprise data reusable and ready for self-service reporting.
  • Build and maintain production dashboards and data visualizations, from requirements gathering through implementation and user adoption.
  • Establish and document shared metric definitions, data dictionaries, and reporting standards to promote consistency across teams.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame business questions and translate analysis into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Develop data-quality checks and monitoring within reporting solutions; investigate discrepancies and work with business and engineering partners to resolve root causes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and documentation while validating AI-generated output before it is shared with stakeholders.
  • Train and support business users in self-service reporting to increase adoption and reduce recurring ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Collaborate with software engineering and infrastructure teams regarding data availability, access controls, and upstream data-pipeline requirements.
  • Perform other duties as needed to support the Data Strategy and Insights team.

Who we are looking for

Skills needed

  • Advanced SQL and hands-on experience working with data warehouses
  • Data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling
  • Data modeling and semantic-layer design for self-service analytics
  • Business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, analyzable problems
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Data quality, documentation, and data-stewardship discipline

Qualifications required for success

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, computer science, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Five to seven years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field
  • Demonstrated proficiency in SQL, including performance tuning of complex queries against large datasets
  • Experience with other programming languages, such as Python, or advanced statistical-analysis software preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery or a comparable cloud-based data warehouse
  • Proven experience building and maintaining production dashboards using Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable visualization tools
  • Demonstrated examples of data visualizations or analyses that influenced how a team operated or what a stakeholder decided
  • Experience defining and governing shared metrics across multiple stakeholder groups
  • Experience working with accounting, investment, philanthropic, or family-office data preferred

Personal attributes that support success

  • Demonstrates discretion, integrity, and expertise while serving as a trusted advisor to principals and colleagues.
  • Collaborates respectfully and effectively with others, contributing to a supportive, team-oriented environment.
  • Approaches challenges with curiosity, bold thinking, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation.
  • Maintains a strong focus on results while consistently exercising sound judgment and decision-making.
  • Brings a visionary mindset, planning strategically for the future with imagination and insight.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to excellence and actively engages with others to accomplish shared goals.


All offers of employment are contingent on your successful completion (where permitted by state law) of a confidentiality agreement and background check. In addition, you will need to provide proper identification verifying your eligibility to work in the United States on your first day of work.


Benefits Information


Benefits Information: We offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan and paid time off.


Work Environment and Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made, provided they do not pose an undue hardship to the company.


Work is generally performed in a standard office or remote office environment. Duties typically require sitting for long periods; prolonged use of a computer, phone, and other standard office productivity equipment; participating in meetings, communicating by phone, video, and email; and occasional movement within the office or between meeting locations. Occasional lifting of boxes, files, or paperwork may be required. The role is not normally subject to extreme environmental conditions or unusual physical demands.


This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs.


About the Information Technology Department


The Information Technology Department provides a suite of services including hardware and software support, custom application development, cybersecurity, networking and tools for software integration. These services are provided to Walton Enterprises, the Walton Family Foundation and to Walton Family Entities.


About Walton Enterprises


Walton Enterprises supports the personal, philanthropic, and business activity for the Walton family. We are a family-led organization, supporting multiple generations of Sam and Helen Walton’s family.


We value trust, mutual respect, and a workplace where every associate belongs and can do their best work. We bring together talented people with different backgrounds and viewpoints, support their growth, and empower them to contribute meaningfully.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to a workplace that is free of discrimination and harassment of any kind.
