descriptionHtml:
AgWest Farm Credit is a member-owned financial cooperative that provides financing and related services to farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, commercial fishermen, timber producers, rural homeowners and crop insurance customers in a seven-state territory in the Western United States. AgWest is part of the 100+ year-old Farm Credit System – the leading provider of credit to American agriculture.

AgWest champions the growth and advancement of agriculture, the value of rural communities, and the vital contribution our customers make to the economy and society. We serve customers in 59 locations throughout the West.

We are in search of a Business Intelligence Developer II to join our Information Technology department in Spokane, Washington (Headquarters). This full-time position reports to the SVP, Internal Controls and Reporting and collaborates with internal stakeholders to design, develop, and maintain enterprise business intelligence solutions that support financial, operational and regulatory needs. This role is responsible for dashboard and paginated report development, data ingestion, and semantic modeling, while providing end-to-end ownership of solution delivery and change management.

Compensation Information

The base salary range for this position in Spokane, Washington is:

Level II

Typical starting range: $72,600 - $99,900

Full base salary range: $72,600 - $113,600

Annual performance-based incentive target is 10% of base.

  • Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who must relocate to accept this position.

Essential Duties

  • Business Intelligence Solution Design and Development
    • Utilizing comprehensive understanding of organization’s business, works with internal stakeholders, including IT project teams and business clients, to develop high-level requirements that align reporting solutions with intended business outcomes.
    • Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that meet stakeholders' operational requirements and deliver intuitive, performant and actionable insights.
    • Build and maintain paginated reports for standardized, regulatory and external reporting requirements.
    • Ensure reporting solutions comply with established formatting, performance, security and governance standards.
  • Data Ingestion and Semantic Modeling
    • Design and maintain ETL processes that integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality, consistency and reliability.
    • Create, manage, and enhance Power BI semantic models that support accurate, scalable and efficient reporting.
    • Create, optimize and document measures that support complex business logic, calculations and KPI definitions.
    • Maintain consistency and accuracy of metrics across dashboards and reporting layers through sound data governance practices.
  • Solution Delivery and Ownership
    • Follow processes, systems and tools defined under AgWest’s IT operating model for workflow management and deployment standards.
    • Perform cost-benefit analysis for technical solution design and build activities, identifying and evaluating upstream and downstream impacts.
    • Own the full development lifecycle from intake and requirements definition through deployment and final sign off.
    • Create and manage development plans, including timelines, milestones, dependencies and delivery sequencing.
    • Ensure solutions progress through defined review, validation, testing and approval processes.
    • Serve as the primary point of accountability for assigned reporting solutions and deliverables.
    • Perform all duties and maintain all standards in accordance with company policies, procedures, and internal controls.
    • Other duties as assigned.
Travel Requirements

  • AgWest employees may occasionally be asked to travel for conferences, training and/or all-staff or team meetings that fall outside the role's standard travel requirements.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data analytics, data science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Generally, requires three to five years' progressively responsible experience as a Business Intelligence Developer, Analytics Engineer or similar role
  • Proficient experience with Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard and paginated report development, DAX development, performance tuning and semantic model design
  • Working knowledge of dimensional modeling and star schema design
  • Experience with semantic model development
  • Experience with Git-based version control and pull request workflows
  • Experience using Azure DevOps or similar tools for project tracking, workflow management and deployment coordination
  • Proficient SQL skills and experience querying curated data warehouse tables
  • Ability to identify and evaluate cross-functional dependencies, including upstream and downstream impacts
  • Demonstrated critical thinking and ability to structure and solve moderately complex problems
  • Ability to plan, prioritize and manage multiple assignments with competing timelines
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Databricks, Fabric or other Azure-based data platforms
  • Experience applying change management best practices to business intelligence deployments
  • Understanding of project management concepts and experience supporting complex or enterprise-wide initiatives
  • Experience supporting accounting, finance or operational reporting, preferably in a financial institution

Workplace Flexibility

  • After an initial in-office training period, this position is eligible for workplace flexibility and a one-time home office stipend.
  • This position is eligible for coordinated hybrid flexibility

Benefits Offered By AgWest

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Basic term life and AD&D insurance (fully paid for by the company)
  • Paid days off annually: 15 vacation*, 15 sick, 12 holidays and 3 volunteer
  • 401(k) plan (6% match plus 3% employer contribution)
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Wellness Program
  • Jeans are welcome at work every day at AgWest!
  • Vacation accrual rates increase with tenure.

Details about insurance and retirement benefits are available at: https://www.farmcreditfoundations.com/fcfbenefits

If hired, you will be required to provide proof of authorization to work in the United States. Applicants and employees will not be sponsored for work authorization, including but not limited to H-1B, OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, or STEM.

Job level and starting annual salary will be based on a variety of factors including but not limited to experience, education, certifications/licensure, internal equity, location, business needs and market demands. The listed compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the posting date. AgWest reserves the right to adjust compensation for all positions and modify or discontinue benefits programs at its sole discretion, subject to applicable law.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender orientation, national origin, marital status, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by law.

When you apply for a position with AgWest Farm Credit, we collect personal identifiers (from your resume and other application information you submit), such as your name, email address, mailing address, telephone number(s) and employment and education related information. This helps us evaluate job applicants for hiring opportunities, and, communicate with them.

To comply with federal regulations for equal employment opportunity and affirmative action (EEO/AA), we track our applicants by gender, race/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, and the position for which they applied. You will be presented with a voluntary self-identification form as part of this application; we wanted you to know why we collect this information and what we do with it. Please be aware that this information is kept separate from your application, and not utilized in the selection process.

For more information about the information AgWest Farm Credit collects, please see the AgWest Farm Credit California Privacy Policy.

descriptionHtml:
Company: Dentive

Department: Data & Technology

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Compensation: $100,000–$115,000 annually

About The Role

Dentive is seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Developer to support the development and ongoing improvement of our enterprise reporting and analytics capabilities.

We're looking for a hands-on Power BI developer who can independently build sophisticated reports, develop and optimize semantic models, and translate business requirements into reliable, scalable reporting solutions.

This role will work closely with Data & Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, leveraging our Microsoft Fabric data platform to deliver high-quality financial, operational, and workforce analytics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Create advanced DAX measures, including financial calculations, time intelligence, and dynamic reporting metrics.
  • Develop and optimize data models using dimensional modeling and star-schema principles.
  • Implement and maintain row-level security (RLS) and reporting access controls.
  • Write SQL queries to validate reporting data, investigate discrepancies, and support development.
  • Optimize Power BI reports and semantic models for performance, usability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Work with data engineering to leverage centralized data within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, documentation, and enhancement of existing reporting solutions.
  • Promote consistency in KPI definitions, reporting standards, and development practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in DAX, Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, and semantic modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling, relationships, filter context, and data model optimization.
  • Experience implementing row-level security and managing reporting access.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver production-quality reports and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Warehouses, Lakehouses, or Direct Lake.
  • Familiarity with Power BI Premium, DirectQuery, and composite models.
  • Experience with DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, or similar development tools.
  • Experience with version control, deployment pipelines, and BI development best practices.
  • Experience supporting financial, operational, or workforce reporting.
  • Background in healthcare, multi-location businesses, or private equity-backed organizations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Independently delivers accurate, polished Power BI reporting solutions from requirements through deployment.
  • Improves reporting performance, consistency, and reliability.
  • Develops reusable semantic models and standardized reporting approaches.
  • Effectively troubleshoots complex reporting and data discrepancies.
  • Builds strong relationships with stakeholders while maintaining high technical standards.
  • Helps strengthen and scale the organization's business intelligence capabilities.

The role may also be eligible for an annual discretionary incentive award. In addition to cash compensation, SMBC offers a competitive portfolio of benefits to its employees.

Role Description

Power BI / Analytics Developer

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Developer who will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing comprehensive business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI. You will work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze data, and deliver actionable insights to drive informed decision-making.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and develop end-to-end business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI, including data modeling, data integration, and report/dashboard creation.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and design efficient and visually appealing Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Develop complex Power BI data models to enable accurate and efficient data analysis and visualization.
  • Conduct data profiling and analysis to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and anomalies, and work with stakeholders to address them.
  • Create and maintain data connections and ETL processes to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into Power BI.
  • Optimize performance and usability of Power BI reports and dashboards by tuning queries, implementing efficient data models, and applying best practices.
  • Ensure data security and compliance standards are met by implementing appropriate security measures and access controls within Power BI.

If you are excited about building sustainable analytics frameworks that evolve with business needs, apply today!

  • Integrate new and existing data sources into a sustainable data repository.
  • Maximize the use of reusable objects (data sources, stored procedures, functions, report objects).
  • Migrate and enhance legacy analytics and reporting systems.
  • Automate manual processes and improve data performance.
  • Distinguish between current operational needs and long-term strategic analytics requirements.
  • Adhere to established Data Governance Standards.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate effectively across departments.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered
  • 2–4 years of related experience and/or training in business intelligence, data analytics, or data development
  • Experience in financial services or a credit union environment is preferred
  • Strong SQL and relational database knowledge
  • Experience with ETL processes and data integration
  • Ability to create scalable dashboards and reporting solutions
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Adaptable, open-minded, and solution-oriented
  • Ability to communicate effectively and consistently with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Commitment to data accuracy, governance, and process improvement

A Culture Of Care And Reward

You give your best, and we give back with a comprehensive and meaningful rewards package:

  • Enjoy 11 paid holidays and generous paid time off to recharge and reset
  • Build your future with a 6% 401(k) match
  • Receive a $700 annual contribution to your Health Savings Account
  • Access our comprehensive maternity leave program to support growing families
  • Stay covered with medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
  • Grow your career through leadership development, tuition assistance, and advancement opportunities
  • Earn rewards for financial wellness through our Debt Free Club and Dave Ramsey’s SmartDollar program
  • Thrive in a purpose-driven, people-first culture where your impact matters

This is more than your next job. It’s your next step in changing lives; starting with your own.

At FAIRWINDS Credit Union, Financial Freedom Happens Here. Headquartered in Orlando, we’ve proudly served members for more than 70 years. We’re honored to be recognized as one of the Forbes 2024 Best-in-State Credit Unions and Orlando Business Journal’s Best Places to Work. descriptionHtml:
Location:

New Bremen, OH, US, 45869

Company Description

Crown Equipment Corporation is a leading innovator in world-class forklift and material handling equipment and technology. As one of the world’s largest lift truck manufacturers, we are committed to providing the customer with the safest, most efficient and ergonomic lift truck possible to lower their total cost of ownership.

Job Posting External

Job Responsibilities

The Senior PowerBI Developer is a critical role within InfoLink, Crown’s global fleet management software solution. Support business operations or customers by transforming the company’s data into meaningful and useful information for business purposes. Modify existing or create new reports and dashboards to assist in the planning and decision process. This position is a technical position and is expected to perform as an expert in business intelligence (BI) reporting. May mentor other Business Intelligence Developer and/or Report Developers. Use tools, methodologies, and processes to transform and consolidate large amounts unformatted data into a visual format, in the form of dashboards, reports, etc.

  • Data Model/ Extraction/ Integration - Build, enhance, and support data modeling and extraction of data elements using Python from multiple internal or external databases to meet business or customer reporting requirements. Design and build data load process taking all dependencies into consideration. Support data loading and extraction processes including ensuring optimal performance. Recommend and develop new metrics that may benefit the company or customers. May provide context analysis and suggestions based on items discovered during data review.
  • Report Creation - Use complex logic to create, test, implement and maintain complicated reports and ad-hoc queries providing actionable information necessary to support business or customer requirement. Identify data needed to provide the desired output. Design and develop analytic and reporting solutions appropriate for Business Intelligence platform. Fine tune reports and dashboards for optimal performance. Assist with issue resolution and end user support. Be an expert with BI reporting tools. Use the latest techniques in the industry to make the reporting process efficient which includes but is not limited to automation, speed, aesthetic designs and reducing complexity.
  • Business Analysis - Work with the business to analyze data and understand business and reporting needs and translate the requirement into technical specifications. Communicate status reports/important findings to management and decision-makers. Work to achieve standardized business reports and data across the organization or for customers. Perform data analysis on analytical and reporting requirements and recommend solutions for development.

Remote Work: Crown offers hybrid remote work for this position. A reasonable commute to the New Bremen, OH office is necessary since some onsite work is required.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, MIS, or related field, with at least 5 or more years of related work experience (salary will be commensurate with experience)
  • Expert level PowerBI experience
  • Experience with Python and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Good written, verbal, analytical and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to occasionally travel with overnight stays (0-5%)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PowerBI administration experience and comprehension of the capacity to embed reports within other applications.
  • Experience developing custom and complex queries in SQL for reporting needs and familiarity with creating custom DAX expressions/functions.
  • Understanding of ETL development with Microsoft SQL Server and SSIS.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs and API-based integrations.
  • Capable of implementing row-level security on data along with an understanding of application security layer models in Power BI.

Work Authorization

Crown will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

No agency calls please.

Compensation And Benefits

Crown offers an excellent wage and benefits package for full-time employees including Health/Dental/Vision/Prescription Drug Plan, Flexible Benefits Plan, 401K Retirement Savings Plan, Life and Disability Benefits, Paid Parental Leave, Paid Holidays, Paid Vacation, Tuition Reimbursement, and much more.

Responsibilities

The company is an equal opportunity employer.

We are seeking a BI Developer to lead Power BI report development and semantic modeling as we modernize our data and analytics environment. Candidate must sit in the Jacksonville, FL office.

Key Functionswill Include But Not Be Limited To

  • Design, develop, test and support Power BI dashboards, reports and apps.
  • Build reusable semantic models, measures and KPIs using dimensional modeling and advanced DAX.
  • Gather requirements and translate business questions into clear, actionable analytics.
  • Inventory and rationalize duplicate, obsolete or conflicting reports and metrics.
  • Migrate reporting from siloed data sources to governed enterprise datasets.
  • Optimize Power BI models and reports for performance, usability and maintainability.
  • Implement role-based security, deployment standards, documentation, lineage and dataset certification practices.
  • Partner with data engineers to place transformation logic in the appropriate DWH or semantic layer.
  • Validate reports and metrics through reconciliation and user acceptance testing.
  • Perform other duties and/or projects as assigne d

Education Requirement

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field

Qualifications: Include necessary skills/experience and core competencies required

  • Strong hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • DAX, Power Query and SQL skills.
  • Strong semantic modeling and dimensional/star schema experience.
  • Experience with performance optimization and Power BI security.
  • Ability to translate technical data into clear business insights and visualizations.

  • Experience connecting Power BI to Databricks or modern cloud data platforms.
  • Experience modernizing or consolidating enterprise reporting.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality and controlled reporting environments.

Power BI Developer, Business Integration

Company Overview

At Mitsubishi Power, we're not just building better clean energy technologies; we're architecting a better future. Our team is boldly redefining power generation to accelerate the world's energy transition. We operate as one team, pushing toward our vision of the future. We value problem solvers, prioritize collaboration, and support each other in an inclusive culture built on accountability and authenticity by demonstrating our values: Safety, Family, Innovative, Inclusive, Accountable & Courageous. Together, we’re building the future we all aspire to - making net zero a reality.

Role Overview

The Power BI Developer, Business Integration designs, develops, deploys, and supports production-ready Power BI solutions primarily serving North American Manufacturing and Supply Chain operations. This role works with business stakeholders, Business Intelligence developers, data engineering teams, IT, and Finance resources across multiple business units to transform complex operational data into accurate, intuitive, secure, and high-performing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and semantic models. The position requires advanced hands-on experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL, relational data modeling, Microsoft Fabric, automated refreshes, governed deployment, and performance optimization, with the ability to contribute quickly in an established enterprise analytics environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, publish, and maintain production-ready Power BI reports, dashboards, scorecards, semantic models, and datasets supporting North American Manufacturing and Supply Chain operations, analytics, and performance management.
  • Connect to and transform governed data from the enterprise data lake, Microsoft Fabric, relational databases, ERP systems, and other approved sources using Power Query, SQL, dataflows, and supported Power BI connectivity methods.
  • Analyze source tables, keys, data grain, cardinality, relationships, and business rules to build accurate star-schema or other fit-for-purpose data models.
  • Create clear, reusable DAX measures and calculation logic that produce consistent business results while minimizing unnecessary model complexity.
  • Optimize semantic models and reports for responsiveness and capacity efficiency by reducing model size, limiting high-cardinality columns, preserving query folding when available, selecting appropriate storage modes, and removing unnecessary visuals, queries, and calculations.
  • Design, configure, and monitor dependable scheduled refresh processes, including refresh sequencing, incremental refresh where appropriate, connection and gateway dependencies, credentials, failure handling, and data validation.
  • Use Power BI Performance Analyzer, refresh history, capacity metrics, query diagnostics, and approved tools to identify and correct slow visuals, inefficient DAX, long-running queries, refresh bottlenecks, and excessive resource consumption.
  • Apply enterprise Power BI and Microsoft Fabric development standards for naming, model organization, security, accessibility, source control, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support across development and production environments.
  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence developers, analytics teams, data engineering, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, validate metrics, resolve data issues, and deliver aligned reporting solutions.
  • Participate in Business Integration developer communities, technical reviews, working sessions, and cross-business-unit initiatives to promote standards, reusable solutions, shared practices, and knowledge transfer.
  • Evaluate existing enterprise data products, semantic models, datasets, and reporting assets before creating new solutions to promote reuse and reduce unnecessary duplication.
  • Implement and maintain row-level security, object-level security, sensitivity labels, and workspace access controls in accordance with company data-governance and security requirements.
  • Build scalable solutions that support common requirements across business units while meeting specific operational needs of Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams.
  • Manage multiple report-development assignments, communicate progress and risks, facilitate user acceptance testing, and deliver solutions on schedule.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for every Power BI report, Power Automate flow, Power Apps application, and related digital solution using the approved organizational template.
  • Establish technical documentation at project initiation and complete or update it before production release and project closeout.
  • Document business purpose, scope, ownership, requirements, data sources, connections, relationships, transformation logic, calculations, security, dependencies, environments, refresh or trigger schedules, capacity considerations, deployment approach, testing results, support procedures, known limitations, and change history as applicable.
  • Treat approved and current technical documentation as a required production deliverable before a digital solution is considered complete.
  • Comply with safety policies, protect confidential information, communicate effectively, contribute to team goals, and maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of relevant education, technical training, certification, and practical experience may be considered.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and production datasets.
  • Ability to independently deliver a reporting solution from requirements and source-data assessment through development, validation, publishing, refresh configuration, deployment, documentation, and support.
  • Advanced understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, data grain, primary and foreign keys, one-to-many and many-to-many relationships, filter direction, role-playing dimensions, and date tables.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose inaccurate results caused by data-modeling, relationship, filter-context, or source-data issues.
  • Advanced DAX skills, including measures, filter context, time intelligence, variables, iterators, and reusable calculation patterns.
  • Strong Power Query and M skills, including data shaping, merge and append operations, parameters, error handling, and query-folding awareness.
  • Demonstrated experience improving report responsiveness, semantic-model efficiency, and refresh performance.
  • Knowledge of model-size reduction, cardinality management, Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Direct Lake considerations, aggregations, incremental refresh, visual optimization, and capacity-aware development.
  • Practical experience developing Power BI solutions using enterprise data lakes, Microsoft Fabric lakehouses or warehouses, relational sources, and ERP data.
  • Ability to read and write SQL, profile source data, validate joins and row counts, trace business logic, and collaborate with data engineers on source changes.
  • Experience publishing and managing Power BI Service content in an enterprise environment, including workspaces, apps, semantic-model settings, refresh schedules, gateways or cloud connections, permissions, endorsements, deployment pipelines, and refresh troubleshooting.
  • Experience working effectively within platform standards managed by a separate Microsoft Fabric administration or governance team.
  • Ability to collaborate within a shared Business Intelligence community, participate in technical reviews and developer forums, share reusable practices, and align local solutions with enterprise standards.
  • Experience applying row-level security, data-access controls, naming standards, documentation, testing, reconciliation, controlled releases, and governed deployment practices.
  • Ability to translate business questions into technical reporting requirements and explain model, metric, and calculation logic to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to enter an existing analytics environment, learn its data and standards quickly, isolate data or performance issues, and implement practical corrections without unnecessary redesign.
  • Preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, lakehouses, data warehouses, SAP or another ERP platform, Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Power BI REST APIs, Git-based source control, Power Automate, Power Apps, or the broader Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification or comparable demonstrated expertise is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric platform administration is beneficial but is not the primary responsibility of the position.
  • Ability to stand and walk regularly, lift or move up to 25 pounds frequently, and lift or move up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to work in moderate-to-loud environments where hearing protection may be recommended or required.

Why Should You Apply?

  • Excellent Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision & 401K Matching).
  • Excellent development programs and advancement opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement and on-the-job training.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.
  • Committed to quality products and services.
  • Great working environment and culture.
  • Employee Appreciation Programs and Event.

Mitsubishi Power is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer actively seeking to diversify the workforce and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. Therefore, all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under applicable law, are strongly encouraged to apply.

Job Title: Data Engineer



Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS) – Enabling Technology



Location: Remote



About Pearson Virtual Schools



At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. PVS is a division within Pearson, a global leader in the education industry. Our PVS Enabling Technology team plays a critical role in this mission by building scalable, trusted data products that empower school leaders, educators, and operational teams to make informed decisions that improve student outcomes.



As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization , we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences .



Role Overview



We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence , turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.



You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.



What You’ll Do



Data Visualization & Reporting



  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting


  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards


  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)


  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices


Semantic Modeling



  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations


  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security


  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer


Data Quality & Reliability



  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems


  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues


  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions


  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment


Collaboration & Delivery



  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features


  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews


  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Scalability & Data Product Enablement



  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy


  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions


  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management


What You Bring



Technical Expertise



  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI , including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3 , DAX Studio , or ALM Toolkit is helpful


  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts , including star schema and fact/dimension design


  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses


  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)


Problem Solving & Growth



  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support


  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues , with support when needed


  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability


Collaboration & Communication



  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers


  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights


  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices


Qualifications



  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area


  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making


  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve


Preferred Experience



  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments


  • Experience with Google BigQuery


  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization


  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale


Why Join Us



  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide


  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS


  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement


  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning


Success in This Role Looks Like



  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders


  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics


  • Reduced data discrepancies and improved reporting reliability


  • Strong partnership across engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Consistent delivery of reporting projects meeting and exceeding requirements and timeframes


Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows:

descriptionHtml:
Troon’s Corporate Office, located in Scottsdale, Arizona, is pleased to announce an excellent career opportunity for a BI Developer! We are seeking a highly motivated individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and advance their career within a rapidly growing organization. The ideal candidate will bring a strong commitment to professional development and a desire to succeed in a dynamic corporate environment.

Leads the design, development, and delivery of Power BI reporting solutions and enterprise semantic models to support data-driven decision-making. Responsible for end-to-end data transformation using Power Query and DAX, building and maintaining reusable semantic models, and enforcing data quality and governance standards across the reporting environment. Serves as a technical lead for BI development while partnering with business stakeholders to ensure reports are accurate, consistent, and fit for purpose.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that meet business requirements for accuracy, performance, and usability
  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, including table relationships, calculated columns, measures, and row-level security configurations
  • Develop and manage Power Query data transformation logic to clean, reshape, and integrate data from multiple source systems into consistent, analysis-ready datasets
  • Partner with data engineering, IT, and business stakeholders to define source-to-report data flows and resolve upstream data issues affecting report reliability
  • Define and enforce data quality rules, profiling standards, and validation checks to ensure reports reflect accurate and trustworthy data
  • Establish and document data governance standards for the Power BI environment, including dataset ownership, naming conventions, certification processes, and access controls
  • Monitor and maintain the health of published datasets and reports in the Power BI service, including refresh schedules, gateway configurations, and usage metrics
  • Optimize report and dataset performance through query folding, incremental refresh, aggregations, and efficient DAX patterns
  • Provide guidance and enablement to report consumers on Power BI navigation, filtering, and correct interpretation of metrics
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership in a clear, concise, and actionable manner

Qualifications:

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a reporting-focused role
  • Demonstrated experience delivering Power BI reports and semantic models used in production environments
  • Hands-on experience writing DAX measures and Power Query transformations for complex business reporting requirements

Preferred:

  • Experience working with data warehouses, lakehouses, or cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure Synapse, Fabric, Databricks) as Power BI data sources
  • Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, or ALM Toolkit for model development and optimization
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Power BI Premium capacity management

Knowledge and Skills:

Required:

  • Advanced proficiency in DAX for calculated columns, measures, and time-intelligence functions
  • Strong proficiency in Power Query (M) for data transformation, cleansing, and integration across heterogeneous sources
  • Deep experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, and semantic model design (star schema, relationships, hierarchies)
  • Solid understanding of data quality concepts including profiling, validation, lineage, and issue triage across the data pipeline
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation validation, and troubleshooting source data issues
  • Ability to document data models, transformation logic, and governance policies clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred:

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Dataverse, or other Power Platform data sources
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK or enterprise data catalog tools (e.g., Purview)
  • Experience implementing row-level security (RLS) and object-level security (OLS) in Power BI semantic models
  • Knowledge of version control practices for Power BI (e.g., PBIP format with Git integration) and deployment pipeline management
  • Experience with Python or R for data preparation tasks that feed into Power BI datasets

Education Requirements:

Minimum education credentials required for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or related field
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

Certificates/Licenses:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) preferred; not required

Physical Requirements:

Minimum physical requirements required to perform the duties of the job

Environment/Noise:

Describe Work Environment (i.e. Office, Outside, Working with Machinery) and Noise Level

About Troon

Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ, Troon is the world’s largest professional club management company that specializes in services in golf, hospitality, and residential communities. With more than 900 locations in 45+ states and 27+ countries, Troon is a leading employer in hospitality. Guided by values that emphasize being infectiously energetic, consciously kind, and humbly prosperous, Troon offers professionals the opportunity to grow and succeed within a globally respected organization. Learn more at www.troon.com.

About Pearson Virtual Schools



At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. PVS is a division within Pearson, a global leader in the education industry. Our PVS Enabling Technology team plays a critical role in this mission by building scalable, trusted data products that empower school leaders, educators, and operational teams to make informed decisions that improve student outcomes.



As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization , we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences .



Role Overview



We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence , turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.



You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.



What You’ll Do



Data Visualization & Reporting



  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting


  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards


  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)


  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices


Semantic Modeling



  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations


  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security


  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer


Data Quality & Reliability



  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems


  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues


  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions


  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment


Collaboration & Delivery



  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features


  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews


  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Scalability & Data Product Enablement



  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy


  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions


  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management


What You Bring



Technical Expertise



  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI , including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3 , DAX Studio , or ALM Toolkit is helpful


  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts , including star schema and fact/dimension design


  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses


  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)


Problem Solving & Growth



  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support


  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues , with support when needed


  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability


Collaboration & Communication



  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers


  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights


  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices


Qualifications



  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area


  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making


  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve


Preferred Experience



  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments


  • Experience with Google BigQuery


  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization


  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale


Why Join Us



  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide


  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS


  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement


  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning


Success in This Role Looks Like



  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders


  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics


  • Reduced data discrepancies and improved reporting reliability


  • Strong partnership across engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Consistent delivery of reporting projects meeting and exceeding requirements and timeframes

JOB SUMMARY


The Business Intelligence Developer designs, develops, and maintains business intelligence solutions that promotes data driven decision making across the organization. The Developer works collaboratively with business and clinical stakeholders, business analysts, technical support teams and leadership to design and deploy analytic solutions that support operational, clinical, and financial performance improvement. The incumbent utilizes critical thinking, technical, analytical, and communication skills to create data models, subject area marts, reports, data visualizations, and self-service tools that meet customer needs.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Utilizes business intelligence development tools to design, deploy, and maintain moderate to complex data models, extracts, subject area marts, stored procedures, and self-service reporting tools that support organization wide data driven activities.

  • Maintains and supports electronic medical record business intelligence data models, functions, and reports. This includes active participation and support of software upgrades.
  • Documents technical/business specifications, performs testing and data validation to support data governance and maintenance of business intelligence solutions.
  • Performs data analysis to support organization clinical, financial, and operational performance improvement initiatives.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelors in or 4 years' work related experience Required
  • Masters in in Business Administration, Computer Science, Informatics, or related discipline. Preferred

  • 2 years SQL query development Required
  • 2 years Data visualization development using Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or similar software Required

descriptionHtml:
Job Details

Description

Third Federal is a leading lender of conventional home mortgages lending in 27 states, plus the District of Columbia, with retail branch offices in Ohio and Florida. Our mission is to help people achieve the dream of home ownership and financial security while creating value for our customers, our communities, our associates, and our stockholders. Our value system of love (concern for others), trust, respect, a commitment to excellence, and fun is at the heart of our commitment to our mission, and just as importantly, to our company culture. Through this, we help people find the loan or savings product that makes sense for them.

At Third Federal, you will find strength and stability in your career. In our nearly 90-year history, we have never had layoffs, and have one of the lowest annual turnover rates at 6% (versus an industry average of nearly 19%). We have been certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ multiple times in the last decade alone, and have been recognized with several additional workplace awards and recognitions. Because Third Federal associates are the foundation of our success, we take a genuine interest in each of them – from their professional development to their health and wellness.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Power BI Reporting & ETL Analyst to join our team here at Third Federal. This role will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to support enterprise-scale, data-driven decision making, improving business processes, and executing organizational objectives. This role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining standardized reporting and analytics solutions while partnering closely with business stakeholders to ensure reporting aligns with business needs and enterprise data standards. The Power BI Reporting & ETL Analyst will work directly with business owners, management, and end users across departments to intake, document, prioritize, and deliver reporting and analytics requests. This role will also support and maintain data management platforms, ETL processes, and data warehouse solutions used for data storage, transformation, analysis, and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business owners and stakeholders to intake, document, prioritize, and deliver enterprise reporting and analytics requests.
  • Design, develop, and maintain standardized enterprise reports, dashboards, and analytical datasets that support data‑driven decision making.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries and analytic datasets, ensuring data accuracy, performance, and consistency across reporting solutions.
  • Support and maintain data management platforms, ETL processes, and data warehouse solutions used for data storage, transformation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with data management and technology teams to ensure data integrity, security, and governance standards are met across analytics efforts.
  • Act as a data advocate, identifying opportunities to improve data quality, analytics maturity, reporting efficiency, and business processes.
  • Enable business user self‑sufficiency by designing intuitive analytical solutions, promoting self‑service reporting, and establishing a network of power users to support ad hoc analytics needs.
  • Gain knowledge of core banking systems and ancillary products to support the integration of reporting data across disparate systems.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related role, preferably in banking or financial services
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data analysis, reporting, and data validation
  • Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS
  • Experience working with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes
  • Ability to communicate complex data and analytics concepts in a clear, user-friendly manner
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and consistency
  • Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple reporting and analytics requests simultaneously
  • High school diploma or GED (bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, or a related field preferred)

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
  • Prior experience working with data, analytics, reporting, or data management solutions within the banking, financial services, or fintech industry is preferred
  • Familiarity with enterprise reporting standards, KPI definition, and metric governance
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSRS, SSMS and SSAS
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word

Third Federal Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Medical, dental, vision, and more
  • 401k match
  • 11 Bank Holidays + vacation/sick time
  • Stock Ownership Allocation
  • Exceptional culture and value system
  • Strong work/life balance
  • Growth opportunities
  • Mortgage Discount Program
  • Education Reimbursement Program

Our anticipated pay range for this position is $70,000.00 - $100,000.00. At Third Federal, we’re committed to transparency throughout the hiring process. The pay range listed is based on relevant market data, role responsibilities, and skills required for the position. Individual pay will be thoughtfully determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors.

Third Federal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, gender identification or sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status or any other classification protected under law.

Position Summary:

The Senior Analytics Developer delivers trusted business intelligence and analytics solutions across Oatey, partnering with business teams to translate reporting needs into scalable solutions using Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL, and responsible AI. This role owns solutions from requirements through deployment and ongoing support, and reports to the Vice President, Analytics.

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models, including advanced DAX, relationships, security requirements, usability, and performance optimization.
  • Develop and maintain analytics-layer transformations and Silver and Gold structures in Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL Server, and related platforms; use Fabric integration and, where applicable, Azure Data Factory to support ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and refresh.

Job Responsibilities

  • Significant experience developing production BI solutions, with expert-level Tableau skills
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, optimize, and troubleshoot complex, highly visible Tableau dashboards, including performance tuning and usability
  • Hands-on experience with Tableau dashboard embedding and both packaged (.twbx) and un-packaged (.twb) workbooks
  • Experience working with varied data types and structures, and connecting Tableau to data warehouses and multiple database platforms
  • Strong knowledge of data warehouse concepts, data modeling, and live and extract-based data connections
  • Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.

  • Experience using GitHub Copilot and understanding techniques for integrating AI-assisted development into team workflows
  • Ability to translate business requirements into secure, accessible, maintainable dashboards and data visualizations
  • Experience validating data accuracy and dashboard functionality, usability, and performance
  • Experience with ETL tools such as Alteryx

  • Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to build effective relationships, document technical solutions, and work effectively in Agile delivery teams
  • Exposure to cloud technologies

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced VP, Business Analytics Developer to design, develop, and enhance enterprise-level business intelligence solutions. This individual will leverage Microsoft Power BI to transform complex data into meaningful insights, build scalable reporting solutions, and support strategic business decisions.


The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise in Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling, along with the ability to collaborate with business stakeholders and deliver intuitive, high-performing dashboards. This role offers the opportunity to work with cross-functional teams, support a global user base, and drive improvements in analytics and reporting capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level Power BI dashboards, reports, and business intelligence solutions that deliver actionable insights.
  • Build and optimize complex data models, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, and ETL processes to ensure accurate and efficient reporting.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver intuitive, user-friendly dashboards.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including relational databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems, while maintaining data quality, security, and performance.
  • Provide production support, troubleshoot reporting issues, mentor junior developers, and promote self-service analytics capabilities across the organization.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 3–10+ years of experience developing business intelligence and analytics solutions, with a strong focus on Microsoft Power BI.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling, including experience designing and optimizing complex dashboards and reports.
  • Strong understanding of relational and dimensional databases, SQL querying, ETL processes, and data integration techniques.
  • Experience working with enterprise data environments; exposure to Azure, Denodo, APIs, Power BI gateways, PowerApps, Power Automate, Tableau, or Cognos is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with excellent communication, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

descriptionHtml:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 🚀

Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions.

You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment.

 

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization
  • Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics
  • Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales

 

What Success Looks Like  📈

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly
  • Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests
  • Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource
  • Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work

 

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions
  • Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences
  • Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions
  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data
  • Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments
  • Experience in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred)
  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

 

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analytics Engineer, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

 

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation 💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

descriptionHtml:
About AIB International:

AIB International is a global leader in food safety and quality professional services, including training, consulting, certification and inspection. We are committed to supporting the food industry through expert guidance, innovation, and a deep understanding of global safety regulations.

 

Description of Job Function:

The BI Developer is a technical role responsible for building and maintaining business intelligence solutions that support internal operations and external client reporting. This role sits at the intersection of data preparation and reporting delivery — querying source systems, maintaining automated pipelines, and developing Power BI dashboards and client-facing reports. The BI Developer works closely with the Manager, Business Intelligence and will collaborate on data infrastructure projects as the team expands its Databricks and Azure platform footprint.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for internal stakeholders and external clients via the company BI portal
  • Write SQL and Python/pandas scripts to query operational databases and pull data from APIs including Salesforce
  • Own the production and delivery of ad hoc client reports in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Monitor and maintain Databricks notebook jobs, identify failures, and coordinate resolution
  • Support the development of automated data pipelines, working toward reducing manual Excel-based reporting
  • Maintain report documentation, data dictionaries, and end user guides
  • Participate in BI-related meetings and contribute to project intake and prioritization
  • Collaborate with the Analyst, Business Intelligence on report QA and distribution workflows
  • Grow familiarity with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and Databricks as the team expands platform use

 

Qualifications

Required:

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in a BI, reporting, or data analyst role
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field
  • Proficiency in SQL — comfortable querying relational databases independently
  • Able to query relational databases (SQL) and transform data with Python
  • Working knowledge of Python, particularly pandas for data manipulation
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI
  • Familiarity with Excel and PowerPoint for client-facing deliverables
  • Ability to troubleshoot data issues and pipeline failures with moderate supervision
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data

 

Preferred:

  • Experience with Azure cloud services, particularly ADLS Gen2 or Azure Databricks
  • Exposure to REST API data pulls or Salesforce reporting
  • Familiarity with Power BI embedded reporting or the Power BI service
  • Experience working in a BI team supporting external client.

 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Power BI and Data Engineer Developer to support business intelligence, data reporting, and data engineering initiatives. This role will be responsible for designing and developing Power BI dashboards, building data pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources, and maintaining reliable datasets for business users.


The ideal candidate should have strong experience with Power BI, SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud data platforms. This person will work closely with business teams, data analysts, finance, operations, and IT teams to deliver accurate and scalable reporting solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Power BI Development

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and datasets.
  • Create user-friendly dashboards with filters, slicers, drill-throughs, bookmarks, and interactive visuals.
  • Build and optimize DAX measures and calculated columns.
  • Design efficient data models using star schema and reporting best practices.
  • Publish and manage reports in Power BI Service.
  • Configure scheduled refreshes, gateways, workspaces, apps, and user access.
  • Troubleshoot Power BI performance issues and optimize report load times.
  • Work with business users to gather requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.
  • Validate report data against source systems and ensure accuracy.

Data Engineering

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to move and transform data from multiple source systems.
  • Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and transformations.
  • Integrate data from systems such as SQL Server, Snowflake, APIs, flat files, Excel, and other business applications.
  • Design and maintain data warehouse tables, staging tables, and reporting views.
  • Monitor data loads, troubleshoot failures, and ensure timely data refreshes.
  • Perform data cleansing, validation, deduplication, and transformation.
  • Support migration of reports and data processes from legacy systems to modern platforms.
  • Maintain documentation for data flows, business rules, table relationships, and reporting logic.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in Power BI development.
  • 2+ years of experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse concepts.
  • Experience writing complex SQL queries, joins, CTEs, views, and stored procedures.
  • Strong experience with DAX and Power Query/M.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT tools and data integration processes.
  • Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and performance issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work directly with business users.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Snowflake, Azure SQL Database, SQL Server, or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, SSIS, CData, or similar integration tools.
  • Experience with Power BI deployment pipelines, incremental refresh, and row-level security.
  • Knowledge of APIs and JSON data extraction.
  • Experience working with finance, HR, marketing, or operational reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and access control.
  • Experience migrating reports from Excel, Access, or legacy reporting tools to Power BI.


Soft Skills

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a focus on business value.


Role Summary

The Power BI and Data Engineer Developer will design, build, and maintain business intelligence dashboards and data pipelines. This role requires strong Power BI development skills, advanced SQL knowledge, and experience working with data warehouses and ETL processes. The candidate will partner with business users to understand reporting needs, create reliable datasets, and deliver accurate, scalable dashboards that support business decision-making.
