descriptionHtml:
Korn Ferry is partnering with a global third-party logistics and manufacturing organization in their search for a Senior BI / Decision Intelligence Developer.


Position Summary

The Senior BI / Decision Intelligence Developer will build and support enterprise reporting and decision-support solutions across Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. Reporting to the Director of FP&A, the role will translate business requirements into accurate, intuitive, and scalable analytics products while supporting testing, deployment, user adoption, and production issue resolution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain executive, financial, commercial, and operational Power BI reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical applications
  • Develop and test DAX measures, calculation groups, report logic, and reusable reporting solutions
  • Design intuitive user experiences using drill-throughs, tooltips, bookmarks, guided navigation, and accessible visualizations
  • Translate business requirements and KPI definitions into report specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Validate calculations, reconcile reporting outputs, coordinate UAT, and resolve defects
  • Manage report releases using PBIP/PBIR, Git, version control, and deployment pipelines
  • Monitor refresh performance, troubleshoot production issues, and maintain release documentation
  • Train users, support governed self-service reporting, and improve analytics products based on usage and feedback


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting enterprise Power BI or comparable business intelligence solutions
  • Advanced experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, paginated reporting, and semantic models
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, PBIP/PBIR, Git, deployment pipelines, CI/CD, APIs, gateways, and workspace administration
  • Working knowledge of dimensional modeling, star schemas, SQL, RLS/OLS, DirectQuery, Direct Lake, and data lineage
  • Experience translating business requirements into accurate, maintainable, and action-oriented analytics products
  • Financial, sales, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational reporting experience preferred
  • Experience with Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric Mirroring preferred
  • Microsoft Power BI or Fabric certification preferred
  • Strong data visualization, stakeholder communication, documentation, and production-support skills

Role Description

Power BI Developer

We are seeking a skilled Power BI Developer with experience in the healthcare domain to design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports that drive data-informed decision-making across clinical, operational, and business teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of healthcare data (claims, eligibility, enrollment, etc.), hands-on expertise with Power BI, and the ability to work with stakeholders to translate business needs into insightful visualizations. Experience working with HIPAA-compliant data environments is highly desirable.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain visually compelling Power BI reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Translate business requirements into data models and meaningful metrics.
  • Connect to multiple data sources (SQL Server, Excel, cloud services, etc.) and build data models using Power Query and DAX.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, and subject matter experts in the healthcare domain.
  • Ensure reports adhere to performance, usability, and accessibility best practices.
  • Validate and reconcile data across systems, ensuring accuracy and integrity.
  • Document report logic, data definitions, and visual elements for knowledge sharing and compliance.
  • Work within healthcare regulatory requirements such as HIPAA to manage sensitive data responsibly.

This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

Required

What You Need

  • 6–10 years of experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Strong proficiency in DAX, Power Query (M), and data modeling techniques.
  • Solid understanding of healthcare data, such as claims, eligibility, member/provider data, or clinical data.
  • Experience working with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Azure SQL) and writing T-SQL.
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PHI).
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interact with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience with EDI X12 (e.g., 837, 835, 270/271) or FHIR/HL7 healthcare data formats.
  • Exposure to Azure Data Platform (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Power BI Service).
  • Background in working with large datasets and optimizing performance in Power BI.
  • Familiarity with Agile development and tools like Jira, DevOps Boards, or Confluence.
  • Microsoft certification in Power BI (e.g., PL-300 or DA-100) is a plus.

We Are Currently Seeking An Experienced

BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE DEVELOPER II

Job Summary



- Assists in implementing effective business analytics practices that drive improved decision-making, efficiency and performance. 
- Communicate with business users to determine specific requirements for BI reports and business intelligence solutions. Determines what information is needed and defines how to present it effectively. 
- Partner with business leaders to develop innovative ways to deliver dashboards, reports and queries using tools such as Python and Microsoft’s BI and reporting technology stack (Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Factory pipelines, Power Apps, Power Automate, SSAS, SSRS). 
- Collaborate with members of the development team to develop reports and advanced analytics using data warehousing concepts and technologies. 
- Create and maintain documentation including requirements, designers, user manuals and data dictionaries. 
- Can work and plan independently at the Task, User Story, and Feature level in agile-based tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable development environment. 
- Provides ongoing maintenance for BID systems, reports, and data. 
- Provides customer service by communicating with end users, identifying user needs and requests, researching trends, software, evaluating environments, BID-related applications and providing related information to users. 
- Assess user’s information requirements by interviewing affected agency personnel. Determines what information is needed and defines how to present it effectively. 
- Designs system components such as forms, reports, screen formats, files, and databases. 
- Performs work during emergency/disaster situations. 
- Serves as a BI expert to staff by assessing needs and recommending appropriate solutions. 
- Ability to document work with tools such as Atlassian Confluence. Additionally, able to actively look for undocumented processes, applications, and integrations, then document or seek assistance. 
- Ability to identify and seek out work that needs to be done and then assist with planning out that work. 
- Ability to use Azure GIT version control.

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline, required
- A minimum of 2 years’ Business Intelligence Development experience, required. 
- Proficient level knowledge of T-SQL development. 
- Proficient level knowledge of BI related development methods and techniques. 
- Proficient level knowledge of data structures. 
- Proficient level knowledge of database management. 
- Proficient level knowledge of customer service techniques. 
- Proficient level of knowledge of GIT version control
- Preferred: Knowledge of value-based insurance practices
- Preferred: Experience working with or for Third Party Administrators 
- Preferred: Experience working with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
- Managing large data processing systems. 
- Researching BI topics via the Internet and other online sources. 
- Communication, interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisors, the public, etc. are sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction. 
- Assists in preparation of long-range data management strategies. 

Visit www.libertycareers.com for more information.

Background checks/drug-free workplace.

  • Collaborate across technical and business teams on evolving priorities
  • Contribute to backend dataset development and visualization improvements

 

Required Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics or BI roles
  • Strong SQL skills and quantitative problem-solving ability
  • Experience building dashboards and user-friendly visualizations
  • Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data modeling framework
  • 2+ years of Power BI experience
  • Experience programming in a collaborative environment
  • Familiarity with version control workflows
  • Ability to design and communicate KPI choices effectively

 

Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

  • Experience with Snowflake

  • Exposure to Prefect, Terraform, or CI/CD tools

Perks & Benefits:

  • This opportunity includes a comprehensive and competitive benefits package—details will be shared during later stages of the hiring process.

companySlogan: Eliminating waste at every turn.
descriptionHtml:
Why Tosca?

At Tosca, we’re redefining supply chains by delivering innovative solutions that drive sustainability, efficiency, and performance. As a leader in reusable packaging, we thrive on collaboration, transparency, and doing the right thing. Here, your work will matter. You’ll lead change, drive impact, and shape the future of how products move through global supply chains. Join a team where your voice is heard, your ideas have power, and your career can grow.


What You'll Do

You’ll own some of our most important BI work in North America, from complex Power BI solutions to the metric logic and semantic models behind them. You’ll also partner closely with Data Engineering and help set the technical standard for the broader BI team.


  • Own the North America semantic model, KPI logic, and shared metric definitions.
  • Lead complex, multi-source and performance-critical BI builds.
  • Build and optimize Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to prototype and implement business logic within our Snowflake/dbt environment.
  • Help define what the business should measure — not just how it should be reported.
  • Set BI development standards and support design reviews.
  • Mentor BI Developers and collaborate across BI, Data Engineering, and Data Quality teams.
  • Evaluate new BI capabilities, including AI-assisted development, embedded analytics, and self-service tools.


What We Are Looking For

We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can also understand the business questions behind the numbers. This person should be comfortable working independently, challenging assumptions, and communicating with both technical teams and business leaders.


  • 7+ years of BI development experience or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Expert-level Power BI experience.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with warehouse data.
  • Deep understanding of dimensional modeling and semantic-model design.
  • Hands-on experience with either warehouse/dimensional design or dbt transformation development.
  • Experience delivering BI solutions through the full development lifecycle.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to challenge or refine KPI definitions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Work Schedule

On-site Tuesday–Thursday; remote Monday and Friday (company-paid parking). Regular in‑office presence is essential for effective team collaboration, engagement, and relationship‑building. Hybrid and remote work schedules typically consist of nine hours per day, five days per week, with a 60‑minute lunch break. Business needs may require occasional work outside standard hours, including on‑site attendance as needed to support team and operational requirements.


Benefits

Tosca offers a comprehensive benefits package to our team members. Full-time employees (30+ hours per week) have access to multiple healthcare plan options (including medical, dental, and vision coverage), a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match, paid time off, paid parental leave, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability coverage, as well as long-term disability for eligible roles. We also provide tax-advantaged health accounts (HSA with employer contributions and FSA programs), an Employee Assistance Program, and a range of additional perks – such as a fitness reimbursement program, educational assistance, employee discount programs, and optional supplemental insurance (e.g., accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity) and legal/identity theft protection plans.


Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Tosca, we believe in fostering a workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity. We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to creating an inclusive and equitable environment where all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.


Compliance

Tosca participates in the E-Verify program to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information, please visit the E-Verify website.

descriptionHtml:
Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. By utilizing enhanced automatic speech recognition, human captioning, and innovative product development, we deliver easy-to-use, cutting-edge technology to our primarily senior customer base. Our near real-time phone captioning technology allows individuals with hearing loss to see what callers are saying, enabling them to regain their connection to the world.

ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations.

For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.

The kind of people we look for:

  • Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
  • Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
  • Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
  • Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

Summary:

The BI Report Developer has a strong focus on working within the enterprise. The role is crucial in leveraging Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, and Synapse Analytics as structured data sources to create insightful and actionable reports. The BI Report Developer contributes to data governance and change control processes and excels in delivering high-quality presentations to internal stakeholders.

What This Role Does:

  • Designs, develops, and deploys advanced Power BI reports and dashboards using structured data from Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse, SQL Server, and Synapse Analytics.
  • Utilizes DAX expertise to create complex calculations, measures, and KPIs that provide meaningful insights to business users.
  • Implements row-level security measures within Power BI to ensure data confidentiality and compliance with organizational policies.
  • Collaborates with data engineering teams to optimize structured data models for enhanced report performance and user experience.
  • Manages Fabric capacity resources, monitors usage, and optimizes performance to ensure efficient report rendering.
  • Participates in data governance initiatives and adheres to change control processes to maintain data accuracy and consistency.
  • Performs thorough data analysis, distills insights, and crafts compelling data-driven narratives for effective storytelling.
  • Utilizes advanced visualization techniques to create interactive and visually appealing reports that convey complex information clearly.
  • Presents complex findings and reports to executive stakeholders in a clear, professional, and impactful manner.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves issues related to report performance, data accuracy, and visualizations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, business, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • A minimum of three (3) years of hands-on experience as a Power BI developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing diverse and impactful reports, is required.
  • Expertise in working with structured data from Tabular Models, SQL Server, and Synapse Analytics as data sources.
  • Proficiency in writing complex DAX expressions and calculations to meet advanced reporting requirements.
  • Familiarity with Power BI security mechanisms.
  • Strong data modeling skills within Power BI, including structured data transformation and optimization.
  • Intermediate skills in Power BI Desktop, including using custom visuals, themes, and advanced interactivity.
  • Exceptional data analysis, storytelling, and visualization skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to confidently present to executive-level stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities, maintaining professionalism under pressure and demonstrating attention to detail.
  • Ability to guide and support others through collaboration, including assisting teammates and contributing to shared processes, to foster a high-quality, team-oriented environment that drives results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.
  • Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed, including availability for off-hours support as part of an on-call rotation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and modern communication tools for virtual teams (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Slack).

Preferred:

  • Scrum, Jira, or DevOps experience.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric/OneLake.
  • Relevant Power BI certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate or Microsoft Certified: Power BI.

Physical Demands:

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with documented disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodations would impose an undue hardship. Employees seeking accommodation should contact the People Department to initiate the interactive process.

Employees may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time:

  • Sitting, standing, and walking (95-100%)
  • Keyboarding (70-90%)
  • Viewing computer monitor, tablet, and cell phone requiring close vision (70-90%)

Work Environment:

100% Remote: Work environment is at home.

Compensation:

$95,000 to $100,800 determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity considerations. Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. For details on our comprehensive benefits program, visit www.clearcaptions.com/careers to explore our total rewards package.

Intrigued to learn more?

When you apply for this role, your information will be personally reviewed by our talent acquisition team (not by a robot). You can expect to hear back from us if we think there could be a fit and what next steps look like.

ClearCaptions is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusion and diversity. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Disclaimer:

The above information in this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to do this job.

ClearCaptions does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work for any employer in the US without a current or future need for Visa sponsorship.

Protecting Your Candidate Experience

At ClearCaptions, your candidate experience matters to us. To ensure transparency and security throughout the hiring process, please keep the following in mind:

  • All legitimate ClearCaptions job openings are posted exclusively on this careers page.
  • Our recruiters will only contact you from verified @clearcaptions.com email addresses.
  • We will never offer a job through LinkedIn messages or any social media platform.
  • We will never ask for sensitive personal information (like banking details or Social Security numbers) during early stages of the hiring process.

We encourage all applicants to stay vigilant against online job scams, especially those that misuse company names or logos to appear legitimate. If you receive a message that seems suspicious or doesn’t follow these guidelines, please don’t engage. You’re welcome to verify any opportunity by reaching out to us directly at recruiting@clearcaptions.com.

We’re committed to a hiring process that is respectful, secure, and clear every step of the way.

About HCC/CCI

Henry Crown & Company/CC Industries is a Chicago-based, privately-held company that manages business, philanthropic, and family interests on behalf of a multi-generational family. The business ventures fall into broadly-defined categories: wholly-owned operating companies, public and private equity investments, and real estate. The enterprise also supports individual and collective giving through Crown Family Philanthropies and provides traditional family office services across generations. The enterprise employs approximately 350 professionals in the areas of investment management, corporate development, financial operations, tax, research and innovation, human resources, information technologies, and legal.

Why work for us?

We are a private enterprise with more than a 100-year legacy and track record of financial success, supporting our communities, and taking care of our employees. We plan strategically with a long-term time horizon and an integrated approach to access superior opportunities and optimize financial results. Integrity, collaboration, and dedication are cornerstones of our workplace culture that create rewarding professional experiences.

Position Description

The Advanced Data Visualization Analyst designs and develops Power BI dashboards and reports that transform complex data into clear, actionable insights for teams across Henry Crown & Company. As a member of the Business Intelligence team, this individual partners with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand business needs and build reporting solutions that support informed decision-making. Responsibilities include developing and maintaining visualizations, supporting data modeling and reporting automation, and ensuring report accuracy and usability. This role offers opportunities to contribute to projects across the organization while building technical expertise through collaboration with experienced team members.

Responsibilities

  • Develop Data Visualizations: Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI to visualize complex data for key business stakeholders.
  • Develop Automation Flows: Build and maintain flows in Power Automate to orchestrate key reporting workflows.
  • Optimize Data Models: Create and maintain data models in Azure Synapse and Power BI to support reliable reporting solutions, with some direction from senior team members on complex work.
  • Enhance Reporting Capabilities: Continuously monitor and improve the performance and accuracy of Power BI reports and Azure Synapse queries to meet evolving business needs.
  • Ensure Data Governance: Adhere to and enforce data governance best practices to ensure data quality, consistency, and security.
  • Support Stakeholders: Provide training and ongoing support to business users for self-service analytics and BI tool usage.
  • Document Processes: Create and maintain documentation for data models, ETL workflows, and visualizations.
  • Leverage AI Visualization Tools: Utilize Microsoft Copilot for Power BI, AI visuals, and smart narrative features to accelerate report development and surface automated insights for business stakeholders.
  • Stay Current with Trends: Keep up with the latest trends and updates in Azure, Power BI, and data visualization tools, and share knowledge with the team.
  • Support Data-Driven Decisions: Provide ad hoc support for data queries and analysis to aid in decision-making for various departments.
  • Backup and Cross-Training: Serve as a backup for other team members in the event of absence, covering essential data analysis and reporting functions.
  • Explore AI Enhancements: Experiment with and evaluate emerging AI capabilities in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including Copilot-generated report summaries and AI-powered anomaly detection, and share findings with the BI team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate preferred.
  • Approximately 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, with growing proficiency in Power BI. Demonstrated experience working with Azure Synapse Analytics or other Azure cloud-based tools required.
  • Knowledge:
    • Working knowledge of Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and report/dashboard creation, applied with growing independence and consistency.
    • General understanding of Power Automate, including how to create and maintain flows.
    • Working knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics for data modeling, ETL processes, and building data pipelines.
    • General understanding of Microsoft Fabric and its role in advanced analytics.
  • Skills:
    • Data Visualization: Ability to translate data sets into clear, actionable visualizations using Power BI, with growing originality and consistency in design and delivery.
    • SQL Proficiency: Working proficiency in SQL for data retrieval, filtering, and reporting queries, with ability to write and troubleshoot queries with growing independence.
    • Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights and technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • AI-Augmented Analytics: Working knowledge of AI features within Power BI (Copilot, Q&A, Smart Narratives, Key Influencers) and the ability to incorporate AI-driven visuals and natural-language summaries into dashboards and reports.
  • Abilities:
    • Ability to apply data visualization concepts and tools with growing independence, requiring limited supervision on routine tasks.
    • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to project work with some responsibility and specific direction.
    • Ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications, applying some evaluation and originality in approach.
The Starting Salary Range: $93k - $105k. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. To see an overview of all our benefits please go to our career portal here .

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, members of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals experiencing disability and BIPOC are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At CC Industries we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Overview

The Business Intelligence Analyst III / IV is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and visual analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role transforms complex data into meaningful reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support operational and strategic business outcomes.

The associate partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data engineering partners to deliver scalable visual reporting solutions, establish semantic modeling standards, and translate advanced analyses into clear recommendations. Microsoft Power BI is the primary business intelligence platform for this role; however, the associate is expected to remain agile and use Apache Superset or other visualization tools when they are better suited to the business need.

As a member of an agile team, the incumbent contributes to solution design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, production support, report certification, and modernization of enterprise reporting assets. The role focuses on business intelligence and visual analytics rather than primary ownership of source-data engineering or Power BI tenant administration.

Level Expectations

Business Intelligence Analyst III: Designs end-to-end BI solutions, including semantic and metric layers, data models, reports, and dashboards. Applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to move reporting from descriptive insight toward diagnostic analysis of performance drivers and customer behavior, while introducing predictive approaches where appropriate. Works independently with minimal guidance, leads solution components, partners with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, and provides technical guidance to peers.

Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Leads the design of complex, reusable BI solutions and serves as a technical lead for reporting and analytics initiatives. Balances regular delivery responsibilities with leadership of cross-functional projects, establishes semantic modeling and reporting standards, reviews technical designs, influences BI architecture and tooling decisions, and mentors analysts and developers across levels.

Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end business intelligence solutions, including semantic and metric layers, dimensional data models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visual analytics products.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using DAX, Power Query, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, performance drivers, customer behaviors, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Translate descriptive reporting into diagnostic insight and introduce predictive approaches where appropriate to the business question and available data.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, evaluate findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, compelling recommendations.
  • Establish, document, and promote semantic modeling standards, reusable design patterns, visualization standards, and reporting best practices.
  • Support report certification by validating solution quality, consistency, usability, maintainability, performance, documentation, and adherence to established standards.
  • Publish and support Power BI solutions through Power BI Service, including Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Optimize report and semantic model performance, refresh reliability, storage-mode selection, and overall user experience across BI platforms.
  • Assess the downstream impact of design choices involving Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Row-Level Security, refresh strategies, and available Power BI capacity.
  • Evaluate visualization technologies and select Power BI, Apache Superset, or other appropriate tools based on business need, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Use Snowflake and other approved enterprise data sources to deliver reliable, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and technology partners to ensure source data is available, reliable, understandable, and usable for reporting.
  • Document report definitions, calculations, assumptions, semantic models, technical designs, and support procedures.
  • Lead improvements to reporting processes, including automation of recurring outputs and reduction of manual effort.
  • Support report migration and modernization initiatives, including conversion of legacy reporting solutions to modern BI platforms and reusable semantic model architectures.
  • Perform testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and post-implementation support.
  • Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, status reporting, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members through design, DAX, query, and solution reviews.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Serve as technical lead for complex reporting and analytics initiatives, lead cross-team projects, review technical designs, and mentor analysts and developers across levels.

Qualifications

  • Advanced experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, Power Query, data visualization, and enterprise BI architecture.
  • Experience publishing and supporting Power BI solutions through Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries used in reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable solutions with minimal guidance.
  • Must have the following experience:
  • Business Intelligence Analyst III: 4-7 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: 7-10 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, semantic models, and visual analytics solutions.
  • Experience partnering with stakeholders to define business questions, gather requirements, assess findings, and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with enterprise data platforms and large-scale datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Microsoft Power BI administration certification or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of Power BI administration concepts.
  • Strongly preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric features such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, and related capabilities.
  • Strongly preferred experience using Snowflake as a primary enterprise data source for reporting and analytics.
  • Experience with Apache Superset or other business intelligence and visualization platforms, with the ability to select the appropriate visual tool for the business use case.
  • Experience developing or supporting Apache Airflow workflows.
  • Experience with Power BI Project (PBIP) formats and collaborative development of Power BI assets.
  • Experience using Git-based version control, including branching, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Knowledge of Power BI administration and architecture concepts, including capacity management, storage modes, licensing, workspaces, tenant considerations, governance, and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of performance and capacity considerations involving DirectQuery, Import mode, composite models, incremental refresh, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to generate or refine scripts, troubleshoot solutions, create documentation, support testing, and accelerate analytics delivery.
  • Working knowledge of Python, scripting, or related programming concepts, with emphasis on effectively reviewing, validating, and applying AI-generated code.
  • Experience supporting report certification, semantic modeling standards, and reporting modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or a comparable agile work management and delivery platform.
  • Property and Casualty insurance, claims analytics, finance analytics, or enterprise reporting experience.

Annual Salary

$109,675.00 - $172,200.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment.   • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Proven ability translating business requirements into useful reports.

  • Experience working with global team

What We Offer:

Comprehensive Benefits

  • Health, dental, and vision plans
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Short- and long-term disability, life, and accidental insurance
  • 15 PTO days and 11 paid holidays

Work-Life Balance

Ongoing Training & Recognition

  • Get up to speed quickly with our structured onboarding process.
  • Access to online courses to keep your skills sharp and up to date.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues and industry experts.
  • Length of Service awards to celebrate your milestones.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

ASSA ABLOY fosters a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. We celebrate diversity and strive for equity in all aspects of our organization. Together, we innovate and create solutions that serve our global community.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

descriptionHtml:
Who are we? 

A strategic and trusted insurance partner, Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance (BHSI), provides a broad range of commercial property, casualty and specialty insurance coverages and outstanding service to customers and brokers around the world. Part of Berkshire Hathaway’s insurance operations, we bring our solutions to market with our stellar brand name, top-rated balance sheet, and the expertise of our global team of professionals, who exude excellent capabilities and strong character.

We are a values-based organization where respect, integrity, excellence, collaboration, and passion define who we are and how we do business. We value diversity of backgrounds, experience, and perspectives and strive to foster an inclusive environment that enables all our team members to bring their best selves to work. We are one team committed to building a culture where every teammate has the opportunity to contribute and be recognized. Want to be part of the team building the finest property, casualty and specialty lines insurance company in the world?

Learn more about our unique  culture  and  history .

Job Opportunity: 

BHSI has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Business Intelligence Engineer to join our Global Business Intelligence team in Boston, Massachusetts. This role will support BHSI’s Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) business, including our digital and direct-to-broker distribution capabilities.

The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer will partner closely with business, underwriting, operations, technology, Data Engineering, and BI teammates to design, build, and evolve the reporting and analytics capabilities needed to support a growing, digitally enabled insurance business. This individual will develop a strong understanding of the SME business and translate business requirements into trusted data models, semantic models, dashboards, reporting, analytics, and reusable data products.

As part of the Global Business Intelligence organization, this role will apply consistent BI engineering standards while ensuring solutions meet the unique needs of the SME business. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capability, analytical thinking, business curiosity, and a commitment to data quality, with the ability to collaborate across business and technical teams and independently deliver production-quality BI solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of SME business processes, products, distribution models, performance drivers, and information needs and apply that knowledge to BI solution design.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and BI leaders to translate business questions and analytical needs into scalable solutions and prioritized deliverables.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and reusable analytical data products that provide a trusted view of SME business performance.
  • Build and maintain reporting across the SME insurance lifecycle, including submissions, indications, quotes, binds, policies, premium, portfolio performance, distribution, and operational activity.
  • Use advanced SQL to investigate, transform, validate, reconcile, and optimize complex datasets across multiple source systems and analytical platforms.
  • Develop dimensional and semantic models that support consistent business definitions, reusable measures, governed datasets, and self-service analytics.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to define data requirements, improve data quality, resolve defects, and deliver scalable and reliable data pipelines and analytical solutions.
  • Monitor and improve the usability, reliability, performance, and adoption of BI solutions while reducing fragmented or manually assembled reporting.
  • Contribute to the Global BI Center of Excellence through reusable patterns, standards, templates, documentation, and technical best practices.

Required

Qualifications, Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, analytics, reporting, data management, or a related discipline.
  • Strong understanding of insurance reporting and analytics concepts.
  • Advanced SQL skills with the ability to independently investigate, analyze, validate, and reconcile complex datasets.
  • Strong experience with Power BI or comparable enterprise BI and visualization platforms.
  • Experience working with dimensional models, semantic models, data warehouses, or modern analytical data platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business questions into analytical solutions, reporting, and actionable insights.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and build trusted relationships across business and technology teams.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting digital insurance, small commercial insurance, direct-to-broker, or other high-volume transactional businesses.
  • Familiarity with insurance lifecycle concepts, including submissions, indications, quotes, binds, policies, premium, distribution, and underwriting performance.
  • Experience developing enterprise semantic models, governed BI datasets, and reusable data products.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure-based analytics technologies, or modern cloud-based analytical platforms.
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, data quality initiatives, or business data dictionaries.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery models and business-led analytical environments.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Senior Business Intelligence Engineer will:

  • Become a trusted BI partner for the SME business and a subject matter expert on both the business and its underlying data.
  • Establish a consistent, trusted view of performance across the SME business.
  • Build scalable, governed BI capabilities that reduce fragmented or manually assembled reporting.
  • Create stronger alignment around SME business definitions, KPIs, and performance measurement.
  • Develop and execute a BI roadmap driven by business value and strategic priorities.
  • Strengthen collaboration between business stakeholders, BI, Data Engineering, and Technology teams.
  • Balance the speed and agility needed for a digital business with the governance and consistency expected of an enterprise BI function.

BHSI Offers

  • A competitive package and exciting growth opportunities for career-oriented teammates.
  • A dynamic, action oriented, and thoughtful environment centered on always doing the right thing for our customers, teammates, and our other stakeholders.
  • A purposely non-bureaucratic organization that embraces simplicity over complexity and emphasizes individual excellence in a team framework.
  • Benefits that support your life and well-being, which include:
  • Comprehensive Health, Dental and Vision benefits
  • Disability Insurance (both short-term and long-term)
  • Life Insurance (for you and your family)
  • Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance (for you and your family)
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Health Reimbursement Account
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Retirement Savings 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Generous holiday and Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Parental Leave

The base salary range for this position in Boston, MA is $110,000 to $130,000, along with annual bonus eligibility. Total compensation for a candidate is determined by their relevant skills, location, and experience. We value our teammates – both their capabilities and character – as demonstrated by our amazing culture.

NOTE: Compensation will be commensurate with experience. This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Team Member may perform other related duties as negotiated to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

TherapyNotes® is an online practice management system for behavioral health, featuring robust notes, scheduling, and billing features.

The heart of TherapyNotes® is the notes system. Whereas most practice management systems offer a generic free-form text area, TherapyNotes® offers an easy-to-use form-filled approach, greatly speeding up data entry and note writing.

TherapyNotes® also offers a powerful “to do” list which automatically directs clinicians regarding what actions need to be taken such as notes to write after sessions, to contact the primary care physician when appropriate, or reminders to schedule treatment plan updates.

TherapyNotes® was developed by the husband and wife team: Dr. Debra Pliner, clinical psychologist, and Brad Pliner, web technologies expert, to fill a need for a practice management system that was built for the unique needs of mental health practitioners.
companySlogan: TherapyNotes® is the industry-preferred online EHR for behavioral health. Try one month free!

About Us

TherapyNotes is the go-to superhero for behavioral health Practice Management and EHR software! Our top-notch SaaS solution handles scheduling, billing, documenting, telehealth, and more so clinicians can focus on awesome patient care.

We're a dynamic team of pros who love to innovate and push the envelope, keeping our software cutting-edge. Join us, and let's revolutionize behavioral health software together while making a real difference!

Description

The BI Developer at TherapyNotes is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role transforms raw data into meaningful insights through interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations, primarily using Microsoft Power BI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in data modeling and reporting, proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance development efficiency, troubleshoot complex challenges, and optimize solutions, and the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders to deliver clear, actionable insights.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, publish, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather reporting and analytics requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Develop and maintain data models, including performing data transformations and optimizing queries for performance
  • Connect and integrate Power BI with various data sources, including SQL databases, Excel files, and cloud-based data services
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and appropriate access controls across reports and dashboards
  • Monitor and optimize report performance, usability, and reliability
  • Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT to accelerate Power BI development, including complex DAX expressions, data models, and reporting solutions
  • Provide documentation, guidance, and training to end users to promote effective use of business intelligence tools
  • Continuously enhance reporting solutions based on user feedback and evolving business needs
  • Support broader analytics initiatives by helping establish best practices for data visualization, reporting, and data governance

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience developing business intelligence or analytics solutions using Power BI or similar BI tools
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • Strong experience with Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling
  • Strong experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to enhance productivity and efficiency in Power BI development
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated solutions and validate their accuracy, performance, and adherence to Power BI development best practices
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Understanding of data warehousing concepts, data pipelines, and ETL processes
  • Ability to analyze complex datasets and present insights in a clear and meaningful way
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with careful attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Benefits

  • Competitive salary - $100,000-$125,000
  • Employer sponsored health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Retirement plan with company contribution
  • Annual company profit sharing
  • Personal development/training budget
  • Open, collaborative work environment
  • Extensive 2-week onboarding plan
  • Comprehensive mentorship program

Participate in a cross-functional team environment responsible for development and support of core Dairy Farmers of America (DFA) business applications and processes. The Business Intelligence (BI) analyst / developer will architect, develop, and provide operational support skills to deliver and maintain Snowflake and Power BI data platforms, data warehousing, business intelligence, reporting, and visualization solutions for a wide range of business functions and user communities. The BI analyst / developer will function as part of DFA’s IT organization and follow relevant applications, infrastructure and governance processes.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Snowflake/Power BI data models, schemas, tables, and views to support enterprise BI, analytics, and reporting.
  • Build and optimize BI data pipelines and transformation processes, ensuring efficient performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain transformations, stored procedures, tasks, and data integration processes within Snowflake and Microsoft.
  • Translate business requirements into well-governed, reusable data models aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Define and enforce development standards, naming conventions, data governance, and data modeling best practices.
  • Coordinate development, testing, deployment, and change management activities with business analysts and BI team members.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve query performance, warehouse efficiency, data quality, cost management, and usability.
  • The requirements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employee, but is not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as required.

,

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer or Data Science or equivalent experience
  • 2-3 years of experience as a SQL developer, Snowflake developer, Data Warehouse developer, or BI Developer
  • Strong skills with Snowflake and SQL

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and relational data concepts
  • Knowledge of Snowflake architecture, development, and performance optimization
  • Working knowledge of Power BI and enterprise reporting concepts
  • Familiarity with working in an Agile development environment

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Able to work on-call rotation
  • Able to demonstrate written and verbal communications skills with the ability to effectively communicate with business users, stakeholders, technical teams, and various levels of management
  • Able to work independently
  • Able to work on multiple projects simultaneously, including the ability to prioritize
  • Able to organize time and resources effectively to achieve goals (i.e., organizational skills)
  • Able to demonstrate leadership qualities as a self-starter, set direction, and complete assignments
  • Able to interact effectively and cooperatively with employees at all levels
  • Able to demonstrate strong customer service orientation
  • Strong work ethic
  • Must be able to read, write, and speak English

An Equal Opportunity Employer including Disabled/Veterans

descriptionHtml:
Pay: $110,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Job Description: Power BI Developer (Hybrid)

Constellation is seeking a Power BI Developer to join our Homeland Security Team in Washington, D.C. This role requires advanced dashboarding and data analysis skills. The developer will design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that integrate operational and financial data to create meaningful, actionable insights for stakeholders. This role requires a strong understanding of SQL and coordination with other developers for extraction, transformation, and loading of data. This position is client-facing and requires excellent communication to translate complex technical outputs into clear business value.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards, reports, and data models using Power BI and other visualization tools
  • Design, build, and maintain data ETL pipelines from sources such as SQL databases, SharePoint, and Excel
  • Collaborate with end users and technical resources to understand and integrate data outputs into visualizations effectively
  • Translate complex data findings into clear, digestible insights for stakeholders to support data-driven decision-making
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reports and dashboards
The ideal candidate must have the following experience, background, and credentials:
  • At least 4 years of experience working with large datasets in a Data Visualization tool like Power BI, Tableau or Qlik
  • Advanced understanding of SQL including query optimization, common table expressions (CTEs), and complex joins for deep-dive analysis
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel for standard data analysis tasks (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, complex formulas)
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to gather requirements, present solutions, and translate complex data findings into clear insights for non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree is required, with major in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field preferred
  • Must be a U.S. citizen, able to pass a background investigation by the client agency. DHS clearance with CBP or ICE preferred
  • Experience developing in Python (Pandas) for data analysis is preferred
  • Experience developing PowerApps and Power Automate solutions is preferred
Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Washington, DC (Hybrid)

Education: Bachelor's Degree with major in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field (Required) 

Experience: Power BI OR Tableau OR Qlik: 4 years (Required)

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) contribution
  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life & Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Paid time off
  • Professional development 
  • Employee assistance program
  • Work-life balance

Application Question(s):

  • This position requires U.S. citizenship. Are you a U.S. citizen currently residing in the U.S.?
  • Do you have a DHS or DOD clearance?

Job Title: Commercial Intelligence Specialist

Location: Houston

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities:

  • Power BI Development – Design, development, and optimisation of advanced dashboards, reports, and models within Power BI, ensuring usability and scalability across the business. This includes local desktop development as well as in the Power BI / Fabric service.
  • SQL & Data Modelling – Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries to support analytics and reporting requirements.
  • Cross-functional collaboration – Working with a variety of stakeholders and seniority levels to understand business problems and provide solutions through interactive self-service reports.
  • Issue Resolution – Identify root cause of technical issues and responding to queries in a timely manner, including supporting other teams ad-hoc where necessary.
  • Continuous Improvement – Stay current with Microsoft BI & Fabric updates, recommending and implementing improvements to data workflows and reporting.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s STEM degree
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics roles.
  • Expertise in Power BI – advanced DAX, data modelling, performance optimization, and deployment.
  • Strong SQL skills with ability to optimize.
  • Microsoft Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric a plus.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - able to work effectively with others.
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and deliver measurable business impact.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive nature.

Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking – Capable of aligning technical solutions with commercial objectives.
  • Collaboration – Adept at working cross-functionally and influencing decision-making in a matrixed organization.
  • Problem Solving – Able to diagnose data issues, propose solutions, and implement improvements quickly.
  • Commercial Acumen – Understands the dynamics of sales and commercial operations, ensuring analytics directly support performance improvement.
  • Professional Output – Strives to deliver solutions that are polished, professional, and easy to use

Commercial at AVEVA

Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

USA Benefits include:

Flex work hours, 20 days PTO rising to 25 with service, three paid volunteering days, primary and secondary parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Position: Senior Power BI Developer

 

Compensation: $133-$150k, depending on experience

 

Location: Remote

 

Inceed has partnered with a great company to help find a skilled Senior Power BI Developer to join their team!

 

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on BI professional to step into a high-impact role and help shape enterprise reporting from the ground up. You’ll own semantic models, build impactful dashboards, and support a growing analytics team with modern Power BI solutions. If you enjoy solving complex data challenges, partnering across teams, and building scalable reporting assets, this role offers plenty of room to make a visible difference.

 

Key Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Design and maintain enterprise semantic models using dimensional design.
  • Build advanced DAX measures, calculation groups, and time intelligence logic.
  • Create interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for business users.
  • Develop paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder and PBIRS.
  • Support source control and CI/CD for Power BI projects.
  • Improve performance through tuning, folding, and model optimization.
  • Implement RLS, OLS, sensitivity labels, and dataset governance.
  • Work with data engineering teams to shape and validate source data.
  • Document models, lineage, and reporting standards.
  • Mentor others and support broader BI best practices.
 

Required Qualifications & Experience:

  • 5–7 years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • 15+ years of overall BI and reporting experience.
  • Strong experience with enterprise semantic model design.
  • Deep knowledge of DAX and performance tuning.
  • Experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.
  • Skilled in Power Query and SQL for data preparation.
  • Experience with CI/CD and source-controlled BI development.
  • Understanding of row-level and object-level security.
 

Perks & Benefits:

  • This opportunity includes a comprehensive and competitive benefits package—details will be shared during later stages of the hiring process.
  • Exceptional medical coverage at a very reasonable cost.
  • Four floating holidays in addition to standard holidays.
  • 15 days of prorated vacation in the first year.
 

Other Information:

  • This position can be fully remote
  • This position requires a background check and drug test
 

If you are interested in learning more about the Senior Power BI Developer opportunity, please submit your resume for consideration. Our client unable to provide sponsorship at this time.

Description

Amazon MGM Studios is one of the largest and most ambitious content studios in the world. The Prime Video Finance Analytics organization supports this business with a centralized team of 40+ technical specialists spanning data engineering, business intelligence, data science, and product development, powering the data platforms and reporting that inform how content is planned, evaluated, and optimized across the entire Prime Video portfolio.

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to join a dedicated, LA-based Studios Analytics team embedded alongside Amazon MGM Studios leadership. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Studios Analytics, you will build the dashboards, automated reporting, and AI-assisted tooling that give Studios leaders and the Strategy organization real-time visibility into content performance and portfolio health. You will translate the questions of senior content decision-makers into clear, reliable analytical products — and you will do it as part of a larger central technical organization, leveraging shared infrastructure, governed datasets, and established tooling rather than building in isolation.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for someone who is energized by turning messy content and performance data into trusted, self-service reporting that leadership relies on daily.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards, automated reporting, and analytical tooling that surface title-level performance (launch KPIs, completion, retention) and portfolio views for Studios leadership, primarily through FrameOne and related surfaces.
  • Automate high-volume, manual workflows — including templated title-level reporting, talent-facing presentations, and slate/portfolio summaries — with a bias toward scalable, reusable solutions over one-off outputs.
  • Partner directly with Studios Strategy, Finance, and content stakeholders to refine ambiguous requests into specific, well-scoped deliverables, anticipating downstream needs.
  • Write efficient, well-tested SQL and BI logic against governed datasets, ensuring your solutions are maintainable, performant, and resistant to data quality issues.
  • Uphold central metric governance — using the single-source-of-truth definitions for content metrics so that Studios reporting is consistent with official Prime Video and finance reporting.
  • Apply AI-assisted tooling to accelerate delivery, in partnership with the organization's AI enablement function.
  • Collaborate closely with data engineers, product development, and the financial reporting team to deliver integrated, dependency-light solutions.
  • Enable self-service access to underlying data where appropriate, reducing reporting bottlenecks for business stakeholders.

About The Team

This role sits on a newly-expanded LA Studios Analytics team embedded with Studios but part of the broader 40+ person central Prime Video Finance Analytics organization. This structure is deliberate: you'll have the proximity of a small, focused team partnering directly with Studios VPs and Strategy, with the leverage of shared central infrastructure, governed data, and a dedicated AI enablement function behind you.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • Knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts
  • Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, and forecasting to guide business decisions
  • Knowledge of methods for statistical inference (e.g. regression, experimental design, significance testing)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
  • Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems as it pertains to data storage and computing
  • Knowledge of basic modeling techniques such as linear regression, ANOVA etc.
  • Experience in digital media/marketing strategy, data analysis, analytics & visualization
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to accelerate analytical or reporting workflows.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Intelligence Analyst develops, maintains, and enhances Power BI reports that turn data from relational databases, the enterprise data warehouse, and data marts into reliable, business-facing analytics. You will partner with business stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and take assignments from requirements through implementation and ongoing support. Responsibilities include investigating and transforming data using T-SQL and Power Query, developing Power BI semantic models and DAX measures, building interactive reports, optimizing performance, and validating results against source data and business requirements before release.

The ideal candidate has strong T-SQL and DAX skills and experience working with complex datasets and data relationships. You will work with the business and the Business Intelligence team to resolve data quality issues and identify reporting data needs, document report logic and definitions, and apply sound technical judgment and independent problem-solving skills to deliver accurate, maintainable reporting solutions.

This job might be for you if you're interested in:

  • Working at a member-focused, mission-driven, not-for-profit organization.
  • Joining a welcoming and supportive environment where you can make an impact on patient care.
  • Enjoying excellent work-life balance, reasonable working hours, and generally no evening or weekend work in a hybrid or fully remote environment.
  • Receiving a competitive compensation package that includes outstanding medical and dental benefits, an employer-funded 403(b) retirement contribution of 10 to 15 percent of salary after one year of service, generous time off including a week-long Winter Break, paid parental leave, and more.
  • Expanding your skills through training and professional development, including Microsoft Fabric and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Joining a team with longstanding tenure at RSNA, a culture of continuous improvement, a strong sense of teamwork, and a fabulous sense of humor.
  • Solving a variety of challenges in your day-to-day work.

Responsibilities

  • Write, optimize, and maintain T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and aggregate data for reporting.
  • Design, build, and publish Power BI reports, including the semantic model, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, interactive features appropriate to the business need, and scheduled refresh.
  • Meet with business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements, identify appropriate data sources, and determine the T-SQL and Power BI approach.
  • Validate report output against source data and resolve discrepancies before release.
  • Support and enhance existing reports, including troubleshooting issues reported by stakeholders and updating logic as business rules change.
  • Document report logic, data definitions, and validation so that others can maintain the work.
  • Identify trends and relationships across data sources and translate findings into business insights for stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical reasoning and problem-solving: Investigates unfamiliar data, tests assumptions, evaluates potential approaches, and develops solutions without relying on step-by-step direction.
  • Resourcefulness and ownership: Moves work forward independently, recognizes when additional information is needed, asks focused questions, and follows through to completion.
  • Creative report development: Translates business needs into clear, practical, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
  • Troubleshooting: Traces report results through T-SQL queries, Power Query transformations, model relationships, and DAX calculations to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Communication and collaboration: Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication skills, clearly explains technical decisions, raises questions and concerns promptly, and incorporates feedback from peer reviews and QA.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience and certifications.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in business intelligence or data analytics with strong proficiency in writing, reading, and debugging T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures, including the ability to explore an unfamiliar schema, profile data, and identify the right source tables.
  • 3+ years building Power BI reports in a production environment, including semantic modeling, DAX measures, and Power Query.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders, translate them into a technical approach, and deliver a complete, validated report independently and on schedule. Candidates should be prepared to walk through a report they built this way.

This job might be for you if you're interested in:



- Working at a member-focused, mission-driven, not-for-profit organization.
- Joining a welcoming and supportive environment where you can make an impact on patient care.
- Enjoying excellent work-life balance, reasonable working hours, and generally no evening or weekend work in a hybrid or fully remote environment.
- Receiving a competitive compensation package that includes outstanding medical and dental benefits, an employer-funded 403(b) retirement contribution of 10 to 15 percent of salary after one year of service, generous time off including a week-long Winter Break, paid parental leave, and more.
- Expanding your skills through training and professional development, including Microsoft Fabric and AI-assisted analytics.
- Joining a team with longstanding tenure at RSNA, a culture of continuous improvement, a strong sense of teamwork, and a fabulous sense of humor.
- Solving a variety of challenges in your day-to-day work.

Responsibilities



- Write, optimize, and maintain T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and aggregate data for reporting.

- Validate report output against source data and resolve discrepancies before release.
- Support and enhance existing reports, including troubleshooting issues reported by stakeholders and updating logic as business rules change.
- Document report logic, data definitions, and validation so that others can maintain the work.

Core Competencies



- Analytical reasoning and problem-solving: Investigates unfamiliar data, tests assumptions, evaluates potential approaches, and develops solutions without relying on step-by-step direction.

descriptionHtml:

You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer specializing in Microsoft Analytics, you will design and develop business intelligence, data warehousing, and reporting applications using Microsoft BI tools and products. You will utilize your strong foundation in SQL Server programming and experience with Power BI to deliver high-quality solutions.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Design and Develop BI Solutions: Design and develop business intelligence, data warehousing, and reporting applications using Microsoft BI tools and products such as Power BI, Power BI Report Builder, Power BI Embedded services, and SSRS.
