  • Implement Security Features: Implement security features to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data, while also optimizing Microsoft Power BI dashboards for usability, performance, flexibility, testability, and standardization.
  • Build Reports and Visualizations: Build reports and visualizations with Power BI to provide insights and support business decision-making.
  • Optimize Dashboard Performance: Optimize Microsoft Power BI dashboards to ensure they meet performance, flexibility, and standardization requirements.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Microsoft BI Tools Proficiency: Exposure to designing and developing business intelligence, data warehousing, and reporting applications using Microsoft BI tools and products such as Power BI, Power BI Report Builder, Power BI Embedded services, and SSRS.
  • Complex Query Development: Exposure to writing complex queries using Power Query, DAX, R, and TSQL to support business intelligence and reporting applications.
  • SQL Server Programming Foundation: Exposure to SQL Server programming, including building reports and visualizations with Power BI.
  • Security Feature Implementation: Experience with implementing security features to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data in Microsoft Power BI dashboards.
  • Dashboard Optimization: Experience with optimizing Microsoft Power BI dashboards for usability, performance, flexibility, testability, and standardization.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Advanced Power BI Skills: Experience with advanced Power BI features, including Power BI Embedded services and Power BI Report Builder, to design and develop complex business intelligence and reporting applications.
  • Data Visualization Expertise: Exposure to building interactive and dynamic reports and visualizations with Power BI to provide insights and support business decision-making.
  • Performance Optimization Techniques: Experience with optimizing Microsoft Power BI dashboards for usability, performance, flexibility, testability, and standardization to ensure seamless user experience.
  • Preferred Skills: Microsoft Technologies, Xpertdocs, Individual annuity

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

Who Are We?    

The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens, to venues such as St Andrews Links and Target Field, we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100 years of operation under our belt and a healthy tenure, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place in the Twin Cities to build a career.

Job Purpose

As a Data Analyst III, you will design and deliver analytics solutions that support the Commercial Sales, Marketing, and Distributor Development teams. Working independently and collaboratively, you will develop reports and dashboards, optimize data models and their performance. You will translate business needs into reliable insights, promote self-service analytics, and support effective decision-making across the division.

Through accurate data stewardship, responsive analysis, and continuous process improvement, you will help the division achieve its sales objectives.

What Will You Do? 

  • Develop, manage, and distribute interactive dashboards and reports, including advanced calculations and measures.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Distributor Development and stakeholders to define reporting needs and document requirements.
  • Design and optimize data models, calculated fields, semantic layers, and report performance.
  • Create and maintain standardized report templates and themes.
  • Ensure the accuracy and reliability of data, reports, and dashboards by troubleshooting data-quality, integration, and visualization issues.
  • Analyze business performance and provide actionable recommendations that support divisional objectives.
  • Own the customer-classification process to enable retail-sales analysis by market segment.
  • Support ad hoc analysis and reporting from Commercial Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Finance, Product Forecasting and Distributor Development.
  • Serve as a data steward by cleansing, maintaining, and compiling data as needed.
  • Support user adoption by maintaining system and process documentation, delivering demonstrations and training, and providing first-level support to internal and external users.
  • Plan and complete special projects that support Commercial Division strategies
  • Represent the division on enterprise-wide Business Intelligence initiatives.
  • Continuously improve Sales and Marketing information processes.
  • Other duties as requested or assigned by supervisor.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS) or a related field
  • Three to five years of experience in analytics or reporting development
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models that support decision-making and enable self-service analytics
  • Advanced experience with at least one business intelligence platform; Power BI with DAX experience preferred
  • Intermediate SQL and data-modeling skills
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms; Snowflake experience preferred
  • Experience developing semantic layers
  • Strong understanding of data visualization concepts
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated proficiency with other Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex data and insights clearly to stakeholders and executive leadership
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects

Other Job-Related Components

  • Occasional travel of less than 10% may be required
  • Hybrid work environment: 3 days in office required

What Can We Give You?    

At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical/dental/vision plan, 401k, and many other great benefits - The Toro company offers employees at our Bloomington, MN HQ location a variety of perks, including: 

  • Dress for your day - We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. 
  • Location – Conveniently located near both St. Paul and Minneapolis, we are centrally located for most commuters! 
  • Food - Take advantage of our onsite café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. With a Caribou Coffee attached, you can grab a snack and a coffee at any time during your day. 
  • Wellness - The Toro Company’s HQ offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical wellbeing, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.
  • Volunteerism - The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. 
  • Summer Hours – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at our Bloomington HQ are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. 
  • Competitive Salary – The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. It is not common to be hired at or near the top of the range; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is between $96,900 - $121,100. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. You may be eligible to participate in an incentive program, which rewards employees based on individual and organizational performance. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics. If you need to, you can access your pay early with the dailypay app.

At The Toro Company, we are committed to fostering a secure and trustworthy recruitment experience for our applicants. Recruitment fraud is a growing concern for job seekers, so please be aware that throughout our recruitment process, you’ll never be required to pay any fees or disclose personal financial details when applying to TTC opportunities. All legitimate job opportunities must be applied for directly through our official careers page at jobs.thetorocompany.com or via Workday, our applicant tracking system.

The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

descriptionHtml:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Visualization Engineer – Mid Level, you will analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to analysts and decision makers. You will identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to locate influences. You will create specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required or available data elements. You may participate in consultation to users and in cross functional teams to address business issues, and prototypes solutions for displaying information based on business needs.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently participates in gathering complex business requirements by partnering with customers to define the business problem and data needs.
  • Utilizes an intermediate understanding of multiple data structures and sources to lead the development and implementation of business intelligence solutions, which may include data visualization, data transformation, or data collection.
  • Works closely with IT execution teams on the development of analytic infrastructures, data engineering, or related business intelligence efforts.
  • Includes collaborating on the design and implementation of technical standards and governance practices.
  • Applies data visualization best practices - often selecting the right data 'tool for the job' - to identify and interpret trends or patterns while following standard Enterprise branding.
  • Understands the value of prototyping, usability, and the end-user experience to maximize the impact of the final data visualization product (dashboard, report, insight, or analysis).
  • Acts as a trusted data visualization advisor to the stakeholder/end-user in order to drive business value.
  • Develops advanced knowledge to influence relevant data, information, and application architecture decisions.
  • Actively participates in industry, COE, or other discipline-relevant groups/panels to keep abreast of industry trends and share best practices with team.
  • Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or a business or quantitative field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
  • 4 years of experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e.P&C, Bank, Finance, etc.)OR advanced degree in quantitative analytics field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science or other quantitative discipline with 2 years experience experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e.P&C, Bank, Finance, etc.).
  • Experience identifying and implementing innovative approaches to address business problems and solutions.
  • Experience developing business deliverables that leverage business intelligence platforms, data management platforms, or SQL-based languages (Tableau, Business Objects, Snowflake, Hadoop, Netezza, NoSQL, ANSI SQL, or related).
  • Proven ability to build business knowledge through meaningful partnerships at the individual contributor, leadership, and EMG levels.
  • Demonstrated advanced communication skills with the ability to deliver presentations to all levels of management.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed intuitive story telling within business intelligence solutions.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $85,040 - $162,550

USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description

The Senior BI Analyst will be responsible for developing, advancing, and driving adoption of Vistar’s reporting and analytics capabilities across the organization. This role partners with business stakeholders and IT to understand business needs, translate them into scalable, high-performing BI solutions, and transform data into actionable insights. The Senior BI Analyst will help shape data structure, integration, and reporting standards while enabling self-service analytics across the organization.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design and optimize dimensional models and semantic layers to support scalable BI solutions, self-service analytics, and a single source of truth.
  • Develop insightful and visually compelling Power BI reports and dashboards that transform data into actionable business insights.
  • Perform data analysis to validate assumptions, support decision-making, troubleshoot issues, and identify improvements in data quality and structure.
  • Communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and translate business needs into effective BI solutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Power BI, data modeling, Power Query, and DAX, providing guidance on best practices to team members and stakeholders.
  • Promote data accessibility, self-service analytics, and data literacy across the organization.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance standards, including data quality, privacy, security, and integrity.
  • Manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams to deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement by evaluating tools, techniques, and best practices that improve the effectiveness and performance of BI solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be local to the Denver area; out-of-state candidates will not be considered.
  • 5+ years of Power BI experience, with advanced expertise in developing and optimizing complex DAX calculations, data modeling, and data visualization.
  • Strong SQL experience, including data extraction, manipulation, and querying from relational databases.
  • Expertise in performance tuning and optimization of Power BI reports and SQL queries
  • Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling and Business Intelligence/Data Warehousing concepts.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with keen attention to detail and a passion for data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Compensation

$90,000 - $110,000 + 15% Annual Incentive Potential

descriptionHtml:
Nexora is seeking a Power BI Developer to join the Commercial Excellence team. This role owns the full lifecycle of Power BI reporting and dashboard delivery from scoping requirements with internal customers through to building, maintaining, and auditing dashboards. This role is focused exclusively on the Power BI layer (report/dashboard development, data modeling within Power BI, DAX, visualization design, and governance) and does not cover data warehouse architecture, ETL/ELT pipeline development, or upstream data engineering.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Analytics & Business Insights

Working With Internal Customers To Scope The Design, Development, And Evolution Of Commercial Analytics Supporting Sales Decision-making Across The Enterprise, Including

  • Establish and maintain a standardized commercial analytics foundation supporting:
    • All Commercial and Operational performance and productivity,
    • Working with IT Datawarehouse developers to feed North American Data Lake feeding PBI,
    • Good Business/Financial Acumen required for thought provoking solution architecting and prioritization of the open build pipeline.
  • Define a clear commercial KPI framework in partnership with Finance and IT, ensuring:
    • Consistent definitions across BUs,
    • Establishment of Single-Source of Truth and confidence in data accuracy and reconciliation,
    • Alignment between executive, BU, and frontline views.
  • Lead the development and prioritization of analytics and dashboards (Power BI and CRM-embedded) tailored to:
    • Executive leadership (enterprise-level visibility),
    • BU and sales leadership (performance management),
    • Frontline sellers and managers (daily execution),
    • Ingestion of other data sources to provide next-level insights across the business.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear, decision-oriented insights, highlighting not just “what happened,” but “how, where, and why to act.”
  • Continuously improve insight relevance by grounding analytics in real sales questions and field feedback rather than static reporting requirements.
  • Ensure analytics outputs are intuitive, consumable, and designed for speed of interpretation in live sales and leadership environments.
  • End-to-End Analytics and Insights must include sales and leadership teams trust of the numbers, understand the drivers behind the numbers, culminating in a single source of truth strategizing their operating rhythm and not as retrospective reporting.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to gather and define reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into clear dashboard/report specifications
  • Prioritize and manage a backlog of Power BI requests across internal teams
  • Run discovery sessions to clarify KPIs, metrics, and intended audience for each report
Power BI Development

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards end-to-end
  • Develop and optimize data models within Power BI (star schemas, relationships, calculated tables)
  • Write and maintain DAX measures, calculated columns, and calculation groups
  • Build reusable templates, themes, and visualization standards for consistency across the organization
  • Configure Power BI datasets, dataflows (within Power BI Service), and scheduled refreshes
  • Manage row-level security (RLS) and access controls on published reports
  • Publish and maintain workspaces, apps, and content distribution in the Power BI Service

Dashboard Governance

  • Conduct regular audits of existing Power BI dashboards for accuracy, performance, and adherence to design standards
  • Identify and remediate broken visuals, outdated logic, orphaned reports, or unused datasets
  • Maintain an inventory/catalog of active dashboards, owners, and refresh schedules
  • Monitor report performance (load times, query efficiency) and optimize as needed
  • Establish and enforce naming conventions, documentation standards, and version control practices for Power BI content
  • Review and validate DAX logic and data accuracy against source of truth

Collaboration & Support

  • Provide training and light enablement to internal customers on self-service Power BI usage
  • Troubleshoot report issues and respond to ad hoc requests from business users
  • Document report logic, data lineage (within Power BI), and business definitions for maintained dashboards
  • Out of Scope
  • Data warehouse design, architecture, or maintenance
  • ETL/ELT pipeline development
  • Upstream data engineering or database administration

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience developing in Power BI (Desktop and Service)
  • Strong command of DAX and Power BI data modeling best practices
  • Experience with Power Query (M) for report-level data shaping
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements directly from business/internal stakeholders
  • Experience auditing or governing a portfolio of BI reports at scale
  • Familiarity with RLS, workspace/app management, and Power BI administration basics
  • Strong communication skills; comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders

Why Join Us

Ready to join our team? Here’s why …

  • Comprehensive group benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, Short- and Long-Term Disability
  • Wellness Incentive Program and Employee Assistance Program
  • RRSP / 401(k) matching program
  • Work-life balance matters: Flextime, summer hours, paid vacation, and personal time off
  • A casual, fun, and collaborative work environment
  • Lively social calendar—there’s always something for everyone
  • Generous employee discounts on our products
  • Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  • The chance to work alongside a highly talented, high-performing team

Workplace Commitments

We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. All employees are expected to follow workplace safety protocols, including compliance with local regulations and internal standards, to ensure the well-being of everyone.

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where individuals feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We recognize that different perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes for our employees and customers.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Power BI Developer / Reporting Lead


Location: Onsite at the customer office in Fort Worth, TX


Experience: 8-10 years


Role Summary

We are looking for a seasoned Business Intelligence professional to design, build, and maintain enterprise reporting and dashboard solutions. You will work directly with customer stakeholders to turn business needs into clear, reliable insights, using Power BI with Databricks as the primary data source.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver interactive Power BI dashboards and reports for business and executive users.
  • Connect Power BI to Databricks (SQL Warehouses, Delta tables) and build optimized data models, DAX measures, and datasets.
  • Gather requirements from customer stakeholders and translate them into reporting solutions.
  • Tune report performance, manage refresh schedules, and apply data security (RLS) and governance practices.
  • Validate data accuracy and troubleshoot reporting issues.
  • Work with data engineering teams to shape curated datasets in Databricks.
  • Support or migrate reports from other BI tools such as Tableau as needed.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of experience in business intelligence and reporting.
  • At least 3 years of current, hands-on Power BI experience, including DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and Power BI Service administration.
  • Proven experience integrating Power BI with Databricks as a data source.
  • Working experience with Tableau and at least one other reporting tool.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. You must be able to present to and work with business and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to work onsite at the customer’s Fort Worth office.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure data services, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog.
  • Power BI certification (PL-300) or Databricks certification.
  • Background in financial services or a similar regulated industry.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Azure data services, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog.
- Power BI certification (PL-300) or Databricks certification.

Description

The Business Intelligence Developer designs, builds, and supports modern business intelligence and automation solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role combines expertise in data integration, reporting, and analytics to improve business processes through self-service reporting, workflow automation, and trusted data.

Working closely with business stakeholders and IT teams, the Business Intelligence Developer develops dashboards, semantic data models, and workflow automations that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and provide timely, trusted business insights. The role ensures that solutions are built on secure, governed, and high-quality data, and applies modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, responsibly and effectively.

Business Intelligence & Analysis

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards, scorecards, and reports, using modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, to work efficiently.
  • Build and maintain semantic models, data marts, and reporting datasets that provide a consistent source of truth.
  • Develop KPIs, metrics, and executive reporting aligned with organizational goals.
  • Partner with business units to understand reporting needs and translate requirements into scalable analytics solutions.
  • Improve self-service analytics capabilities by creating reusable datasets, documentation, and user-friendly reporting experiences.

Workflow Automation

  • Design, develop, and deploy workflow automations that reduce repetitive manual processes, using modern low-code and workflow automation tools.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement across operations, knowledge management, customer service, and internal productivity.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI-assisted tools, and recommend practical applications aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Monitor the performance of automated solutions and continuously improve accuracy, usability, and business value.

Data Integration & Engineering

  • Develop and maintain secure integrations between enterprise applications, databases, APIs, cloud services, and reporting platforms.
  • Design ETL/ELT processes that ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data availability.
  • Optimize SQL queries, data models, and data pipelines for performance and scalability.
  • Support data governance by maintaining metadata, data quality standards, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with application owners to ensure data consistency across systems.

Data Governance & Security

  • Ensure reporting and automation solutions comply with organizational security, privacy, and governance standards.
  • Implement role-based security and appropriate access controls.
  • Promote responsible use of data and emerging technologies, including AI-assisted tools, with attention to transparency and data protection.
  • Assist in establishing standards for reporting, automation, documentation, and lifecycle management.

Collaboration & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders on reporting, analytics, and automation opportunities.
  • Facilitate workshops to identify automation and reporting improvements.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring for self-service BI and automation tools.
  • Create documentation, training materials, and best practices.
  • Work closely with infrastructure, development, security, and business teams to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Other Duties as Assigned

Requirements

To perform the essential functions of this position successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Knowledge of business intelligence, data modeling, and reporting principles and best practices.
  • Knowledge of SQL, relational database structures, and data integration processes (ETL/ELT).
  • Knowledge of modern analytics, data visualization, and workflow automation platforms.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information security, and privacy requirements.
  • Knowledge of business process analysis, workflow design, and automation methodologies.
  • Skill in developing interactive dashboards, reports, and semantic data models to support business decision-making.
  • Skill in designing and implementing automated workflows to improve operational efficiency.
  • Skill in writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting SQL queries and integrating data from multiple systems and sources.
  • Skill in analyzing business requirements and translating them into effective technical solutions.
  • Skill in presenting and communicating technical concepts and recommendations to business and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Skill in identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting, data quality, and integration issues.
  • Ability to analyze complex business challenges and develop practical, data-driven solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and apply emerging technologies to enhance organizational performance.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment in handling sensitive information and implementing secure, compliant, and well-governed solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3–7 years of experience developing business intelligence, analytics, or data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in a modern BI platform.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and building data pipelines and curated, analysis-ready datasets.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), which would help support existing solutions.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms and pipeline tools, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar.
  • Experience with Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Freshservice, or similar enterprise platforms.
  • Experience with Python, C#, or JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, such as Copilot or similar.
  • Relevant industry certifications (for example, Microsoft).
  • Ability to communicate effectively in American Sign Language (ASL)

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Visualization Engineer – Mid Level, you will analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to analysts and decision makers. You will identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to locate influences. You will create specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required or available data elements. You may participate in consultation to users and in cross functional teams to address business issues, and prototypes solutions for displaying information based on business needs.

We offer a flexible work environment that requires an individual to be in the office 4 days per week. This position can be based in one of the following locations: San Antonio, TX, Plano, TX, Phoenix, AZ, or Charlotte, NC. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently participates in gathering complex business requirements by partnering with customers to define the business problem and data needs.
  • Utilizes an intermediate understanding of multiple data structures and sources to lead the development and implementation of business intelligence solutions, which may include data visualization, data transformation, or data collection.
  • Works closely with IT execution teams on the development of analytic infrastructures, data engineering, or related business intelligence efforts.
  • Includes collaborating on the design and implementation of technical standards and governance practices.
  • Applies data visualization best practices - often selecting the right data 'tool for the job' - to identify and interpret trends or patterns while following standard Enterprise branding.
  • Understands the value of prototyping, usability, and the end-user experience to maximize the impact of the final data visualization product (dashboard, report, insight, or analysis).
  • Acts as a trusted data visualization advisor to the stakeholder/end-user in order to drive business value.
  • Develops advanced knowledge to influence relevant data, information, and application architecture decisions.
  • Actively participates in industry, COE, or other discipline-relevant groups/panels to keep abreast of industry trends and share best practices with team.
  • Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science, or a business or quantitative field; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
  • 4 years of experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e.P&C, Bank, Finance, etc.)OR advanced degree in quantitative analytics field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Sciences, Operations Research, Data and/or Business Analysis, Data Science or other quantitative discipline with 2 years experience experience in data/analytics or functional business experience within the respective industry of responsibility (i.e.P&C, Bank, Finance, etc.).
  • Experience identifying and implementing innovative approaches to address business problems and solutions.
  • Experience developing business deliverables that leverage business intelligence platforms, data management platforms, or SQL-based languages (Tableau, Business Objects, Snowflake, Hadoop, Netezza, NoSQL, ANSI SQL, or related).

Description

Do you want to be part of an organization that is designing and launching new business? Do you enjoy fusing customer experience, operational knowledge, and financial understanding to create a holistic picture? Do you enjoy driving positive culture and team experience through inclusion and engagement? If so, Rapid and Rural Logistics (R2L) is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to establish a standardized data platform with clean, reliable and accessible data feeds allowing Operations and Finance customers to trust the data, technology and the tools and help become more data aware and make data-driven business decisions.

Key job responsibilities

A successful candidate is a seasoned data professional with a strong bias for action, data modeling, ETL, SQL, and scripting skills.

  • In this role, you will help identify complex business problems, identify opportunities, and implement solutions to improve operations finance facing systems, processes, and tools.
  • You will provide technical expertise in extracting, integrating, and analyzing critical data.
  • Clearly communicate any potential discrepancies and/or reporting downtime, including specific root cause and steps to resolution and design/develop key performance metrics and indicators.
  • You will be a self-starter, quick learner, comfortable with ambiguity, result-oriented with strong attention to detail, insist on high standards, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Demonstrate an ability to influence business owners, support thoughtful decision-making, and adapt to a rapidly-evolving environment.
  • Collaborate effectively with business customers and cross-functional data management teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with executives and business units across Amazon, and prioritize the most impactful projects and programs to drive businesses forward.

A day in the life

A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to build innovative data solutions with large-scale systems, identify high-priority work and projects that maximize results for key stakeholders, and solve complex problems that impact company-wide strategic decisions.

Further, you will help automate processes by developing deep-dive tools, metrics, and dashboards to communicate these insights in real time to the business teams.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About The Team

The Rapid and Rural Logistics team covers a portfolio of high-growth businesses with unique fulfillment and operational capabilities such as Sub Same Day (SSD), Rural Super Rural (RSR), and Amazon Now. Our team needs to move fast and scale quickly with the growing businesses we support. We expect you to be able to identify one- vs two-way doors and make decisions on your own, requesting help when necessary. Strong bias for action is important. Technical skills must be balanced against people skills and business acumen so you can work with stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver the optimal BI solution.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • Experience writing complex SQL queries
  • Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
  • Bachelor's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
  • Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
  • Master's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
  • Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis

Who is Gen II?

Gen II is a leading fund administration provider focused entirely on serving private capital asset managers and investors with a best-in-class combination of people, process, and technology. Gen II has more than $1 trillion in private fund capital assets under administration.

With offices in the US and Europe, we’re looking for do-ers, problem-solvers, and entrepreneurs like you who want to make an impact in our industry, grow with us, and create a community where everyone thrives.

Careers mean more at Gen II – more opportunity, more innovation, and more ideas! You’ll have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you and work alongside some of the best people in their field. You’ll also receive training which will advance your skill set, both technically and personally allowing you to achieve your career aspirations with us. Be part of our community that recognizes achievements, promotes from within, and receive meaningful benefits which focus on your physical, mental and financial well-being.

www.gen2fund.com



Position Overview

The Business Intelligence/ PEX Report Developer will be responsible for working with fund accounting professionals and technology organizations to build, maintain and complete customized reporting statements. This role requires expertise in QlikView and QlikSense dashboard design, NPrinting report development, and complex data modeling to deliver mission-critical financial reporting solutions for Gen II Fund Services, LLC's private equity clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use QlikView, QlikSense and NPrinting technologies to create and provide business areas with new reporting and dashboard applications, enabling better decision making.
  • Work with stakeholders, business users and technical teams to identify use cases; organize requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders, capture and translate business requirements into system & functional requirements.
  • Collaborating with business leads to develop prototypes and Proof of Concepts.
  • Develop and conduct analysis on key business metrics and answer on-going ad-hoc questions.
  • Install, configure & maintain QlikView and QlikSense environments (QlikView Server, QlikSense Server, Publisher, NPrinting).
  • Create and maintain complex QlikView and QlikSense applications using advanced functions as needed (set analysis, section access, alternate states, loop and reduce, QlikSense Mashups, Sheets, etc.).
  • Define and extract data from a variety of data sources (SQL Server, Oracle, Excel Files, Hive, etc.). Architect data structures and processes to standardize, distribute and provide access to information.
  • Work with the Business Intelligence Architect, IT Operations, and Information Security on designing and implementing the appropriate security model.
  • Mentor and train other Data Services team members and power users on best practices: QVD generation, Publishing, developing QlikView and QlikSense applications, data visualization and NPrinting reports.
  • Implement procedures around migration, scheduling and distribution of applications
  • Help design support procedures and train IT support on best practices; provide Level 3 end-user support for all QlikView and QlikSense related issues.
  • Follow the SDLC methodology in all development activities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience using QlikView version 11 or higher.
  • QlikView and QlikSense Dashboard Design & Development.
  • Good knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and Dimensional Modeling.
  • Working with large data sets & Experience with complex data models involving more than 10 tables.
  • Integrating data from multiple data sources into a QlikView Data Model (Sage Intacct, SQL Server, Oracle, Excel, API extensions, etc.).
  • Use of complex QlikView functions and developing the most optimal scripts for a given solution
  • Optimization of Dimensional data model for performance.
  • Extensive experience across all stages of the QlikView and QlikSense lifecycle (sourcing data, QVD generation, dashboard design, app development).
  • Experience with complex QlikView and QlikSense functions: set analysis, alternate states, advanced scripting, Mashups, Sheets, etc.
  • Experience with section access and implementing data level security.
  • Distributed QlikView applications and reports using Publisher and NPrinting.
  • Knowledge of QlikView and QlikSense distributed architecture and experience with administering and governing QlikView and QlikSense environments.
  • Knowledge of SDLC and familiarity with Agile software development concepts.
  • Prior experience with process improvement is a plus.
  • Ability to own initiatives and work in a matrix-based organization.
  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or similar discipline.

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $145,000, in addition to a discretionary bonus and comprehensive benefits package. Please note that the actual salary offered within that range will depend on the candidate’s experience level.

Work Arrangement

All applicants applying to Gen II Fund Services, LLC must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Please note that all US employees are required to work a hybrid schedule, comprised of one (1) to four (4) days on-site per week as needed.

Position Title

BI Developer Senior

Broadmoor Campus

Position Summary / Career Interest

"The Business Intelligence (BI) Developer designs, develops, and supports reporting and analytics solutions that enable clinical, operational, and financial decision-making. BI Developers are aligned to a primary reporting platform based on organizational needs and role assignment. Primary platforms include:

  • Epic Analytics (Reporting Workbench, SlicerDicer, Radar)
  • Enterprise BI Platforms (Power BI, Paginated Reports)
  • Workday Reporting & Prism Analytics"

As a Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Developer, you will provide technical assistance across the Business Intelligence team and ensure analytics solutions are consistent, scalable, and aligned across reporting platforms, and will serve as a technical expert and thought leader in enterprise analytics. You will architect advanced BI solutions, design scalable data models, and lead initiatives that integrate data across multiple systems. This role requires deep expertise in BI technologies, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to influence technical direction and standards for the organization.

Responsibilities And Essential Job Functions

  • **Leadership
  • Lead technical design discussions and set coding standards for BI solutions within a domain.
  • Drive initiatives to optimize data models for scalability and sustainability; validate recommendations with engineering teams.
  • Serve as a technical authority for troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Establish BI standards and best practices
  • Serve as a technical escalation point
  • **Essential Skills
  • Contribute to technical strategy and innovation by recommending improvements to BI architecture and supporting alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Research and introduce new methodologies and tools, applying emerging BI practices to enhance solution performance and scalability.
  • Participate in defining internal standards and best practices, ensuring adherence within assigned projects and promoting consistency across the team.
  • Provide technical expertise on complex solutions, guiding development efforts and collaborating with senior experts to resolve challenges.
  • **Connect The Dots
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of how BI and analytics capabilities drive departmental and organizational goals. Influence solution design to support business priorities.
  • Assess and improve workflows, data collection methods, and reporting ecosystems within assigned domains. Present trade-offs of analytical approaches and recommend optimal solutions for performance and governance.
  • Translate multi-domain business requirements into advanced BI solutions. Design frameworks that enable self-service analytics while maintaining governance.
  • Partner with BI Managers, Data Engineering, and Product Owners to implement strategies for system upgrades, platform enhancements, and process improvements.
  • Review and prioritize technical initiatives within the domain, ensuring incremental delivery aligns with roadmap objectives and resource constraints.
  • Identify potential risks early and communicate mitigation strategies to managers and stakeholders before escalation is required.
  • Understands how Epic, enterprise BI, and Workday reporting interact
  • Align analytics solutions with organizational goals
  • Translate strategic objectives into analytics solutions
  • Integrates AI/GenAI capabilities into BI solutions (e.g., natural language querying, automated insights); evaluates AI-generated code and outputs for accuracy, bias, security, and governance compliance
  • **Innovation and Process Improvement
  • Proactively identify and lead improvements to reporting workflows and data integration processes, introducing automation and advanced methodologies where applicable.
  • Evaluate, validate, and recommend new data sources that drive measurable business outcomes. Collaborate with content development and engineering teams to ensure usability and integration consistency.
  • Establish and maintain robust documentation standards for datasets and models, ensuring alignment with governance frameworks and enterprise best practices.
  • Participate in and lead workshops, providing insights and recommendations for systemic process improvements across teams and business units.
  • Ensure all BI initiatives adhere to data security, governance, and organizational standards while promoting best practices for scalability and sustainability.
  • Drive adoption of new tools and capabilities
  • Improve BI delivery and governance processes
  • Leads pilots of AI-enabled BI features and emerging AI capabilities, evaluating their impact on efficiency, quality, and scalability; shares findings with the broader team
  • Must be able to perform the professional, clinical and or technical competencies of the assigned unit or department.
  • These statements are intended to describe the essential functions of the job and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Skills and duties may vary dependent upon your department or unit. Other duties may be assigned as required.

Required Education And Experience

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent years in experience)
  • 5 or more years experience in healthcare environment
  • 6 or more years *SQL experience in a relational database or an equivalent combination of education and experience;*experience developing applications with one or more business intelligence tools such as Epic Reporting Epic Cogito Reporting, Power BI, SAP Business Objects, Workday Report Writer or equivalent;*experience in data literacy, using data storytelling and interpretation techniques to uncover insights, influence stakeholder decisions, and drive data‑backed, measurable outcomes.

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Master's Degree in Business/ Health Administration, Computer Science/ or related field
  • *Experience with database management technologies;*Experience in database building, maintenance, and reporting;*Experience with BI visualization, Workday, or Epic Reporting;*Experience with Vizient or related healthcare improvement companies.;*Project management, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile certification;*Experience using data mining/analytical methods and associated tools such as Python, R, etc.;* Experience with on premise database management technologies;*Experience with cloud service such as Azure Cloud, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure SQL;*Experience with on premise database management technologies;*Exposure to Epic Clarity/Caboodle, Power BI semantic modeling, or Workday Prism
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI/GenAI tools and prompt engineering to optimize BI development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and evaluate AI-enabled platform features (e.g., Copilot for Power BI, Epic AI/NLP capabilities)

Required Licensure And Certification

  • *Cogito Fundamentals - Within 12 months;*Core Analyst Badge - Within 12 months;*Clarity Data Model - Within 12 months;*Caboodle Data Model - Within 12 months;* Epic COG200 OR PowerBI PL-900 OR Workday Reporting Fundamentals - Within 12 Months;* 1 Epic Data Model (Access, Revenue, or Clinical) OR PowerBI PL-300 OR Workday Pro HCM Reporting OR Vizient CDB Certification - Within 12 Months;* 2 Epic Data Models (Access, Revenue, or Clinical) OR PowerBI DP-600 OR Workday Pro Prism Analytics - Within 12 Months
  • 2 Data Model (Access, Revenue or Clinical) – Within 12 months OR
  • Microsoft: DP-600 within 12 months OR
  • Workday: Workday Pro - Prism Analytics OR
  • Equal Professional Experience

Preferred Licensure And Certification

  • MS Certifications: Power BI Data Analyst Associate, MCSA: BI Reporting, MCSA: SQL 2016 BI Development

  • Strong planning, priority setting, and project management skills to balance multiple projects and resources in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Over 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Power BI as an enterprise platform.
  • 2+ years leading BI teams or managing cross-functional BI initiatives.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end Power BI solutions within a complex Enterprise IT ecosystem, including integration with centralized data platforms, ERP systems (e.g., Oracle), and governed data models.
  • Prior knowledge of a domain such as Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, etc.
  • Experience in creating and managing a Power BI CoE.
  • Experience working within Agile Methodology.
  • Experience with innovative solutions, problem-solving, and working across diverse groups and domains.
  • Excellent written and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree/MBA.
  • Related Experience in CPG/Hard Goods/Retail Industry.
  • Knowledge and experience in crafting and building a scalable BI infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with designing and implementing a modern data platform architecture.

Description

The Business Intelligence Developer designs, develops, and maintains enterprise business intelligence data solutions and semantic models that enable trusted reporting, analytics, self-service, and artificial intelligence capabilities across the organization. This position serves as a technical bridge between business requirements, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence.

The Business Intelligence Developer partners with Business Intelligence Analysts to understand business processes, reporting requirements, key performance indicators, and analytical needs. The role works closely with Data Engineering teams to map source data and define requirements necessary to transform enterprise data from Bronze through Gold medallion architecture within Microsoft Fabric. Using governed Gold data, the Business Intelligence Developer designs and develops reusable enterprise semantic models that translate technical data structures into business-ready analytical data products with standardized relationships, measures, calculations, definitions, metadata, and business context.

The incumbent in this position is expected to model the following practices daily:

  • Demonstrate alignment with the company's mission and core business values;
  • Collaborate with key internal/external resources;
  • Participate in ongoing self-development.

Essential Functions

  • Model, promote, reinforce, and recognize the consistent use of HOLT's Values Based Leadership (VBL) tools, models, and processes to ensure alignment with our Vision, Values, and Mission
  • Partners with Business Intelligence Analysts and business stakeholders to understand business processes, reporting requirements, analytical needs, key performance indicators, calculations, and business definitions
  • Translates business and analytical requirements into technical data and semantic modeling requirements
  • Collaborates with Data Engineering teams during data mapping and modeling activities to identify required source data, transformation logic, business rules, relationships, and data quality requirements
  • Defines Gold data requirements with Data Engineering to ensure data products are structured appropriately for downstream semantic modeling, reporting, analytics, and AI consumption
  • Validates Gold data against documented business requirements and source-system logic before incorporating data into governed semantic models
  • Designs, develops, deploys, and maintains enterprise semantic models within Microsoft Fabric
  • Develops and maintains DAX measures and standardized business calculations to ensure consistent calculation of enterprise metrics and key performance indicators
  • Adds business context to semantic models through clear naming conventions, descriptions, metadata, relationships, hierarchies, formatting, and documented business definitions
  • Develops reusable enterprise semantic models that can support multiple downstream reports, dashboards, applications, and analytical use cases rather than creating report-specific data solutions when enterprise reuse is appropriate
  • Designs semantic model architecture that allows specialized downstream semantic models to extend governed enterprise models for specific business or operational use cases
  • Optimizes semantic models for performance, scalability, usability, security, and maintainability
  • Implements appropriate data and semantic model security, including row-level security, object-level security, and other access-control requirements
  • Identifies data quality issues and works with Business Intelligence Analysts, Data Engineering, Data Stewards, and business stakeholders to determine appropriate resolution
  • Establishes and follows enterprise semantic modeling standards, naming conventions, documentation practices, reusable development patterns, and governance requirements
  • Documents data lineage, business definitions, transformation logic, model relationships, calculations, measures, and dependencies to improve transparency and maintainability
  • Uses Git-based source control and Azure DevOps to manage development work, version control, code reviews, pull requests, and solution deployment
  • Implements and follows CI/CD practices for semantic models and related Business Intelligence solutions across development, test, and production environments
  • Partners with Business Intelligence Analysts who use governed semantic models to develop Power BI dashboards, reports, and other business-facing analytical solutions
  • Partners with Data Scientists to ensure enterprise semantic models can appropriately support advanced analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and other AI-driven solutions
  • Evaluates emerging Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, semantic modeling, and analytics capabilities and recommends opportunities to improve the organization's Business Intelligence architecture
  • Provides training and technical support and serves as a subject matter expert for semantic modeling and Business Intelligence development
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge through ongoing training, conferences, webinars, certifications, and other educational opportunities
  • Works safely at all times and adheres to all applicable safety policies; complies with all company policies, procedures, and standards
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of Business Intelligence architecture, data modeling, dimensional modeling, and semantic modeling concepts
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Fabric and Power BI architecture, including Lakehouses, semantic models, notebooks, workspaces, and deployment processes
  • Advanced understanding of dimensional modeling and star-schema design, including fact tables, dimension tables, relationships, hierarchies, and appropriate model grain
  • Advanced knowledge of Power BI semantic models and DAX, including measures, calculation logic, model relationships, filter context, and performance optimization
  • Advanced SQL skills for querying, validating, profiling, transforming, and reconciling enterprise data
  • Strong understanding of modern data architecture and Medallion Architecture, including Bronze, Silver, Gold, and semantic data layers
  • Ability to understand source-system data structures and work with Data Engineering teams to map source data into governed analytical data products
  • Ability to translate business processes, terminology, rules, calculations, and analytical requirements into scalable technical and semantic solutions
  • Experience with Git-based source control, Azure DevOps, pull requests, peer review, CI/CD, and modern software development practices
  • Understanding of Power BI reporting and visualization principles sufficient to design semantic models that effectively support downstream analytical experiences
  • Understanding of AI and advanced analytics concepts and how governed semantic data can support AI-driven analytical solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify data discrepancies, determine root causes, and implement appropriate solutions
  • Excellent verbal, written, communication, documentation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong consulting and influencing abilities with the ability to work across Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, IT, leadership, and operational business teams
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively as part of a cross-functional development team
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining technical quality, documentation, and development standards
  • Ability to train, mentor, and provide technical guidance to other Business Intelligence professionals

Requirements

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline required
  • Minimum of two years of experience in Business Intelligence, analytics engineering, data modeling, data development, or related disciplines required; four or more years of experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing dimensional or semantic data models required
  • Experience developing Power BI semantic models and DAX required
  • Experience with SQL and relational data structures required
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms strongly preferred
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric notebooks, Python, or similar data development technologies preferred
  • Experience working with Data Engineering teams on data mapping, transformation requirements, and analytical data products preferred
  • Experience with Git-based source control, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, or comparable modern development practices preferred

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Travel:

  • Up to 15% to include conferences or travel to other locations for in-person meetings

Physical Requirements:

  • This position involves extended periods in a stationary position
  • Occasional movement inside the office to access office machinery, file cabinets, etc.
  • This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines
  • This position frequently communicates with employees and stakeholders; Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations
  • Occasionally moves or transports items weighing up to 10 lbs.

Work Environment:

  • This job is generally performed in a professional office environment, in environmentally controlled conditions
  • Frequently works at a fast pace with unscheduled interruptions

We are currently hiring a BI Developer II in Boston, MA.

The BI Developer II role drives business insights at BBC by delivering dashboards, reports, and semantic models on the Power BI platform. This role combines business intelligence development with a consultative approach, partnering with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable analytics solutions aligned to business objectives. Within the Power BI Center of Excellence (COE), the role promotes best practices and supports self-service analytics through documentation, coaching, and user enablement. It also contributes to data preparation and modeling to ensure data quality and performance, while supporting enterprise BI platforms by maintaining reliability, troubleshooting issues, and responding to user needs.

What You'll Brew:

  • Partner with stakeholders to define analytics requirements and deliver dashboards, semantic models, and data analytics products aligned to business objectives
  • Support data modeling and transformation activities to ensure data quality, performance, and well-structured semantic models
  • Promote best practices and provide coaching, documentation, and training to support adoption of self-service analytics through the Power BI COE
  • Support enterprise BI platforms by troubleshooting data, reporting, and platform issues, and contributing to performance improvements
  • Ensure analytics solutions follow governance and security standards, including adherence to enterprise policies and access controls
  • Provide responsive user support, identify opportunities to improve processes and automate workflows, and serve as backup for IT Data & Analytics team members as needed

What Ingredients You'll Bring:

  • 2+ years of professional experience within the Data & Analytics space
  • 1+ years of Power BI experience, including semantic modeling and visualization
  • 1+ year of experience with SQL and data transformation workflows
  • Experience in a customer-facing role working with end users on requirements, coaching, and training

Desired Experience:

  • Experience support enterprise solutions for Corporate & Sales functional areas
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python

Additional Skills:

  • Strong understanding of semantic data modeling, DAX, and BI best practices, with experience working in Power BI and structured data environments
  • Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights that support business decision-making
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with stakeholders
  • Curiosity and interest in emerging analytics technologies, including AI and automation, with a willingness to learn and apply new capabilities

Level: 7

Description

Senior Analytics Developer

About The Role

At NewYork‑Presbyterian (NYP), analytics developers power data‑driven decisions across a leading academic health system. As a Senior Analytics Developer on the Data Shared Services (DSS) team, you will partner with clinical, business, and quality leaders to deliver governed data products and decision support that improve access, quality, equity, and operational performance across our hospitals and affiliated medical schools.

Corporate Services Strategic Analytics within DSS serves as a central analytics partner across Finance, HR, Workforce Operations, Legal and Compliance, supporting the enterprise systems and measures that underpin these functions. The team brings consistency across these domains through shared analytics standards, scalable solutions, and a common approach to enterprise data.

Design analytics solutions and deliver insights that inform business and clinical decision-making. Partner directly with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into governed analytics and mentors junior team members.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and deliver reusable Power BI datasets and dashboards; optimize performance and drive adoption across stakeholder groups.
  • Guide DSS engineers in designing and optimizing scalable Snowflake data models to support complex analytics use cases
  • Maintain clear metric definitions and drive consistent metadata and lineage practices in Alation. Ensure consistency and reliability of metrics across datasets and dashboards
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes and translates ambiguous needs into solutions and actionable analytics; thinking creatively and planning strategically
  • Lead root cause data quality analysis and remediation design; feed defects to stewards
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams; improve reliability.
  • Drive medium to large scoped initiatives, mentor analytics developers, and contribute to standards for modeling, visualization, and SDLC; collaborate with other analytics developers to eliminate redundancy.
  • Own delivery of features and datasets; coordinate cross‑team dependencies with light oversight. Improve team standards and promote adoption tactics (certified datasets, usage telemetry).
  • Perform other special projects and duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Biomedical Informatics, Epidemiology, Computer Science, Data Science, Public Health, Economics, Biostatistics, Health Policy, Statistics, Biometrics) or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of analytics/BI experience preferably in healthcare delivery, payer, or life sciences.
  • SQL and dimensional modeling (or equivalent).
  • Power BI experience: DAX, M, semantic models, RLS, performance tuning (or equivalent).
  • Epic Module Certification (Cogito) upon hire or within 6 months.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Epic Clarity data models or other clinical/financial systems; familiarity with HL7 FHIR, ICD 10/CPT/LOINC a plus.
  • Demonstrated PHI/PII handling and HIPAA awareness
  • Practical data governance & metadata management with Alation or equivalent; strong documentation habits.
