descriptionHtml:
At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

Job Description

The Analytics Developer, reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Northwestern Medicine is looking for a data driven, business-minded; results oriented Analytics Developer to join our team. The Analytics Developer uncovers insights that drive strategy and optimal decision making for the executive team and leaders across the organization. In this role, you will be charged with understanding the ‘who, what, and whys’ of our business - working cross-functionally to realize the value of NM’s data assets.

Northwestern Medicine Information Services drives innovative, high-value solutions to transform health care.

We are committed to supporting the relentless pursuit of better medicine by providing exceptional service to our patients and guests as well as internal clients across the organization. To ensure excellence, our team goes to extraordinary lengths to ensure that our systems work together seamlessly.

Northwestern Medicine understands that technology plays an integral role in shaping the future of health care. Information Services strategically supports the organization by:

  • Leveraging AI, automation and rollout of advanced cyber controls that support digital transformation strategies
  • Implementing advanced technologies in clinical and administrative areas
  • Furthering development of the end user support model to help enhance modern infrastructure

Responsibilities:

To succeed in this role, you must be innately curious, deeply analytical, highly driven, and a strong communicator. Some of those qualities include but are not limited to:

  • Be a Data Champion! Effective analysis is only possible with good data - be an advocate of data accessibility, accuracy and quality.
  • Be Curious! Find data nuggets, trends and other analytical goodies that help support our mission, vision, and values and advance our department as a whole.
  • Be a Team Player! Collaboration is what makes us great – come prepared to work with a diverse cross-section of technical and business professionals.
  • The Analytics Developer is responsible for delivering data warehouse and analytic solutions by writing ETL packages, developing visualizations, performing data and statistical analyses, and administering systems to deliver information to the health system.¿
  • Assists with development of pipelines to synthesize raw data into actionable information.
  • Evaluates data quality and interprets results in a clear, concise manner.
  • Develops documentation on requirements, decisions, design, modifications, and any associated maintenance.¿
  • Supports analytics projects and is accountable for collaborating with the business to gather and execute on requirements, which exceed customer expectations.
  • Works collaboratively with and support multi-departments efforts and projects.
  • Participates and contributes to overall training development, maintenance, and facilitate trainings both internally and externally as needed.
  • Performs other duties and functions as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience:

  • Two or more years of experience in a role querying and/or analyzing data
  • Experience using SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and reporting
  • Experience working with business users in developing analytical solutions to meet business needs
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as: Tableau, Crystal Reports,¿SSRS, Microsoft Power BI, etc.¿
  • Experience in all areas of development including analysis, design, development and support with particular emphasis on structured programming
  • Knowledge of relational database skills including SQL knowledge and the ability to create queries and stored procedures

Behavioral Attributes:

  • Demonstrated competency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and/or Access
  • Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple-priorities
  • Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills

Preferred:

  • Experience developing, designing and supporting applications and relational databases¿
  • Previous experience working with Epic Clarity data
  • Previous healthcare experience, ideally with a health system
  • Experience using the Microsoft stack (SSRS, SSMS, SSIS, SSAS)
  • Previous experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience using a software package for statistical analysis (R, Python, etc.)

Additional Information

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

descriptionHtml:
At Coaction, we’re a unique mix of leaders, achievers, thinkers, and team players with a high-performance mindset and a diverse skillset. We bring our industry expertise together to continually push the boundaries of what insurance can be for our clients.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Developer to join the Data Analytics Engineering team and help build the next generation of enterprise analytics solutions. This is a hands-on senior technical role for an individual who combines deep Power BI expertise, semantic and dimensional modeling experience, strong business acumen, insurance industry knowledge, and excellent communication skills.

The successful candidate will partner with stakeholders to understand complex business problems, translate them into scalable analytics solutions, and own delivery from requirements and data analysis through semantic modeling, visualization, validation, deployment, and production support. The role will operate as a senior individual contributor, independently driving complex BI initiatives, applying strong technical judgment, and delivering high-quality solutions across multiple business functions.

Key Responsibilities

Business Intelligence and Power BI Development

  • Design and develop enterprise-grade Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical experiences for executive, operational, and self-service use cases.
  • Translate complex business questions into intuitive analytical solutions that clearly communicate performance, trends, drivers, and areas requiring action.
  • Apply advanced Power BI capabilities across visualization, filtering, drill-through, navigation, accessibility, security, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Design reports around clear business questions and stakeholder-friendly terminology, progressing from summary information into controlled analytical detail.
  • Build solutions that are scalable, maintainable, performant, and aligned with enterprise BI standards.


Semantic and Dimensional Modeling

  • Design and enhance reusable enterprise semantic models supporting multiple reports, business domains, and analytical use cases.
  • Apply strong dimensional-modeling practices, including defined grain, fact and dimension tables, conformed dimensions, surrogate and composite keys, bridge tables, hierarchies, role-playing dimensions, and multiple-fact scenarios.
  • Design governed business measures, KPIs, ratios, time-intelligence calculations, and reusable analytical logic.
  • Understand how modeling decisions affect accuracy, usability, scalability, query performance, security, and self-service capabilities.
  • Promote reusable semantic solutions rather than isolated report-specific logic or duplicate metric definitions.


Analytics Engineering and Platform Delivery

  • Serve as a Power BI subject-matter expert and technical resource for the broader analytics organization.
  • Troubleshoot complex report, semantic-model, data, security, gateway, performance, refresh, deployment, and production issues.
  • Apply sound practices for DAX, live connections, row-level security, workspace management, source control, release management, and production monitoring.
  • Validate analytical results against source data, approved SQL, and documented business definitions before release.
  • Partner with data engineering and architecture teams to ensure reusable transformations and dimensional structures are implemented at the appropriate layer.


Insurance Analytics and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Apply insurance domain knowledge to translate business concepts into meaningful analytics and reusable enterprise metrics.
  • Partner effectively with stakeholders across Underwriting, Claims, Finance, Actuarial, Exposure/Risk, Operations, and other insurance functions.
  • Lead requirements and discovery discussions and translate business language into actionable technical designs.
  • Explain complex data and BI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leaders.
  • Communicate status, risks, dependencies, design decisions, and tradeoffs clearly and proactively.


Solution Ownership and Delivery

  • Take ownership of complex or ambiguous analytics problems and drive them through resolution.
  • Use a solution-oriented approach that considers root cause, downstream impacts, maintainability, and opportunities for reuse.
  • Produce well-designed, thoroughly tested, and documented BI solutions that meet business requirements and enterprise standards.
  • Apply reusable implementation patterns and follow team standards for quality, documentation, testing, and production readiness.
  • Drive complex initiatives independently while coordinating delivery across business and technology teams.
  • Demonstrate accountability, sound judgment, transparency, and consistent follow-through.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data and Analytics, or a closely related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Power BI experience designing and delivering enterprise BI solutions.
  • Advanced Power BI expertise, including Power BI Desktop and Service, DAX, semantic modeling, visualization, performance optimization, row-level security, workspace and deployment concepts, and production troubleshooting.
  • Strong hands-on experience with dimensional and semantic modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills and the ability to investigate, reconcile, and validate data independently.
  • Experience delivering solutions across the full BI development lifecycle, from discovery and design through development, testing, UAT, deployment, and production support.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert business requirements into reusable, governed technical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated experience independently delivering complex BI initiatives and contributing to solution design, testing, documentation, and production readiness.
  • Insurance industry experience, including familiarity with one or more domains such as underwriting, claims, premium, policy, actuarial, exposure/risk, or finance.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AtScale or another enterprise semantic or metrics layer.
  • Experience with Amazon Redshift or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and enterprise Power BI administration concepts.
  • Experience migrating analytics from Tableau or another legacy BI platform to Power BI.
  • Experience building governed self-service analytics solutions and certified KPI frameworks.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git-based source control, CI/CD, and structured deployment practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise security, gateways, workspaces, deployment pipelines, and production operations.
  • Experience participating in large-scale analytics modernization or BI transformation programs.


Salary range specific to for this role: $146,000-$200,000 + discretionary incentive bonus + benefits depends on various factors including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. The offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, experience, and qualifications. In addition, employees are eligible for standard benefits package including paid time off, medical, dental and retirement.

descriptionHtml:
Join our team as a BI Solutions Developer, where you will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting business intelligence and data solutions across the Firm. This role works across the BI lifecycle, including data transformation, data modeling, reporting, visualization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

You will work closely with business departments and technical teams to transform trusted enterprise data into intuitive, visually compelling solutions that tell a story with the data and make information easier to understand and use. Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related technologies, you will support the Firm’s enterprise data strategy while promoting BI standards and enabling departments to develop effective solutions through citizen development.

Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Data Visualization

  • Design and develop intuitive, visually compelling Power BI reports and dashboards that tell a story with the data, clearly communicate key insights, and support business decision-making.
  • Translate business requirements and trusted enterprise data into practical BI solutions that make complex information easy to understand and use.
  • Develop and maintain semantic models, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, and reusable reporting components.
  • Apply strong visual design, user experience, and attention to detail to create polished, consistent, and professional BI solutions.
  • Maintain, modernize, optimize, and support new and existing reports, dashboards, semantic models, refresh processes, and data connections.

Microsoft Fabric & Data Transformation

  • Use Microsoft Fabric as the primary low-code platform for developing data transformation, integration, analytics, and BI solutions.
  • Develop and maintain Dataflows Gen2 and related Fabric components to prepare, cleanse, combine, and transform enterprise data for reporting and analytics.
  • Create downstream Fabric data solutions, including lakehouses and reusable transformations, using trusted data from the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model.
  • Use Fabric pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related capabilities as appropriate to develop scalable and maintainable BI solutions. Apply data quality and validation practices and identify transformations or business rules that should be transitioned to Data Engineering for implementation within the enterprise data layer.

Enterprise Data & Integration

  • Use the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model as a primary source of trusted, consistent data for BI, analytics, AI, and reporting solutions.
  • Maintain a strong working understanding of enterprise data architecture, including Azure Data Lake, data pipelines, integration, transformation, dimensional modeling, and related data engineering concepts.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineers and application developers to understand enterprise data structures and define data requirements for BI and analytical solutions.
  • Recognize when data requirements extend beyond the BI and low-code layer and work with Data Engineering to develop appropriate enterprise-level solutions.
  • Integrate data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, SharePoint, files, and other approved sources when required to support business solutions.

AI & Automation

  • Develop and support AI-enabled BI and data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, Data Agents, and related technologies.
  • Develop and support data agents that allow users and business solutions to interact with trusted enterprise data through intuitive, AI-enabled experiences.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers, developers, and business teams to identify and prepare the data required for AI and agent-based solutions.
  • Develop workflow and data automation solutions using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Microsoft Fabric, and related low-code technologies.
  • Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and Fabric capabilities and apply them where they can improve access to information, automate manual processes, or deliver greater business value.

BI Governance, Standards & Citizen Development

  • Establish and promote standards and best practices for BI development, data modeling, visualization, transformation, security, performance, deployment, and support.
  • Partner with Finance, Client Value, and other technically capable departments to enable effective citizen development of reports, dashboards, dataflows, automations, and other BI solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, visualization, data modeling, and other approved low-code technologies.
  • Promote the use of trusted enterprise data, shared semantic models, reusable solutions, and consistent business definitions while reducing duplication of data and business logic.
  • Review and support citizen-developed solutions to promote appropriate design, data quality, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in the following tools, technologies, and concepts:

  • Microsoft Power BI, including report and dashboard development, semantic models, Power BI Service, security, deployment, and data refresh.
  • Microsoft Fabric, including Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory, pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related analytics capabilities.
  • Power Query/M and DAX for data transformation, business calculations, KPIs, and semantic model development.
  • Data modeling and transformation, including dimensional modeling, data integration, cleansing, validation, and data quality.
  • SQL and relational database concepts for querying, validating, and working with enterprise data.
  • Power Platform and automation technologies, including Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps.
  • AI-enabled data solutions, including familiarity with Fabric Data Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and related technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Azure and data engineering concepts, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, data pipelines, REST APIs, enterprise data models, and modern data architectures.

Required Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience developing business intelligence, reporting, data, or related technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data transformation solutions.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Experience supporting self-service BI, citizen development, or technically capable business teams is preferred; experience with legal industry data, terminology, or business processes is a plus.

Required Interpersonal And Communication Skills

  • Ability to build effective relationships and collaborate with business stakeholders, citizen developers, Data Engineers, application developers, and other technical teams.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences and translate business needs into practical solutions.
  • Ability to guide and mentor technically capable business users and citizen developers while promoting appropriate BI standards and best practices.
  • Ability to lead discussions, provide technical recommendations, solve complex problems, and build consensus across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of solutions, and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Other Desired Traits

  • Strong attention to detail with a professional, business-focused approach and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
  • Proactive and able to identify opportunities to improve reporting, data processes, automation, and user experience.
  • Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to balance business enablement with appropriate technology standards and governance.
  • Curious and adaptable, with an interest in emerging BI, data, AI, and automation technologies and their practical application to business needs.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENT

Minimal.

OFF-HOURS SERVICE REQUIREMENT

Responsibility within a 24x7 Technology Services organization may require work outside standard business hours, including weekends, based on support emergencies, deployments, and other system responsibilities.

How To Apply

Interested individuals should apply directly via our job posting.

About Us

BakerHostetler is recognized as one of the leading law firms in the country. With more than 1,000 attorneys located in 18 offices from coast to coast, BakerHostetler is a great place to work for those who seek professional and personal growth in a collaborative environment. We deliver the highest quality counsel to our clients, who include many of the nation’s largest and most well-known companies. BakerHostetler’s values have remained unchanged since our founding more than 100 years ago: dedication to the law, commitment to the highest standard of client service, continuous development of our people and active participation in the communities in which we work and live.

BakerHostetler offers a comprehensive and competitive benefit program. Specific information is provided during the interview process.

  • Competitive Salaries
  • Performance Bonus Program
  • Generous Time Off
  • Generous Retirement Program including 401(k) Plan
  • Group Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • BHealthy Wellness Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Accident Insurance – Self and Family
  • Short and Long-Term Disability
  • Pre-Tax Benefit Programs

Please visit www.bakerlaw.com for more information about our Firm.

Baker & Hostetler LLP is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Ohio, Florida - $130,000-150,000/year

-  Develop workflow and data automation solutions using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Microsoft Fabric, and related low-code technologies. 
-  Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and Fabric capabilities and apply them where they can improve access to information, automate manual processes, or deliver greater business value. 

BI Governance, Standards & Citizen Development



-  Establish and promote standards and best practices for BI development, data modeling, visualization, transformation, security, performance, deployment, and support. 
-  Partner with Finance, Client Value, and other technically capable departments to enable effective citizen development of reports, dashboards, dataflows, automations, and other BI solutions. 
-  Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, visualization, data modeling, and other approved low-code technologies. 
-  Promote the use of trusted enterprise data, shared semantic models, reusable solutions, and consistent business definitions while reducing duplication of data and business logic. 
-  Review and support citizen-developed solutions to promote appropriate design, data quality, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards. 

Required Technical Skills

Proficiency in the following tools, technologies, and concepts:



-  Microsoft Power BI, including report and dashboard development, semantic models, Power BI Service, security, deployment, and data refresh. 
-  Microsoft Fabric, including Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory, pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related analytics capabilities. 
-  Power Query/M and DAX for data transformation, business calculations, KPIs, and semantic model development. 
-  Data modeling and transformation, including dimensional modeling, data integration, cleansing, validation, and data quality. 
-  SQL and relational database concepts for querying, validating, and working with enterprise data. 
-  Power Platform and automation technologies, including Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps. 
-  AI-enabled data solutions, including familiarity with Fabric Data Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and related technologies. 
-  Working knowledge of Azure and data engineering concepts, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, data pipelines, REST APIs, enterprise data models, and modern data architectures. 

Required Education And Experience



-  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field. 
-  Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience developing business intelligence, reporting, data, or related technology solutions. 
-  Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data transformation solutions. 
-  Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical teams. 
-  Experience supporting self-service BI, citizen development, or technically capable business teams is preferred; experience with legal industry data, terminology, or business processes is a plus.

-  Ability to build effective relationships and collaborate with business stakeholders, citizen developers, Data Engineers, application developers, and other technical teams. 
-  Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences and translate business needs into practical solutions. 
-  Ability to guide and mentor technically capable business users and citizen developers while promoting appropriate BI standards and best practices. 
-  Ability to lead discussions, provide technical recommendations, solve complex problems, and build consensus across business and technical teams. 
-  Ability to work independently, take ownership of solutions, and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

-  Strong attention to detail with a professional, business-focused approach and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions. 
-  Proactive and able to identify opportunities to improve reporting, data processes, automation, and user experience. 
-  Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to balance business enablement with appropriate technology standards and governance. 
-  Curious and adaptable, with an interest in emerging BI, data, AI, and automation technologies and their practical application to business needs.

Minimal.

At OCHIN, we value the unique perspectives and experiences of every individual and work hard to maintain a culture rooted in our values.

Founded in Oregon in 2000, OCHIN employs a growing virtual workforce of more than 1,200 skilled professionals, working remotely across 49 states. We offer a generous compensation package and are committed to supporting our employees’ entire well-being by fostering a healthy work-life balance and opportunity for professional advancement. We are curious, collaborative learners who strive to live our values every day. OCHIN is excited to support our continued national expansion and the increasing demand for our innovative tools and services by welcoming new talent to our growing team.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis at the time of application.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. OCHIN does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas or transfers of existing employment-based visas.

Position Overview

The Business Intelligence Developer designs, develops, tests, documents, maintains, and troubleshoots database objects, ETL processes, and custom reporting solutions across a broad suite of Business Intelligence and data integration tools. This role is responsible for implementing reliable data pipelines and scalable data structures, as well as creating and optimizing various reporting products for business users. The developer actively supports the full project lifecycle, including gathering and defining requirements, solution design, solution development, automated and manual quality assurance testing, and user acceptance testing phases of projects.

Essential Functions

  • Design, build, and maintain database objects such as tables, stored procedures, functions, and views, and develop complex SQL queries to support reporting, analytics, and data integration needs including the secure and automated delivery of file extracts via SFTP.
  • Develop custom reporting solutions within Epic Hyperspace, including Reporting Workbench and Cogito SQL reports, Radar dashboards, and all associated Cogito build elements.
  • Responsible for the execution of full reporting lifecycle; from design, development, testing, documentation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and documentation of processes and systems.
  • Lead working sessions directly with OCHIN members, third party vendors, and/or staff to design and develop technical solutions that fit reporting and analytic needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Requirements

  • Certification or Proficiency in Caboodle Data Modeling preferred; if candidate does not have certification or proficiency, proficiency would be required within the first 90-days of employment (applicants must meet the minimum requirements listed below to qualify).
  • Minimum five years of experience reporting in Epic is required
  • Minimum five years of experience with complex SQL development required.
  • Minimum 3 years of broad knowledge using SQL hyperspace, SQL metrix, Cogito SQL
  • Minimum 3 Experience with Slicer/Dicer

The assessment gives us insights into how your strengths, preferences, and work style align with the OCHIN's nine core competencies. It’s not about passing or failing—it’s about understanding fit and setting you up for success.


Base Pay Overview

OCHIN uses broadened pay ranges to support equitable and market-aligned compensation practices. The final offer will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant skills, certifications, education, experience, training, responsibilities, internal equity, and market data.

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

  • Constant interpersonal skills, teamwork, and customer service. Frequent creativity, mentoring, presentations/teaching. Occasional decision making and independent judgment or action.
  • Reading, speaking, writing, and understanding English.
  • While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit for long periods of time; stand and walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms.
  • This position requires a virtual home-office environment, working remotely and will require that employees be on camera for all virtual meetings.
  • The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers and mobile devices.
  • Travel is required to support OCHIN’s business requirements for Go-Live installations or training which may require travel by air, vehicle, or train.


Work Location and Travel Requirements

OCHIN is a 100% remote organization with no physical corporate office location. Employees work remotely from home and many of our positions also support our member organizations on-site for new software installations. Nationwide travel is determined based on OCHIN business needs. Please inquire during the interview process about travel requirements for this position.

Work From Home Requirements Are

  • Ability to work independently and efficiently from a home office environment
  • High Speed Internet Service
  • It is a requirement that employees work in a distraction free workplace

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. OCHIN does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas or transfers of existing employment-based visas.

descriptionHtml:
As a Business Intelligence Developer on our solutions delivery team, you will have the unique opportunity to work on innovative projects advancing the digital transformation of critical government systems with true mission impact.

Mission Focus: Our delivery teams are driven to explore new ideas and technology, and care deeply about collaboration, feedback, and iteration. We follow lean agile practices, embrace the Ops (DataOps/DevSecOps/MLOps) to "automate-first", use modern tech stacks, and constantly challenge each other to grow and improve.     

Technical members of our solutions teams require little guidance, but love to learn, collaborate, and problem solve. This position requires experience and passion for solving our customers' hardest technical and data challenges.

Clearance: TS/SCI with Polygraph

Location/Flexibility: Hybrid. Onsite in Vienna, VA and Chantilly, VA with up to 3 days remote. Remote flexibility subject to change based on program needs.

The Business Intelligence Developer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining reports and dashboards that transform complex data into actionable insights for stakeholders and decision-makers. The ideal candidate brings practical experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Grafana), combined with foundational knowledge in data manipulation, database connectivity, and AWS cloud infrastructure. The Business Intelligence Developer works collaboratively with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate analytics objectives and business requirements into clear, easily digestible reporting mechanisms that drive informed decision-making and support mission-critical operations.

Responsibilities: 

  • Design, build, and maintain interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, and other visualization tools
  • Connect to and extract data from various databases within AWS cloud infrastructure (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, RDS)
  • Perform data manipulation, transformation, and preparation to ensure data quality and accuracy for reporting purposes
  • Translate business requests and data analytics objectives into demonstrable, user-friendly reporting mechanisms
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, understand business needs, and define key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Develop and maintain data models, queries, and ETL processes to support dashboard and reporting requirements
  • Ensure reports and dashboards are optimized for performance, usability, and accessibility
  • Conduct data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support business decision-making
  • Document reporting processes, data sources, and dashboard functionality for knowledge sharing and maintenance
  • Provide training and support to end-users on dashboard navigation and data interpretation
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data quality issues, working with technical teams to resolve discrepancies
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver analytics solutions

 Basic Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience with designing, building, and maintaining data analytics reports for business intelligence and real-time system infrastructure monitoring (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Grafana, Splunk, etc.) 
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (additional experience may be substituted for education)
  • Experience working with databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.) to include:
  • Basic understanding of relational database design principles (e.g. Normalization vs Denormalization)
  • General knowledge of database administration concepts (e.g. users, schemas, constraints)
  • Basic query development experience 
  • Experience working with data from Excel, Jira, ServiceNow, etc.
  • Experience leveraging programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc.
  • Experience leveraging Generative AI tools
  • Experience working in a fast-paced agile environment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports
  • 1+ year experience writing code leveraging programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • DAX, Power Query, SQL
  • Data modeling principles
  • Dashboard design
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple source systems
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with Cloud Providers, preferably AWS

Physical Requirements: 

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 10-15 pounds at times.

#CJ

The pay range listed for this position reflects the wage or salary range NT Concepts expects to pay for this role at the time of posting. The compensation offered to a successful candidate within this range will be based on legitimate, job-related factors, including (but not limited to) the candidate's work location, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements.

Virginia Pay Range

$120,336—$180,504 USD

About NT Concepts

Founded in 1998 and headquartered in the Washington DC Metro area, NT Concepts is a private, mid-tier company with clients spanning the Intelligence and Defense communities. We deliver end-to-end  data and technology solutions  that advance the modernization, transformation, and automation of the national security mission—solutions with real impact developed in a strong engineering culture that encourages technical growth, leadership, and creative "big idea" problem-solving.

Employees are the core of NT Concepts. We understand that world-changing concepts happen in collaborative environments. We are a company where talented teams work together using innovation and expertise to solve our clients' most critical challenges. Here, you'll gain competitive benefits, opportunities to bolster your skills and develop new abilities, and a company culture dedicated to support and service. In addition to our benefits program, we encourage our employees to take part in #NTC_GivesBack, which paves the way for positive social change.

If joining a stable company with strong professional growth opportunities resonates with you, and you seek vital, mission-driven projects (for some pretty cool clients) that use your specific talents, we'd love to have you move forward with us.

About FIS

Are you curious, motivated, and forward-thinking? At FIS you’ll have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our talented people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate and above all fun.

Atlanta, GA Hybrid (two days in-office, three days virtual)

About The Team

If you enjoy solving data problems, turning business needs into practical solutions, and working with modern cloud and BI tools, this role offers the chance to do work that matters. You will join a team that values clear thinking, strong collaboration, and continuous improvement.

This team builds and supports analytics solutions that help the business make better decisions. They work across data engineering, reporting, and business intelligence to deliver trusted data, scalable pipelines, and useful dashboards for stakeholders across the organization.

You will help design, build, and support analytics data solutions used for reporting and decision-making. You will also help ensure the data is accurate, reliable, and easy to use.

  • Create scalable data models that support analytics and reporting needs
  • Write, test, and tune SQL for transformation, reporting, and analysis

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations in Cognos or Tableau

  • Familiarity with AWS services such as S3, EC2, and Redshift
  • Understanding of data modeling, warehousing, and data quality practices
  • Ability to work well with technical and non-technical teams
  • Clear communication, problem-solving ability, and a practical mindset

Bonus if you have

  • Experience working in Agile teams using tools such as Jira
  • Familiarity with GitHub and software development lifecycle practices
  • Experience supporting BI platforms in enterprise environments
  • Exposure to financial services or regulated data environments
  • Ability to create insights and recommendations from business data

What We Offer You

  • Meaningful work on important business and technology challenges
  • A collaborative work environment with supportive teammates

Location: Fontana, CA or El Monte, CA

Schedule: 4/10 or 9/80 or 5/40

Position Type: Permanent Full Time


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Business Intelligence Developer to design, develop, and maintain advanced enterprise reporting and analytics solutions, with a primary focus on Microsoft Power BI. This position will serve as the organization's Power BI Subject Matter Expert (SME), responsible for developing sophisticated dashboards, executive reports, interactive visualizations, and enterprise analytics solutions that support business operations and strategic decision-making. The Senior Business Intelligence Developer will lead the architecture, development, optimization, and administration of Power BI solutions while integrating data from enterprise data warehouses, SQL databases, cloud platforms, APIs, and other business applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards, interactive reports, executive scorecards, and enterprise analytics solutions.
  • Serve as the primary Power BI Subject Matter Expert, providing technical leadership in report architecture, development, optimization, and best practices.
  • Develop complex DAX calculations, Power Query (M) transformations, semantic models, and advanced data visualizations.
  • Design and optimize enterprise data models, including star schemas, relationships, calculated measures, and incremental refresh strategies.
  • Administer Power BI Service, including workspaces, gateways, scheduled refreshes, deployment pipelines, security, and governance.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize Power BI performance, including DAX queries, semantic models, report execution, and data refresh processes.
  • Write, develop, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Integrate Power BI with Azure Enterprise Data Warehouses, SQL Server databases, and other enterprise applications.
  • Develop, maintain, and support ETL/ELT processes using SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), and automated data pipelines.
  • Connect and integrate data from REST APIs, JSON, SharePoint, cloud applications, and third-party enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with department managers, business stakeholders, and executive leadership to identify reporting requirements and establish key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and actionable analytics.
  • Automate reporting processes to improve operational efficiency, data accessibility, and decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy, security, reliability, and consistency across enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Implement and maintain Power BI security, governance, and access controls.
  • Perform quality assurance testing, troubleshoot reporting issues, and validate data integrity.
  • Maintain technical documentation covering data models, reporting architecture, integrations, and development processes.
  • Provide ongoing technical support, guidance, and training to business users and technical teams.
  • Independently manage the full lifecycle of enterprise reporting solutions, from requirements gathering and development through deployment, optimization, and production support.


Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Reporting, Data Analytics, or a comparable technical role.
  • Minimum 5 years of advanced, hands-on Microsoft Power BI development experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including enterprise dashboard development, administration, and deployment.
  • Advanced hands-on experience developing complex DAX calculations, measures, and analytical expressions.
  • Strong proficiency in Power Query (M) for data transformation, preparation, and integration.
  • Advanced experience designing and optimizing Power BI semantic models, dimensional models, star schemas, relationships, and calculated measures.
  • Experience implementing incremental refresh strategies and optimizing large-scale Power BI datasets.
  • Hands-on experience administering Power BI Service, including workspaces, gateways, scheduled refreshes, deployment pipelines, security, and governance.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and optimize Power BI report performance, DAX queries, semantic models, and refresh processes.
  • Advanced SQL Server and T-SQL development skills, including complex queries, stored procedures, views, functions, and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data warehouses, dimensional modeling, and data integration architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).
  • Experience designing, developing, maintaining, or supporting ETL/ELT processes and automated data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, SharePoint, cloud applications, and multiple enterprise data sources.
  • Experience integrating Power BI with Microsoft Azure technologies and enterprise data warehouse environments.
  • Strong understanding of data security, governance, data accuracy, and reporting reliability.
  • Ability to independently design, develop, deploy, optimize, and support enterprise-level Power BI reporting solutions.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple reporting initiatives simultaneously.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including modern data integration and analytics capabilities.
  • Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL Database.
  • Knowledge of DAX Studio and Tabular Editor for advanced Power BI development and performance optimization.
  • Experience using Python and PowerShell for automation, data processing, or analytics workflows.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, and automated deployment processes.
  • Familiarity with enterprise utility systems, including utility billing, Customer Information Systems (CIS), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), and Geographic Information Systems (GIS).
  • Experience developing operational reporting and analytics solutions for utility or infrastructure organizations.
  • Microsoft certifications, including:
  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600)
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700)


Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.

Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.


Ideal Candidate

The strongest candidate will bring 7+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience, including at least 5 years of advanced, hands-on Power BI development, with demonstrated ownership of complex enterprise reporting solutions.

descriptionHtml:
Star Seven Six is a company dedicated to innovation, Star talent, and revolutionizing business and technology solutions. As your advocate, the common thread across our associates is crafting the right tech-savvy solutions. Whether it’s Application Development, Infrastructure Services, Security, Enterprise Service Management or Interactive Design, we’re all about finding solutions that advance your career aspirations. Our ongoing client relationships and our proven experienced leadership speak to our long-term collaborative partnerships. This gives our associates the opportunity to work with a large, diverse group of high-profile clients across a variety of industries.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise business intelligence solutions. This role requires strong expertise in Power BI, SQL, DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional data modeling, data visualization, security, administration, and embedded analytics.

The ideal candidate understands the full reporting lifecycle, from underlying data structures through semantic models and ultimately the user experience. They can work with transactional, Operational Data Store (ODS), and dimensional Data Mart environments and understand how data architecture, relationships, cardinality, DAX, security, and visualization design affect the accuracy and usability of a Power BI solution.

This individual will work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data professionals, application developers, and other Power BI developers while taking ownership of the quality and testing of their work.

Key Responsibilities

Power BI Development & Semantic Modeling

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI semantic models, reports, and dashboards.
  • Build semantic models against transactional databases, Operational Data Stores (ODS), data warehouses, and Data Marts.
  • Understand dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, grain, keys, star schemas, and relationships.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of cardinality, relationship direction and filter propagation.
  • Determine when source data structures should be simplified or reshaped to create effective analytical models.
  • Design semantic models for accuracy, usability, maintainability, and performance.

SQL & DAX

  • Able to write advanced SQL for analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
  • Can demonstrate proficiency with joins, CTEs, subqueries, aggregations, data types, NULL handling, and query performance.
  • Develop maintainable DAX measures for KPIs, ratios, trends, time-based analysis, and complex business calculations.
  • Understand DAX concepts including row context, filter context, context transition, CALCULATE, iterators, time intelligence, and relationship behavior.
  • Troubleshoot results across the full data path, including source data, SQL, semantic model relationships, filters, and DAX calculations.

Data Visualization & User Experience

  • Apply established data visualization and information-design principles to reports and dashboards.
  • Be familiar with recognized visualization thought leaders and approaches, including Edward Tufte, Stephen Few, and Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic.
  • Make effective use of visual selection, layout, color, hierarchy, labeling, and information density to communicate information clearly.
  • Design intuitive report experiences using appropriate navigation, filtering, drill-through, tooltips, bookmarks, and other Power BI capabilities.
  • Translate business requirements into clear and actionable visualizations while maintaining consistency, accessibility, and ease of use.

Embedded Power BI & Web Integration

  • Embed Power BI reports and dashboards into web applications, including iframe-based implementations.
  • Collaborate with application developers to integrate Power BI content into a cohesive web application experience.
  • Understand authentication, authorization, Power BI permissions, and semantic model security as they relate to embedded reporting.
  • Design reports with the embedded experience in mind, including navigation, sizing, filtering, and usability.
  • Troubleshoot embedded report issues involving authentication, permissions, rendering, filtering, and user access.

Security, Administration & Deployment

  • Design and implement Row-Level Security (RLS), including appropriate static and dynamic security patterns.
  • Test security using different roles and user scenarios to ensure users can access only authorized information.
  • Understand Power BI Service capabilities including workspaces, apps, semantic models, refresh, gateways, permissions, workspace roles, and deployment processes.
  • Troubleshoot refresh, gateway, access, and Power BI Service issues.
  • Follow established governance, naming, documentation, deployment, and change-management practices.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Take ownership of developer-level testing before solutions are delivered for user acceptance testing or production deployment.
  • Validate Power BI results against authoritative source data using SQL and appropriate reconciliation techniques.
  • Test DAX calculations, aggregations, relationships, cardinality, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, RLS, and embedded functionality.
  • Test expected results as well as edge cases, exceptions, NULL/blank handling, and negative security scenarios.
  • Perform regression testing when changes are made to existing functionality.
  • Document defects and verify corrections rather than relying solely on visual inspection of reports.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work effectively with business analysts, data engineers, data architects, database developers, application developers, QA professionals, and business stakeholders.
  • Participate in design, semantic model, code, and report reviews.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with team members on design decisions and be receptive to technical and business feedback.
  • Question unclear requirements and business rules rather than making unsupported assumptions.
  • Document important business logic, measures, model designs, security rules, and technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience developing enterprise Microsoft Power BI solutions.
  • Strong SQL and DAX development and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong knowledge of Power BI semantic modeling and dimensional modeling.
  • Experience working with transactional databases, ODS environments, data warehouses, and dimensional Data Marts.
  • Strong understanding of cardinality, data grain, relationships, and filter propagation.
  • Experience creating effective, user-friendly Power BI reports and dashboards.
  • Strong knowledge of data visualization and information-design best practices.

Star Seven Six is a company dedicated to innovation, Star talent, and revolutionizing business and technology solutions. As your advocate, the common thread across our associates is crafting the right tech-savvy solutions. Whether it’s Application Development, Infrastructure Services, Security, Enterprise Service Management or Interactive Design, we’re all about finding solutions that advance your career aspirations. Our ongoing client relationships and our proven experienced leadership speak to our long-term collaborative partnerships. This gives our associates the opportunity to work with a large, diverse group of high-profile clients across a variety of industries.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Power BI Developer to design, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise business intelligence solutions. This role requires strong expertise in Power BI, SQL, DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional data modeling, data visualization, security, administration, and embedded analytics.

The ideal candidate understands the full reporting lifecycle, from underlying data structures through semantic models and ultimately the user experience. They can work with transactional, Operational Data Store (ODS), and dimensional Data Mart environments and understand how data architecture, relationships, cardinality, DAX, security, and visualization design affect the accuracy and usability of a Power BI solution.

This individual will work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data professionals, application developers, and other Power BI developers while taking ownership of the quality and testing of their work.

Key Responsibilities

Power BI Development & Semantic Modeling



- Design, develop, and maintain Power BI semantic models, reports, and dashboards.
- Build semantic models against transactional databases, Operational Data Stores (ODS), data warehouses, and Data Marts.
- Understand dimensional modeling concepts including facts, dimensions, grain, keys, star schemas, and relationships.
- Demonstrate a strong understanding of cardinality, relationship direction and filter propagation.
- Determine when source data structures should be simplified or reshaped to create effective analytical models.
- Design semantic models for accuracy, usability, maintainability, and performance.

SQL & DAX



- Able to write advanced SQL for analysis, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
- Can demonstrate proficiency with joins, CTEs, subqueries, aggregations, data types, NULL handling, and query performance.
- Develop maintainable DAX measures for KPIs, ratios, trends, time-based analysis, and complex business calculations.
- Understand DAX concepts including row context, filter context, context transition, CALCULATE, iterators, time intelligence, and relationship behavior.
- Troubleshoot results across the full data path, including source data, SQL, semantic model relationships, filters, and DAX calculations.

Data Visualization & User Experience



- Apply established data visualization and information-design principles to reports and dashboards.
- Be familiar with recognized visualization thought leaders and approaches, including Edward Tufte, Stephen Few, and Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic.
- Make effective use of visual selection, layout, color, hierarchy, labeling, and information density to communicate information clearly.
- Design intuitive report experiences using appropriate navigation, filtering, drill-through, tooltips, bookmarks, and other Power BI capabilities.
- Translate business requirements into clear and actionable visualizations while maintaining consistency, accessibility, and ease of use.

Embedded Power BI & Web Integration



- Embed Power BI reports and dashboards into web applications, including iframe-based implementations.
- Collaborate with application developers to integrate Power BI content into a cohesive web application experience.
- Understand authentication, authorization, Power BI permissions, and semantic model security as they relate to embedded reporting.
- Design reports with the embedded experience in mind, including navigation, sizing, filtering, and usability.
- Troubleshoot embedded report issues involving authentication, permissions, rendering, filtering, and user access.

Security, Administration & Deployment



- Design and implement Row-Level Security (RLS), including appropriate static and dynamic security patterns.
- Test security using different roles and user scenarios to ensure users can access only authorized information.
- Understand Power BI Service capabilities including workspaces, apps, semantic models, refresh, gateways, permissions, workspace roles, and deployment processes.
- Troubleshoot refresh, gateway, access, and Power BI Service issues.
- Follow established governance, naming, documentation, deployment, and change-management practices.

- Take ownership of developer-level testing before solutions are delivered for user acceptance testing or production deployment.
- Validate Power BI results against authoritative source data using SQL and appropriate reconciliation techniques.
- Test DAX calculations, aggregations, relationships, cardinality, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, RLS, and embedded functionality.
- Test expected results as well as edge cases, exceptions, NULL/blank handling, and negative security scenarios.
- Perform regression testing when changes are made to existing functionality.
- Document defects and verify corrections rather than relying solely on visual inspection of reports.

Job Summary

MacLean-Fogg is hiring a Business Intelligence Specialist to design, develop, and maintain reporting that supports financial, operational, and supply chain decision-making. You’ll build and improve Power BI, ReportsNow, SQL, and ERP reporting while partnering with business users to define requirements and support the transition to a centralized data warehouse. This role offers a flexible work arrangement, with preference for candidates near Mundelein, IL or Detroit, MI and remote work considered for the right candidate.

  • Location: Preference for candidates near Mundelein, IL or Detroit, MI
  • Work Arrangement: Flexible; on-site, hybrid, or remote depending on the candidate
  • Schedule: Standard business hours
  • Pay: $75,000–$85,000/year
  • Employment Type: Full-time / Salary
  • Travel: Up to 10%

What You'll Do as a Business Intelligence Specialist

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modeling, DAX measure development, visualization design, and publishing to shared workspaces.
  • Develop and maintain reports in the company’s JD Edwards reporting toolset, ReportsNow, including scheduled distributions and drill-down reporting for operational users.
  • Write, test, and tune SQL queries against JD Edwards tables and SQL Server databases to source, shape, and validate report data; resolve data discrepancies and improve query and report performance.
  • Partner with functional end users, business analysts, and finance, operations, and supply chain teams to gather reporting requirements, translate business needs into documented technical specifications, review draft reports, incorporate feedback, and confirm acceptance.
  • Apply consistent standards for report design, naming conventions, and data definitions across business units and manufacturing locations, while identifying duplicate or overlapping requests and recommending consolidation when appropriate.
  • Support the migration and rebuild of existing Power BI reports as the organization transitions from a third-party data model to a centralized data warehouse, including report portfolio rationalization and defining reporting requirements for data engineering.
  • Develop and maintain semantic models and shared datasets that support self-service reporting, and document report logic, data sources, business definitions, and change history.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot the existing report portfolio, including performance tuning and updates as business processes, master data, and source systems change.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly related experience.
  • Two to four years of experience developing production reports and dashboards in a business environment.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, report design, and publishing to a shared workspace.
  • Demonstrated proficiency writing SQL, including multi-table joins, aggregation, and query performance troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing reports against a transactional business system and a working understanding of how operational data is structured.
  • Ability to elicit reporting requirements from non-technical users and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Ability to communicate data concepts and report results clearly to business and operational audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience independently validating work products before release.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests, establish priorities, and communicate realistic delivery timelines.
  • Ability to learn new reporting platforms and ERP data structures, including JD Edwards and ReportsNow, through on-the-job training.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision and collaboratively within a cross-functional team.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel functionality.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and personnel data with discretion.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Work is primarily performed in an office environment and involves remaining in a stationary position for extended periods while operating a computer.
  • The role requires the use of standard office equipment and communication by telephone, video conference, and electronic mail.
  • Occasional visits to manufacturing facilities may be required, where personal protective equipment and adherence to plant safety procedures are required.

The physical requirements described above represent those needed to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Benefits

Eligible employees across MacLean-Fogg and its affiliated companies have access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to support health, financial well-being, time away, and development. This position is eligible for benefits that include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match and potential profit sharing
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Health Savings Account contributions for eligible plans
  • Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability coverage
  • Paid parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program and mental health resources
  • Virtual healthcare resources
  • Tuition reimbursement and development opportunities
  • Additional wellness, financial, and employee programs

Benefits are subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Explore our full benefits and interactive resources: https://explore.benefits.macleanfogg.app

Pre-Employment Requirements

After a conditional offer, this position requires a pre-employment drug screen and criminal background check. Screening and employment decisions are administered consistent with applicable law and the requirements of the position.

About MacLean-Fogg

MacLean-Fogg is a fourth-generation, family-owned American manufacturing company headquartered in Mundelein, Illinois. Founded in 1925, we design and manufacture engineered components and solutions for automotive and industrial markets.

Our portfolio includes MacLean-Fogg Component Solutions, OMCO, Mallard Manufacturing, and Threadstrong. Across our companies, we share a commitment to Integrity, People, Customers, and Stewardship while investing in our people, manufacturing capabilities, customers, and communities.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Accommodations

MacLean-Fogg and its affiliated companies are equal opportunity employers. We provide equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply, complete an assessment, or participate in the hiring process, contact careers@macleanfogg.com.

High school graduate or equivalent.

descriptionHtml:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm, and every member feels valued.

Evaluate, design, code, test, optimize and modify Medica's financial or operations systems solutions and reporting capabilities that support multiple lines of Businesses and IT initiatives. Capture, develop, and document data definitions, business rules, and data quality requirements. Conduct data analysis in support of a variety of analytic solutions. Interpret data, analyze results, and provide insights to determine operational impact, trends, and opportunities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with internal business customers to establish and develop relationships, establishing credibility as a key internal resource.
  • Use analytic tools such as Power BI and SQL, and other in-house tools to utilize multiple data sources and environments to produce reports to meet needs of business users.
  • Develop analytical and reporting specifications for enterprise healthcare projects through participation in project teams or meetings with internal customers.
  • Develop and maintain business performance reports for operational business units and produce executive analytic summaries to aid decision-making using various reporting and analytic tools.
  • Research subjects surrounding claims, providers, pricing, benefits, government programs or membership, conduct analysis, interpret data, perform data quality checks, identify threats, and present information to internal customers.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous business and data requirements, independently investigate issues, identify appropriate data driven solutions, and communicate recommendations to business partners.
  • Participate in team activities to identify problems and improve work processes and systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field
  • 3 years of work experience beyond degree
  • Advanced SQL, Power BI, data analysis skills

Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with cloud-based technologies such as Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Healthcare insurance industry experience or interest.
  • Demonstrated examples of taking initiative and being curious with data.

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, or Madison, WI.

The full salary grade for this position is $70,200 - $120,400. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $70,200 - $105,315. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US: Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Position Summary

Design, develop paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder and integrate with Power BI Reports and dashboards to deliver interactive and print-ready reporting solutions.

Develop SQL queries and support ad hoc reporting requirements.

Integrate and transform data using Azure services and enterprise data sources.

Support data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, and reporting modernization efforts.

Enable data sharing and reporting across Power BI, Tableau, CRM, SAS, and related platforms.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver analytics solutions.

Participate in Agile/Scrum development activities. Refine technical user stories and provide estimates.

Create technical documentation and diagrams as needed.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in BI, reporting, data analytics, or data engineering.

3+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience.

Strong experience with:

Power BI Desktop & Power BI Service

DAX, Power Query, and data modeling

SQL Server / T-SQL development

Azure data services and data integration

Data warehousing and ETL/ELT processes

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
