Position Summary

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for delivering scalable analytics, reporting solutions, and business intelligence capabilities that drive data-informed decision making. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing sales reporting, data models, automation solutions, and analytical frameworks across multiple platforms, including SQL Server, Oracle, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable insights. This individual will serve as a subject matter expert for reporting architecture, data governance, automation initiatives, and commercial analytics while driving continuous improvement across systems, processes, and reporting capabilities

Essential Functions Of The Position

  • Develop and manage scalable data models, pipelines, and reporting frameworks supporting Sales Operations, commercial analytics, and executive reporting
  • Lead reporting initiatives related to Oracle ERP and associated business systems, including implementations, upgrades, data migrations, and building and maintaining SQL-based reporting to support Sales Operations
  • Design, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts across multiple data environments and sources
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using Power BI, Oracle reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and other business intelligence platforms
  • Deliver high-impact reporting and actionable insights on sales performance, forecasting, and key business metrics to support strategic decision-making
  • Collect, cleanse, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources to support business intelligence initiatives
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, consistency, and performance across all reporting and analytics environments
  • Partner with IT and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance data accessibility, reporting capabilities, and decision-support tools
  • Establish and champion best practices for reporting development, documentation, testing, deployment, and data governance
  • Lead and support strategic initiatives focused on process improvement, operational excellence, and reporting modernization
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities that streamline reporting and data management activities
  • Perform root-cause analysis and resolve data, reporting, visualization, and system integration issues
  • Develop and maintain advanced VBA solutions, macros, and automated workflows to improve efficiency
  • Mentor analysts and business users on reporting tools, data interpretation, and analytics best practices

Additional Essential Functions Of The Position

  • Demonstrate consistent, reliable, and professional work performance.
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exercise sound judgment and independent decision-making
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders
  • Maintain strong attention to detail while balancing strategic priorities
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics or related field, or demonstrated equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of advanced Power BI development experience, including complex data modeling and DAX
  • Expert-level SQL skills with demonstrated experience developing complex queries, views, stored procedures, and data transformation logic
  • Experience working with Oracle ERP or other Oracle reporting environments
  • Advanced experience designing and maintaining reporting and dashboard solutions
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, Power Query, and VBA/macros development
  • Strong experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple systems and sources
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or related discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of Power BI development experience
  • 3+ years of Oracle ERP or other Oracle reporting experience
  • 3+ years sales operations experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device industry
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, and cloud-based analytics platforms

Other Requirements

  • Ability to regularly walk, sit, or stand as needed
  • Ability to occasionally bend and push/pull as needed
  • Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and background check

  • Optimize the performance and scalability of BI solutions.
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to the BI development team.

  • Collaborate with executive leadership to align BI initiatives with organizational goals.

  • Advanced experience with reporting tools (Power BI).
  • Solid SQL skills and the ability to write complex, highly-optimized queries.
  • Experience with Application Development

Qualifications We Prefer

  • Experience in the Aerospace and Defense industry.
  • Certification in BI tools or data analytics.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).

  • Data Model design: familiarity with OLAP and Tabular model design principles.
  • Languages: Advanced DAX, Power Query (M).

  • Experience with Application Development

Essential Functions

  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods.
  • Frequent communication with team members and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment.
  • Occasional travel may be required.
  • Must be able to lift up to 10 lbs occasionally.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior BI developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the BI team.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, to understand data needs and deliver high-quality BI solutions.
  • Foster strong collaboration with other departments, including IT, operations, and compliance, to ensure BI solutions are integrated seamlessly and support the broader organizational objectives.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

Ready to Love Your Job?

Texas Roadhouse is looking for legendary, passionate Roadies to join our Support Center team in Louisville, KY. If you’re ready to bring your energy, partnership, and heart to a place where fun meets purpose, you’ve come to the right place. Come see why our Roadies love their jobs!

Why This Role Rocks

Do you love turning complex data into meaningful insights? As an Analytics Engineer II, you'll play a key role in building the foundation that powers data-driven decision-making across the business. You'll design and own enterprise-scale semantic models, create trusted metrics, and develop impactful Power BI reporting solutions using Microsoft Fabric.

In this role, you'll collaborate closely with our BI Product Owner, Data Engineering team, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable analytics that empower self-service reporting and drive smarter decisions. If you're passionate about data modeling, Power BI, and creating analytics solutions that make a real impact, we'd love to meet you.

  • This is an on-site position working a hybrid schedule (minimum 3 days in office every week) at the Texas Roadhouse Support Center in Louisville, Kentucky.

Your Recipe for Success

  • 4-6 years of experience in Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, or advanced Power BI development
  • Strong expertise in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, DAX, dimensional modeling, and performance optimization
  • Experience owning and supporting production-ready semantic models, datasets, and governed business metrics
  • Solid SQL skills and strong understanding of data modeling best practices
  • Experience building analytics solutions used by business stakeholders across an organization
  • Familiarity with Git and analytics deployment processes
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business partners
  • Experience aligned with Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600) capabilities
  • Bonus Points For:
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, Warehouse, or Direct Lake
  • Experience with Tabular Editor
  • Experience working within a product-based analytics environment

Certifications

  • DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) and PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) preferred
  • Candidates who do not currently hold these certifications should be willing to pursue them within their first 6-12 months of employment. We'll provide support along the way!

What's On Your Plate

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable semantic models in Microsoft Fabric and Power BI
  • Create governed business metrics and complex DAX calculations that drive consistent reporting across the organization
  • Develop and support high-impact Power BI reports, dashboards, and applications
  • Optimize report performance, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure data accuracy
  • Implement and manage row-level security, data governance standards, and certified datasets
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure analytics-ready data structures and solutions
  • Support self-service analytics by publishing reusable, trusted datasets
  • Monitor analytics asset performance, reliability, and user adoption
  • Contribute to analytics standards, documentation, and best practices
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver meaningful insights
  • Participate in modern analytics development practices, including Git, deployment pipelines, and CI/CD processes

Why You'll Love Your Job

As our founder Kent Taylor said, “We’re a people-first company that just happens to serve steaks.” We believe in taking care of the whole Roadie: from professional development opportunities to a robust benefits package. Our culture is just one reason why many of our leaders started as servers, managers, and line cooks, and have grown Legendary careers with us. Here’s a taste of what we offer:

  • Best-in-class benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 100% paid maternity leave
  • Generous time off including vacation, parental, donor, and bereavement leave
  • Wellness perks like on-site personal trainers, massages, a full gym, and a registered nurse
  • Convenience services like car detailing, dry cleaning, and even spray tans
  • Financial support with 401(k), tuition reimbursement, stock units, and holiday bonuses
  • Delicious perks from Willie’s Joynt-our full-service cafe serving up legendary meals

Assets will include (but are not limited to) reports, visualizations, dashboards, and data extracts. Produces complex reports and performs meaningful quantitative or qualitative analyses addressing impactful business issues or questions. Combines these reports with subject-matter expertise to deliver coherent, insightful takeaways comprehensive read-outs, and advice/recommendations grounded in what our data is telling us.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

  • Develops complex BI solution architecture that accurately translates business requirements to technology solutions and ensures the design will meet business requirements throughout the lifecycle of a change
  • Participates in and implements day-to-day activities related to defining architecture, establishing infrastructure, and implementing standards used to create frameworks/patterns for delivering business intelligence solutions
  • Conducts complex business analysis activities to enable technology solutions that adequately fulfill strategic business needs and objectives
  • Delivers complex project setups, analysis, data flows, designs (wireframes/mock-up), etc., for and in partnership with customers
  • Helps lead the execution of long-term strategic goals for business intelligence development in conjunction with end users, management, customers, and other stakeholders
  • Conducts extensive research and makes recommendations on business intelligence products, services, and standards in support of procurement and development efforts
  • Performs and oversees complex programming, quality assurance reviews, documentation, system deployment, training, and project setup/support
  • Provides timely and appropriate communication to business owners, stakeholders, and users on issue status and resolution
  • Develops, maintains, and implements the business intelligence architecture as a core asset at Centene
  • Collaborates with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management, process efficiency with respect to data and delivery
  • Collaborates with both Enterprise Architecture (EA) and EDAS Solutions Architecture on the solution/service design to ensure it conforms to enterprise architectural standards and future roadmaps
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

descriptionHtml:
Exciting Career Opportunity with Avance Care!

Join our rapidly expanding network of 30+ practice locations in the Triangle Area (Raleigh-Durham-Chapel Hill), the Charlotte Region, and Wilmington, NC.

Avance Care is dedicated to elevating the standard of healthcare. As one of North Carolina's largest networks of independent primary care practices, we offer comprehensive services to support the physical, mental, and emotional health of our patients.

We are seeking a senior-level Epic Business Intelligence Developer (BID) to design, develop, and deliver actionable data insights across our organization using Epic Cogito tools and enterprise BI platforms. Operating at the intersection of healthcare operations, data architecture, and analytics, you will partner with clinical, financial, operational, and executive stakeholders to translate complex requirements into scalable reporting solutions. In this fast-paced role, you will manage the full project lifecycle—from requirements gathering and data modeling in Caboodle, Clarity, and Slicer/Dicer to deployment via Power BI and SSRS—while ensuring data governance and contributing to advanced initiatives like AI and predictive modeling.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

 Epic BI Development & Data Management

  • Design, develop, and maintain Epic-based reporting solutions using Caboodle, Clarity, and Slicer/Dicer
  • Build and optimize dashboards, reports, and data extracts using SQL, Power BI, SSRS, and other BI tools
  • Develop and maintain data models (relational and dimensional)
  • Ensure data integrity through rigorous validation processes and stakeholder sign-off

Business Engagement & Requirements Translation

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across clinical, financial, and operational domains to gather and define requirements
  • Translate business needs into technical specifications and scalable data solutions
  • Present data insights, trends, and findings to non-technical audiences in a clear and actionable manner
  • Provide consultative guidance on best practices in analytics, reporting, and data usage

Advanced Analytics & Innovation

  • Explore and implement Epic tools, such as Nebula, and other emerging analytics technologie
  • Identify opportunities to leverage data for operational improvement, quality outcomes, and cost efficiency
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new tools, features, and methodologies to enhance BI capabilities

Strategic & Project Leadership

  • Participate in strategic planning, analytics roadmap development, and enterprise data initiatives
  • Manage BI projects, including project plans, timelines, resource allocation, and deliverables
  • Lead complex data initiatives from concept through deployment, ensuring alignment with organizational goals
  • Facilitate meetings, manage stakeholder expectations, and resolve competing priorities or requirements

Operational Support & Governance

  • Manage BID/reporting ticket queues, including triage, prioritization, and resolution of incidents and requests
  • Maintain and enhance a centralized data catalog, including data definitions and metadata documentation
  • Ensure adherence to data governance standards, including data quality, security, and master data management
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, data dictionaries, and end-user training materials

Team Development & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with analysts, developers, and informatics teams to deliver integrated data solutions
  • Provide constructive feedback and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should bring a Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent experience), backed by 2+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, reporting, file transfers, or ETL. You should bring a strong background in Epic environments, with an active Epic certification in Caboodle, Clarity, or Cogito highly preferred. Additionally, experience integrating Epic analytics with enterprise BI and data visualization platforms will make you stand out in this role.

If you are excited to join a growing organization focused on changing the way healthcare is delivered to patients in North Carolina, please submit your resume.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are & What We Do

Hallmark’s Data & Business Intelligence organization turns enterprise data into trusted insights that help teams across Hallmark make better, faster decisions. We build and manage the data platforms, pipelines, semantic models, and analytics solutions that support critical business areas including retail, product, consumer, merchandising, planning, finance, and executive reporting.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING & THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE

We are looking for an experienced BI Engineer to design and build scalable, governed analytics solutions that enable trusted and intuitive access to enterprise data. This role will focus on developing Power BI semantic models, reusable business/context layers, and self-service analytics capabilities, leveraging Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and AI-assisted development practices. The ideal candidate will have 6–8 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or related areas, with strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, dimensional modeling, semantic model development, SQL, and modern cloud data platforms. This role also requires an AI-first engineering mindset. The engineer will be expected to use approved AI capabilities to accelerate development, testing, documentation, optimization, and modernization while maintaining accountability for the quality, security, and maintainability of production solutions.

This is a progressive role that will be filled at the level based on the skills and experience of the selected candidate.

Additional Details

  • The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $110,000. Final compensation varies based on several factors.
  • This is a U.S.-based remote role.* We’re committed to creating a connected, collaborative culture, no matter where you are. You’ll have access to virtual tools, team support, and opportunities to engage and grow with us. *Due to state-specific benefits regulations, Hallmark cannot consider candidates for remote positions who reside in Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico, or any country outside of the United States.
  • This is a progressive role designed to grow with you. We’ll match the job level to your skills and experience so you can hit the ground running and keep building your career.
  • Hallmark is committed to recognizing and rewarding performance. Employees are eligible for annual merit-based increases, aligned with individual and company performance.
  • In alignment with our culture of care, Hallmark offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision plans, paid time off, 401K with company match, and profit-sharing.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS (the following is required to be considered for this role):

  • At lease 6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic model development, DAX, Power Query/M, dimensional modeling, Power BI Service, data security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing and developing dimensional data models using star schemas, facts, dimensions, aggregations, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.
  • Demonstrated experience building shared and reusable semantic/business layers, rather than primarily developing individual reports.
  • Experience developing and implementing self-service analytics capabilities for business users.
  • Experience developing and optimizing SQL queries for performance and efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience working with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Understanding of modern analytical architectures spanning data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers.
  • Experience designing or developing modern analytical architectures that include data platforms, analytical data products, semantic models, and visualization layers
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into scalable technical and analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI or AI coding assistants into real-world development workflows.
  • Ability to use AI effectively to generate, review, refine, and troubleshoot SQL, DAX, M, semantic-model metadata, documentation, and other engineering artifacts.
  • Experience using AI across multiple stages of the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, troubleshooting, optimization, and documentation.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness rather than accepting generated code without appropriate engineering review.
  • Experience applying responsible AI development practices, including data protection, security, validation, governance, and human accountability

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (your application will stand out if you have the following):

  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, and data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating and optimizing Power BI with Snowflake.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures and curated analytical data products.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

Experience designing solutions that consider networking concepts, protocols, network security methodologies, cyber‑threats, vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity principles.

Knowledge of data administration, data‑standardization policies, and standards.

Application of data‑mining, data‑warehousing, machine‑learning, and artificial‑intelligence theory/principles.

Demonstrated understanding of network access, identity, and access management (e.g., PKI).

Knowledge of programming language structures/logic and query languages such as SQL and object‑oriented design.

Familiarity with secure coding techniques

Desired Skills

Technology / Tool – Desired Proficiency

Oracle / Microsoft SQL Server – Working knowledge (SQL querying, basic performance tuning)

Microsoft Power BI Report Server – Proficient (dashboard design, DAX)

Deltek COBRA – Working knowledge

Microsoft SharePoint – Working knowledge

SAP – Working knowledge

Teamcenter – Working knowledge

Scripting – Python, PowerShell – Basic to intermediate (data extraction, automation)

Data modeling & metadata management tools – Familiarity

Cloud & distributed data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) – Familiarity

Additional analysis tools – Excel, STATA, SAS, SPSS – Familiarity

Script languages – PERL, VBS (Windows/UNIX) – Basic

Relevant certifications (e.g., IBM Certified Data Engineer, TOGAF, Certified Data Management Professional, Security+) are a plus.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $76700.00 - $142500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

  • Design, develop, and maintain data flows in Tableau to support engineering and operational requirements.
  • Support data transformation, reporting, and visualization in Power BI.

  • Integrate and manage data across Tableau, SharePoint, Jira, Power BI and other enterprise systems to improve accessibility and consistency.

Work Location: This is a hybrid position. A minimum of one onsite day each week at the NIWC PAC Point Loma worksite in San Diego, CA is required. Although some remote work is permitted, due to this onsite requirement and the possibility of additional onsite meetings or events with limited or no notice, this position requires an employee to maintain a primary residence in California and within reasonable commuting distance of the Point Loma worksite. Changes to this hybrid schedule, including requiring additional onsite days up to and including full time onsite, may be required by the company or government customer.

Work Schedule: This position follows the California Alternate Work Week Schedule: Monday – Thursday are 9-hour days; Fridays are alternating 8- or 0-hour days, for a total of 80-hours for every two weeks. Workday starts at 7:15am PST Mon-Thu and on working Fridays.  

Typical Physical Activity: Primarily desk/computer work in an office environment. May involve: repetitive motion.  

Typical Pay Range: The anticipated pay for this position in the identified location(s) is $43.14/hour. Actual compensation offered will be based upon individual factors including education, qualifications, and experience. 

Existing SECRET Security Clearance Required: This position requires eligibility for a Secret security clearance, to be obtained after hire. Only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance; therefore, only current U.S. citizens will be considered for this position.

  • An exceptionally qualified candidate without a current Security clearance may be considered.

  • Data Analysis & Troubleshooting: Strong analytical capability to interrogate complex datasets, proactively identify operational or data quality issues, and develop effective, sustainable solutions.
  • System Integration: Experience integrating and managing data across SharePoint, Jira, and other enterprise systems.
  • Strong proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, and Power Apps.
  • Proficiency with AI and integrating AI tools into data visualization and analysis workflows.
  • Excellent communication skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and support fast-paced operational environments. 

  Additional Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:  

  • Ten (10) years of combined relevant professional experience in Tableau, Power BI, data analytics, or related business intelligence technologies preferred.
  • Data Preparation: Expertise with data shaping, cleaning, and preparing workflows, in Tableau.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, Navy, or other government organizations is highly preferred.

  • Paid Time Off (accrued)
  • Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with employer match and Traditional/Roth options
  • Medical Insurance (3 plan options)

  • Dental Insurance (2 plan options)

  • Build automated business processes using Power Automate integrated with AI services.

  • Develop and support scalable transformation models within Snowflake.
  • Create reusable data models, testing frameworks, and documentation within dbt.
  • Implement data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and automated validations.

  • Validate data quality and reconcile results with source systems.
  • Participate in testing, deployment, and production support activities.
  • Provide production support and issue resolution.



Qualifications



  • EducationBachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience developing Power Automate workflows.
  • Experience writing advanced SQL queries.
  • Experience supporting enterprise reporting environments.



Required Skills

  • Source control systems (Azure DevOps, Git, etc.)
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

descriptionHtml:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Package Specialist: SAP BW Analytics, you will develop and support analytical applications built using SAP BW, leveraging data modeling, data architecture, ETL, end-user reporting, and analytics. You will utilize your skills in SAP BW, SAP BW Integrated Planning, and SAP BW ABAP Modeling to deliver high-quality solutions.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

  • Develop Analytical Applications: Design, build, and maintain analytical applications using SAP BW, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
  • Support Data Architecture: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement data architecture solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Leverage ETL Processes: Extract, transform, and load data from various sources into SAP BW, ensuring seamless integration and data quality.
  • Deliver End-User Reporting: Create and deploy reports and analytics solutions to meet end-user needs, utilizing SAP BW capabilities.
  • Apply SAP BW Skills: Utilize expertise in SAP BW, SAP BW Integrated Planning, and SAP BW ABAP Modeling to resolve complex technical issues and optimize solution delivery.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • SAP BW Development: Experience with developing analytical applications using SAP BW, including data modeling, data architecture, and ETL processes.
  • Data Architecture Support: Exposure to designing and implementing data architecture solutions that meet business requirements, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
  • ETL Process Management: Experience with extracting, transforming, and loading data from various sources into SAP BW, ensuring seamless integration and data quality.
  • SAP BW Technical Skills: Experience with SAP BW, SAP BW Integrated Planning, and SAP BW ABAP Modeling, with the ability to resolve complex technical issues and optimize solution delivery.
  • End-User Reporting: Experience with creating and deploying reports and analytics solutions using SAP BW capabilities to meet end-user needs.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • SAP BW Integrated Planning: Exposure to SAP BW Integrated Planning, with the ability to design and implement planning solutions that meet business requirements.
  • SAP BW ABAP Modeling: Experience working with SAP BW ABAP Modeling, with the ability to create and deploy complex data models and analytics solutions.
  • Advanced ETL Processes: Exposure to advanced ETL processes, including data quality and data governance, to ensure seamless integration and data accuracy.
  • Preferred skills - SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA, data modeling, ETL, reporting, analytics, SQL.

companyDescription: The Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS) is a public pension system created in 1967. Our mission is to support a secure retirement for our members by partnering with Missouri’s local governments to provide a sustainable defined benefit plan. We serve over 70,000 current and former local government workers including firefighters, police officers, utility workers, administrators, EMTs, public works personnel, public healthcare professionals, librarians, and more.

companySlogan: Enhancing the lives of our members by promoting financial stability for their future.
descriptionHtml:
Joining the Missouri LAGERS, team as a Data Analytics Engineer II offers the opportunity to leverage your experience to develop analytics solutions and deliver actionable insights that drive informed decision-making. This position focuses on developing and optimizing SQL queries, reports, dashboards, and data models; improving data quality, consistency, and accessibility; and maintaining data definitions, documentation, and governance standards to ensure accurate, reliable organizational reporting.

As a Data Analytics Engineer II, you will partner with business stakeholders and IT team members to assess reporting needs, identify opportunities for meaningful analysis, and translate business requirements into practical, effective reporting solutions. Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a commitment to data accuracy, and a proactive approach to improving reporting processes, operational efficiency, and the organization’s overall analytics capabilities.

LAGER’s vision is to enhance the lives of our 83,000+ members by providing financial stability for their future through a protected, defined benefit retirement. Our team members value excellence, embody dedication and exemplify leadership. We work together, take ownership of our actions, and thrive in an environment of continuous improvement.

Salary: $88,606 to $106,328 starting annual salary is negotiable and will depend on experience and identified value brought to the organization.

LAGERS benefits include:

  • Hybrid work environment with collaborative in-office days and work-from-home days as designated.
  • 12 paid holidays per year.
  • Annual Leave: Starting at 15 days per year.
  • Sick Leave: 15 days per year.
  • Health insurance options effective DAY 1 of your employment.
  • Vision, Dental, Life, Long-term Disability, and IDShield protection for you on
  • DAY 1 of your employment.
  • Defined Benefit Retirement Plan providing lifetime monthly retirement benefits at no cost to you.
  • Deferred Compensation Plan with employer match.
  • Professional development reimbursements and more…


Data Analytics Engineer II Job Functions:

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present insights in a clear and actionable manner. (Power BI preferred)
  • Implement and maintain scalable data models, warehouses, and analytics platforms.
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and security by applying quality assurance and governance standards.
  • Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
  • Contribute to the development of best practices for data management, analytics, and reporting.
  • Analyzes existing SQL reports and queries to improve and optimize business reporting and processes.


Our ideal Data Analytics Engineer should have:

  • Possession of a bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science or related field preferred; and
  • Three to five years of experience in data engineering, analytics or related field; or
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience which would provide the knowledge, skills and abilities noted below.


Recruitment Schedule:

  • Our application deadline has been extended to November 20, 2026, or until the position is filled. 
  • We will conduct prescreening calls with applicants who meet the criteria listed above.  
  • Interviews with best fit candidates will be scheduled throughout the recruitment schedule.


As part of our application process, it is required that each applicant must complete a Culture Index Survey. The survey is a 2-question survey which will take 5-8 minutes to complete. For full consideration, both your application and survey must be submitted.  After you apply, the link will be emailed to you or after you apply click the link provided here: https://go.cultureindex.com/s/q17WC04EV4

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.

We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior BI Developer to design, build, and own BI and reporting solutions for our fast-paced multi-tenant Life Science Data Management Platform. Our BI ecosystem is primarily built on TIBCO Spotfire, with Power BI used for selected reporting and analytics use cases. We are looking for a developer with deep Spotfire expertise who is also willing and able to work across Power BI and other visualization platforms as business needs evolve. This role requires strong ownership, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards, visualizations, analyses, and reporting solutions in TIBCO Spotfire.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of BI solutions: requirements, data modeling, calculations, and report/dashboard development.
  • Shape design approach and architecture for data models and calculations, setting patterns other developers can build on.
  • Oversee version control and deployment processes via GitHub, including code review and approval for team members' contributions.
  • Partner with data engineers, architects, and product teams to resolve data and quality issues proactively.
  • Identify and escalate risks or inefficiencies early.
  • Mentor team members and guide their design decisions.
  • Define and drive adoption of BI standards and best practices.
  • Operate independently, exercising judgment on trade-offs without requiring sign-off.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of BI development experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and developing dashboards, visualizations, analyses, and reporting solutions in TIBCO Spotfire.
  • Experience with Power BI and willingness to work across multiple BI and visualization platforms as business needs evolve.
  • Strong data modeling skills (star schema, relationships, performance tuning at scale).
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant data architecture and Row-Level Security (RLS).
  • Practical GitHub experience in a team deployment workflow.
  • Proven ability to own deliverables independently.
  • Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented, with consistent follow-through.
  • Comfortable in a high-pace, evolving environment.
  • Adaptable across BI/visualization platforms.

Additional Information

What does IntegriChain have to offer?

  • Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
  • Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and much more!
  • Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

descriptionHtml:
The Lead Business Intelligence Developer will be responsible for the overall management and development of business intelligence assets for the Department of Health Economics. Utilizing strong interpersonal skills, business acumen, and critical thinking, the individual will partner and consult with business and clinical leaders to identify and understand business needs. Once business needs are understood, the individual will utilize semantic model design and data visualization technical skills (Power BI strongly preferred), data storytelling skills, and creativity, to provide user-friendly, easy to consume BI tools and assets for our stakeholders. This individual will also assess the current suite of BI tools within the department and identify opportunities for combining or organizing information differently for ease of consumption. Title: Business Intelligence Specialist

Location: Cold Spring, MN

Job Type: Permanent/Direct-Hire

Compensation: $87,872 - $106,446 annually

Industry: Construction

About The Role

Our client, a leading manufacturer and supplier in the natural stone industry, is seeking a Business Intelligence Specialist to help transform enterprise data into trusted, actionable insights. This organization has invested heavily in building a modern data foundation and is now seeking a data professional to lead the development of a business-facing analytics ecosystem.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the organization's data strategy from the ground up. You will establish data modeling standards, own the transformation layer, develop certified data assets, and create the KPIs and reporting solutions that guide business decisions across operations, sales, production, logistics, and other key functions.

Working within a collaborative Business Intelligence team, you will partner with technical and business stakeholders to deliver scalable analytics solutions that improve data accessibility, governance, and decision-making throughout the organization.

Job Description

As the Business Intelligence Specialist, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining enterprise data models and reporting solutions within a modern medallion architecture. You will serve as the primary owner of the organization's transformation and semantic data layers, ensuring data is accurate, governed, and easily consumable by business users.

Responsibilities

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize the dbt environment used for enterprise data transformation.
  • Design and develop dbt models that transform data across bronze, silver, and gold layers, including testing, monitoring, and quality controls.
  • Build and maintain curated, business-facing data models that support reporting and analytics initiatives.
  • Develop certified data assets, including data dictionaries, metric definitions, refresh schedules, and governance standards.
  • Establish and maintain best practices for data modeling, naming conventions, testing, documentation, and source control.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define metrics, and translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Centralize business logic and KPI calculations within the data layer to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and performance metrics for business teams across the organization.
  • Identify data quality issues and collaborate with system owners to improve data accuracy and completeness.
  • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of the enterprise data warehouse and analytics platform.
  • Collaborate with project management and IT teams to estimate effort, define technical approaches, and deliver prioritized initiatives.
  • Provide guidance and occasional training to business users on certified data sources and reporting capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including development, optimization, and troubleshooting of complex queries.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling principles, including facts, dimensions, and grain.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations using platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather business requirements, manage priorities, and deliver projects through completion.
  • Excellent collaboration and relationship-building skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong judgment and critical thinking abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with Tableau, including certified data source management and governance.
  • Experience working with ERP-sourced data; exposure to JD Edwards is a plus.
  • Experience supporting medallion or layered data architectures.
  • Knowledge of modern data transformation, testing, and data quality frameworks.
  • Python or other scripting experience for data preparation and automation.
  • Experience within manufacturing, production, industrial, supply chain, or distribution environments.
  • Experience establishing data governance, certification standards, and enterprise reporting best practices.

Benefits

Our client’s benefits include profit sharing, a 401(K) match, training and career growth opportunities, professional development, financial services, on-site coaching and wellness counseling, and much more.

How To Apply

Take the first step on your new career path! To submit yourself for consideration for this role, simply click the apply button and complete our mobile-friendly online application. Once we’ve reviewed your application details, a recruiter will reach out to you with next steps!

Equal Opportunity Statement

As an equal opportunity employer, Dahl Consulting welcomes candidates of all backgrounds and experiences to apply. If this position sounds like the right opportunity for you, we encourage you to take the next step and connect with us. We look forward to meeting you!

Overview

Join the Xanterra Travel Collection team:

Xanterra Travel Collection is a premier group of travel and leisure businesses with a focus on sustainability and exceptional service. Headquartered in Greenwood Village, Colorado, we operate iconic properties and services in stunning locations worldwide, including lodging, food and beverage, Windstar Cruises, short-line railroads, and adventure travel. We are dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for our guests and providing transformative career opportunities for our team members.

Job Summary:

The Analytics Engineer joins a small but mighty Data & Analytics team responsible for the data products and reporting used across Xanterra's operations, finance, sales, and revenue management teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the analytics stack rather than specializing in only one area.

Approximately 60% of the role focuses on Power BI semantic models, measures, reporting, and dashboards, with the remaining 40% focused on the Snowflake and dbt data models that support them. You'll work across the full lifecycle, from understanding a business question to building the underlying data model and delivering the final reporting solution.

The core platform is already established, so this role is focused on extending and improving the existing environment rather than building a new data platform from scratch. The team works with Snowflake, dbt, Power BI, and GitHub within a layered bronze, silver, and gold architecture.

This is a strong fit for someone who likes owning their work from data model through final reporting and seeing how it is used by the business. You'll join a small team with an established modern data platform and have the opportunity to work with data across Xanterra's diverse portfolio of travel and hospitality businesses. This position reports to the Director, Data & Analytics and works onsite five days per week in Greenwood Village, Colorado. Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the Denver metropolitan area. Relocation assistance is not available.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, including relationships, DAX measures, row-level security, and the reporting built on top of them.
  • Develop SQL and dbt models in Snowflake using the team's established data architecture and development standards.
  • Partner directly with business teams to understand reporting and analytics needs and translate them into reliable data products.
  • Test and validate data products by reviewing record counts, keys, business rules, and reported figures against source systems.
  • Create and maintain consistent metric and measure definitions so business users are working from consistent data across reports.
  • Troubleshoot data and reporting issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings and resolutions clearly to business partners.
  • Document data models, metrics, definitions, and key logic so both technical and business users can understand what the data represents.
  • Participate in sprint planning, peer and code reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and monitor assigned data processes for issues requiring resolution or escalation.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development tools where appropriate, reviewing and validating generated work before release.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related data-focused role.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with data in a cloud-based environment.
  • Hands-on Power BI experience, including data modeling and DAX measures.
  • Working knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot data issues, validate accuracy, and clearly communicate findings to both technical and nontechnical partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, or similar modern data and development tools.
  • Experience working with layered data architecture or automated data testing.
  • Experience supporting hospitality, travel, retail, or another operations-focused business.

Compensation:

The salary range is $100,000 - $115,000 depending on experience.

Benefits:

For full-time employees, Xanterra offers a comprehensive benefits package including: Medical, Dental & Vision; HSA & FSA; Life & Disability; Accident, Hospital & Critical Illness; Pet Insurance; PTO and paid Holidays; 401(k) with Company Match; Employee Assistance Plan; Education Assistance; RTD-Denver transit pass for in-office employees, and Employee Discounts & Travel Deals.

Xanterra Travel Collection is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Job Title: Lead BI Developer (Tableau)

Workplace Type: Hybrid-3 Days Onsite (New York, NY)

Employment Type: Direct Hire


Overview

A leading company is seeking a Lead BI Developer specializing in Tableau to transform complex media data into clear, actionable insights. In this role, you will lead the full lifecycle of advanced Tableau dashboards, from design and development through testing and deployment. Your work will support reporting on audience consumption, advertising performance, content engagement, subscriptions, and revenue-related metrics.

This position offers the opportunity to serve as a technical authority for Tableau development, establish visualization standards, optimize reporting performance, and mentor other BI professionals. You will also help translate advanced analytical models into intuitive dashboards for executive and operational users.


Required Skills

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence development.
  • At least 5 years of Tableau experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Expert knowledge of Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server or Cloud administration and governance.
  • Advanced SQL expertise, including complex querying, ETL processes, and performance optimization.
  • Experience developing and optimizing Tableau solutions for large datasets, including datasets exceeding 100 million rows.
  • Strong background in data modeling and designing structures that support efficient BI reporting.
  • Experience with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.
  • Ability to manage the complete Tableau dashboard lifecycle, including design, development, testing, and deployment.
  • Experience with advanced Tableau capabilities, including:
  • Level of Detail expressions
  • Data blending
  • Dynamic parameters
  • Performance tuning
  • Ability to develop scalable Tableau data sources and apply visualization standards to media reporting.
  • Experience translating analytical models, including attribution and predictive content scoring, into business-focused visualizations.
  • Experience building or supporting BI portal environments using Apache Tomcat, PHP, and JavaScript.
  • Experience developing custom BI applications that operate as a wrapper around Tableau reports using Tableau APIs.
  • Experience integrating a BI portal with backend AI agents to support interaction through text prompts.
  • Understanding of media-related metrics such as subscriber churn, ad impressions, video views, content watch time, audience demographics, and campaign ROI.
  • Ability to collaborate with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and key performance indicators.
  • Experience mentoring developers on dashboard design, data storytelling, SQL optimization, and BI governance.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Current Tableau Certified Professional certification or an equivalent advanced certification.
  • Experience in the Media, Entertainment, Publishing, or Ad-Tech industries.
  • Familiarity with major advertising technology platforms, including Google Ad Manager, DSPs, or SSPs.
  • Experience with audience measurement tools such as Nielsen or Comscore.
  • Programming experience with PHP, JavaScript, or Python for data preparation and custom web BI portal development.


Bring your Tableau leadership and BI expertise to a role focused on turning complex data into high-impact business insight—apply today.
