descriptionHtml:
Here’s What All The Hype Is About…

Premier Nutrition Company (PNC) is one of the fastest-growing companies in the proactive wellness space showing clear leadership in the category of protein shakes and powders. We make the brands Premier Protein and Dymatize, and are part of our publicly traded holding company, BellRing Brands (NYSE: BRBR).

We have a simple, yet powerful, formula for our success, which we’ve been nailing since our founding in 1997. We start with an organization powered by our company purpose—Changing Lives with Good Energy. Then our purpose-driven people are given the support and autonomy to develop and grow. Next, we are super-intentional about designing a culture where everyone feels like they truly connect and belong, which is one of our five company core values. Purpose-driven, connected employees deliver amazing business results. And winning companies with remarkable people and thriving cultures attract and retain top talent, so the cycle becomes self-reinforcing or what we call our regenerative culture.

We don’t mind sharing our formula, since we believe the world would be a better place if more workplaces treated adults like adults and gave them the platform to do the best work of their lives—alongside some truly amazing colleagues. Why don’t more companies do this? It takes deep-in-your-bones conviction to your people, products, and purpose to pull it off. It also takes resisting the urge to try to control people, and instead, trusting them to make the right decisions. The result of our vibrant culture speaks for itself: We were certified as a Great Place to Work™ for the 9 th year-running in 2025. And we currently rank #8 on Fortune Magazine’s Best Workplaces in our category and were in the top 12 for each of the last 7 years.

We have a long list of ways we take care of our people, but here are some crowd-pleasers that our employees often say they love most: Year-round ½ day Fridays, free lunches & snacks, dogs in the office, culture of belonging celebrations, engaging in-office events like bring your kids to work day, 6% 401k match after 1 year, generous paid family leave regardless of gender, all positions bonus-eligible, company-wide volunteer days, company-matched charitable donations, no employee handbook, no dress code, coaching conversations instead of performance reviews, and walking meetings.

PNC seeks individuals who will flourish in this type of work environment and will add to our culture and help build this high-growth company for the next phase in our amazing journey. Does this sound like you? Then read on…

We believe in the power of mindset, and specifically what we call the Challenger Mindset. Do you take smart, bold risks, display relentless hunger, and see yourself as a builder? We’re looking for individuals who choose action over analysis paralysis—those who start before they feel completely ready, make calculated moves based on the best information available, and build momentum through decisive action rather than perfect planning. You should have an insatiable drive that keeps you agile and forward-thinking, always challenging assumptions, seeking new opportunities, and focusing on long-term impact over short-term wins. Above all, you’re a builder—someone who transforms the status quo, finds smarter, simpler, faster ways to get things done, and inspires others to do the same.

The role you’re interested in…

As a BI Developer, you will help our company solve challenging business problems and drive decisions through trusted, scalable analytics. As a member of our Enterprise Data Intelligence team, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, partnering with stakeholders to understand business problems, define meaningful metrics, and deliver analytical solutions that enable better and faster decision-making.

In this role, you will have an opportunity to own up to medium complexity BI solutions end-to-end, from business discovery and requirements definition through metric definition, data and semantic modeling, visualization, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing support. You will primarily work in Power BI and SQL, while partnering closely with Data Engineering and working within a broader modern data ecosystem that includes Snowflake and dbt.

This role goes beyond building dashboards. You will contribute to development standards, reusable patterns, semantic modeling practices, and practical governance while bringing your own informed point of view to how analytical solutions should be designed and delivered.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically strong, self-directed, curious, and biased toward action and closure. You should be comfortable operating with ambiguity, forming recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions, respectfully challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of moving work across the finish line.

The work environment…

So, what’s it like to work here? If you’re based in the greater Bay Area, you’ll walk into our Emeryville office each Tuesday morning and start the in-person portion of our hybrid work week at our weekly all-company meeting and find close to 200 of your colleagues, some sitting with their dogs, talking excitedly through the week ahead and watching a newer teammate tell their personal life and career journey followed by a quick update on any hot topics that might be relevant to the week ahead.

We are a dynamic, HYBRID workplace so every employee who lives within 100 miles of our offices is expected to come in Tuesday through Thursday. We are very intentional about connecting in person for things like innovation, impromptu collaboration, having respectful challenges to get to better decisions, leadership role-modeling, and culture building. Great work cultures are built on stories about what great looks like in practice, and great stories during virtual meetings just don’t happen. The expected pay scale for this role is $120k to $140k, which may vary based on relevant experience, qualifications, geographic area (if applicable), and internal equity for the role.

At the beginning of 2026, we will move into our massive modern 133,000 square foot headquarters in Emeryville, California, complete with spacious personal workspaces, gym with rock-climbing wall, a café, free onsite parking, tons of greenery, and many transportation options.

You’re excited about this opportunity because your time will be filled with…

Design, Develop, and Deliver BI Solutions: 50% of your time

  • In partnership with Associate Director, own BI projects end-to-end, including discovery, requirements definition, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, training, adoption, and ongoing support.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders and lead discovery sessions to understand business processes, and the decisions the analytics need to support, , translating loosely defined business questions into analytical requirements, metric definitions, data requirements, and implementable BI solutions..
  • Design and develop intuitive, scalable, and performant Power BI reports and dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify opportunities, and take action.
  • Develop and maintain DAX measures, calculations, KPIs, and analytical experiences using sound modeling practices.
  • Apply effective visualization, information-design, and user-experience principles so BI products clearly communicate insights rather than simply present available data.
  • Explore and analyze data to identify patterns, anomalies, data-quality issues, and assumptions that should be validated before solutions are implemented.
  • Bring an informed point of view to business and technical discussions. Respectfully challenge requirements, metric definitions, or proposed solutions when the data or experience suggests a better approach.
  • Manage dashboard design discussions, UAT, stakeholder communication, and delivery activities necessary to successfully implement BI solutions.
  • Manage multiple initiatives and dependencies, communicate risks early, respect agreed-upon timelines, and actively drive open decisions and deliverables toward closure.
  • Partner with stakeholders following deployment to evaluate adoption and effectiveness, gather feedback, and evolve analytical products as business needs change.

Build and Maintain Trusted Semantic Models and Metrics: 30% of your time

  • Design, build, maintain, and support reusable Power BI semantic models that provide consistent analytical experiences across reports and business use cases.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define KPIs and metrics, including their business meaning, calculation logic, grain, dimensions, filters, and underlying business rules.
  • Build reusable measures and analytical constructs that promote consistent interpretation of business performance across reports and teams.
  • Apply consistent practices for semantic model naming, documentation, ownership, security, performance, metric definition, lifecycle management, and reuse.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering to communicate data requirements, understand upstream transformations and dependencies, troubleshoot data issues, and determine the appropriate layer for business and analytical logic.
  • Understand the upstream data lifecycle sufficiently to recognize when a requirement should be addressed through the underlying data model or transformation layer rather than through additional report-specific logic.
  • Help reduce duplicated business logic and unnecessary report-specific calculations by promoting scalable and reusable analytical patterns.
  • Contribute to practical governance practices that improve the consistency, usability, trust, maintainability, and reuse of semantic models and metrics.

Drive BI Development Excellence and Innovation: 20% of your time

  • Contribute to establishing and continuously improving BI development standards, best practices, and reusable patterns across solution design, semantic modeling, metric development, visualization, testing, documentation, review, deployment, and support.
  • Help demonstrate through implementation what good looks like for BI from a process, technical, and implementation perspective.
  • Understand and follow structured software development and deployment practices appropriate to BI delivery, including requirements and design, development, testing, peer review, version control, deployment/release management, documentation, and production support.
  • Develop and apply appropriate testing approaches for BI solutions, including validation of source-to-report data, metric calculations, filters, security, edge cases, and regression impacts.
  • Assist in the implementation and maintenance of appropriate data-access and security practices within BI solutions.
  • Monitor deployed solutions, troubleshoot issues across the BI stack, and partner with Data Engineering when root causes extend into upstream data models or pipelines.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, consolidate, or improve existing BI solutions and development processes.
  • Apply practical governance practices and contribute to improving how BI assets, semantic models, metrics, documentation, access, and lifecycle management are handled.
  • Use AI-assisted tools as a practical, repeatable part of day-to-day BI development to accelerate and improve requirements analysis, SQL and DAX development, semantic modeling, dashboard prototyping, documentation, test creation, troubleshooting, and technical/design reviews, and proactively identify new ways to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of BI delivery.
  • Apply sound judgment to AI-generated outputs by reviewing, validating, and testing results before incorporating them into production solutions.

What are we looking for?

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience developing enterprise BI and analytics solutions, with demonstrated experience delivering solutions from business requirements through production deployment and support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including report/dashboard development, semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, security, deployment, and performance optimization.
  • Advanced SQL skills with the ability to independently explore complex datasets, develop analytical logic, troubleshoot data issues, and write efficient and maintainable queries.
  • Strong understanding of data and dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and common analytical modeling patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining semantic models and reusable business metrics/KPIs.
  • Experience partnering with business stakeholders to define metrics rather than simply implementing predetermined calculations.
  • Ability to lead requirements and discovery conversations and translate ambiguous business questions into clearly defined analytical requirements and solutions.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to explore data, identify patterns and anomalies, validate assumptions, and critically evaluate whether the underlying data supports the business question being addressed.
  • Experience collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams and an understanding of how BI fits within the end-to-end data lifecycle, from source data and transformations through dimensional models, semantic models, and downstream analytical consumption.
  • Exposure to modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and analytics transformation frameworks such as dbt, with an understanding of their role in producing trusted, analytics-ready data. Hands-on development expertise in Snowflake or dbt is not required.
  • Understanding of structured software development and deployment practices as they apply to BI, including testing, review, version control, deployment across environments, release management, and production support.
  • Understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, security, and documentation concepts relevant to enterprise analytics.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive BI initiatives, manage dependencies, communicate risks, respect delivery commitments, and move projects and decisions toward closure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools within BI or analytical development workflows, with practical examples of how AI has been used to improve development speed, quality, testing, documentation, reviews, troubleshooting, or delivery.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools within BI or analytical development workflows, with practical examples of improving development speed, quality, testing, documentation, reviews, troubleshooting, or delivery, and sound judgment in validating AI-assisted work to maintain the accuracy and quality expected of production analytical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience contributing to or implementing BI standards, reusable development patterns, or best practices within an analytics organization.
  • Exposure to implementing practical BI or analytics governance practices, including areas such as ownership, certification, documentation, access, lifecycle management, or metric consistency.
  • Experience contributing to semantic-model standards or governance in an environment supporting multiple reports, analytical products, or business teams.
  • Experience supporting analytics across business functions such as Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, or Marketing.
  • Experience working in the CPG industry.
  • o Microsoft Power BI certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • o Experience improving BI deployment, testing, version-control, or release-management practices.Experience with a shared or universal semantic/metrics layer that enables governed business definitions and metrics to be reused beyond an individual Power BI report or visualization layer.

Skills

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to take ambiguous business and data problems, structure them, investigate the underlying data, and drive them toward practical and scalable solutions.
  • Business Curiosity: Seeks to understand why a metric or analytical solution matters, how the underlying business process works, and what decisions the solution needs to support.
  • Ownership & Execution: Self-directed and accountable for outcomes. Establishes clear next steps, manages dependencies, surfaces risks early, respects delivery commitments, and drives work through decisions, implementation, and closure.
  • Brings a Point of View: Uses business context, data, experience, and technical judgment to develop recommendations. Will respectfully challenge requirements, definitions, or proposed solutions when there is a better path rather than simply implementing what is requested.
  • Technical Depth: Comfortable moving across SQL, dimensional models, semantic models, DAX, and Power BI while understanding how these components fit within the broader data ecosystem.
  • Metric Discipline: Understands that a KPI is more than a calculation and works to establish clear definitions, grain, dimensionality, business rules, ownership, and context.
  • Obsesses Over the Details: Committed to accuracy and recognizes that seemingly small inconsistencies in data, definitions, calculations, or implementation can undermine trust in analytics.
  • Drives Continuous Improvement: Constantly looks for opportunities to improve processes, standards, patterns, tools, quality, and efficiency.
  • Raises the Bar: Contributes ideas and practical examples that help the team continuously improve what good BI development looks like without requiring that the individual already have owned enterprise-wide standards.
  • Collaborative: Partners effectively with Data Engineering, business stakeholders, and other technical teams while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
  • AI-Enabled: Uses AI naturally and thoughtfully as part of modern BI development and continually explores ways it can improve quality and productivity.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly with technical and business audiences, explains recommendations and trade-offs, and brings stakeholders along through context and rationale.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities as business needs evolve.
  • Continuous Learner: Passionate about staying current with advancements in BI, analytics, semantic modeling, AI, and related technologies.

What The Work Is Like

  • You'll spend a significant portion of your day working on a computer, reviewing data, creating reports, communicating with partners, and joining virtual and in-person meetings
  • This role requires frequent and ongoing use of a keyboard, mouse, phone, and other office technology
  • You'll regularly navigate multiple systems at once, analyze detailed information, and shift between competing priorities and deadlines
  • You'll communicate regularly with team members, cross-functional partners, external partners, and leaders through meetings, Outlook based email, messaging platforms such as Microsoft Teams, and presentations
  • Occasional movement around the office may be required for meetings, collaboration, and team activities
  • May occasionally lift or move office materials weighing up to 10 pounds

So, if after reading through this long list you’re thinking—I’m not sure I meet 100% of these requirements, should I still apply? YES—if you embody a growth mindset, see challenges as opportunities to develop, and find innovative ways to get the real work that matters done, you sound like our kind of candidate!

The 5 capabilities or mindsets most relevant to this role:

  • Challenger Mindset—bias for action, hungry to get after it, comfortable taking smart risks
  • Be a builder by creating for the future
  • Enterprise strategic view—take the full company perspective over departments or channels
  • Challenge ideas respectfully by sharing your real opinion with conviction; disagree in a way people feel heard
  • Bring people along by providing context and cascading information; share openly and inclusively

You will thrive here and may just do the best work of your life if…

  • You are hungry, are comfortable with smart risks,
  • You like to get sh*t, I mean—stuff done
  • You can be both clear and kind—empathetic yet hold people accountable
  • You want to be an integral part of shaping an amazing work culture and being a culture-add
  • You are comfortable being natural, casual, open, and even a bit playful at work

This may not be your ideal next career move if you like…

  • …a lot of structure, rules, and uniformity
  • …a lot of command and control management
  • …a “big company” impersonal, cog-in-the-machine vibe—that ain’t us
  • …to build a beautiful, orderly bureaucracy
  • … things to not change much

Here’s the deal with our not-so-standard, um…standard interview process because we know you are the curious type, which is why you’re still reading this…

  • Quick 30 min phone chat with a high energy member of our Talent Acquisition team to do a quick overview of your background and answer any burning questions you have
  • Team interviews are kept to a minimum to foster a more efficient, candidate-friendly process (too many interviewers yields little value and drags out the process for you—and who wants that, right?):
    • A short series of in-person or video interviews in a 1:1 setting; these are usually with the hiring manager, one or two other team members, and a person from another team to get broader perspectives (note: we don’t do panel interviews because they don’t give interviewers a chance to ask you unique questions, and we assign interviewers different roles so we’re probing different capabilities)
  • A case study or job task to simulate what you’d actually be doing in the role might be included (since your job is not actually to be interviewed for a living, why is that the thing companies rely on so much?) Yes, there will be a small panel for this one so you don’t have to do it more than once, and yes, they might ask you some kind yet probing questions at the end after the raucous applause stops.
  • Once your interview concludes, the team will meet for an in-depth consultative process to ensure we are hiring the right person for the right job. Interviewers must come in with a strong yes or no vote beforehand to avoid groupthink with supporting reasons. The collective thoughts on your candidacy will be discussed in an environment of safety to challenge ideas respectfully, debate. and be open to all important qualifications of the candidates. A trained, disinterested bias blocker will be present to help mitigate bias so the team can make a sound hiring decision. The moment of truth arrives when the hiring manager makes the big decision. If you nailed the interviews and the case study was brilliant, guess what? The offer is all yours! And the ball is in your court. Will you accept? descriptionText:
Here’s What All The Hype Is About…

Premier Nutrition Company (PNC) is one of the fastest-growing companies in the proactive wellness space showing clear leadership in the category of protein shakes and powders. We make the brands Premier Protein and Dymatize, and are part of our publicly traded holding company, BellRing Brands (NYSE: BRBR).

We have a simple, yet powerful, formula for our success, which we’ve been nailing since our founding in 1997. We start with an organization powered by our company purpose—Changing Lives with Good Energy. Then our purpose-driven people are given the support and autonomy to develop and grow. Next, we are super-intentional about designing a culture where everyone feels like they truly connect and belong, which is one of our five company core values. Purpose-driven, connected employees deliver amazing business results. And winning companies with remarkable people and thriving cultures attract and retain top talent, so the cycle becomes self-reinforcing or what we call our regenerative culture.

We don’t mind sharing our formula, since we believe the world would be a better place if more workplaces treated adults like adults and gave them the platform to do the best work of their lives—alongside some truly amazing colleagues. Why don’t more companies do this? It takes deep-in-your-bones conviction to your people, products, and purpose to pull it off. It also takes resisting the urge to try to control people, and instead, trusting them to make the right decisions. The result of our vibrant culture speaks for itself: We were certified as a Great Place to Work™ for the 9 th year-running in 2025. And we currently rank #8 on Fortune Magazine’s Best Workplaces in our category and were in the top 12 for each of the last 7 years.

We have a long list of ways we take care of our people, but here are some crowd-pleasers that our employees often say they love most: Year-round ½ day Fridays, free lunches & snacks, dogs in the office, culture of belonging celebrations, engaging in-office events like bring your kids to work day, 6% 401k match after 1 year, generous paid family leave regardless of gender, all positions bonus-eligible, company-wide volunteer days, company-matched charitable donations, no employee handbook, no dress code, coaching conversations instead of performance reviews, and walking meetings.

PNC seeks individuals who will flourish in this type of work environment and will add to our culture and help build this high-growth company for the next phase in our amazing journey. Does this sound like you? Then read on…

We believe in the power of mindset, and specifically what we call the Challenger Mindset. Do you take smart, bold risks, display relentless hunger, and see yourself as a builder? We’re looking for individuals who choose action over analysis paralysis—those who start before they feel completely ready, make calculated moves based on the best information available, and build momentum through decisive action rather than perfect planning. You should have an insatiable drive that keeps you agile and forward-thinking, always challenging assumptions, seeking new opportunities, and focusing on long-term impact over short-term wins. Above all, you’re a builder—someone who transforms the status quo, finds smarter, simpler, faster ways to get things done, and inspires others to do the same.

The role you’re interested in…

As a BI Developer, you will help our company solve challenging business problems and drive decisions through trusted, scalable analytics. As a member of our Enterprise Data Intelligence team, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, partnering with stakeholders to understand business problems, define meaningful metrics, and deliver analytical solutions that enable better and faster decision-making.

In this role, you will have an opportunity to own up to medium complexity BI solutions end-to-end, from business discovery and requirements definition through metric definition, data and semantic modeling, visualization, testing, deployment, adoption, and ongoing support. You will primarily work in Power BI and SQL, while partnering closely with Data Engineering and working within a broader modern data ecosystem that includes Snowflake and dbt.

This role goes beyond building dashboards. You will contribute to development standards, reusable patterns, semantic modeling practices, and practical governance while bringing your own informed point of view to how analytical solutions should be designed and delivered.

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically strong, self-directed, curious, and biased toward action and closure. You should be comfortable operating with ambiguity, forming recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions, respectfully challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of moving work across the finish line.

The work environment…

So, what’s it like to work here? If you’re based in the greater Bay Area, you’ll walk into our Emeryville office each Tuesday morning and start the in-person portion of our hybrid work week at our weekly all-company meeting and find close to 200 of your colleagues, some sitting with their dogs, talking excitedly through the week ahead and watching a newer teammate tell their personal life and career journey followed by a quick update on any hot topics that might be relevant to the week ahead.

We are a dynamic, HYBRID workplace so every employee who lives within 100 miles of our offices is expected to come in Tuesday through Thursday. We are very intentional about connecting in person for things like innovation, impromptu collaboration, having respectful challenges to get to better decisions, leadership role-modeling, and culture building. Great work cultures are built on stories about what great looks like in practice, and great stories during virtual meetings just don’t happen. The expected pay scale for this role is $120k to $140k, which may vary based on relevant experience, qualifications, geographic area (if applicable), and internal equity for the role.

At the beginning of 2026, we will move into our massive modern 133,000 square foot headquarters in Emeryville, California, complete with spacious personal workspaces, gym with rock-climbing wall, a café, free onsite parking, tons of greenery, and many transportation options.

You’re excited about this opportunity because your time will be filled with…

Design, Develop, and Deliver BI Solutions: 50% of your time



- In partnership with Associate Director, own BI projects end-to-end, including discovery, requirements definition, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, training, adoption, and ongoing support.
- Partner directly with business stakeholders and lead discovery sessions to understand business processes, and the decisions the analytics need to support, , translating loosely defined business questions into analytical requirements, metric definitions, data requirements, and implementable BI solutions..
- Design and develop intuitive, scalable, and performant Power BI reports and dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify opportunities, and take action.
- Develop and maintain DAX measures, calculations, KPIs, and analytical experiences using sound modeling practices.
- Apply effective visualization, information-design, and user-experience principles so BI products clearly communicate insights rather than simply present available data.
- Explore and analyze data to identify patterns, anomalies, data-quality issues, and assumptions that should be validated before solutions are implemented.
- Bring an informed point of view to business and technical discussions. Respectfully challenge requirements, metric definitions, or proposed solutions when the data or experience suggests a better approach.
- Manage dashboard design discussions, UAT, stakeholder communication, and delivery activities necessary to successfully implement BI solutions.
- Manage multiple initiatives and dependencies, communicate risks early, respect agreed-upon timelines, and actively drive open decisions and deliverables toward closure.
- Partner with stakeholders following deployment to evaluate adoption and effectiveness, gather feedback, and evolve analytical products as business needs change.

Build and Maintain Trusted Semantic Models and Metrics: 30% of your time



- Design, build, maintain, and support reusable Power BI semantic models that provide consistent analytical experiences across reports and business use cases.
- Partner with business stakeholders to define KPIs and metrics, including their business meaning, calculation logic, grain, dimensions, filters, and underlying business rules.
- Build reusable measures and analytical constructs that promote consistent interpretation of business performance across reports and teams.
- Apply consistent practices for semantic model naming, documentation, ownership, security, performance, metric definition, lifecycle management, and reuse.
- Collaborate closely with Data Engineering to communicate data requirements, understand upstream transformations and dependencies, troubleshoot data issues, and determine the appropriate layer for business and analytical logic.
- Understand the upstream data lifecycle sufficiently to recognize when a requirement should be addressed through the underlying data model or transformation layer rather than through additional report-specific logic.
- Help reduce duplicated business logic and unnecessary report-specific calculations by promoting scalable and reusable analytical patterns.
- Contribute to practical governance practices that improve the consistency, usability, trust, maintainability, and reuse of semantic models and metrics.

Drive BI Development Excellence and Innovation: 20% of your time



- Contribute to establishing and continuously improving BI development standards, best practices, and reusable patterns across solution design, semantic modeling, metric development, visualization, testing, documentation, review, deployment, and support.
- Help demonstrate through implementation what good looks like for BI from a process, technical, and implementation perspective.
- Understand and follow structured software development and deployment practices appropriate to BI delivery, including requirements and design, development, testing, peer review, version control, deployment/release management, documentation, and production support.
- Develop and apply appropriate testing approaches for BI solutions, including validation of source-to-report data, metric calculations, filters, security, edge cases, and regression impacts.
- Assist in the implementation and maintenance of appropriate data-access and security practices within BI solutions.
- Monitor deployed solutions, troubleshoot issues across the BI stack, and partner with Data Engineering when root causes extend into upstream data models or pipelines.
- Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, consolidate, or improve existing BI solutions and development processes.
- Apply practical governance practices and contribute to improving how BI assets, semantic models, metrics, documentation, access, and lifecycle management are handled.
- Use AI-assisted tools as a practical, repeatable part of day-to-day BI development to accelerate and improve requirements analysis, SQL and DAX development, semantic modeling, dashboard prototyping, documentation, test creation, troubleshooting, and technical/design reviews, and proactively identify new ways to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of BI delivery.
- Apply sound judgment to AI-generated outputs by reviewing, validating, and testing results before incorporating them into production solutions.

What are we looking for?

Education



- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience



- 3+ years of experience developing enterprise BI and analytics solutions, with demonstrated experience delivering solutions from business requirements through production deployment and support.
- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including report/dashboard development, semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, security, deployment, and performance optimization.
- Advanced SQL skills with the ability to independently explore complex datasets, develop analytical logic, troubleshoot data issues, and write efficient and maintainable queries.
- Strong understanding of data and dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and common analytical modeling patterns.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining semantic models and reusable business metrics/KPIs.
- Experience partnering with business stakeholders to define metrics rather than simply implementing predetermined calculations.
- Ability to lead requirements and discovery conversations and translate ambiguous business questions into clearly defined analytical requirements and solutions.
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to explore data, identify patterns and anomalies, validate assumptions, and critically evaluate whether the underlying data supports the business question being addressed.
- Experience collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams and an understanding of how BI fits within the end-to-end data lifecycle, from source data and transformations through dimensional models, semantic models, and downstream analytical consumption.
- Exposure to modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and analytics transformation frameworks such as dbt, with an understanding of their role in producing trusted, analytics-ready data. Hands-on development expertise in Snowflake or dbt is not required.
- Understanding of structured software development and deployment practices as they apply to BI, including testing, review, version control, deployment across environments, release management, and production support.
- Understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, security, and documentation concepts relevant to enterprise analytics.
- Demonstrated ability to independently drive BI initiatives, manage dependencies, communicate risks, respect delivery commitments, and move projects and decisions toward closure.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools within BI or analytical development workflows, with practical examples of how AI has been used to improve development speed, quality, testing, documentation, reviews, troubleshooting, or delivery.
- Demonstrated use of AI-assisted tools within BI or analytical development workflows, with practical examples of improving development speed, quality, testing, documentation, reviews, troubleshooting, or delivery, and sound judgment in validating AI-assisted work to maintain the accuracy and quality expected of production analytical solutions.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience contributing to or implementing BI standards, reusable development patterns, or best practices within an analytics organization.
- Exposure to implementing practical BI or analytics governance practices, including areas such as ownership, certification, documentation, access, lifecycle management, or metric consistency.
- Experience contributing to semantic-model standards or governance in an environment supporting multiple reports, analytical products, or business teams.
- Experience supporting analytics across business functions such as Sales, Finance, Revenue Growth Management, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, or Marketing.
- Experience working in the CPG industry.
- o Microsoft Power BI certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
- o Experience improving BI deployment, testing, version-control, or release-management practices.Experience with a shared or universal semantic/metrics layer that enables governed business definitions and metrics to be reused beyond an individual Power BI report or visualization layer.

Skills



- Problem-Solving: Ability to take ambiguous business and data problems, structure them, investigate the underlying data, and drive them toward practical and scalable solutions.
- Business Curiosity: Seeks to understand why a metric or analytical solution matters, how the underlying business process works, and what decisions the solution needs to support.
- Ownership & Execution: Self-directed and accountable for outcomes. Establishes clear next steps, manages dependencies, surfaces risks early, respects delivery commitments, and drives work through decisions, implementation, and closure.
- Brings a Point of View: Uses business context, data, experience, and technical judgment to develop recommendations. Will respectfully challenge requirements, definitions, or proposed solutions when there is a better path rather than simply implementing what is requested.
- Technical Depth: Comfortable moving across SQL, dimensional models, semantic models, DAX, and Power BI while understanding how these components fit within the broader data ecosystem.
- Metric Discipline: Understands that a KPI is more than a calculation and works to establish clear definitions, grain, dimensionality, business rules, ownership, and context.
- Obsesses Over the Details: Committed to accuracy and recognizes that seemingly small inconsistencies in data, definitions, calculations, or implementation can undermine trust in analytics.
- Drives Continuous Improvement: Constantly looks for opportunities to improve processes, standards, patterns, tools, quality, and efficiency.
- Raises the Bar: Contributes ideas and practical examples that help the team continuously improve what good BI development looks like without requiring that the individual already have owned enterprise-wide standards.
- Collaborative: Partners effectively with Data Engineering, business stakeholders, and other technical teams while maintaining clear ownership and accountability.
- AI-Enabled: Uses AI naturally and thoughtfully as part of modern BI development and continually explores ways it can improve quality and productivity.
- Communication: Communicates clearly with technical and business audiences, explains recommendations and trade-offs, and brings stakeholders along through context and rationale.
- Adaptability: Comfortable managing multiple projects and priorities as business needs evolve.
- Continuous Learner: Passionate about staying current with advancements in BI, analytics, semantic modeling, AI, and related technologies.

What The Work Is Like



- You'll spend a significant portion of your day working on a computer, reviewing data, creating reports, communicating with partners, and joining virtual and in-person meetings
- This role requires frequent and ongoing use of a keyboard, mouse, phone, and other office technology
- You'll regularly navigate multiple systems at once, analyze detailed information, and shift between competing priorities and deadlines
- You'll communicate regularly with team members, cross-functional partners, external partners, and leaders through meetings, Outlook based email, messaging platforms such as Microsoft Teams, and presentations
- Occasional movement around the office may be required for meetings, collaboration, and team activities
- May occasionally lift or move office materials weighing up to 10 pounds

So, if after reading through this long list you’re thinking—I’m not sure I meet 100% of these requirements, should I still apply? YES—if you embody a growth mindset, see challenges as opportunities to develop, and find innovative ways to get the real work that matters done, you sound like our kind of candidate!

The 5 capabilities or mindsets most relevant to this role:



-  Challenger Mindset—bias for action, hungry to get after it, comfortable taking smart risks
-  Be a builder by creating for the future
-  Enterprise strategic view—take the full company perspective over departments or channels
-  Challenge ideas respectfully by sharing your real opinion with conviction; disagree in a way people feel heard
-  Bring people along by providing context and cascading information; share openly and inclusively

You will thrive here and may just do the best work of your life if…



-  You are hungry, are comfortable with smart risks,
-  You like to get sh*t, I mean—stuff done
-  You can be both clear and kind—empathetic yet hold people accountable
-  You want to be an integral part of shaping an amazing work culture and being a culture-add
-  You are comfortable being natural, casual, open, and even a bit playful at work

This may not be your ideal next career move if you like…



-  …a lot of structure, rules, and uniformity
-  …a lot of command and control management
-  …a “big company” impersonal, cog-in-the-machine vibe—that ain’t us
-  …to build a beautiful, orderly bureaucracy
-  … things to not change much

Here’s the deal with our not-so-standard, um…standard interview process because we know you are the curious type, which is why you’re still reading this… 



- Quick 30 min phone chat with a high energy member of our Talent Acquisition team to do a quick overview of your background and answer any burning questions you have
- Team interviews are kept to a minimum to foster a more efficient, candidate-friendly process (too many interviewers yields little value and drags out the process for you—and who wants that, right?):

- A short series of in-person or video interviews in a 1:1 setting; these are usually with the hiring manager, one or two other team members, and a person from another team to get broader perspectives (note: we don’t do panel interviews because they don’t give interviewers a chance to ask you unique questions, and we assign interviewers different roles so we’re probing different capabilities)
- A case study or job task to simulate what you’d actually be doing in the role might be included (since your job is not actually to be interviewed for a living, why is that the thing companies rely on so much?) Yes, there will be a small panel for this one so you don’t have to do it more than once, and yes, they might ask you some kind yet probing questions at the end after the raucous applause stops.
- Once your interview concludes, the team will meet for an in-depth consultative process to ensure we are hiring the right person for the right job. Interviewers must come in with a strong yes or no vote beforehand to avoid groupthink with supporting reasons. The collective thoughts on your candidacy will be discussed in an environment of safety to challenge ideas respectfully, debate. and be open to all important qualifications of the candidates. A trained, disinterested bias blocker will be present to help mitigate bias so the team can make a sound hiring decision. The moment of truth arrives when the hiring manager makes the big decision. If you nailed the interviews and the case study was brilliant, guess what? The offer is all yours! And the ball is in your court. Will you accept? We sure hope so, because this place is the real deal, and don’t just believe us—just ask the 91% of our people who said this is a great place to work in our most recent employee survey.

Position Description

CGI is seeking a talented Power BI Report Developer to join our growing team supporting large scale ERP implementations and enterprise analytics initiatives. In this role, you'll design and deliver impactful reporting solutions that empower business users and executive leaders with the insights they need to make informed, data driven decisions. Working closely with business stakeholders, functional analysts, data engineers, and solution architects, you'll transform complex business requirements into intuitive dashboards, interactive reports, and scalable analytics solutions.

If you're passionate about data visualization, business intelligence, and solving complex business challenges using Microsoft technologies, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact while advancing your career with CGI.

This position is located in Arlington, VA.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and visualizations that deliver actionable business insights.

Connect, transform, and integrate data from multiple enterprise sources, including SQL Server, Excel, SharePoint, Databricks, APIs, and other business applications

Develop, optimize, and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets, DAX calculations, and Power Query transformations to ensure high performing, reliable, and scalable reporting solutions

Analyze complex business data and deliver intuitive visualizations that support operational performance, strategic planning, and executive decision making

Collaborate with business analysts, data engineers, architects, and project teams to identify opportunities to enhance reporting capabilities and drive business value

Troubleshoot and resolve reporting, data quality, integration, and performance issues while ensuring timely delivery of high quality reporting solutions

Create technical documentation, report specifications, user guides, and knowledge transfer materials while providing user support and training to encourage successful adoption

Evaluate emerging Microsoft Power Platform and Power BI capabilities and recommend innovative enhancements that strengthen the organization's business intelligence ecosystem

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

3+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and reporting solutions

Active or eligible to receive a Secret level clearance.

At least 3 years of hands on experience with Microsoft Power BI, developing dashboards, reports, and interactive visualizations

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related technical discipline

Strong expertise with Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, semantic models, datasets, report optimization, and performance tuning

Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise sources, including SQL Server, Excel, SharePoint, Snowflake, Databricks, APIs, and other business systems

Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling, data warehousing, and ETL concepts

Experience developing enterprise scale reporting and analytics solutions with an emphasis on performance, scalability, usability, and data quality

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions

Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams

Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:

Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and using design solutions or frameworks.

Knowledge of machine learning tools and development best practices.

Knowledge of web frameworks (React/Angular).

Knowledge of Python.

Knowledge of Tableau.

Knowledge of Palantir solutions.

The Sr. BI Developer will be responsible for elevating the lives of each Helen of Troy employee by crafting analytical tools that drive decision-making at every level of the organization and using our data assets to drive actions and insights.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs.
  • Build/Propose solutions that enable data-driven decision-making within HELE.
  • Understand business models, data sources, system infrastructure.
  • Design and implement robust Power BI Architectures that empower organization-wide self-service reporting and ad-hoc data exploration.
  • Design and Implement a Power BI COE in partnership with key partners within different business departments and functions.
  • Apply a hands-on approach to build and lead the key analytical assets needed for the organization.
  • Develop scalable Power BI data models that drive strategic decision-making and deliver measurable business value.
  • Optimally delegate and use repartees and other individuals (consultants/onsite/offshore) and ensure accountability to delivering timely solutions.
  • Ensure solutions are adequately embraced and used by the business groups.
  • Ensure accountability with various partners who are contributing to building Power BI solutions.
  • Adoption and use of agile methodologies for all activities.
  • Design and implement proven methods for DevOps and project management including vital metrics and measures.
  • Incorporate proven methods for governing Power BI solutions including the use of a business glossary, standard KPI, business definitions, etc.
  • Guide and support team members and business users in building their own reports on top of scalable Power BI models.
  • Stay updated with the latest data trends and technologies to enhance our BI capabilities continuously.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

  • Ability to connect with various audiences with varying degrees of technical expertise.
  • Strong planning, priority setting, and project management skills to balance multiple projects and resources in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant field.
  • Over 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Power BI as an enterprise platform.
  • 2+ years leading BI teams or managing cross-functional BI initiatives.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end Power BI solutions within a complex Enterprise IT ecosystem, including integration with centralized data platforms, ERP systems (e.g., Oracle), and governed data models.
  • Prior knowledge of a domain such as Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, etc.
  • Experience in creating and managing a Power BI CoE.
  • Experience working within Agile Methodology.
  • Experience with innovative solutions, problem-solving, and working across diverse groups and domains.
  • Excellent written and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree/MBA.
  • Related Experience in CPG/Hard Goods/Retail Industry.
  • Knowledge and experience in crafting and building a scalable BI infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with designing and implementing a modern data platform architecture.

In Massachusetts, the standard base pay range for this role is $111,791- $167,687 annually. This base pay range is specific to Massachusetts and may not be applicable to other locations. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Benefits: Salary + Bonus, Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, 401(k) with company match, Basic Life Insurance, Short Term Disability (STD), Long Term Disability (LTD), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Charitable (volunteer) Leave, and Educational Assistance.

Position Purpose: Creates complex Enterprise-class data assets that provide business insight and aid business decision-making. Assets will include (but are not limited to) reports, visualizations, dashboards, and data extracts. Produces complex reports and performs meaningful quantitative or qualitative analyses addressing impactful business issues or questions. Combines these reports with subject-matter expertise to deliver coherent, insightful takeaways comprehensive read-outs, and advice/recommendations grounded in what our data is telling us.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

  • Develops complex BI solution architecture that accurately translates business requirements to technology solutions and ensures the design will meet business requirements throughout the lifecycle of a change
  • Participates in and implements day-to-day activities related to defining architecture, establishing infrastructure, and implementing standards used to create frameworks/patterns for delivering business intelligence solutions
  • Conducts complex business analysis activities to enable technology solutions that adequately fulfill strategic business needs and objectives
  • Delivers complex project setups, analysis, data flows, designs (wireframes/mock-up), etc., for and in partnership with customers
  • Helps lead the execution of long-term strategic goals for business intelligence development in conjunction with end users, management, customers, and other stakeholders
  • Conducts extensive research and makes recommendations on business intelligence products, services, and standards in support of procurement and development efforts
  • Performs and oversees complex programming, quality assurance reviews, documentation, system deployment, training, and project setup/support
  • Provides timely and appropriate communication to business owners, stakeholders, and users on issue status and resolution
  • Develops, maintains, and implements the business intelligence architecture as a core asset at Centene
  • Collaborates with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management, process efficiency with respect to data and delivery
  • Collaborates with both Enterprise Architecture (EA) and EDAS Solutions Architecture on the solution/service design to ensure it conforms to enterprise architectural standards and future roadmaps
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and Requires 4 – 6 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise BI solutions using Power BI or comparable business intelligence and data visualization platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting complex queries and datasets used by enterprise BI solutions; Snowflake or Teradata experience preferred.
  • Experience with data validation, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and quality assurance testing for complex data solutions.
  • Experience independently translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and supporting solutions through development, deployment, and production.
  • Experience with Git, GitLab CI/CD, code reviews, and automated deployment practices.

Soft Skills

  • Intermediate - Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty
  • Intermediate - Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Intermediate - Ability to work independently
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated analytical skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated project management skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills

Pay Range: $87,000.00 - $161,300.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

descriptionHtml:
As part of the Data Analytics team and reporting to the Director, Data Analytics, the Lead Business Intelligence Developer will lead the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of business intelligence and analytical solutions that advance the data maturity of Augusta National Golf Club (ANGC). Working closely with business stakeholders and Data Engineering, this role will translate business needs into trusted metrics, visualizations, semantic models, forecasts, and other analytical products using SQL, Python, Tableau, and related technologies. The Lead Business Intelligence Developer will apply strong technical expertise to deliver reliable and scalable solutions and transform complex data into actionable insights that support informed decision-making and contribute to the continued growth and vision of ANGC.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead all aspects of the business intelligence and analytics lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, implementation, documentation, ongoing support, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business processes, define analytical needs, and translate business questions into data and analytics solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, visualizations, reporting products, and analytical applications using Tableau and other data visualization technologies.
  • Use SQL, Python, and related technologies to analyze complex data, automate analytical processes, develop code-based visualizations, and create reusable analytical solutions.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to define and translate business logic, measures, and analytical requirements into curated data models that support consistent, accurate, and trusted analytics across the organization.
  • Analyze data to identify meaningful trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers, translating findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Develop forecasting, statistical, scenario-planning, and other advanced analytical solutions that support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of standards and best practices, including source control, peer review, testing, documentation, deployment processes, data governance, and CI/CD.
  • Provide outstanding, friendly customer service to all Augusta National staff, including executives and Club members as appropriate, while positively representing the Software Engineering and Data Analytics department throughout the organization.
  • Assist with Data Analytics related tasks and preparations for The Masters Tournament.
  • Meet with users as required to discuss and re-visit departmental application needs.
  • Maintain the strict confidentiality of Augusta National Golf Club, its staff and membership, and all aspects of the business.
  • Performs other duties which are deemed by management to be an important part of the job.
  • Physical demands are outlined immediately below.

Physical Demands

  • Acceptable level of hearing and vision to perform job duties.
  • Occasionally required to walk and work with hands and arms, lift up to 25 pounds and/or drive a golf cart.
  • Constantly required to sit, sometimes for several hours at a time, and use their hands and fingers to operate a computer.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Qualifications

Skills/Knowledge/Attributes

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including the ability to analyze complex data, develop reusable queries and calculations, validate results, and optimize analytical workloads.
  • Advanced proficiency with Tableau or other data visualization tools, including dashboard design, data visualization, performance optimization, and development of intuitive analytical experiences.
  • Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for data analysis, automation, forecasting, code-based visualization, and development of analytical solutions.
  • Strong understanding of semantic layers, dimensional modeling, business logic, metric definitions, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience working with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse platform and an understanding of how analytical products are supported by curated data models.
  • Experience applying statistical analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, or other advanced analytical methods to business and operational questions.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand business processes, solve complex problems with data, and translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, executives, and other audiences.
  • Experience with modern development practices, including source control, peer review, testing, documentation, deployment processes, data governance, and CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise, sound judgment, initiative, curiosity, and the ability to mentor others while managing multiple priorities in a collaborative, customer-focused environment.

Relative Experience/Education

  • Undergraduate degree in Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Management, or a related technical discipline.
  • Two (2) to five (5) years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with BI reporting tools such as Tableau and Power BI.
  • Experience with or exposure to cloud data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake is preferred.
  • Prior experience working in the Sports & Entertainment industries is a plus.

Required License(s)

  • Possess a valid driver’s license and/or successfully complete the Club’s internal motor vehicle training program.

Projected Work Schedule

Normal work hours are 8:30 am to 5:00 pm, Monday through Friday. Must be available to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

Work Authorization & Sponsorship

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are:
At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:
Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.
Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.
Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.
Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.
 

We’re Looking For:

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer who is solutions-oriented, proactive, and thrives in ambiguity. This individual will not simply respond to requests but will lead initiatives, identify opportunities, and use data to unlock business growth. You will play a key role in maintaining data flow across systems, building scalable data models, and partnering across teams to inform decision-making. The ideal candidate will have 2+ years of experience in Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing, with deep expertise in SQL, data pipelines, visualization tools, and cloud-based data architecture.

You Are:

Proactive. You take full ownership of your domain and drive action independently.
Insightful. You generate meaningful, data-driven insights that fuel decision-making.
Collaborative. You work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex problems and improve processes.
Technical. You have a strong command of data engineering, visualization, and analytical tools.

You Will:

  • Take ownership of the Business Intelligence domain, surfacing insights, solving problems, and driving data-driven decisions
  • Partner with stakeholders in product, sales, and operations to ensure data quality, availability, and effective usage
  • Manipulate and transform large datasets using SQL and scripting languages to generate impactful business insights
  • Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to optimize strategies
  • Apply data science fundamentals to build predictive models and trend analyses
  • Develop scalable data models, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Domo
  • Continuously improve data pipelines, infrastructure, and analytical capabilities
  • Mentor colleagues to enhance analytics capabilities and foster a data-driven culture

Who You Will Work With:

This role reports into the BI Manager and collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, and Data Engineering teams. You will also work closely with senior leadership to support key strategic initiatives.

Must Have’s:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence
  • Utilization of Looker or DOMO.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQL Server)
  • Strong experience in ETL/ELT development and data pipeline management
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, Scala)
  • Strong foundation in data modeling, governance, and structuring datasets for long-term use
  • Expertise in data visualization and dashboarding (Domo preferred)
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel, Google Sheets)
  • Self-starter with strong problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities

Nice to Have’s:

  • Understanding of cloud-based data architectures and security best practices
  • Leading or guiding small teams
  • Experience creating and implementing data governance strategies
  • Background in data science or machine learning application
  • Familiarity with API integrations and automation techniques


What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

  • Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

  • Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

  • Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program

  • Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

  • Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

  • Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

  • Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement


Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Business Intelligence Developer, who will support and participate in the design and development process for creating and maintaining SQL Server BI stacks (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS) and SQL Server BI Databases. The position will work with a team to maintain/enhance the existing company-wide Business Intelligence Platform and implement the daily activities of the Corporate Reporting and Data Platform. This exciting role will work with all departments and executives by helping to put data into useful and meaningful reports to make business decisions easier.

This position is 100% on-site Monday through Friday from 800am to 500pm in Stevens Point, WI.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the U.S.A. without the need for visa sponsorship.

Application Deadline (Estimated) Applications will be accepted through December 9th, 2026, however, this timeline may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate volume.

What to Expect

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance ETL processes throughout the Reporting and BI Platforms.
  • Gather user requirements for custom database reporting; troubleshoot SQL, reporting functionality and performance issues.
  • Analyze business needs and provide technology solutions in support of IT Portfolio Management process.
  • Design and build Reporting services that meet user/business specifications.
  • Use Visual Studio and Team Foundations Server to manage the reporting BI Platforms.
  • Support Power BI source data workflow and efficient data model design incorporating best practices.
  • Support and maintain data integrity and security in BI databases.
  • Plan and implement testing/deployment and coordinate with infrastructure team.


What You Will Contribute

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Management Information Systems.
  • 3-5 years’ experience with SQL Server BI Platform (2016 - 2022, SSRS, SSAS, SSIS).
  • 3-5 years’ experience with SQL Server Administration (SQL Server 2016 - 2022).
  • 3-5 years’ experience with business analysis - designing and implementing solutions for business needs.
  • 1-2 years’ experience with Power BI integration and data source design Visual Studio, use of Team Foundation Server, and Agile/Scrum Methodologies.
  • 1-2 years’ SQL Server administration (maintenance plans, performance tuning).
  • Expert knowledge of T-SQL/DAX.
  • Exhibits character qualities of diligence, cooperation, flexibility, orderliness, and thoroughness.


What You Will Receive

  • The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $95,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) with matching, HSA with company contribution.
  • Earn up to 15 paid days off annually.
  • Paid Holidays on business workdays.
  • Company-paid on-site wellness meals.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Voluntary benefits short-term disability, whole/term life, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident expense.
  • Opportunities for growth and development such as company university and tuition reimbursement options.
  • On-staff health coach, one-on-one or group coaching.
  • Health and wellness initiatives walking challenge, weight loss challenge, health risk assessment and more!

Simply put, our healthcare system is broken. It is expensive, complicated, and dysfunctional. At Ortho Molecular Products, our vision is to transform the practice of medicine. Every day, across America and the world, we help health care providers implement better solutions for health challenges that include lifestyle medicine and nutritional therapies proven to improve patient outcomes. We do this by manufacturing science-based products and developing innovative clinical programs for doctors that help their patients get better faster.

We are looking for people who align with our mission and want to invest their lifework and passion into transforming the practice of medicine. Our team is purpose-driven, values-based, and service-focused. We are looking for like-minded people who want to join the movement that is changing the way healthcare is being delivered.

Ortho Molecular Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
