Position Summary:

The Data Intelligence Developer, reporting to the Director of Data Solutions, is an experienced professional with a passion for preparing and presenting information in a visually appealing and easily understood manner, making it relevant and actionable for key stakeholders. Requires the ability to collect and synthesize complex data from multiple sources, provide intellectual rigor to analysis and interpretation processes, and derive meaningful insights that support the achievement of strategic and operational goals.

As a successful candidate, you will:

  • Design, create, test and maintain a portfolio of reports, scorecards and dashboards.
  • Utilizes understanding of dimensional data modeling techniques, data warehousing, design and concepts to produce balanced scorecard design, and design of dashboards and KPI’s (Key Performance Indicators).
  • Gather and analyze business requirements to perform data modeling and mapping across multiple platforms for enterprise-wide BI initiatives.
  • Develop and implement business logic and the ETL mechanism to populate the EDW and Programming ETL tool with business rules to be applied to data from source input to target data repository, automating data extraction/load programs to run on regular schedule.
  • Analyze large datasets to discover trends, patterns and actionable insights.
  • Work closely with multiple internal stakeholders to analyze business needs and deliver relevant information in appropriate formats.
  • Apply research and evaluation standards, descriptive statistics and data management principles to translate complex data into meaningful content.
  • Present findings using verbal, written, and graphic communication techniques. Offer recommendations to support organizational performance improvement.
  • Participate in enterprise-level metadata, master data management and data governance initiatives.
  • Stay informed about Business Intelligence industry trends, technologies and best practices that can be applied to achieve business goals.
  • Follows established City of Hope and department policies, procedures, objectives, performance improvement, attendance, safety, environmental, and infection control guidelines, including adherence to the workplace code of Conduct and Compliance Plan.
  • Practices a high level of integrity and honesty in maintaining confidentiality.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field OR 3 additional years of experience plus the minimum experience requirement may substitute for minimum education

Minimum Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, systems analysis, data informatics or related discipline, including requirements gathering, solution implementation, testing and validation.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in a health care, biomedical research and / or academic medical environment is preferred.

Skills/Abilities:

  • Present complex information in a logical and understandable format to a wide variety of audiences.
  • Strong analytical skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Translate business requirements into technical and functional specifications. Design, develop and test deliverables based on specifications.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in analyzing data to derive business insights and support performance improvement initiatives.
  • An innovative thinker that can turn ideas into solutions.
  • Demonstrated proficiency, formal training and / or certifications in one or more Business Intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, QlikView,) required. Tableau experience strongly preferred.

City of Hope employees pay is based on the following criteria: work experience, qualifications, and work location.

City of Hope is an equal opportunity employer.

In this role, you will be charged with understanding the ‘who, what, and whys’ of our business - working cross-functionally to realize the value of NM’s data assets.

Northwestern Medicine Information Services drives innovative, high-value solutions to transform health care.

We are committed to supporting the relentless pursuit of better medicine by providing exceptional service to our patients and guests as well as internal clients across the organization.   • Implementing advanced technologies in clinical and administrative areas
  • Furthering development of the end user support model to help enhance modern infrastructure

Responsibilities:

To succeed in this role, you must be innately curious, deeply analytical, highly driven, and a strong communicator. Some of those qualities include but are not limited to:

  • Be a Data Champion! Effective analysis is only possible with good data - be an advocate of data accessibility, accuracy and quality.
  • Be Curious! Find data nuggets, trends and other analytical goodies that help support our mission, vision, and values and advance our department as a whole.
  • Be a Team Player! Collaboration is what makes us great – come prepared to work with a diverse cross-section of technical and business professionals.
  • The Analytics Developer is responsible for delivering data warehouse and analytic solutions by writing ETL packages, developing visualizations, performing data and statistical analyses, and administering systems to deliver information to the health system.¿
  • Assists with development of pipelines to synthesize raw data into actionable information.
  • Evaluates data quality and interprets results in a clear, concise manner.
  • Develops documentation on requirements, decisions, design, modifications, and any associated maintenance.¿
  • Supports analytics projects and is accountable for collaborating with the business to gather and execute on requirements, which exceed customer expectations.
  • Works collaboratively with and support multi-departments efforts and projects.
  • Participates and contributes to overall training development, maintenance, and facilitate trainings both internally and externally as needed.
  • Performs other duties and functions as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience:

  • Two or more years of experience in a role querying and/or analyzing data
  • Experience using SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and reporting
  • Experience working with business users in developing analytical solutions to meet business needs
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as: Tableau, Crystal Reports,¿SSRS, Microsoft Power BI, etc.¿
  • Experience in all areas of development including analysis, design, development and support with particular emphasis on structured programming
  • Knowledge of relational database skills including SQL knowledge and the ability to create queries and stored procedures

Behavioral Attributes:

  • Demonstrated competency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and/or Access
  • Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple-priorities
  • Effective problem solving and critical thinking skills

Preferred:

  • Experience developing, designing and supporting applications and relational databases¿
  • Previous experience working with Epic Clarity data
  • Previous healthcare experience, ideally with a health system
  • Experience using the Microsoft stack (SSRS, SSMS, SSIS, SSAS)
  • Previous experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience using a software package for statistical analysis (R, Python, etc.)

Equal Opportunity

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

descriptionHtml:
Senior IT Business Intelligence Developer

Application due date: December 9, 2026

Location: Maple Grove, MN


(Eligible for hybrid schedule, providing flexibility to work remotely and in the office. Employees are required to report to GRE’s Maple Grove office as needed to meet business and operational requirements. This is not a fully remote position.)


Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restriction. Visa sponsorship is not available.


Your perspective is powerful. To do what’s never been done before, we need to think differently. We seek out people with unique backgrounds, unique skillsets and unique perspectives who want to help shape what’s next.


Summary:

Are you passionate about leveraging data to drive business decisions? Do you have hands-on experience with modern data platforms and enterprise BI tools, and do you enjoy both building analytics solutions and keeping them running well? We are seeking a Senior IT Business Intelligence Developer to join our team!


This position is responsible for the development and support of company-wide business analytics solutions across our BI platforms, and for the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of current and future business analytics tools. The role balances development, platform support and administration, and mentoring, working alongside existing team members. The Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Developer also supports other IT team members and analysts across the company as a trainer, coach and a technical subject matter expert for analytic solutions, tools and data sets.


Total Rewards:

A typical starting range for this position is $130,000 - $177,000 annually. We offer market competitive base pay and adjust our offer accordingly based upon the value of the candidate’s knowledge, skills and experience. In addition, our Total Rewards strategy focuses on recognizing individual performance and rewarding business results. Our robust Total Rewards package includes exceptional benefits and retirement, a focus on continuous engagement, recognition, personal and professional development, and an emphasis on work-life effectiveness.


Responsibilities: Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to

• Design, develop, and maintain data solutions on modern data platforms, including lakehouse storage, data pipelines, and data transformations, to support decision-making across the company.

• Create and manage semantic models, reports, and dashboards across our BI platforms.

• Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and translate them into effective analytics solutions, engaging early in projects from kickoff through delivery.

• Provide production support for BI solutions and platforms, including troubleshooting data pipelines, data refreshes, and performance issues, and share in the team’s support and break/fix work.

• Serve as a primary or backup platform administrator, including security and access governance, release and deployment management, platform configuration, capacity and performance management, and upgrades.

• Mentor and train IT staff and business users on BI tools, data modeling, and governance best practices.

• Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and standards, and lead knowledge transfer of existing solutions.

• Contribute to the strategic development and expansion of the business analytics program.

• Sense of humor and a love for making big things happen.


Qualifications:

Knowledge typically acquired through a bachelor’s degree in management information systems (MIS) or a related field, plus 7+ years of experience in designing, developing, supporting, and implementing business intelligence systems or associated tools, or 2+ years post high school education in a technology related field and 9+ years of management information systems experience designing, developing, and supporting business intelligence systems or associated tools.


Required:

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including lakehouse design and development.

• Advanced knowledge of Power BI development, semantic modeling, and DAX.

• Experience administering Power BI/Fabric, including workspaces, deployment pipelines, and capacity.

• Expertise in dimensional data modeling, SQL, and ETL/ELT.

• Strong communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills, with demonstrated experience mentoring and coaching others.


Preferred:

• Experience with IBM Cognos Analytics authoring or administration. Candidates without Cognos experience will be expected to learn it.

• Python for data engineering in Fabric notebooks.

• Experience with AI and Copilot features in Power BI and Fabric.


Apply:

Qualified candidates please apply at www.greatriverenergy.com (under the Careers tab) by Dec. 9, 2026. GRE values diversity, equity and inclusion and we are an equal employment opportunity employer.

Founded in 2022, SpeedX provides last-mile delivery services that connect brands with their customers. We work with online marketplaces, third-party logistics providers, and retailers to support their e-commerce delivery needs.


Job Summary

We are seeking a BI Developer / Analytics Engineer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise reporting and analytics solutions that transform raw data into actionable business insights. This role will work closely with Business Analysts, business stakeholders, and data engineering teams to build scalable dashboards, semantic models, curated data marts, and self-service reporting solutions. The ideal candidate has strong experience in business intelligence development, dimensional data modeling, SQL optimization, and dashboard design using modern BI platforms. This role requires both technical expertise and strong business understanding to ensure consistent, reliable, and scalable analytics across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Improve dashboard performance, data refresh efficiency, and query execution times
  • Troubleshoot reporting and data performance issues
  • Ensure scalability and maintainability of BI solutions

Reporting Governance & Standards

  • Standardize metrics and reporting definitions across departments
  • Maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reporting quality standards
  • Implement BI development best practices and documentation standards
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and dashboard validation activities

Collaboration & Support

  • Work closely with Business Analysts and stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and business processes
  • Partner with data engineers to ensure reliable and high-quality data pipelines
  • Provide support and enhancements for existing dashboards and reporting solutions
  • Train and support business users on self-service reporting capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in BI development, analytics engineering, or business intelligence solutions
  • Strong experience developing dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience optimizing analytical queries
  • Experience with dimensional modeling and data warehousing concepts
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Required Technical Skills

Business Intelligence & Reporting

  • Power BI and/or Tableau
  • Web-based dashboard development
  • Self-service reporting platforms

Data & Modeling

  • SQL
  • Dimensional modeling
  • Data marts
  • Semantic/business modeling
  • KPI and metrics design

Preferred Additional Skills

  • Experience with data warehouse/lakehouse environments
  • Familiarity with dbt or analytics engineering workflows
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT processes
  • Experience with DAX, Tableau calculations, or similar analytical languages
  • Understanding of data governance and reporting standards

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise BI environments
  • Experience working with cross-functional business teams

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon’s culture and people who are exceptionally talented at analyzing large sets of data to build insights are critical. Your work will directly impact the decisions and strategy of the entire AWS Infrastructure Services org and our customers. You will be gathering customer needs and insights, mining large and diverse data sets from across AWS Infrastructure, building visualizations and tools for our business partners, generating insights to help senior leaders make critical business decisions. Hence, the successful BIE will not only possess the expertise and passion for analyzing data, designing metrics to measure the performance of the business, and building reporting capabilities and tools, but also will interact directly with business leaders and teams that rely on the metrics and analyses that they produce.

The successful candidate will be an expert in data analytics (data engineering and visualizations), and have exemplary verbal and written communication skills. The candidate will need to be comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and able to think big while paying careful attention to detail. The candidate will have to work closely with business partners to answer key business questions through the analytics their team creates. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, deep knowledge of tools and platforms (like SQL, Tableau, Redshift, Glue, Airflow) for developing business intelligence solutions as well as ability to communicate clearly, and collaborate with both business owners and other analytics teams.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable solutions for ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to support analytical and business needs.
  • Work directly with customers to understand the business problems at hand and propose impactful analyses and solutions.
  • Partner with data engineers to develop automated solutions.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our vast data sources and identify which to use to solve specific business problems.
  • Manage prioritization of business intelligence requests, allocate work across the team, and be responsible for communications with our customers.
  • Lead the creation of user-friendly repeatable reporting solutions to minimize ad hoc customer requests.
  • Serve as a senior SME and lead for SQL and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Write high quality SQL to retrieve and analyze data from relational databases (e.g., AWS Redshift).
  • Manage and improve our internal customer communication channels (e.g., wikis, data dictionaries).

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with statistical analytics and programming languages such as R, Python, Ruby, etc.
  • 5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
  • 5+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 5+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
  • Experience with operations/supply chain

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in statistics, data science, or an equivalent quantitative field

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Provides technical leadership in the design, development, and delivery of enterprise analytics and reporting solutions. Partners with business and technology teams to translate complex data and reporting needs into scalable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions. Establishes analytics standards, improves data quality and reporting processes, and serves as a technical resource for modern cloud data and visualization technologies.

Responsibilities

Job Description

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of enterprise analytics, reporting, and dashboard solutions.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver datadriven insights that improve business outcomes.
  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Design, develop, and optimize SQL queries, data transformations, and analytical datasets to support reporting and decision-making.
  • Create and maintain scalable data models, Power BI reports, dashboards, and other enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Develop and support SSRS, cloud-based analytics platforms, and reporting environments, including AWS Athena, Snowflake, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Collaborate with data architecture and engineering teams to enhance data pipelines, warehouses, cloud platforms, and reporting frameworks.
  • Establish and promote standards for data governance, quality, security, validation, performance, and reporting best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex data and reporting issues while improving accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Provide technical leadership, design oversight, mentorship, and guidance for analytics modernization, cloud migration, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, reporting, or a related discipline
  • Advanced experience developing and optimizing SQL queries and working with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Experience developing and supporting enterprise reporting solutions using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Power BI
  • Experience with data modeling, data warehousing, data transformation, and data integration concepts and practices
  • Experience with cloud analytics technologies, including AWS Athena and Snowflake
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including pipelines, OneLake, and data synchronization optimization
  • Experience leading analytics, reporting, or data engineering initiatives from design through implementation
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale analytics and reporting environments
  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, data quality, and reporting standards
  • Knowledge of extract, transform, load (ETL) and extract, load, transform (ELT) development and data integration practices
  • Experience with cloud-native analytics architectures and modernization of data platforms or data warehouses
  • Experience mentoring technical professionals and leading cross-functional initiatives
  • Relevant certifications in Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, or analytics technologies

Working Conditions

  • Office environment
  • Hybrid office environment (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday)
  • Locations: Cedar Rapids, Denver, Philadelphia

Compensation

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $120,000-130,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration, sponsorship or otherwise serving as an employer of record for immigration employment purposes. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship.

Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion.

Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant

requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business

Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

Compensation Benefits

  • Competitive Pay
  • Bonus for Eligible Employees

Benefits Package

  • Pension Plan
  • 401k Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Disability Insurance
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Employee Discounts
  • Career Training & Development Opportunities

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.
  • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).
  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars
  • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Back-Up Care Program
  • PTO for Volunteer Hours
  • Employee Matching Gifts Program
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Inclusion and Diversity Programs
  • Employee Recognition Program
  • Referral Bonus Programs

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

 

Transamerica’s Parent Company 

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity.

Education Required

Qualifications

  • The ability to develop data extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes via Power Query, with a working knowledge of the M query language (required)
  • Experience creating dimensional data models such as star and snowflake schemas (required)
  • Proven experience using data visualization techniques to create meaningful reports and dashboards (required)
  • Able to translate business requirements into elegant and user-friendly reports and dashboards (required)
  • Eager to effectively articulate to a broad audience ideas and solutions of a complex/technical nature (required)
  • Experience working with and/or developing in Microsoft Power Automate (preferred)
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with business unit leadership (preferred)
  • Experience with programming languages such as SQL or Python (preferred)

descriptionHtml:
Who we are


Profile Films is a highly respected, customer-focused extruder and converter of plastic film located in Grand Rapids, Michigan. For over 25 years, Profile has succeeded by providing exceptional customer service and value-added product solutions for our customers while creating a great place for our employees to work and contribute. At Profile, we don’t just sell custom plastic packaging; we sell trust and dependability. Our team members provide quality products and exceptional service for our customers every day. At Profile you will find a great work environment in a beautiful modern facility and the opportunity to be an important part of well-established, but rapidly growing company.


We are looking for an enthusiastic Business Intelligence Analyst to add to our business development team. This position will report directly to the Senior Business Systems Manager.


About the Role


The Business Intelligence Analyst will take ownership of Profile's Power BI and Microsoft Fabric environment and lead our transition to Power BI. This is an analyst role focused on data modeling and visualization, with data engineering support from our vendor partner. We're a growing, family-owned manufacturer, and this is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills and grow with us.


What you will do:


Power BI Reporting & Data Visualization


  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that give business teams clear, accurate, and actionable information.
  • Lead the migration of Profile's existing Tableau dashboards and reports to Power BI, rebuilt on the curated data in Profile's new Microsoft Fabric environment.
  • Apply sound visualization design practices (clear layout, appropriate chart choices, consistent formatting, and intuitive filtering and drill-through) so reports are easy to use and trusted.
  • Manage Power BI workspaces, apps, and publishing, ensuring content is well organized and access permissions are accurate.


Semantic Modeling & Analytics


  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI semantic models on top of Profile's Fabric data, using star schema principles and well-defined relationships.
  • Develop and maintain reusable, well-documented DAX measures so key metrics are defined once and calculated consistently across reports.
  • Work with business stakeholders to clarify and document metric definitions, helping Profile move toward agreed, consistent KPIs.
  • Use Power Query for data shaping where appropriate and move reusable transformation logic into the Fabric Gold layer so it is defined once and shared across models.
  • Monitor and tune semantic model performance, storage modes, and refresh schedules.
  • Validate model and report outputs against source systems and legacy reports so the numbers match what the business expects before and after cutover.


Data Platform Partnership & Engineering Growth


  • Build hands-on data engineering skills over time (for example Fabric dataflows, notebooks, and pipelines) with vendor support, taking on more Silver and Bronze layer work as interest and ability grow.
  • Help design and maintain Gold layer tables in Fabric that feed Profile's Power BI semantic models.
  • Serve as the primary internal point of contact for Profile's data engineering vendor, who owns the Silver and Bronze layers, translating business and reporting needs into clear requirements for new or updated data.
  • Review and test vendor-delivered data and pipeline changes, identifying data quality issues and gaps before they reach reports.
  • Coordinate the cutover of reporting from legacy SQL Server / Snowflake / Mozart sourcing onto Fabric: planning timing, validating results, and retiring legacy reports and data sources.
  • Write SQL against Fabric and SQL Server for analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting.


Business Process & Software


  • Work directly with internal customers and Profile's Senior Business Systems Manager to learn Profile's key business processes, support our software platforms, and ensure the data captured is properly structured.
  • Support new process initiatives by advising on adherence to Profile's data quality & governance standards.
  • Assist in defining data and reporting requirements for systems that are in use, under development, or planned for future development.


Documentation & Data Governance


  • Create and maintain clear documentation for semantic models, measures, reports, and data sources (definitions, parameters, aggregation logic) to reduce single-point-of-failure risk in Profile's BI reporting.
  • Help establish and enforce data governance and data quality standards, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and security of data across the organization.
  • Ensure reporting solutions comply with internal data privacy and security policies.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualiﬁcations):


  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and building Power BI dashboards and reports used by business stakeholders.
  • Experience building Power BI semantic models, with a solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, fact and dimension tables, relationships).
  • Strong DAX skills with the ability to build, validate, and troubleshoot reusable business measures.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouses, Warehouses, Direct Lake semantic models, Dataflows Gen2), or a comparable platform with the ability to ramp quickly on Fabric.
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL skills, with the ability to write and troubleshoot queries for performance and data validation.
  • Experience publishing and managing content in the Power BI Service (workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh, gateways, and row-level security).
  • A strong eye for data visualization design and the ability to turn business questions into clear, usable reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot data issues independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to document work clearly.
  • Clear communicator who is comfortable working directly with business users and outside vendors.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of work in a growing, fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and not every project is fully scoped up front.
  • Consistently adhere to all Food Safety, GMP, Personal Safety, and Company Policy standards.


Move to the top if you have (Preferred Qualifications):


  • Microsoft Power BI, Fabric or other relevant certification.
  • Experience with platforms such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Mozart Data, Tableau Cloud, Sage 100, Salesforce, or Claris FileMaker.
  • Experience working with manufacturing, ERP, or operations data.
  • Experience designing or maintaining Gold-layer (reporting-ready) tables in a medallion architecture. Silver and Bronze layer engineering experience is not required.
  • Experience with Tableau, especially migrating reports from Tableau or another BI tool to Power BI.
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and an interest in growing data engineering skills.
  • Exposure to Python for data analysis or automation.


Core Strengths & Mindset (Essential for success!):


  • Eagerness to learn and grow
  • Positive and collaborative mindset
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Ability to balance technical work with business needs
  • Attention to quality, reliability, and maintainability


What you can expect from Profile:


  • Positive, supportive environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition and professional certification assistance
  • Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, STD and LTD insurance
  • 401k with match
  • Employee Assistance program
  • Clean, modern work environment in newly redesigned office space
  • Onsite fitness facilities
  • Office Happy Hours, Summer BBQ’s, Celebrations!

descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Developer, who will support and participate in the design and development process for creating and maintaining SQL Server BI stacks (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS) and SQL Server BI Databases. The position will work with a team to maintain/enhance the existing company-wide Business Intelligence Platform and implement the daily activities of the Corporate Reporting and Data Platform. This exciting role will work with all departments and executives by helping to put data into useful and meaningful reports to make business decisions easier.

This position is 100% on-site Monday through Friday from 8:00am to 5:00pm in Stevens Point, WI.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the U.S.A. without the need for visa sponsorship.

 Application Deadline (Estimated): Applications will be accepted through December 9th, 2026, however, this timeline may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate volume.

What To Expect

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance ETL processes throughout the Reporting and BI Platforms.
  • Gather user requirements for custom database reporting; troubleshoot SQL, reporting functionality and performance issues.
  • Analyze business needs and provide technology solutions in support of IT Portfolio Management process.
  • Design and build Reporting services that meet user/business specifications.
  • Use Visual Studio and Team Foundations Server to manage the reporting BI Platforms.
  • Support Power BI source data workflow and efficient data model design incorporating best practices.
  • Support and maintain data integrity and security in BI databases.
  • Plan and implement testing/deployment and coordinate with infrastructure team.

What You Will Contribute

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or Management Information Systems.
  • 3-5 years’ experience with SQL Server BI Platform (2016 - 2022, SSRS, SSAS, SSIS).
  • 3-5 years’ experience with SQL Server Administration (SQL Server 2016 - 2022).
  • 3-5 years’ experience with business analysis – designing and implementing solutions for business needs.
  • 1-2 years’ experience with Power BI integration and data source design Visual Studio, use of Team Foundation Server, and Agile/Scrum Methodologies.
  • 1-2 years’ SQL Server administration (maintenance plans, performance tuning).
  • Expert knowledge of T-SQL/DAX.
  • Exhibits character qualities of diligence, cooperation, flexibility, orderliness, and thoroughness.

What You Will Receive

  • The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $95,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) with matching, HSA with company contribution.
  • Earn up to 15 paid days off annually.
  • Paid Holidays on business workdays.
  • Company-paid on-site wellness meals.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Voluntary benefits: short-term disability, whole/term life, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident expense.
  • Opportunities for growth and development such as company university and tuition reimbursement options.
  • On-staff health coach, one-on-one or group coaching.
  • Health and wellness initiatives: walking challenge, weight loss challenge, health risk assessment and more!

Why Work At Ortho Molecular Products

Simply put, our healthcare system is broken. It is expensive, complicated, and dysfunctional. At Ortho Molecular Products, our vision is to transform the practice of medicine. Every day, across America and the world, we help health care providers implement better solutions for health challenges that include lifestyle medicine and nutritional therapies proven to improve patient outcomes. We do this by manufacturing science-based products and developing innovative clinical programs for doctors that help their patients get better faster.

We are looking for people who align with our mission and want to invest their lifework and passion into transforming the practice of medicine. Our team is purpose-driven, values-based, and service-focused. We are looking for like-minded people who want to join the movement that is changing the way healthcare is being delivered.

Ortho Molecular Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

We invite you to explore the Ortho website to learn about our career opportunities and apply ( www.orthomolecularproducts.com ).

descriptionHtml:
Location: Lakewood, CO, Onsite

Reports to: Director of Data & Systems Infrastructure

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to turn our data into trusted insights that support all areas of the business. You'll own the full path from modeled data to data-driven decision making: building dbt models, defining governed semantic models in Snowflake that both people and AI tools can rely on, delivering Power BI dashboards, and answering the ad-hoc questions that come up along the way.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics and data modeling. You'll work closely with business stakeholders to understand what they need, and with our data engineering team to make sure the underlying data is clean, documented, and consistent.

What You'll Do

Partner with the business

  • Consult with stakeholders to clarify what they need, define how success will be measured, and turn requirements into clear reporting and analysis plans.
  • Train and support end users so they can explore data on their own with confidence.
  • Spot opportunities to improve efficiency through analysis, and recommend new reporting solutions when you see a gap.

Build the foundation

  • Develop and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, tested, well-documented datasets.
  • Create and maintain semantic models in Snowflake that define metrics, relationships, and business context clearly enough for AI tools to return accurate answers. Test them against real business questions and refine as needed.
  • Improve test coverage and pipeline monitoring to ensure our stakeholders always have accurate data.

Deliver insight

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that put key metrics in front of the people who need them.
  • Use SQL to answer ad-hoc questions quickly and accurately, from one-off requests to deeper dives into trends and anomalies.
  • Interpret results in context and present findings in a way that influences decisions, including being upfront about limitations in the data.

Keep it trustworthy

  • Trace discrepancies back through the pipeline and work with data engineering to fix root causes.
  • Document metric definitions, models, and dashboards so the business uses data consistently.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelors degree in Math, Biostatistics, Engineering, or another data intensive field; Master’s preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a related role.
  • Strong SQL skills (required), including CTEs, window functions, and query optimization on a cloud data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards (required), including data modeling and DAX.
  • Experience with dimensional modeling concepts such as star schemas, facts, and dimensions.
  • Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, or a strong foundation in SQL-based modeling and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.
  • Clear communication with non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain what the data can and can't tell us.
  • Attention to detail and a habit of validating results before sharing them.

Preferred

  • Experience working with healthcare data, with knowledge of population health and Accountable Care Organization (ACO) concepts such as quality measures, attribution, risk adjustment, and value-based care reporting.
  • Experience with ELT/ETL pipelines and how data flows from source systems into the warehouse.
  • Python for analysis, automation, or data manipulation.
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and version control for analytics code.
  • Exposure to semantic layers, metric definitions, or AI-assisted analytics tools.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Dashboards are accurate, adopted, and used regularly by their intended audience.
  • Key metrics are defined once and used consistently across reports and AI tools.
  • Ad-hoc requests are answered quickly, with results stakeholders trust.
  • DBT models and semantic definitions are tested, documented, and easy for others to build on.

Compensation And Benefits

Bloom Healthcare offers a competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including:

Base salary range: $120,000 – $160,000 annually, depending on qualifications and experience

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Employer-sponsored 401(k)

Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and CME/professional development allowance

Hybrid work flexibility (Lakewood-based role; some remote work available)

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bloom Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Bloom Healthcare only contacts through official channels using the @bloomhealthcare.com domain. We are aware of a fraudulent Gmail account impersonating our recruiting team and have reported it to Google.

Job Title: Principal Analytics Engineer

Location: Remote, LA

Position Overview

We are seeking a dedicated Principal Analytics Engineer with at least 8 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics engineering. The candidate will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for designing and delivering enterprise analytics solutions that enable operational, financial, engineering, and executive decision-making across Bollinger Shipyards.

This role provides deep technical leadership across enterprise reporting, KPI frameworks, semantic models, dashboards, self-service analytics, and decision-support solutions. The Principal Analytics Engineer partners closely with business leaders, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and other analytics resources to translate complex business requirements into scalable, governed, and actionable analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver enterprise analytics and decision-support solutions across Finance, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Development, and other business functions
  • Develop and standardize enterprise KPIs, metrics, semantic models, dashboards, and reporting structures
  • Lead the technical design and development of executive dashboards and operational decision-support solutions
  • Build advanced Power BI dashboards, semantic models, data transformations, and self-service analytics capabilities
  • Analyze complex enterprise data to identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement
  • Translate business questions and operational requirements into scalable analytics solutions
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, usability, and performance of enterprise analytics products
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Enterprise Architecture to define data requirements and ensure reliable, governed, and accessible data
  • Establish and promote analytics development standards, reusable patterns, and reporting best practices
  • Mentor Analytics Engineers, BI developers, and analysts and provide technical leadership across analytics initiatives
  • Partner directly with business leaders and subject-matter experts to drive adoption and data-driven decision-making
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve operational workflows through analytics
  • Measure adoption and business impact of analytics solutions and continuously improve them based on user needs and results
  • Evaluate emerging analytics and AI capabilities that can enhance enterprise decision-support solutions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Analytics, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI or similar enterprise BI platforms
  • Strong experience with SQL, data analysis, data modeling, semantic models, and KPI development
  • Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise dashboards, reporting solutions, and decision-support capabilities
  • Experience working directly with business and executive stakeholders to translate business needs into analytics solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements through implementation and adoption

Skills And Abilities

  • Advanced Power BI, including semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, visualization, and dashboard development
  • Strong SQL and analytical data-modeling skills
  • Experience establishing KPI definitions, reporting standards, and reusable analytics models
  • Experience implementing self-service analytics capabilities
  • Familiarity with Azure data and analytics technologies
  • Experience working with large, complex enterprise datasets and multiple operational systems
  • Experience supporting operational performance management, forecasting, and executive reporting
  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial, shipbuilding, engineering, or operational environments preferred
  • Strong business analysis, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills

Bollinger is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to minorities, females, veterans and disabled individuals, and without regard to sexual orientation and gender identity.

Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS) – Enabling Technology



Location: Remote



About Pearson Virtual Schools



At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. PVS is a division within Pearson, a global leader in the education industry. Our PVS Enabling Technology team plays a critical role in this mission by building scalable, trusted data products that empower school leaders, educators, and operational teams to make informed decisions that improve student outcomes.



As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization , we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences .



Role Overview



We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence , turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.



You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.



What You’ll Do



Data Visualization & Reporting



  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting


  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards


  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)


  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices


Semantic Modeling



  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations


  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security


  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer


Data Quality & Reliability



  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems


  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues


  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions


  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment


Collaboration & Delivery



  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features


  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews


  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Scalability & Data Product Enablement



  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy


  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions


  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management


What You Bring



Technical Expertise



  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI , including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3 , DAX Studio , or ALM Toolkit is helpful


  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts , including star schema and fact/dimension design


  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses


  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)


Problem Solving & Growth



  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support


  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues , with support when needed


  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability


Collaboration & Communication



  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers


  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights


  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices


Qualifications



  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area


  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making


  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve


Preferred Experience



  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments


  • Experience with Google BigQuery


  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization


  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale


Why Join Us



  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide


  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS


  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement


  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning


Success in This Role Looks Like



  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders


  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics


  • Reduced data discrepancies and improved reporting reliability


  • Strong partnership across engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Consistent delivery of reporting projects meeting and exceeding requirements and timeframes


Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows:



The full-time salary range for this position is between $100,000 - $110,000. This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, and information on benefits offered ishere.



Applications will be taken until 11/19.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Overview

The Sr Professional Data Visualization Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualization solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. Data Visualization & Reporting

  • Ensure consistency in reporting standards, branding, definitions, and calculations while optimizing reports and dashboards for performance, scalability, and user experience.

Dashboard & Report Development

  • Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets, dataflows, and complex DAX measures that support scalable and optimized analytics.
  • Design and implement row-level security (RLS), workspace security models, and support Power BI Service administration and report deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams and leverage Microsoft Fabric to ensure data models support reporting and analytics requirements.

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with business leaders to identify reporting needs and analytics opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate reporting requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and dashboard requirements to provide recommendations for improving business processes.
  • Support self-service reporting initiatives and encourage data-driven decision-making.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Adhere to enterprise data governance standards, security requirements, privacy regulations, and reporting policies.
  • Validate data quality, accuracy, and consistency, partnering with data stewards and business owners to resolve data quality issues across reporting environments.
  • Assist with the establishment and maintenance of data definitions, business glossaries, and metric standards.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and analytics processes while leveraging advanced analytics capabilities within Power BI, Fabric, and AI-enabled reporting and analytics capabilities.
  • Monitor report usage and user feedback to continuously improve solutions.
  • Stay current with emerging visualization technologies and Microsoft platform enhancements.

Training & Support

  • Provide end-user training and support for Power BI reports and dashboards while developing documentation, user guides, and knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Mentor business users on reporting best practices and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Assist in troubleshooting reporting and data-related issues.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5-10 years of experience developing Power BI dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power Query.
  • Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
  • Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries.
  • Experience gathering and translating business requirements into reporting solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing KPI-based dashboards and executive reporting.
  • Experience working in a structured project environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data governance initiatives.
  • Experience with AI-enabled reporting, predictive analytics, or machine learning outputs.
  • Experience within the Engineering, Manufacturing, and/or Construction industries.
  • Certifications such as:
    • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
    • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
    • Certified Business Intelligence Professional (CBIP)
Skills and Behaviors

Technical Expertise

  • Microsoft Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
  • Power Query (M Language)
  • SQL Development and Data Analysis
  • Data Modeling and Dimensional Modeling Concepts
  • Data Warehousing and Data Lake Concepts
  • ETL/ELT Processes
  • Microsoft Azure Data Services
  • Data Governance and Data Quality Practices
  • Dashboard Design and Data Visualization Best Practices
  • Business Intelligence and Analytics Platforms
  • AI-Assisted Analytics and Reporting Technologies
  • Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Agents utilized within Power BI framework

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills.

Business Acumen

  • Understanding of business operations, performance metrics, and key business drivers.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where analytics can improve business outcomes.
  • Understanding of KPI development and performance management practices.
  • Commitment to delivering business value through data and analytics.

descriptionHtml:
At CSpring, we believe in the power of data to drive decisions and real-world impact. We’re a purpose-driven consulting firm specializing in data strategy, data engineering, and data analytics. Our clients span the public and private sectors, and our work helps them solve complex problems, gain insights, and achieve measurable results.


We're seeking talented professionals who are collaborative, curious, and committed to making a difference that thrive at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy. Whether you're passionate about transforming public programs, enabling executive decision-making, or modernizing legacy systems, you'll find meaningful work and purpose here.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Purposeful Projects – Improve systems that serve real people by delivering smarter data, streamlined processes, and strategic insight.
  • People-First Culture – We’re as committed to your growth as we are to delivering high-impact solutions. You’ll find support, autonomy, and community here.
  • Strategic, Hands-On Work – From data architecture and documentation to client workshops and solution delivery, you’ll influence every step of the process.
  • Collaborative Trust – Our clients rely on us to listen carefully, deliver consistently, and guide wisely. We partner with integrity, curiosity, and heart.


What You’ll Do

You’ll work across the full BI development lifecycle (design, data modeling, coding, testing, performance tuning, documentation, deployment, and production support) to turn complex Medicaid data into reporting people can act on:


  • Serve as a BI Developer and technical subject matter expert for IBM Cognos Analytics and Tableau reporting solutions.
  • Provide Cognos administration support and serve as a backup to the current Cognos administrator as needed, including user access, security, deployments, scheduling, monitoring, troubleshooting, and environment support.
  • Maintain, support, and enhance existing Cognos reports, packages, dashboards, and Tableau workbooks and data sources.
  • Design and build new Cognos reports and Tableau dashboards based on approved business requirements and reporting standards.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, create report and dashboard mockups, and refine solutions through iterative feedback.
  • Collaborate with the data team to understand source data, define reporting datasets, resolve data issues, and ensure solutions align with the enterprise data model.
  • Develop complex reports and visualizations, including prompts, drill-throughs, calculations, sub reports, graphical components, and well-formatted outputs.
  • Recommend enhancements that improve usability, performance, data quality, and the business value of existing and new reporting objects.
  • Create intuitive dashboards and reports that communicate clear, actionable insights to business users.
  • Validate report results against source and warehouse data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency throughout development and maintenance.
  • Participate in Agile delivery activities, including writing user stories and acceptance criteria, daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work within the project team under the direction of project management and technical leads to deliver reliable reporting solutions and production support.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise business intelligence reports, dashboards, and related reporting objects.
  • 3+ years of experience analyzing data warehouses and interpreting data flow diagrams, conceptual models, physical models, and reporting data structures.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting reports, packages, prompts, schedules, and dashboards in IBM Cognos Analytics.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Tableau dashboards, workbooks, calculations, filters, and published data sources.
  • 3+ years of experience writing and optimizing SQL for report development, data validation, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • 1+ year of experience supporting Cognos administration activities such as security, user access, deployments, scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.


Bonus Experience

  • Knowledge of healthcare or Medicaid data, including claims, eligibility, provider, and encounter reporting.
  • Experience developing BI solutions using cloud data platforms and services, particularly Microsoft Azure and Snowflake.
  • Experience with Cognos Framework Manager, package design, security administration, deployments, scheduling, and environment monitoring.
  • Experience with Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud publishing, permissions, refresh schedules, performance optimization, and production support.


Come Build With Us

At CSpring, we unlock the potential of people and data. If you're ready to lead meaningful projects, collaborate with passionate teams, and grow your career in a people-first consulting environment—apply today!

Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and security within reporting systems.

Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to reporting design and development.

Continuously improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements for better business insights.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud platforms, particularly in the areas of reporting design and development.
  • Familiarity with end-to-end data warehousing processes, analytics tools, and business intelligence applications
  • Exposure to technologies such as Oracle BI Publisher, OTBI, and Oracle Analytics Cloud, as well as a strong understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and dashboard creation
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously will further support your success in this dynamic environment.

US Person

$86,400—$176,200 USD

At Pearson Virtual Schools (PVS), we are committed to expanding access to high-quality education through innovative digital learning solutions. As we evolve toward a Data Product–driven organization , we are investing in modern analytics capabilities that combine trusted data pipelines, semantic models, and self-service reporting experiences .



Role Overview



We are seeking a Power BI Developer to help build and deliver analytics and ETL (extract, transform & load) solutions that support decision-making across Pearson Virtual Schools. This role will work across data engineering and business intelligence , turning data into clear and useful reporting experiences.



You will work with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to develop semantic models, dashboards, and reports that follow established data products and organizational standards. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with independent ownership of reporting work across the delivery lifecycle—from gathering requirements through deployment and support—while collaborating with experienced team members on broader analytics and data engineering initiatives.



What You’ll Do



Data Visualization & Reporting



  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports that support school operations, student outcomes analysis, and enterprise reporting


  • Translate business needs into intuitive, actionable visualizations aligned with PVS reporting standards


  • Help improve report performance, usability, and accessibility for diverse end users (school leaders, analysts, executives)


  • Implement and maintain data security policies within reporting tools in adherence with PVS data security policies, governance and best practices


Semantic Modeling



  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) that serve as governed, reusable data foundations


  • Apply established data modeling practices such as star schema, DAX optimization, and row-level security


  • Partner with engineering to ensure alignment between data pipelines and reporting layer


Data Quality & Reliability



  • Validate data outputs and ensure consistency between reports and source systems


  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, refresh failures, and performance issues


  • Contribute to monitoring, testing, and documentation of reporting solutions


  • Implement and validate Row Level Security in a multi-tenant environment


Collaboration & Delivery



  • Work closely with business stakeholders to refine requirements and prioritize features


  • Participate in design discussions, backlog refinement, and peer reviews


  • Communicate technical tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Scalability & Data Product Enablement



  • Contribute to the development of scalable, reusable reporting assets that align with PVS data product strategy


  • Support self-service analytics by enabling well-documented datasets and consistent definitions


  • Contribute to improvements in deployment practices, governance, and lifecycle management


What You Bring



Technical Expertise



  • 4+ Years of practical experience with Power BI , including report development, visualizations, DAX, Power Query, and semantic modeling; exposure to tools such as Tabular Editor 3 , DAX Studio , or ALM Toolkit is helpful


  • Strong knowledge of data modeling concepts , including star schema and fact/dimension design


  • Experience with SQL and working with structured datasets in data warehouses/lakehouses


  • Familiarity with data pipelines and integration concepts (e.g., Azure Data Factory, ETL/ELT patterns)


Problem Solving & Growth



  • Experience independently delivering reporting solutions from requirements through deployment and support


  • Ability to troubleshoot common data, performance, and visualization issues , with support when needed


  • Experience improving data quality, reliability, and usability


Collaboration & Communication



  • Strong communication skills that deliver exceptional value to internal and external customers


  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights


  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices


Qualifications



  • 3–5 years of experience in Power BI development, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related area


  • Experience building or supporting reports and dashboards used for operational or business decision-making


  • Experience working with data in an environment where tools, architecture, and governance practices continue to evolve


Preferred Experience



  • Experience in education, EdTech, or multi-tenant data environments


  • Experience with Google BigQuery


  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, and semantic layer standardization


  • Experience supporting self-service analytics at scale


Why Join Us



  • Contribute to meaningful analytics work that supports students, educators, and school systems nationwide


  • Be part of a growing Data Product organization shaping the future of analytics at PVS


  • Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement


  • Become part of the Pearson Virtual Schools mission where we are helping people achieve success through lifelong learning


Success in This Role Looks Like



  • Trusted, high-performing Power BI reports used consistently by stakeholders


  • Scalable semantic models enabling self-service analytics


  • Reduced data discrepancies and improved reporting reliability


  • Strong partnership across engineering, analytics, and business teams


  • Consistent delivery of reporting projects meeting and exceeding requirements and timeframes


Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows:
