The Rapid & Rural Logistics (R2L) team is seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer to join the Analytics Team. The R2L team, which includes Sub Same Day (SSD), covers a portfolio of high-growth businesses with unique fulfillment and operational capabilities. R2L exists solely to meet the goal of quick, accurate delivery, which is constantly being challenged and changed as we adapt to our customer demands and make improvements. To meet this goal, R2L must remain flexible at all times, adapting to all changes and growth that come our way. As a Business Intelligence (BI) Engineer, your focus will be on providing metrics, operational insights, and other analytical support to stakeholders for the Sub-Same Day (SSD) Delivery business. The Delivery BI team partners closely with Delivery and operations teams to influence the strategic direction of the business, drive operational excellence, and make sound investment and expansion decisions, with the primary goal of continuously improving the customer experience while driving long-term profitability for our portfolio of businesses. We experiment constantly, fail fast, and never stop learning.

The ideal candidate will draw upon advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, along with a passion for building solutions for automated operational management. The successful leader of this team will collaborate effectively with internal end-users, cross-functional stakeholders, and technical teams to enable data-driven decision-making. They must be a self-starter, show strong bias for action, be comfortable with ambiguity, and be able to think big and be creative to support a rapidly growing business. They will provide technical and business expertise in integrating data from various source systems and presenting it through an array of self-service applications. We look for candidates who are excellent communicators, inspiring leaders, self-motivated, flexible, hardworking, and who like to have fun. If you are excited about data, are results-oriented, and want to join a growing analytics team, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

A successful candidate is a seasoned data professional with a strong bias for action, data modeling, proficiency with data visualization tools, ETL, SQL, and scripting skills.

In This Role, You Will

  • Help identify complex business problems, recognize opportunities, and implement solutions to improve operations and finance-facing systems, processes, and tools.
  • Provide technical expertise in extracting, integrating, and analyzing critical data, clearly communicate any potential discrepancies and/or reporting downtime, including specific root causes and steps to resolution, and design and develop key performance metrics and indicators.
  • Be a self-starter, quick learner, comfortable with ambiguity, results-oriented with strong attention to detail, insist on high standards, and adapt to a rapidly evolving environment.
  • This role provides an opportunity to build innovative data solutions with large-scale systems, identify high-priority work and projects that maximize results for key stakeholders, and solve complex problems that impact company-wide strategic decisions.
  • Help automate processes by developing deep-dive tools, metrics, and dashboards to communicate these insights in real-time to business teams.
  • Successful members of this team collaborate effectively with business customers and cross-functional data management teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

A day in the life

A typical day in this role provides opportunities for building innovative solutions with large-scale data tools, identifying high-priority work and projects that maximize results for key stakeholders, and solving complex problems that impact company-wide strategic decisions.

  • Take detailed requirements from stakeholders to deeply understand their current manual processes and pain points
  • Think creatively to identify opportunities to solve problems using technology-driven solutions
  • Design and implement optimal automation solutions to address stakeholder needs
  • Respond to ad hoc requests and provide support as needed
  • Thoroughly document all processes, solutions, and learnings to ensure knowledge capture and sharing

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401(k) Plan

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About The Team

The Rapid and Rural Logistics team covers a portfolio of high-growth businesses with unique fulfillment and operational capabilities such as Sub Same Day (SSD). Our team needs to move fast and scale quickly with the growing businesses we support. We expect you to be able to identify one- vs two-way doors and make decisions on your own, requesting help when necessary. Strong bias for action is important. Technical skills must be balanced against people skills and business acumen so you can work with stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver the optimal BI solution.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
  • Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
  • Master's degree in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

descriptionHtml:
Position Purpose: Creates complex Enterprise-class data assets that provide business insight and aid business decision-making. Assets will include (but are not limited to) reports, visualizations, dashboards, and data extracts. Produces complex reports and performs meaningful quantitative or qualitative analyses addressing impactful business issues or questions. Combines these reports with subject-matter expertise to deliver coherent, insightful takeaways comprehensive read-outs, and advice/recommendations grounded in what our data is telling us.

Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

  • Develops complex BI solution architecture that accurately translates business requirements to technology solutions and ensures the design will meet business requirements throughout the lifecycle of a change
  • Participates in and implements day-to-day activities related to defining architecture, establishing infrastructure, and implementing standards used to create frameworks/patterns for delivering business intelligence solutions
  • Conducts complex business analysis activities to enable technology solutions that adequately fulfill strategic business needs and objectives
  • Delivers complex project setups, analysis, data flows, designs (wireframes/mock-up), etc., for and in partnership with customers
  • Helps lead the execution of long-term strategic goals for business intelligence development in conjunction with end users, management, customers, and other stakeholders
  • Conducts extensive research and makes recommendations on business intelligence products, services, and standards in support of procurement and development efforts
  • Performs and oversees complex programming, quality assurance reviews, documentation, system deployment, training, and project setup/support
  • Provides timely and appropriate communication to business owners, stakeholders, and users on issue status and resolution
  • Develops, maintains, and implements the business intelligence architecture as a core asset at Centene
  • Collaborates with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management, process efficiency with respect to data and delivery
  • Collaborates with both Enterprise Architecture (EA) and EDAS Solutions Architecture on the solution/service design to ensure it conforms to enterprise architectural standards and future roadmaps
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience: A Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science) and Requires 4 – 6 years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise BI solutions using Power BI or comparable business intelligence and data visualization platforms.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including developing, optimizing, and troubleshooting complex queries and datasets used by enterprise BI solutions; Snowflake or Teradata experience preferred.
  • Experience with data validation, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and quality assurance testing for complex data solutions.
  • Experience independently translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions and supporting solutions through development, deployment, and production.
  • Experience with Git, GitLab CI/CD, code reviews, and automated deployment practices.

Soft Skills

  • Intermediate - Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty
  • Intermediate - Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Intermediate - Ability to work independently
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated analytical skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrated project management skills
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure
  • Intermediate - Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision making skills

Pay Range: $87,000.00 - $161,300.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

  • Experience in creating and managing a Power BI CoE.
  • Experience working within Agile Methodology.
  • Experience with innovative solutions, problem-solving, and working across diverse groups and domains.
  • Excellent written and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree/MBA.
  • Related Experience in CPG/Hard Goods/Retail Industry.
  • Knowledge and experience in crafting and building a scalable BI infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with designing and implementing a modern data platform architecture.

Standard Job Description

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

Experience designing solutions that consider networking concepts, protocols, network security methodologies, cyber‑threats, vulnerabilities, and cybersecurity principles.

Knowledge of data administration, data‑standardization policies, and standards.

Application of data‑mining, data‑warehousing, machine‑learning, and artificial‑intelligence theory/principles.

Demonstrated understanding of network access, identity, and access management (e.g., PKI).

Knowledge of programming language structures/logic and query languages such as SQL and object‑oriented design.

Familiarity with secure coding techniques

Desired Skills

Technology / Tool – Desired Proficiency

Oracle / Microsoft SQL Server – Working knowledge (SQL querying, basic performance tuning)

Microsoft Power BI Report Server – Proficient (dashboard design, DAX)

Deltek COBRA – Working knowledge

Microsoft SharePoint – Working knowledge

SAP – Working knowledge

Teamcenter – Working knowledge

Scripting – Python, PowerShell – Basic to intermediate (data extraction, automation)

Data modeling & metadata management tools – Familiarity

Cloud & distributed data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) – Familiarity

Additional analysis tools – Excel, STATA, SAS, SPSS – Familiarity

Script languages – PERL, VBS (Windows/UNIX) – Basic

Relevant certifications (e.g., IBM Certified Data Engineer, TOGAF, Certified Data Management Professional, Security+) are a plus.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $76700.00 - $142500.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

About The Role

Dentive is seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Developer to support the development and ongoing improvement of our enterprise reporting and analytics capabilities.

We're looking for a hands-on Power BI developer who can independently build sophisticated reports, develop and optimize semantic models, and translate business requirements into reliable, scalable reporting solutions.

This role will work closely with Data & Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, leveraging our Microsoft Fabric data platform to deliver high-quality financial, operational, and workforce analytics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Create advanced DAX measures, including financial calculations, time intelligence, and dynamic reporting metrics.
  • Develop and optimize data models using dimensional modeling and star-schema principles.
  • Implement and maintain row-level security (RLS) and reporting access controls.
  • Write SQL queries to validate reporting data, investigate discrepancies, and support development.
  • Optimize Power BI reports and semantic models for performance, usability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Work with data engineering to leverage centralized data within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, documentation, and enhancement of existing reporting solutions.
  • Promote consistency in KPI definitions, reporting standards, and development practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on Power BI development experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in DAX, Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, and semantic modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling, relationships, filter context, and data model optimization.
  • Experience implementing row-level security and managing reporting access.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently deliver production-quality reports and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Warehouses, Lakehouses, or Direct Lake.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Developer to join our team. This role is critical in transforming data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data modeling, report development, and analytics, with a passion for solving complex business problems through data. Equally important is the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels — from frontline analysts to senior executives — translating complex data concepts into clear, compelling narratives that drive alignment and action. Our team works across modern BI platforms and is actively expanding into AI-assisted report development — using agentic AI tools to generate analytical reports from semantic data views — making adaptability and curiosity about emerging technologies equally as important as core BI skills.


Essential Duties

  • Design, develop, and maintain BI solutions including semantic models, dashboards, and analytical reports across platforms.
  • Develop analytical reports in HTML using agentic AI tools (including Claude) to surface insights from semantic data views.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders at all levels to gather requirements, build consensus, and translate business needs into analytical solutions.
  • Facilitate working sessions and presentations that drive alignment across business and IT teams.
  • Optimize and maintain existing BI systems and processes.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting platforms.
  • Perform advanced data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and insights.
  • Mentor junior BI developers and contribute to best practices in BI development.
  • Work closely with data engineers and analysts to ensure seamless data integration.
  • Stay current with BI tools, technologies, and industry trends, including agentic AI capabilities.


Minimum Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing and supporting end-to-end BI solutions.
  • Strong proficiency in semantic modeling and report development using modern BI platforms.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
  • Comfort working with or learning agentic AI tools for report generation and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.
  • Experience with one or more enterprise BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Snowflake, AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS for report layout and presentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience in mentoring or leading BI teams.


Professional & Interpersonal Qualities

We are looking for someone who brings more than technical depth. The right candidate will demonstrate:

  • Executive presence — confidence and credibility when presenting findings, recommendations, and roadmaps to senior leadership.
  • Cross-functional influence — ability to build trust and alignment across business units and technical teams without direct authority.
  • Clear, audience-aware communication — skilled at translating complex data concepts into language that resonates with both executives and analysts.
  • Collaborative problem-solving — a natural facilitator who brings people together around data to make better decisions.
  • Ownership mentality — proactive, accountable, and solutions-oriented even in ambiguous situations.

Description

Are you passionate about turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business decisions? Amazon is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer II to design and build scalable analytics solutions that empower teams to make smarter, faster decisions. In this role, you will own mid-to-large BI solutions, creating robust data models, performant pipelines, and intuitive visualizations that directly influence how the business operates. You will collaborate with cross-functional partners—including data engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders—to translate ambiguous problems into well-structured deliverables. If you thrive on solving challenging data problems and want your work to have measurable impact at scale, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable data models, ETL pipelines, and curated datasets that form the foundation of your team's analytics infrastructure, ensuring data quality, performance, and maintainability.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics tools using industry visualization platforms, enabling stakeholders to access timely insights and make informed decisions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to refine requirements, recommend analytical approaches, and deliver BI solutions that address both current needs and anticipated future requests.
  • Apply SQL expertise and basic statistical methods to conduct deep-dive analyses, identify root causes, and surface trends that inform strategic and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative AI tools into analytics workflows, refining outputs for accuracy and applying responsible practices to augment productivity and solution quality.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing pipeline health and data freshness before diving into a design session for a new data model that supports an upcoming business initiative. After lunch, you could pair with a data scientist to validate metric definitions or troubleshoot a data lineage question from a partner team. Later, you might refine a dashboard prototype based on stakeholder feedback, write documentation for a recently shipped dataset, or mentor a teammate on query optimization techniques.

About The Team

This role is within broader Amazon Logistics (AMZL) ORBIT (Operations Reporting, Business Intelligence, and Technology) team working under the WW Capacity Planning BIA team.

The WW Capacity Planning BI & Analytics team partners with the business and BI teams across AMZL Business to build analytical products and generate business insights that help these planning teams produce accurate and optimal capacity within the intra-week, short-term, and mid-term planning horizons.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
  • 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
  • 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
  • 1+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
  • Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Our mission is to deliver an exceptional insurance experience through innovative technology, unparalleled customer service, and a comprehensive suite of products. Our vision is to be the premier global provider of insurance solutions and redefine the insurance industry.

Orion180 is proud to call three vibrant cities home. Our headquarters on Florida’s stunning Space Coast in Melbourne offers an exceptional quality of life, with affordable housing, excellent transportation, and close proximity to major cities like Orlando, Tampa, and Miami. Our Irving, Texas, office places us in a dynamic center of culture, business, and entertainment, keeping us closely connected to innovation and growth. Our Draper, Utah, location, nestled in the heart of the Salt Lake Valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

About The Role

We believe analytics isn't a back-office function. It's not a reporting layer bolted onto the business after the real decisions get made. It's the foundation that tells you where risk actually lives, where growth is hiding, and where you're missing opportunities before it's too late to do anything about it.

That belief is driving real investment in our people, platforms, and in how deeply analytics is woven into the way we operate. From underwriting to distribution to customer experience, we're building a data culture where insight drives action.

It also means evolving how we think about the role of a Sr. Business Intelligence Developer.

The expectation isn’t just technical execution. It’s curiosity. Ownership. The ability to step into ambiguity, frame the problem, and help guide the business toward better decisions. Describe the role and team the candidate will be joining

What You’ll Do

  • In this role you will design, develop, and scale enterprise reporting and analytics solutions across the organization. Your primary mandate is to build and maintain centralized semantic models, developing high-performance Power BI solutions, and partnering with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights. This role will play a critical part in advancing our modern data and analytics platform, enabling self-service reporting, standardized business metrics, and data-driven decision making across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with leaders in data, analytics, engineering, and business operations to create capabilities that directly influence company growth and performance.

Power BI Development

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, and scorecards.
  • Create advanced DAX calculations, measures, KPIs, and calculation groups.
  • Implement report performance tuning and optimization best practices.
  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise semantic models, reusable datasets, and certified data products that support self-service analytics.
  • Establish BI development standards, documentation, deployment processes, and governance practices.
  • Collaborate with sales, underwriting, claims, actuarial, and operational teams to deploy reporting solutions, semantic models, and analytical data products.
  • Design and implement Row-Level Security (RLS) and data access controls to ensure secure and governed access to analytics assets.
  • Establish visualization standards and dashboard design guidelines.

Modeling & Analysis

  • Design and optimize data models that support enterprise reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Conduct data analysis and validation activities to ensure data integrity, consistency, and business rule adherence across enterprise data assets.
  • Document semantic models, business definitions, governance processes, and data lineage to support auditability and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and maintain scalable star schema and dimensional data models.
  • Develop and govern enterprise business metrics and KPI definitions.
  • Create centralized semantic models to support multiple business domains.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Stewardship teams to ensure reliable, high-quality data pipelines.
  • Promote consistency of business logic across reporting and analytics platforms.

Visualization & Communication

  • Build intuitive dashboards and data visualizations using Power BI that translate complex insights into clear business intelligence.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams, including leadership and technical partners.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging analytics, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and data engineering technologies.
  • Leverage Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Data Warehouse, and Lakehouse capabilities.
  • Develop data access and reporting solutions using Fabric data assets.
  • Support implementation of enterprise analytics architecture and governance frameworks.
  • Collaborate on data product development and lifecycle management.

Business Partnership

  • Work directly with business leaders, analysts, and operational teams to gather requirements.
  • Translate business needs into scalable reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Provide recommendations based on data analysis and industry best practices.
  • Deliver executive-ready dashboards and presentations.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education and Work Authorization
  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field
  • U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder is required

Experience

  • 5+ years developing enterprise BI solutions.
  • 3+ years of advanced Power BI development experience, including enterprise semantic modeling and performance optimization.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, modeling, and visualization within the insurance or financial services industry.
  • Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, automation, and data quality validation.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric preferred.

    • Microsoft Fabric
    • OneLake
    • Fabric Data Warehouse
    • Lakehouse Architecture
    • Data Products

    • Azure Data Factory
    • Fabric Pipelines
    • Experience designing enterprise semantic models.
    • Experience working with large-scale datasets and performance tuning.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

    Skills & Attributes

    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
    • Strong communication and collaboration abilities across technical and non-technical teams.
    • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

    This position is 100% onsite in our Irving, TX location

    We are interested in candidates who are developing capabilities aligned with modern, forward-looking analytics practices. This includes experience or familiarity with semantic data modeling and governed metric layers, working within scalable cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks), and integrating analytics within broader data engineering workflows. Exposure to emerging capabilities such as AI-assisted analysis, automated insight generation, and advanced data visualization techniques is highly valued.

    What’s In It For You

    Join Our Team & Make an Impact! At Orion180, we don’t just meet expectations, we exceed them. If you’re ready to take your career to the next level and be part of a growing, forward-thinking company, apply today!

    • Dynamic Environment: On-site role with a fast-paced and collaborative team culture. Results-driven office where your contributions make a real impact.
    • Compensation: Competitive base pay and performance bonuses.
    • Career Growth: Mentorship, growth tracks, and professional development.
    • Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401k, paid holidays, PTO and more!

    The office environment is fast-paced and collaborative. An employee must be willing and able to work their regularly assigned work schedule onsite, and in times of need, be able to work an extended schedule depending on company or departmental needs, project requirements, or customer demands.

    While performing general duties for this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and/or walk around (including the use of stairs). Other demands include the ability to openly communicate with others by talking, listening, comprehending, and reading; being able to lift light objects (<25 lbs); and using standard office equipment such as computers, printers, and phones.  In addition, there is an occasional need to bend, twist, or squat down to open/close cabinets and reach for files or other standard office-type objects.

    Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process. Applicants who need accommodations may email hr@orion180.com to request assistance.

Position: Sr. BI Developer

Department: Information Technology

Work Locations: Remote in listed States

What You Will Be Doing

The Sr. BI Developer will be responsible for elevating the lives of each Helen of Troy employee by crafting analytical tools that drive decision-making at every level of the organization and using our data assets to drive actions and insights.

  • Understand HELE's vision, strategies, and organizational priorities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs.
  • Build/Propose solutions that enable data-driven decision-making within HELE.
  • Understand business models, data sources, system infrastructure.
  • Design and implement robust Power BI Architectures that empower organization-wide self-service reporting and ad-hoc data exploration.
  • Design and Implement a Power BI COE in partnership with key partners within different business departments and functions.
  • Apply a hands-on approach to build and lead the key analytical assets needed for the organization.
  • Develop scalable Power BI data models that drive strategic decision-making and deliver measurable business value.
  • Optimally delegate and use repartees and other individuals (consultants/onsite/offshore) and ensure accountability to delivering timely solutions.
  • Ensure solutions are adequately embraced and used by the business groups.
  • Ensure accountability with various partners who are contributing to building Power BI solutions.
  • Adoption and use of agile methodologies for all activities.
  • Design and implement proven methods for DevOps and project management including vital metrics and measures.
  • Incorporate proven methods for governing Power BI solutions including the use of a business glossary, standard KPI, business definitions, etc.
  • Guide and support team members and business users in building their own reports on top of scalable Power BI models.
  • Stay updated with the latest data trends and technologies to enhance our BI capabilities continuously.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

  • Ability to connect with various audiences with varying degrees of technical expertise.
  • Strong planning, priority setting, and project management skills to balance multiple projects and resources in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant field.
  • Over 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Power BI as an enterprise platform.
  • 2+ years leading BI teams or managing cross-functional BI initiatives.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end Power BI solutions within a complex Enterprise IT ecosystem, including integration with centralized data platforms, ERP systems (e.g., Oracle), and governed data models.
  • Prior knowledge of a domain such as Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, etc.
  • Experience in creating and managing a Power BI CoE.
  • Experience working within Agile Methodology.
  • Experience with innovative solutions, problem-solving, and working across diverse groups and domains.
  • Excellent written and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree/MBA.
  • Related Experience in CPG/Hard Goods/Retail Industry.
  • Knowledge and experience in crafting and building a scalable BI infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with designing and implementing a modern data platform architecture.

The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

As the Sr Specialist, Finance Reporting and Power BI Development you will be responsible for critical reporting capabilities as part of Finance Transformation and ongoing operational support. Perform development efforts across multiple projects across the Finance reporting portfolio, collaborate with stakeholders to create value-add solutions, ensure adherence to reporting standards and governance requirements, and provide mentorship and guidance to other developers.

Responsibilities

Job Description

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise Finance reporting solutions using Power BI and related analytics technologies.
  • Lead reporting initiatives supporting Finance Transformation programs, including ERP modernization, US GAAP reporting, and management reporting enhancements.
  • Establish and enforce reporting governance, development standards, data quality controls, and documentation requirements.
  • Guide and advance capabilities within and outside of the team, providing technical oversight and review of reporting solutions.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Technology, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize reporting deliverables.
  • Design and optimize data models, Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) calculations, and reporting architectures to support complex financial and operational reporting needs.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory reporting requirements through strong data governance and control practices.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Finance analytics capabilities, including self-service reporting, automation, and emerging AI-enabled insights.
  • Maintain documentation to ensure continuity of critical reporting processes and solutions.
  • Contribute to strategic planning and ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Ten years of experience and expertise in strategic planning for finance systems, managing stakeholders, and executing outcome driven projects
  • Outstanding strategic planning skills to execute finance system transformations
  • Advanced skills managing expectations and cultivating relationships with key stakeholders
  • Ability to focus on and achieve desired outcomes in finance transformation projects

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced Power BI experience in building data models, DAX calculations and interactive reporting for financial analysis
  • Hands on experience sourcing, transforming, and connecting data from AWS services (e.g. Redshift) into BI solutions
  • Familiarity with GAAP principles and management reporting to design accurate and compliant financial reports
  • Solid understanding of SQL, relational databases, and data modeling best practices for scalable reporting solutions

Working Conditions

  • Hybrid working environment: Baltimore, Cedar Rapids, Denver, Philadelphia

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $110,000.00- $135,000.00 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Department

Creates complex Enterprise-class data assets that provide business insight and aid business decision-making. Assets will include (but are not limited to) reports, visualizations, dashboards, and data extracts. Produces complex reports and performs meaningful quantitative or qualitative analysis addressing impactful business issues or questions. Combines these reports with subject-matter expertise to deliver coherent, insightful business issues or questions. Combines these reports with subject-matter expertise to deliver coherent, insightful takeaways comprehensive read-outs, and advice/recommendations grounded in what our data is telling us.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree A Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science) (Required) Or

Minimum Work Experience

6 years Requires deep functional knowledge with 4 – 6 years of related experience. Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position. (Required)

Required Skills/Knowledge

Experience with Business Intelligence; Data Analysis; Microsoft Azure; SAS (software); SQL (Programming Language); Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS); PowerBI, Tableau, or other business intelligence software.

Experience with Data Modeling; Python (programming Language); Quality Assurance; SQL (Programing Language).

Experience with Analytical Techniques; Business Analysis; Quantitative Analysis; Rist Analysis; Root Cause Analysis; Statistical Process Controls.

Knowledge of Microsoft Visio; User Flows; Workflows

Optional

Experience in the healthcare field

Experience with healthcare data policies

Microsoft certifications in Azure

Experience with Microsoft Fabric

Functional Accountabilities

Core areas of responsibility that fall under this role include:

  • Develops complex BI solutions architecture that accurately translates business requirements to technology solutions and ensures the design will meet business requirements throughout the lifecycle of a change
  • Participates in and implements day-to-day activities related to defining architecture, establishing infrastructure, and implementing standards used to create frameworks/patterns for delivering business intelligence solutions
  • Conducts complex business analysis activities to enable technology solutions that adequately fulfill strategic business needs and objectives.
  • Delivers complex and extensive projects setups, analysis, data flows, designs (wireframe/mock-up), etc., for and in partnership with customers.
  • Helps leads the execution of long-term strategic goals for business intelligence development in conjunction with end user, management, customers, and other stakeholders.
  • Conducts extensive research and makes expert recommendations on business intelligence products, services, and standards in support of procurement and development efforts.
  • Performs and oversees complexity and difficulty of programming, quality assurance reviews, documentation, system deployment, training, and project setup/support.
  • Provides timely and appropriate communication to business owners, stakeholders, and users on issue status and resolution
  • Develops, maintains, and implements the business intelligence architecture as a core asset
  • Collaborates with end users to identify needs and opportunities for improved data management, process efficiency with respect to data and delivery.
  • Collaborates with both Enterprise Architecture and Solutions Architecture on the solutions/service design to ensure it conforms to enterprise architectural standards for future roadmaps.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

To be successful in this role you will need:

  • Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty.
  • Ability to identify basic problems and procedural irregularities, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure.
  • Demonstrates excellent judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, communicate complex findings in a clear and understandable manner
  • Excellent facilitation ability to host sessions and elicit ideas from others, understanding their issues and encourage group participation
  • Attention to detail.
  • Communicate complex findings in a clear and understandable manner
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Adapt to changing priorities and thrive in a dynamic environment

These factors are legitimate and non-discriminatory including, but not limited to, the current market conditions; organizational needs; the individual’s combination of prior work experience, level of education, knowledge, skills, and other qualifications. Children’s National is committed to providing a fair and competitive total rewards package to each of our employees. This base salary range does not include our comprehensive benefits package or any additional compensation for which this position may be eligible.

descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for a full-time position that offers a great work-life balance, competitive salary, and company culture?

Do you favor a relaxed, collaborative office environment over corporate stuffiness?


At JMP, you’re more than an employee—you are an owner! By taking part in our employee-owned stock option plan (ESOP) and 401k you’ll be on the road to financial security and well-planned retirement.


JMP is one of the largest commercial HVAC sales reps in the Southeast, representing over 30 top brands of equipment, including Xylem, Lochinvar, Baltimore Aircoil Company, and ClimateMaster. We have an unprecedented 65-year reputation for engineered equipment sales & support and unparalleled client education programs.


We believe in doing right by our clients and our co-workers by being helpful, courteous, and honorable.


Role Summary

The Data & Analytics Engineer designs, builds, and supports data and reporting solutions that help drive business decisions across the organization. This role will be working with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL, and data pipelines to deliver trusted analytics, reliable data models, and actionable insights.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong SQL/T-SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, aggregations, window functions, data validation, and query troubleshooting.
  • Python or PySpark for data preparation, validation, notebooks, or automation.
  • Hands-on Power BI development experience, including Power Query, semantic models, interactive report design, publishing, and refresh support.
  • Understanding of dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimension tables, star schemas, grain, keys, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Understanding of ETL and ELT concepts, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, dependencies, and error handling.
  • Ability to reconcile data from source systems through transformation layers to published reports.
  • Experience creating clear technical documentation and translating business definitions into governed analytical logic.
  • Working knowledge of security concepts that affect analytics, including access management and row-level security.
  • Basic Git or Azure DevOps source-control practices.
  • Strong communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Fabric workspaces, capacities, items, and deployment concepts.
  • Lakehouse and Warehouse design and support.
  • Data Factory pipelines and Dataflows Gen2.
  • Fabric notebooks and Spark or Python for data engineering tasks.
  • OneLake concepts, shortcuts, and medallion-style data organization.
  • Direct Lake and Import semantic-model considerations.
  • Monitoring Hub, refresh troubleshooting, lineage, and operational support.
  • Deployment pipelines, source control, or structured development and release practices.
  • Advanced calculation patterns.
  • Power Query and reusable transformation logic.
  • Semantic-model performance optimization and model simplification.
  • Row-level security and testing across business entities or user groups.
  • Workspace organization, Power BI apps, deployment, and access management.
  • Report usability, accessibility, visual consistency, and performance optimization.
  • Shared semantic models and thin-report development patterns.
  • PowerShell for administration or repeatable support tasks.
  • Ability to work with REST APIs, JSON, authentication concepts, and configuration values.
  • Ability to read, troubleshoot, and adapt existing code without needing to be a full-stack developer.


Requires periodic travel to the home office, located in Greensboro, NC.

descriptionHtml:
Join Mizuho as Senior Snowflake & BI Developer – Treasury Finance!

The Senior Snowflake & BI Developer designs, develops, and supports enterprise data, analytics, and reporting solutions across Treasury and Finance, partnering with business, Data Architecture, and Engineering teams to translate requirements into scalable, production-quality solutions.

The role requires strong hands-on Snowflake, SQL, data engineering, data modeling, and Power BI expertise, with Treasury and Finance experience supporting areas such as Liquidity Management, Cash Positioning, Funding, Intraday Liquidity, Reconciliation, Bank Statements, and financial reporting, while ensuring appropriate data quality, lineage, performance, security, and governance.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a technical liaison with Treasury, Finance, Data Architecture, Engineering, Operations, Risk, and dependent technology teams.
  • Partner directly with Treasury and Finance users to understand reporting requirements, financial calculations, business rules, and data dependencies.
  • Communicate development progress, data-quality issues, risks, dependencies, and technical recommendations.
  • Work collaboratively with Solution Architects, Data Architects, Business Analysts, and application teams.
  • Support analysis and resolution of data and reporting discrepancies.

Snowflake Data Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable Snowflake data solutions, including advanced SQL transformations, dimensional models, financial data marts, and reusable data components.
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, aggregate, and publish Treasury and Finance data from multiple source systems.
  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, calculations, and DAX measures supporting Treasury and Finance reporting and analytics.
  • Optimize Snowflake queries, data structures, and processing patterns for performance, scalability, and efficient resource utilization, while troubleshooting data issues across upstream and downstream layers.
  • Implement data-quality, reconciliation, and reporting controls to ensure Power BI outputs reconcile to approved source data and financial control totals.

Requirements & Data Solution Design

  • Partner with Treasury and Finance users to translate business requirements into data requirements, reporting specifications, transformation rules, and source-to-target mappings.
  • Collaborate with Data and Solution Architects to design target-state data models and flows, maintaining traceability from source systems through Snowflake to Power BI.
  • Maintain required data models, mappings, and technical documentation.
  • Data Quality, Governance & Controls
  • Implement data-quality, validation, and reconciliation controls across source systems, Snowflake, and reporting layers.
  • Maintain data lineage, governance, security, and access controls for Treasury and Finance data.
  • Support the full development lifecycle, including testing, UAT, code review, deployment, and production support.

________________________________________

Minimum Job Requirements Or Experience

Business & Domain Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, BI development, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or financial-services technology.
  • Hands-on expertise in Snowflake, advanced SQL development, and Power BI, supported by strong knowledge of dimensional data modeling, enterprise data warehousing, data marts, data aggregation and transformation, data-quality controls, and end-to-end data lineage.
  • Experience working directly with Finance/Treasury stakeholders to understand financial data and reporting requirements.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.

Education And Other Requirements

  • Batchlors in Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to translate business concepts into technical data solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of development deliverables.
  • Comfortable working across business, technology, risk, operations, and data organizations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to data accuracy, reconciliation, and financial controls.

The expected base salary ranges from $112k-$190k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.

Other Requirements

In office attendance is an essential function of this role. There is currently a requirement to be in the office a minimum 50% of the time, or five out of every 10 business days. Specific information about the requirements for your role will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Company Overview

Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. is the 15th largest bank in the world as measured by total assets of ~$2 trillion. Mizuho's 60,000 employees worldwide offer comprehensive financial services to clients in 35 countries and 800 offices throughout the Americas, EMEA and Asia. Mizuho Americas is a leading provider of corporate and investment banking services to clients in the US, Canada, and Latin America. Through its acquisition of Greenhill , Mizuho provides M&A, restructuring and private capital advisory capabilities across Americas, Europe and Asia. Mizuho Americas employs approximately 3,500 professionals, and its capabilities span corporate and investment banking, capital markets, equity and fixed income sales & trading, derivatives, FX, custody and research. Visit www.mizuhoamericas.com.

Mizuho Americas offers a competitive total rewards package.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer, and we comply with applicable laws prohibiting discrimination in all of the jurisdictions where we operate. AA Employer - M/F/Disability/Veteran.

Accommodations are available upon request for applicants with disabilities and other covered reasons in accordance with applicable law.

We participate in the E-Verify program.

We maintain a drug-free workplace and reserve the right to require pre- and post-hire drug testing, as permitted by applicable law.

We are so glad you are interested in joining Sutter Health!

Organization

Position Overview

A specialized mid-level technical professional who exercises independent judgment to architect, engineer, and optimize full-stack data products. This role acts as a technical authority, designing complex, end-to-end decision support systems. They are responsible for the entire product lifecycle: from consultative systems analysis and backend data engineering to frontend application architecture and user experience engineering.

Responsible for the full-stack engineering of the department's analytics applications. This role requires the exercise of discretion to solve novel technical problems, such as engineering complex interactivity patterns, optimizing end-to-end application performance, or designing custom data integration logic for specific business use cases.

Education

Job Description:

Equivalent experience will be accepted in lieu of the required degree or diploma

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field

Certification & Licensure

  • Requires Workday Reporting Training Certification AND AI/Copilot certification OR other MS certification like Azure, or Fabric. The first certification must be completed within one year of start date, and the second within six months of completing the first.

Typical Experience

  • 3 years of progressive experience in BI Engineering, Data Product Development, or Full Stack Analytics.
  • Experience independently architecting and managing the full lifecycle of complex data products (from raw data to finished app).
  • Experience in data transformation and ETL development (SSIS, ADF) to support reporting needs.

Skills And Knowledge

  • Strong proficiency in both Tableau and Power BI, including advanced interactivity and complex DAX/LOD expressions.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including deep execution plan analysis and query optimization for visualization tools.
  • Engineering: Advanced proficiency in BI Application Engineering (Tableau & Power BI), including complex calculations (LODs, DAX) and performance tuning.
  • Languages: Expert SQL; Advanced DAX or M (Power Query).
  • Full Stack: Ability to move fluidly between backend data engineering (SQL/ETL) and frontend application design (Viz/UX).

descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for an Analytics Developer to own the technical backbone of our Revenue Intelligence & Analytics team. You’ll keep our Microsoft Fabric pipelines and Power BI models running and trusted, and you’ll build the apps and automations that take manual work off the Sales Operations team.

This is a hands-on build role. You’ll start by owning our daily data refresh pipeline, then take on a growing share of internal application development using modern, AI-assisted tools. As the team grows, there is a clear path to a Senior or BI Lead role.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipelines & Platform Operations

  • Own the daily Microsoft Fabric refresh pipeline: scheduling, monitoring, and recovery when source systems run late
  • Partner with the database and IT teams to track upstream delays and pause or rerun refreshes as data comes online
  • Maintain Power BI semantic models and dataflows, including performance, row-level security, and refresh reliability
  • Document pipelines, models, and data definitions, and contribute to the Sales Operations SOP library, so the team has a clear map of what data feeds what

Applications & Automation Development

  • Help build internal Fabric apps and automations (e.g., territory management, bonus administration) that replace manual Sales Operations work
  • Use version control, separate dev/test/prod environments, and peer review so what we ship is supportable

Dashboard Development & Business Intelligence

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports used by sales leadership, regional managers, and operations stakeholders
  • Translate business questions into analytical solutions: defining data models, DAX measures, and visual layouts that surface actionable insight
  • Own the full lifecycle of each BI deliverable: requirements gathering, development, QA, stakeholder review, and ongoing maintenance
  • Proactively identify opportunities to consolidate, retire, or automate legacy reports that no longer serve a decision-making function
  • Maintain a data quality scorecard tracking duplicate rates, missing fields, and stale records across key data sources, with periodic reporting to leadership

Sales Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Identify, propose, and help implement process improvements for manual or inefficient workflows within the sales operations function
  • Automate routine sales reports, pipeline views, territory summaries, and order recaps so reps and managers get reliable, consistent data
  • Support ad-hoc analytical requests from sales leadership, providing clean, well-documented outputs with appropriate context and caveats

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in a BI, analytics development, or data engineering role, including something you have owned in production (a pipeline, scheduled job, or data model)
  • Hands-on Power BI experience including report and dashboard development, DAX measures, and data modeling
  • Working SQL skills: joins, window functions, and troubleshooting slow or broken queries
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a comparable platform (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake)
  • Experience with Git or another version control tool
  • Organized and self-directed; able to manage multiple recurring workflows and project deliverables without close supervision
  • Experience working with CRM or ERP data (Microsoft Dynamics or SAP preferred)
  • Comfort with data quality concepts e.g. duplicate records, missing fields, metric tie-outs
  • Clear communicator who can translate analytical outputs for non-technical stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and IT

Nice to Have

  • Python or PySpark for data transformation and automation
  • Experience with SAP, Snowflake, IBM Cognos, or similar enterprise ERP and reporting environments
  • Familiarity with Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
  • Experience building apps or automations with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)

Pay Range:

$60,000.00 USD - $85,000.00 USD Annually

What We Offer

  • A commitment that Safety is #1
  • Competitive benefits including:
    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Paid time off and paid holidays
    • Life and disability insurance
  • Career growth, stability, and flexible work arrangements.

Responsible Manufacturing – Protecting Our Planet for the Future

  • We utilize renewable energy and a closed loop recycled water process.
  • We are committed to reducing greenhouse emissions and water consumption.
  • We are the only flooring company recognized by the Asthma and Allergy foundation.

Who we are:

With a history of more than 140 years, Tarkett is a worldwide leader in innovative and sustainable flooring and sport surface solutions, generating turnover of €3.3 billion in 2025. The Group has close to 12,000 employees, 25 R&D centers, 8 recycling centers and 33 production sites. Tarkett creates and manufactures solutions for hospitals, schools, housing, hotels, offices, stores and sports fields, serving customers in over 100 countries. To build “The Way to Better Floors,” the Group is committed to circular economy and sustainability, in line with its Tarkett Human‐Conscious Design® approach.

descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Project Senior Engineering Management Specialist the team, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Power BI dashboards and reports to support maintenance, operational, and business decision-making across Fleet Readiness Centers.
  • Translate user stories and business requirements into actionable data models, visualizations, and analytics solutions within an agile delivery framework.
  • Perform data extraction, transformation, and modeling using SQL and Power BI tools to ensure high-quality, reliable datasets.
  • Leverage Python for data wrangling, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance reporting capabilities and streamline processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional government and contractor teams, actively participating in agile ceremonies (standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives) to deliver iterative product improvements.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Industry Solutions clients seek verticalized solutions that transform how they sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and fulfill mission-critical operations. The Industry Solutions offering delivers integrated business expertise with repeatable scaled technology solutions that are specifically engineered for each sector's IndustryAdvantageTM.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Active Secret security clearance required
  • 4+ years of experience in Power BI development, including dashboard design, data modeling, and report publishing.
  • 2+ years experience in SQL for data querying, transformation, and performance optimization.
  • 2+ years experience with Python for data analysis, automation, or scripting.
  • 1+ years experience working in an agile or scrum environment with strong ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

For individuals assigned and/or hired to work in Rosslyn, VA, Deloitte is required by law to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. This compensation range is specific to Rosslyn, VA and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $84,400 to $140,699.

Position: Sr. BI Developer

Department: Information Technology

Work Locations: Remote in listed States

What You Will Be Doing

The Sr. BI Developer will be responsible for elevating the lives of each Helen of Troy employee by crafting analytical tools that drive decision-making at every level of the organization and using our data assets to drive actions and insights.

  • Understand HELE's vision, strategies, and organizational priorities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs.
  • Build/Propose solutions that enable data-driven decision-making within HELE.
  • Understand business models, data sources, system infrastructure.
  • Design and implement robust Power BI Architectures that empower organization-wide self-service reporting and ad-hoc data exploration.
  • Design and Implement a Power BI COE in partnership with key partners within different business departments and functions.
  • Apply a hands-on approach to build and lead the key analytical assets needed for the organization.
  • Develop scalable Power BI data models that drive strategic decision-making and deliver measurable business value.
  • Optimally delegate and use repartees and other individuals (consultants/onsite/offshore) and ensure accountability to delivering timely solutions.
  • Ensure solutions are adequately embraced and used by the business groups.
  • Ensure accountability with various partners who are contributing to building Power BI solutions.
  • Adoption and use of agile methodologies for all activities.
  • Design and implement proven methods for DevOps and project management including vital metrics and measures.
  • Incorporate proven methods for governing Power BI solutions including the use of a business glossary, standard KPI, business definitions, etc.
  • Guide and support team members and business users in building their own reports on top of scalable Power BI models.
  • Stay updated with the latest data trends and technologies to enhance our BI capabilities continuously.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

  • Ability to connect with various audiences with varying degrees of technical expertise.
  • Strong planning, priority setting, and project management skills to balance multiple projects and resources in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or relevant field.
  • Over 7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Power BI as an enterprise platform.
  • 2+ years leading BI teams or managing cross-functional BI initiatives.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing end-to-end Power BI solutions within a complex Enterprise IT ecosystem, including integration with centralized data platforms, ERP systems (e.g., Oracle), and governed data models.
  • Prior knowledge of a domain such as Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, etc.
  • Experience in creating and managing a Power BI CoE.
  • Experience working within Agile Methodology.
  • Experience with innovative solutions, problem-solving, and working across diverse groups and domains.
  • Excellent written and communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree/MBA.
  • Related Experience in CPG/Hard Goods/Retail Industry.
  • Knowledge and experience in crafting and building a scalable BI infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with designing and implementing a modern data platform architecture.

In Massachusetts, the standard base pay range for this role is $111,791- $167,687 annually. This base pay range is specific to Massachusetts and may not be applicable to other locations. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

Benefits: Salary + Bonus, Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, 401(k) with company match, Basic Life Insurance, Short Term Disability (STD), Long Term Disability (LTD), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Charitable (volunteer) Leave, and Educational Assistance.
