descriptionHtml:
A World-Class Company

Osprey Software, LLC is a leading technology consulting and solutions firm that helps organizations design, build, and deliver enterprise-class software and analytics platforms. Leveraging expertise in AI, automation, cloud, and advanced analytics, we create scalable, high-impact solutions that drive measurable business results and long-term success.

Position Overview

Osprey is seeking an Associate Power BI Developer to support the development and maintenance of business intelligence and financial reporting solutions for a leading financial services organization.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL, and data modeling, along with an interest in expanding their expertise in Microsoft Fabric, Python, and financial analytics. This role offers an opportunity to work alongside experienced technical professionals while contributing to enterprise reporting initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models.
  • Support financial analytics and reporting, including Assets Under Management (AUM), investment performance, revenue, and operational KPIs.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries and DAX calculations.
  • Assist with data modeling, data transformation, and integration from multiple sources.
  • Support Microsoft Fabric solutions, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Notebooks, and Dataflow Gen2.
  • Develop Python and PySpark code in Fabric Notebooks for data ingestion, transformation, validation, and process automation.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into effective visualizations.
  • Troubleshoot data quality, reporting, and performance issues.
  • Follow established data governance, security, and development best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or reporting development.
  • Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and SQL.
  • Foundational proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis (e.g., pandas).
  • Understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, or Dataflow Gen2.
  • Experience with PySpark, Spark SQL, or Python scripting for data pipelines, automation, or CI/CD (e.g., Git, GitHub Actions).
  • Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Amazon Aurora.
  • Financial services, asset management, or investment management experience.
  • Familiarity with AUM, financial reporting, investment performance, or revenue analytics.
  • Microsoft Power BI or Fabric certifications.

Why Join Osprey?

Join a collaborative team working on meaningful analytics initiatives for leading organizations. You'll gain exposure to modern Microsoft data technologies, expand your technical expertise, and contribute to solutions that support important business decisions.


We offer an excellent compensation and benefits package with challenge and opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to a stimulating, fast-paced environment. Osprey is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago provides superior pediatric care in a setting that offers the latest benefits and innovations in medical technology, research and family-friendly design. Location

Olympia Center

Job Description

Assesses the institution’s reporting needs and develops reports and data extracts according to an overall reporting management strategy. Participates in defining and maintaining a reporting management strategy that is non-duplicative, secure and standards-driven, and that anticipates institutional needs.

Essential Job Functions

  • Designs, builds and maintains reports using Epic’s Clarity system and data warehouse, Crystal Reports and SQL.
  • Develops stored procedures and views as necessary.
  • Maintains report schedules and user security on the Business Objects application.
  • Designs and develops extracts from Epic’s Chronicles database and Epic Reporting Workbench.
  • Develops dashboards and data visualizations using Microsoft Business Intelligence Tools, Power BI, SharePoint and SSRS.
  • Analyzes and assess institutional reporting needs.
  • Gathers requirements of individual users and requests.
  • Inventories and analyzes existing reports. Coordinates reporting to minimize duplication and reduce inventory.
  • Participates in completing documentation of data structures, data conversions.
  • Adheres to HIPAA regulations for Transactions, Security and Confidentiality.
  • Performs job functions adhering to service principles with customer service focus of innovation, service excellence and teamwork to provide the highest quality care and service to our patients, families, co-workers and others.
  • Collaborates in iterative design process with users.
  • Works independently on complex projects, seeking assistance or guidance when needed.
  • Takes responsibility for design choices and deadlines.
  • Other job functions as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related training required.
  • Minimum of three years of experience writing reports and/or data extracts required.
  • Prior experience in a healthcare setting preferred.
  • Demonstrated strong business and data analysis skills; Crystal Reports & SQL query writing skills.
  • Experience with Business Objects; knowledge of data structures.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare documentation with generally recognized standards. Working knowledge of personal computers and Microsoft Windows OS and applications.
  • Ability to conduct work on multiple projects with minimal direction and supervision.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of integrity and confidentiality relating to employee/patient and hospital.

If you’d like the chance to make your mark with the world’s largest equipment rental provider, come build your future with United Rentals!

As an experienced Sr. Cloud BI Developer for development and creation of enterprise reporting. This role will be assisting business users and Enterprise Reporting & Analytics team in the successful creation and delivery of Sigma/Tableau dashboards and reports for internal and external clients.

What You'll Do

  • Collect and analyze information requirements from business users (or an IT proxy); translate those needs into use cases, requirements analysis and the general design of the Enterprise Reporting applications.
  • Develop Sigma/Tableau dashboards, visualizations and reports for complex problems. Use innovative insights and creativity in evaluating different approaches to meeting business requirements
  • Mentors the business and Analytics teams on Sigma/Tableau best practices, and act as a supporting resource for other developers.
  • Ensure standards and best practices are established and met for consistent and accurate use of Tableau/Sigma across the company. Ensure data security, integrity, and compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist Enterprise Reporting team in the Tableau administration, including user provisioning, server management, license administration, and version upgrades.
  • Other duties assigned as needed

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Certifications in Sigma/Tableau software
  • 5 + years of Tableau development, web APIs and administration experience.
  • Minimum Tableau Certified Professional of good standing
  • 1+ years of Sigma Computing development experience
  • 5+ years of experience working with relational databases (Snowflake preferred)
  • Strong SQL coding of at least 5 years.
  • Strong data modeling skills of at least 2+ years.
  • Effective communicator both verbal and written.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve problems independently with creative approaches.
  • Ability to communicate standards and best practices and train report developers on their use.
  • Ability to work with report developers, data modelers and business analysts to ensure the BI functional infrastructure meets the design and delivery needs of the business projects.
  • Ability to provide BI functional help desk support including 1st & 2nd level support, on-call troubleshooting & problem resolution.
  • Onsite office attendance in either our Bridgeport, CT or Stamford, CT Office. 3 days in the office (Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday); Monday and Friday remote.

Responsibilities

Headquartered in King of Prussia, PA, Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS) is one of the nation’s largest and most respected providers of hospital and healthcare services. Since our founding in 1979, UHS has grown steadily into a premier Fortune 500® corporation perennially recognized by multiple esteemed national rating entities. Through its subsidiaries, UHS operates inpatient acute care facilities, inpatient behavioral health facilities, outpatient and other facilities, nationwide virtual behavioral health services, an insurance offering, a physician network and various related services with physical locations in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Ireland and United Kingdom. www.uhs.com.

The Corporate Information Services Department is seeking a dynamic and talented Sr. Software Engineer – Epic BI Developer.

The Sr. Software Engineer – Epic BI Developer designs and develops reports and dashboards utilizing Epic reporting tools such as Clarity, Cogito, Caboodle, Slicer Dicer, Radar, and business intelligence tools. Works with SSIS and the development of ETL processes in order to provide consistent, reliable, and automated delivery to the end user. Coordinates the transmission of custom reports to vendors, regulatory agencies, and other reporting applications such as power BI. Responsible for conducting data discovery, analysis, and profiling of data to validate business requirements and provide inputs into functional design while serving as domain expert in Clinical and/or Revenue Cycle business area. Works closely with EMR and Revenue Cycle Analysts to understand operational workflows and data structure. Identifies and manages data quality or integrity issues within the domain and collaborate with business units to design the structure of data solutions, as well as plan their implementation within the team. Troubleshoots and fixes data loads and other issues within Epic and data warehouse and explore new ways to present data insights to end users within a project. Responsible for managing large scale solution commitments to business stakeholders and help develop and maintain the structure of the reporting environment. Fosters informed growth by providing users with the ability to rapidly obtain the data they need. Performs SQL queries and script writing. Works on data flows from source systems to one central EDW platform and creates data models using Integration Services. Utilizes strong skills to create Epic and Tableau dashboards/reports to communicate business metrics, as well as assisting business users with creating their own reports.

Works closely with the Clinical and/or Revenue Cycle teams throughout project life-cycles, ensuring that high-quality, timely and relevant data is available to decision makers across the organization.

Key Responsibilities Include

Solution Development and Design:

  • Designs, develops, implements, and maintains data models to be used by various reporting and data discovery tools. Performance and accuracy are key.
  • Follows established SDLC, change control, release management and incident management processes while developing and deploying standard reports and dashboards.
  • Utilizes established BI data models in order to drive reporting standards, re-use, quality and reporting simplification. Suggests improvements to the data model where applicable.
  • Works collaboratively with the team manager and architects of the team and Project Managers to perform required project tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Completes change requests for new reports and enhancements in a timely manner with high quality.
  • Serves as Technical Lead for medium to large sized projects. Provides guidance to less experienced staff.

Solution Maintenance And Support

  • Ensures that data is available to decision makers through the created reports and dashboards, as well as self-service methods.
  • Interfaces with the user community regarding data model design and support. Treats every person requesting services from the team as a valued customer, both internal and external.
  • Provides technical guidance to business ad-hoc report developers on appropriate usage of the data models and BI tools.
  • Stays current with the needs and operations of the enterprise; provides recommendations on the availability of existing reports and suggests opportunities to improve reporting solutions.
  • Remains technically fluent with new and existing BI tools, process and development techniques.
  • Provides support as needed for software installations and upgrades.
  • Monitors the resolution of maintenance or enhancement issues assigned by the UHS Customer Support Center.
  • Participates in user group forums and knowledge transfer sessions.

Administration And Oversight

  • Provides technical support, assistance and guidance to other team members as required.
  • Keeps management well informed of activities, needs, problems.
  • Tracks on-going work items using work management tools.

Qualifications

Position Requirements:

Knowledge

  • Bachelor’s degree required. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics or related field of study preferred.
  • Epic certification or Accreditation required in Cogito and Clarity Data Model
  • 5+ years of SQL programming and working with relational database experience including:
    • Stored procedure development to support reporting or data warehouse initiatives
    • Database design and administration
    • Performance tuning (SQL code and database architecture)
  • 5+ years of experience developing solutions with BI tools and data models. (Business Objects, SAP Webi, SQL Server, Oracle,)
  • 5 + years of experience with Epic Clarity, Caboodle, and Cogito suite of reporting tools including Reporting Workbench, Radar, or Slicer Dicer
  • 5+ years of related managed healthcare or insurance operations experience preferred.
  • Experience with Python or other object-oriented programming language preferred.
Skills

  • Expertise with relational database concepts, data warehousing and ETL concepts.
  • Focus on Clinical and/or Revenue Cycle
  • Displays an eagerness to continually improve skills and learn new technologies.
  • Comfortable with an environment where priorities change frequently.
  • Ability to work and deliver strong results in a dynamic team environment.
  • Ability to work in a fast moving company and industry.
  • Ability to work mostly unsupervised. Proven communication and collaboration skills; willingness to take initiative to contribute beyond basic responsibilities.
  • Excellent customer service, verbal and written communication skills.

Travel Requirements: 5% US or International travel

This Opportunity Provides The Following

  • Challenging and rewarding work environment
  • Growth and development opportunities within UHS and its subsidiaries
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Plan
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Generous Paid Time Off

descriptionHtml:
Position Overview: Develop and sustain data visualizations and dashboards to support operational reporting and decision-making in a secure enterprise environment. This role builds accurate, well-modeled Power BI solutions, integrates approved data sources, and ensures reporting outputs remain reliable, maintainable, and aligned to governance constraints. Responsibilities:

  • Gather and analyze business and reporting requirements from stakeholders to design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making and organizational objectives.
  • Integrate and manage data from multiple approved sources, including databases, SharePoint lists, spreadsheets, and cloud-based systems, performing data extraction, transformation, and modeling activities using Power Query and related technologies.
  • Develop and optimize advanced calculations, measures, and business logic using DAX to deliver meaningful insights, key performance indicators, and interactive reporting capabilities.
  • Validate data accuracy, troubleshoot report refresh and performance issues, and implement enhancements to improve dashboard usability, scalability, reliability, and overall reporting efficiency.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of datasets, data models, report logic, and sustainment procedures while providing user support, knowledge transfer, and training to ensure effective adoption and ongoing relevance of reporting solutions.
  • Years of Experience: 3+ years Power BI / Power Platform development experience.
  • Education Level: High school diploma/GED.
  • Clearance Requirements: Must have active Top Secret (TS) clearance.
  • Certification Requirements: Microsoft PL-300 (preferred) and/or PL-200/PL-900 (preferred).
  • Any other work-related qualifications needed for the role: Strong DAX and Power Query skills; understanding of governance constraints; ability to build role-aware reporting when required. Salary Range: $95,000 to $112,000 The compensation range listed for this position represents the good faith salary range Diné Development Corporation (DDC) and its subsidiaries reasonably expect to pay for the role, in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including the position's responsibilities, the candidate's education, experience, skills, internal equity, market considerations, and any applicable collective bargaining agreements or legal requirements. About Us Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is a Navajo Nation-owned family of companies that provides government agencies and commercial organizations with high-quality IT, professional, environmental, and research and development services. DDC is dedicated to empowering the Navajo Nation and the communities we serve. Benefits Eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, retirement savings with company match, and paid time off. Additional benefits include voluntary supplemental benefits, access to an employee assistance program, and educational assistance with tuition reimbursement. Equal Opportunity & Compliance Statement This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60-1.4(a), 60-300.5(a), and 60-741.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or for inquiring about, discussing, or disclosing information about compensation, or any other basis prohibited by law. We participate in E-Verify. DDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact Recruiting for assistance

Business Intelligence $ Data Analytics Software Engineer

Reston, VA 20190

Security Clearance Requirement: TS/SCI CI Poly

Location Note: On-Site Support Required

Position Description:

Working within a collaborative government and contractor team, the successful candidate will support an enterprise data warehouse environment by developing business intelligence solutions, optimizing data processes, supporting complex data analytics and reporting, and delivering responsive customer support. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with outstanding analytical, communication, and customer service skills. Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages and technologies (or similar equivalent) is a must: Tableau, IBM DataStage ETL, PL/SQL, or Business Objects.

Duties and responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions supporting enterprise financial and acquisition systems
  • Develop, enhance, and support reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using Tableau, Business Objects, or comparable BI platforms.
  • Develop and optimize complex SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects
  • Support enterprise data warehouse operations, extract transform and load (ETL) processes, and data integration activities using IBM DataStage or comparable technologies
  • Analyze complex business and technical requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable software solutions
  • Troubleshoot application, interface, database, and data quality issues to ensure reliable system performance
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for production issues
  • Provide responsive on-site technical support to government users and senior leadership
  • Support financial system interfaces and transaction processing to ensure data integrity and operational continuity
  • Participate in software releases by supporting integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production deployments
  • Recommend and implement process improvements that enhance system performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles
  • Collaborate with government stakeholders, functional analysts, and technical teams to deliver mission-critical capabilities

Education and qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance.
  • Current CI Polygraph or ability to obtain one.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Demonstrated experience developing and supporting enterprise software applications.
  • Strong experience with SQL and PL/SQL development.
  • Experience with Oracle Database, MariaDB, or comparable relational database platforms.
  • Experience developing reports and dashboards using Tableau, Business Objects, or similar BI tools
  • Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse environments and ETL processes
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience developing technical documentation and supporting software testing activities

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with IBM DataStage ETL
  • Knowledge of Federal financial management or acquisition systems.
  • Experience supporting Intelligence Community or other federal agencies
  • Experience with enterprise system interfaces and data integration.
  • Experience with data analytics, reporting, and performance optimization

Salary: $140,000 - $180,000

E-volve Technology Systems salaries are determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the candidates’ education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract-specific funding and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $140,000 - $180,000 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of E-volve's total compensation package for employees.

E-volve Technology Systems, Inc. provides Mission Operations, Information Technology Management, and Intelligence Analysis support services to advance National Security and other Federal Government programs within the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence, and Civilian government agencies. For more information please visit us at www.e-volvetechsystems.com.

E-volve Technology Systems, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Description

As a Business Intelligence Engineer in Network Evolution Science & Tech (NEST), you will own the design, development, and delivery of reporting and measurement solutions that power the global expansion of our flagship planning platforms — UPX (Unified Planner Experience) and CPF/UPO (the coordination and optimization layer) — into emerging fulfillment networks worldwide.

You will work at the intersection of supply chain planning, operational intelligence, and optimization-model performance. Your reporting products will directly inform decisions that affect planner productivity, plan quality, and automation adoption as we scale from a single network in production to the full universe of non-core networks: Sub Same Day, Quick Commerce, Distribution Centres (SDC/1DC/rDC), AMXL, Rural and Super Rural+, AWD, and more, across all regions. You will design the measurement frameworks that show whether each new network launch is delivering accurate, trusted, adopted plans — before gaps reach decision-makers. And you will own the reporting suite that keeps the NEST function accountable to launch milestones, model performance, and benefits realisation.

You will operate independently, managing ambiguity with rigor and judgment — much of what you measure does not exist yet and will be defined as networks onboard. You will partner closely with Science, Engineering, Product, S&OP planning teams, UPO/UPX platform partners, and Finance. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior leadership, influence launch and prioritisation decisions through data-backed arguments, and contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of automated BI reporting that measures UPX and CPF/UPO expansion across every network × country — model accuracy, planner adoption, plan-vs-actuals, and benefits realisation.

Build the network launch and adoption measurement framework: dashboards and pipelines tracking optimisation-model accuracy, planner cycle time, adoption rates, and manual-process retirement as networks onboard (Sub Same Day, Quick Commerce, SDC, 1DC, rDC, AMXL, Rural and Super Rural+, AWD).

Design model-performance and plan-quality guardrail reporting with scalable alerting that flags when outputs or upstream signals breach thresholds, enabling proactive intervention.

Own the BAU reporting suite: weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR/QBR packs, peak readiness dashboards, launch-milestone tracking, and forecast-accuracy reporting.

Architect dimensional data models and ETL pipelines integrating upstream signals, UPO/CPF, UPX, and network planning tools into a single source of truth.

Drive metric standardisation across networks by partnering with Science, S&OP, and platform teams on definitions, methodologies, and data quality.

Independently apply AI tools to automate reporting workflows and improve speed, quality, and self-service.

Translate deep-dive analyses into narratives for Director- to VP-level audiences, and own data quality, pipeline reliability, SLAs, and on-call support.

About The Team

Network Evolution Science & Tech (NEST) team owns planning optimization for networks outside the core FC network — 8 network types across 12 countries and 2,000+ non-core nodes (Sub Same Day, SDC, 1DC, rDC, Quick Commerce, Grocery, Rural and Super Rural+, AMXL, AWD). Our north star: every planner creates, analyses, and publishes plans through automated optimization on UPX — no spreadsheets, no tribal knowledge. Spanning operations research, optimization modelling, data science, and program management, we automate planning so S&OP capacity scales sub-linearly as the network grows. We're now building the reporting foundation that makes this expansion visible, measurable, and governable.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
  • 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
  • 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
  • 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
  • 1+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
  • Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
  • Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
  • Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
  • Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

  • Domain knowledge of metal and manufacturing industry is a big plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to

non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

Roles & Responsibilities

technical specifications.

  • Understand existing source SQL data architecture

and rearchitect downstream SQL Datawarehouse based on new source system

  • Modify existing standards as well as customized program based on requirement
  • Analyze issues and provide resolution
  • Work with offshore team to provide the requirements and supervise the overall work
  • Testing of application
  • Estimate the effort and timelines for enhancements
  • Create/update technical specifications

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

  • Strong communication skills and client/stakeholder interfacing is mandatory.
  • Developing reusable code/components for future use.
  • Optimization of the applications or modules for maximum performance and scalability.
  • Must follow and ensure the coding standards defined by Oracle and the community in the project.
  • Strong debugging skills.
  • Familiar with Agile and waterfall models.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently in a high availability manufacturing environment.
  • Proactive mindset with ownership and accountability.
  • Experience working in onsite–offshore delivery models.

descriptionHtml:
Wintrust provides community and commercial banking, specialty finance and wealth management services through its 16 bank charters and nine non-bank businesses. Wintrust delivers the sophisticated solutions of a large bank while staying true to the relationship-focused, personalized service of our community banking roots. We serve clients in all 50 states with more than 200 branch banking locations in Illinois, southwestern Florida, northwestern Indiana, west Michigan and southern Wisconsin and commercial banking offices in Chicago, Denver, Milwaukee, Grand Rapids, Mich., and in key branch banking locations throughout Illinois. Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Wintrust is a $66 billion financial institution based in Rosemont, Illinois, and listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol “WTFC.”

Why join us?

  • An award-winning culture! We are rated a Top Workplace by the Chicago Tribune (past 12 years) and Employee Recommended award by the Globe & Mail (past 6 years)
  • Competitive pay and discretionary or incentive bonus eligible
  • Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, a 401k plan with a generous company match and tuition reimbursement to name a few
  • Promote from within culture

Why join this team?

  • This position has the opportunity to interface with and have a positive impact on multiple areas of Wintrust's business
  • We hold ourselves accountable to high standards, share wins, operate ethically, and have fun

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our growing team and play a key role in driving data informed decision making across the organization. This individual will lead complex analytics initiatives from problem definition through delivery, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable insights and data driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, data visualization, and data analysis with the business acumen and communication skills needed to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage analytics projects, identify meaningful trends and opportunities within data, and communicate findings that influence business decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead complex data analysis initiatives, taking ownership of assignments from initial requirements gathering and problem definition through analysis, mapping, documentation, and delivery.
  • Partner directly with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs and translate requirements into detailed technical mappings and specifications.
  • Perform comprehensive source-to-target data analysis and mapping, including data profiling, validation, transformation requirements, and identification of data quality issues.
  • Query and analyze large, complex datasets using SQL to identify relationships, trends, anomalies, and business rules and support data-driven solutions.
  • Apply strong data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables, to support enterprise data initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain clear data documentation while supporting data governance standards, data quality, and integrity across assigned projects.
  • Collaborate closely with data engineers, data architects, analysts, and business users while developing domain expertise and providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data warehousing, including experience supporting complex enterprise data projects.
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, Data Analysis, Data Mapping, and Data Warehousing.
  • Strong hands-on SQL expertise with demonstrated experience performing complex data analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target data mapping.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze source data, work through ambiguous requirements, and partner with business and development teams to translate business requirements into technical mappings and data solutions.

Benefits

Medical Insurance

  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life insurance
  • Accidental death and dismemberment
  • Short-term and long-term Disability Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Traditional and Roth 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan at 5% discount
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Transportation and Commuting Benefits
  • Banking Benefits
  • Pet Insurance

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this role is $98,000.00 - $130,000.00, along with eligibility to earn an annual bonus. Actual salaries may vary based on several factors, such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills and experience.

From our first day in business, Wintrust has been proud to serve a variety of unique communities and people from all walks of life. To build a company that reflects the communities we serve, we believe that fostering a unique and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to succeed will support our ongoing success. Wintrust Financial Corporation, including community banking and financial services subsidiaries, is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories.

descriptionHtml:
Robert Half is currently partnering with an enterprise sized company within the technology sector that is looking to hire a Business Intelligence Engineer. The primary responsibility of the BI Engineer is to design, develop, and optimize enterprise reporting, analytics, and data engineering solutions. This role is responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, integrating and transforming data from multiple sources, developing robust data models, and creating impactful dashboards and visualizations using Microsoft Power BI. The BI Engineer partners with business stakeholders to deliver actionable insights while ensuring data quality, performance, governance, and accessibility across the organization. This position is full time with full benefits and 4 days onsite in the Irvine area.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Build, optimize, and manage data warehouses, data marts, and semantic data models.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Microsoft Power BI.
  • Integrate and pull data from ERP, CRM, Operation and cloud data sources.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Create and manage Power BI datasets, measures, KPIs, and data models to support self-service analytics.
  • Optimize SQL queries, data pipelines, and reporting performance for scalability and reliability.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data integration, transformation, and reporting issues.
  • Support data governance initiatives, metadata management, and documentation of data assets.
  • Develop and enforce BI best practices, standards, and reporting governance frameworks.
  • Stay current with emerging data engineering, analytics, and visualization technologies to continuously improve the BI environment.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering, BI or similar role
  • Python (data processing / ETL development)
  • SQL (advanced querying, data modeling)
  • Proven experience building end-to-end data pipelines
  • Strong understanding of data modeling concepts
  • Experience working with large datasets and distributed data systems
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate with non-technical stakeholders
  • Power BI excel plugin, PowerPivot, and formulas
  • Passion for Data Stewardship.
  • Strong knowledge of ETL.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience in designing and developing reporting and advanced analytics solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills.


Other: This position is full time/ permanent placement with full benefits such as Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k and more!

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support enterprise reporting and analytics.
- Build, optimize, and manage data warehouses, data marts, and semantic data models.

- Experience working with large datasets and distributed data systems
- Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate with non-technical stakeholders

- Passion for Data Stewardship.
- Strong knowledge of ETL.
- Advanced SQL skills.
- Experience in designing and developing reporting and advanced analytics solutions.
- Excellent communication skills.

descriptionHtml:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm, and every member feels valued.

Evaluate, design, code, test, optimize and modify Medica's financial or operations systems solutions and reporting capabilities that support multiple lines of Businesses and IT initiatives. Capture, develop, and document data definitions, business rules, and data quality requirements. Conduct data analysis in support of a variety of analytic solutions. Interpret data, analyze results, and provide insights to determine operational impact, trends, and opportunities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with internal business customers to establish and develop relationships, establishing credibility as a key internal resource.
  • Use analytic tools such as Power BI and SQL, and other in-house tools to utilize multiple data sources and environments to produce reports to meet needs of business users.
  • Develop analytical and reporting specifications for enterprise healthcare projects through participation in project teams or meetings with internal customers.
  • Develop and maintain business performance reports for operational business units and produce executive analytic summaries to aid decision-making using various reporting and analytic tools.
  • Research subjects surrounding claims, providers, pricing, benefits, government programs or membership, conduct analysis, interpret data, perform data quality checks, identify threats, and present information to internal customers.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous business and data requirements, independently investigate issues, identify appropriate data driven solutions, and communicate recommendations to business partners.
  • Participate in team activities to identify problems and improve work processes and systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field
  • 3 years of work experience beyond degree
  • Advanced SQL, Power BI, data analysis skills

Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with cloud-based technologies such as Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Healthcare insurance industry experience or interest.
  • Demonstrated examples of taking initiative and being curious with data.

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, or Madison, WI.

The full salary grade for this position is $70,200 - $120,400. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $70,200 - $105,315. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US: Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Deloitte is seeking a Data and Technology Specialist, Project to support a client project with data and information technology services. In this role, you will analyze financial services data, support data integration and reporting solutions, and help deliver timely insights for critical client operations. This Project Delivery role is designed for a professional with specialized data analytics skills aligned to a current client need.

Work you'll do

As a Data and Technology Specialist, Project on the Government & Public Services team, you will be responsible for delivering data analytics and technology support.

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, validate data quality, and support decision-making.
  • Build and maintain extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows that integrate source-system data into analytics-ready datasets.
  • Develop data visualizations and reporting products that communicate insights to client stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to document requirements, test solutions, and resolve data issues.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Business Finance offering enables finance to drive strategic value through transformation and synchronization of planning, costing, budgeting and forecasting across finance and other functions. Using advanced, scalable data and tech platforms, we also generate actionable insights and analytics, streamline decision making and enable data driven profitable growth. Manages risk and opportunities associated with diverse and complex grant programs through end-to-end grants management solutions.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years of work experience
  • 1+ years of experience in financial services
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience using Databricks
  • Experience using IBM InfoSphere DataStage or IBM InfoSphere QualityStage
  • Experience using Microsoft Power BI
  • Experience using Microsoft Azure SQL Server
  • Experience applying accounting concepts in data analysis
  • Experience performing data analysis, developing data visualizations, and building extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Client Intelligence Analyst

Location: Dallas, TX or Tampa, FL

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

Compensation: $90,000–$120,000+ | Overtime & Bonus Eligibility

Industry: AmLaw 100 | Legal Technology, Business Intelligence & Analytics

Position Overview

Plona Partners is partnering with a leading AmLaw 100 law firm seeking a talented Client Intelligence Analyst to support the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of its enterprise intelligence, analytics, and automation platforms. This position sits at the intersection of business intelligence, data engineering, legal technology, and emerging artificial intelligence solutions. The successful candidate will help design and support lawyer-facing intelligence tools that enable attorneys and business professionals to make informed decisions, streamline operations, and improve client service.


Working across Microsoft Power BI, Fabric, Power Platform, Copilot, and related technologies, this professional will collaborate with stakeholders throughout the firm to deliver scalable reporting, automation, and data-driven solutions. The role offers significant exposure to enterprise-wide technology initiatives, AI-enabled innovation, and digital transformation within a sophisticated legal services environment.


Key Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Analytics Development

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance business intelligence dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions using Microsoft Power BI and related technologies.
  • Build and optimize Power Query transformations, DAX measures, semantic models, visualizations, and reporting frameworks.
  • Develop reusable analytics components that improve reporting consistency, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Implement appropriate security configurations, data validation procedures, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into practical analytics solutions.

Data Engineering & Platform Integration

  • Partner with data engineering and technology teams to integrate information from multiple business systems and data sources.
  • Support data pipeline development and transformation using Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Lakehouse/OneLake, notebooks, and related technologies.
  • Assist in establishing data quality controls, standardized reporting metrics, and governance practices.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues involving data integrations, reporting platforms, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable enterprise intelligence architecture.

Automation & AI-Enabled Solutions

  • Develop and maintain workflow automation using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform, and comparable technologies.
  • Support the evaluation and implementation of emerging AI capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, enhance attorney productivity, and improve business operations.
  • Collaborate with technology teams to test, deploy, and support new platform features and enhancements.
  • Assist in evaluating emerging analytics and automation technologies for future implementation.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Technology Adoption

  • Work closely with attorneys, business professionals, IT, knowledge management, finance, marketing, and other administrative departments.
  • Partner with change management, training, and professional development teams to support platform adoption.
  • Develop technical documentation, user guides, configuration materials, and release documentation.
  • Assist with training initiatives, onboarding programs, and communications designed to improve user engagement.
  • Support the development of analytics standards, best practices, and a centralized center of excellence.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable information for nontechnical stakeholders.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data analytics, automation development, or a related discipline.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, dashboard development, and performance optimization.
  • Strong SQL skills, including experience querying, transforming, validating, and analyzing data from multiple sources.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or comparable cloud-based analytics environments.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse architecture, and modern data integration practices.
  • Experience developing workflow automation using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform, or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of software testing, release management, technical documentation, and development environments.
  • Familiarity with data security, governance, and compliance principles.
  • Demonstrated interest in AI-enabled business applications and emerging enterprise technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience within a law firm, professional services organization, or similarly complex enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with legal technology platforms, law firm business operations, and attorney-facing reporting solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Copilot Studio, or related Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide technology adoption, process improvement, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Knowledge of data governance, standardized reporting frameworks, and analytics best practices.

descriptionHtml:
About Our Company

At Patch My PC, we exist to improve lives. What started as a free tool to keep apps updated has grown into a trusted enterprise solution that helps IT and Security teams automate, manage, deploy, and report on third-party updates in Microsoft ConfigMgr, Intune, and WSUS. Our fully remote crew of 150 GIF-loving humans supports over 10,000 customers and more than 32 million devices. We make patching easier, boost security, and give IT teams their time back.

Our core values guide how we work, how we treat each other, and how we grow. They keep us focused on what matters most. We're here to improve the lives of our customers, our team members, and our communities.

About This Role

Patch My PC is looking for a hands-on Business Intelligence Specialist to help build and maintain our enterprise data infrastructure and reporting capabilities.

In this role, you will work with data from multiple business systems, develop reliable data structures and support the creation of a centralized data warehouse. You'll play an important role in making business data accessible, accurate and useful for reporting and decision-making.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges, takes ownership of technical deliverables and is excited to help build a new business intelligence function from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that extract, transform and integrate information from multiple business systems.
  • Develop SQL queries, data models and database structures to support enterprise reporting.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing development of a centralized enterprise data warehouse.
  • Organize, clean and validate data to improve accuracy, consistency and reliability.
  • Develop datasets and reporting solutions that support historical analysis, business performance tracking and operational KPIs.
  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations and other teams to understand data requirements and troubleshoot integration or reporting challenges.
  • Independently investigate data gaps, recommend solutions and deliver technical work with strong ownership and accountability.

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in business intelligence, data integration, database development or related technical data roles.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases, data models and large datasets.
  • Experience building data pipelines and integrating information from multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure-based data solutions or similar technologies.
  • Experience with data transformation, data quality and historical data management.
  • Working knowledge of reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting skills and the ability to independently solve technical problems.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with Salesforce, financial systems or other enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Familiarity with recurring-revenue metrics and operational reporting.
  • Experience helping build or improve data infrastructure in a growing organization.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Base Salary: $100,000 - $125,000 based on experience and location.

Benefits

  • 401k Match: Match 200% of contributions up to the first 5% of salary, resulting in a total potential match of 10%.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Patch My PC covers 99% of premiums for both team members and dependents.

Other Benefits

  • FSA/HSA.
  • Fertility benefits.
  • Parental leave.
  • Paid-time off (PTO).
  • Volunteer leave.
  • Charitable donation matching.
  • Tuition reimbursement.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Internet stipend.
  • Pet insurance.

Learn more about our benefits here: https://patchmypc.com/careers#we-care .

$100,000 - $125,000 a year

What To Expect In The Interview Process

Curious about what comes next? Learn more about our hiring process here: http://patchmypc.com/careers#hiring-process

Equal Opportunity Employer

Patch My PC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a policy of equal treatment and opportunity in every aspect of its recruitment and hiring process. We encourage women, racial and ethnic minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans to apply.

Work Authorization

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

To be eligible for consideration, candidates for fully remote positions must reside in one of the following U.S. states:

AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV, WY.

An innovative financial services organization is seeking an Analytics Engineer to support their enterprise-wide analytics initiatives, focusing on data modeling, business intelligence development, and operational reporting using industry-standard BI tools. This role offers an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals to develop their expertise in analytics engineering, working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, reusable data solutions that enable strategic decision-making.


Role Overview


This Analytics Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining analytical datasets, interactive reports, and dashboards that support financial planning, operational insights, and business intelligence efforts. The role involves translating business requirements into scalable data models and analytics solutions, working with modern BI platforms, and collaborating with data engineering, finance, and IT teams to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain analytical datasets, data models, and visualizations to support recurring financial and operational reporting needs
  • Build, optimize, and enhance dashboards and reports using Power BI, including DAX measures, relationships, and performance tuning
  • Design and implement interactive analytics applications within Sigma Computing, utilizing input forms, writeback capabilities, approval workflows, and integrations with cloud data platforms like Snowflake
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to understand source systems, support data pipeline development, and troubleshoot data quality issues
  • Transform raw data into structured, fact and dimension tables, establishing data relationships, hierarchies, and business definitions in line with dimensional modeling standards
  • Support financial data reconciliation and validation, resolving discrepancies across source systems, analytical datasets, and reports
  • Automate data quality checks and testing procedures, maintaining thorough documentation on data lineage, model configuration, and business logic
  • Assist in platform support, deployment, version control, access management, and adoption of analytics best practices

Core Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related roles
  • Practical experience with Power BI, including semantic modeling, DAX, and report optimization
  • Design and implement interactive analytics applications within Sigma Computing
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, with the ability to write complex queries, joins, subqueries, window functions, and CTEs
  • Hands-on knowledge of modern data warehouses like Snowflake or similar cloud platforms
  • Understanding of dimensional data modeling concepts, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, and data relationships
  • Experience transforming raw source data into standardized, reusable analytics datasets
  • Ability to coordinate with data engineering and technical teams on data pipeline support
  • Knowledge of financial fundamentals including general ledger structures, account classifications, and reporting requirements
  • Effective communication skills, capable of explaining technical solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or related fields; equivalent practical experience acceptable

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Advanced expertise with Sigma Computing, including input tables, security controls, and workbook performance tuning
  • Experience with data transformation frameworks like dbt, and familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or DataHub
  • Exposure to enterprise data governance, metadata management, and master data management
  • Experience supporting financial activities such as close, consolidation, budgeting, or forecasting
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure environments like AWS or Microsoft Fabric
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and automated testing methodologies
  • Prior experience in finance, asset management, or other data-intensive industries

Core Technical Skills

  • Power BI (semantic models, DAX, relationships, security)
  • SQL (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions, CTEs)
  • Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Sigma Computing (workbooks, input tables, security features)
  • Dimensional data modeling (fact/dimension tables, star schema)
  • Data transformation, ETL, and data pipeline support
  • Version control systems (e.g., Git)


Career Impact

This role offers significant growth potential within a leading organization committed to leveraging data analytics for strategic advantage, enabling the candidate to deepen expertise in enterprise data modeling, BI development, and financial analytics.


Compensation and Benefits

Salary range approximately $120,000 - $140,000, with potential bonus and comprehensive benefits.


Apply Today!

Candidates eager to advance their analytics career and work within a dynamic, data-driven environment are encouraged to apply now.


The Phoenix Group Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We strive to attract talented individuals from all backgrounds and provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment.

Are you looking to join Florida's fastest growing MEP Contractor?

B&I Contractors, Inc., a proud five time winner of the Great Place to Work certification, is seeking an experienced and dedicated Business Intelligence Specialist to join our dynamic and expanding team.

Why Choose B&I Contractors, Inc.?

Industry Leader: As Florida's fastest growing MEP contractor, we specialize in large scale commercial projects.

Continuous Development: Benefit from our NCCER certified in house and online training that equips you with the skills needed to advance in your career.

Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy employer paid health insurance, accrued vacation, and sick time, along with a wellness reimbursement program to support your overall well being.

Retirement Benefits: We are a 100% employee owned company with an ESOP. You can also participate in our 401(k) plan with company match and explore post tax Roth IRA options to secure your financial future.

Established Legacy: Join a team of over 1500 employees contributing to our success since 1960, with a proven track record of excellence in mechanical contracting.

ROLE SUMMARY:

The Business Intelligence Specialist is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing data visualization and reporting solutions that support operational and strategic decision making across the organization. This role focuses on transforming data from multiple systems into clear, actionable insights through Power BI and related tools.

Working under the direction of the Business Intelligence Manager, this role plays a key part in executing the organization's data strategy by delivering high quality dashboards, ensuring data accuracy, and supporting user adoption across departments.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Execute defined data initiatives and priorities in alignment with direction from the Business Intelligence Manager
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards that provide actionable insights across business units
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including Viewpoint Vista, Autodesk platforms, and other operational systems
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all reporting solutions
  • Monitor and optimize dashboard performance, usability, and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into reporting solutions
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data connectivity, data quality, and dashboard performance
  • Support data validation and quality assurance processes across datasets
  • Document data sources, transformations, and reporting logic to ensure sustainability and scalability
  • Provide training and support to end users to drive adoption and effective use of dashboards


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field required
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and data models
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience integrating data from diverse sources, including relational databases, APIs, and other structured and unstructured systems
  • Experience with Python or similar programming languages is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and usability for end users
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across technical and nontechnical teams
  • Familiarity with project management concepts and experience working within structured project plans (e.g., timelines, milestones, Gantt charts) is a plus

Position Scope

The Data & Analytics Developer supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of technology solutions.  This position works closely with operations and business stakeholders to analyze data, develop reports and dashboards, support system integrations, and build technology solutions to help improve efficiencies and streamline processes.

The ideal candidate is technically curious and motivated to solve small and big challenges. This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple technologies and business functions while developing further technical expertise.

Location & Travel: This is an onsite position at our office in Fargo, North Dakota. 

Company Overview  

PACK Power was founded in 2023 to meet a growing demand for specialized High Voltage and Medium Voltage expertise within the Renewable, Power Delivery, Utility, and Data Center markets. The company was built by industry veterans, bringing decades of hands-on experience and a shared vision of partnering with clients to deliver exceptional, successful projects. Our suite of specialized services spans substations, transmission lines, switchyards, and collection systems, delivering innovative solutions that power the future while prioritizing sustainability and reliability.   

At its core, PACK Power is built on people. We operate like a family, with a culture rooted in teamwork, trust, and looking out for one another. Our “us over me” mindset creates a respectful, collaborative, and high-performing environment where individuals can grow and succeed together. Honesty, responsiveness, and clear communication guide on how we work — with each other and with our clients. Like a pack of wolves, every team member plays a vital role, united by shared purpose as we lead the High Voltage and Medium Voltage industries.  

 

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Analyze data from multiple systems to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Assist in developing data-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency and support business decisions.
  • Troubleshoot data-related issues and recommend practical, sustainable solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to support business operations.
  • Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, and data needs.
  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardization, and enhanced data accessibility.
  • Support data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting solutions.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and integrations between business applications.
  • Support the movement, organization, and accessibility of data across systems.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the flow of information between departments.
  • Collaborate with senior IT team members to troubleshoot integration issues and implement improvements.
  • Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining internal applications, tools, and automated workflows.
  • Support enhancements to existing technology solutions based on evolving business needs.
  • Participate in evaluating and implementing emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, where appropriate.
  • Document technical solutions, processes, and system configurations to support ongoing maintenance and scalability.
  • Partner with IT team members to ensure solutions align with organizational technology standards and long-term objectives.
  • Communicate technical information and project updates clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Participate in testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of technology solutions.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and data analytics tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support evolving business and technology needs.

Education and Work Experience

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Software Development, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 0–3 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, software development, systems integration, or a related technical field.
  • Relevant internships, academic projects, certifications, or demonstrated technical projects may be considered in place of professional experience.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Take reasonable care of your own and others’ health and safety and of those who may be affected by the day-to-day delivery of this role by taking personal responsibility for working toward the goal of zero injuries.
  • Foundational knowledge of SQL, databases, data structures, and data analysis concepts.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, C#, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
  • Exposure to business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI or comparable platforms.
  • General understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data transformation processes.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to changing business requirements.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating with senior technical team members.
  • Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, and willingness to take ownership of technical challenges.

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase 
  • 401(k) with Competitive Company Match  
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance  
  • Parental Leave  
  • Health Savings Account with Employer Contribution  
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)  
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability  
  • Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave 
  • Employee/family focused culture   

Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need accommodation as part of the employment process, contact careers@packpowerco.com.

The Company’s policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also PACK Power policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.
