descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0253075

Data Visualization Specialist

The Opportunity:

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain interactive dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Microsoft Power BI and Tableau. Create executive-level reporting products that communicate program performance, operational health, and key business insights. Develop datasets, data models, calculations, and reporting frameworks to support operational and strategic decision-making. Build and maintain Power Automate solutions and related Power Platform capabilities to streamline data collection, workflow automation, and business processes. Clean, validate, reconcile, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure reporting accuracy and integrity. Investigate data discrepancies, identify authoritative data sources, document assumptions, and implement quality-control processes. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define success metrics, and continuously improve reporting and visualization products.

You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data visualization, reporting, or data management
  • 3+ years of experience developing complex dashboards and visualizations using Microsoft Power BI and Tableau
  • Experience building business applications and workflow solutions using Microsoft Power Apps and the Microsoft Power Platform
  • Experience working with Jira, including Jira reporting, Jira Query Language (JQL), and integration of Jira data into reporting platforms
  • Experience with data preparation, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance across multiple data sources
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, lookup functions, data validation, and repeatable analytical templates
  • Ability to translate business and program requirements into meaningful metrics, KPIs, reports, and dashboards
  • Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Possession of strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and client-facing skills


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Consultant, Data Modeling & Analytics Reporting job is responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing moderately complex datasets to generate actionable insights and builds detailed reports and dashboards using specifics tools. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to ensure data accuracy and integrity performing data and statistical analysis using various programming languages. This job supports the effective presentation of data findings to partners to meet business objectives.

Key Accountabilities

  • DATA COLLECTION & ANALYSIS: Gathers, processes, prepares, and analyzes moderately complex datasets to extract significant insights, develop and maintain automated reporting systems to streamline data analysis.
  • REPORTING & VISUALIZATION: Implements detailed reports and dashboards using various tools, designs and completes data visualizations to communicate moderately complex data clearly.
  • STATISTICAL ANALYSIS: Supports statistical analysis execution to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data using statistical software and programming languages for data manipulation and analysis.
  • PROCESS IMPROVEMENT: Implements found opportunities to improve data collection and reporting processes and applies standard methodologies for data management and reporting.
  • COLLABORATION: Works closely with multi-functional teams to support data needs, value opportunities and delivers solutions in partnership with digital technology and data engineering teams to help ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  • DATA ANALYSIS: Conducts moderately complex data analyses to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights for decision making.
  • QUALITY ASSURANCE & DATA VALIDATION: Performs moderately complex reports and analyses in support of the accuracy, consistency, and security of data.

  • 2+ years of experience using SQL and Power BI to build analytics solutions

Job Purpose and Impact

The Consultant, Data Modeling & Analytics Reporting job is responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing moderately complex datasets to generate actionable insights and builds detailed reports and dashboards using specifics tools. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to ensure data accuracy and integrity performing data and statistical analysis using various programming languages. This job supports the effective presentation of data findings to partners to meet business objectives.

Key Accountabilities



- DATA COLLECTION & ANALYSIS: Gathers, processes, prepares, and analyzes moderately complex datasets to extract significant insights, develop and maintain automated reporting systems to streamline data analysis. 
- REPORTING & VISUALIZATION: Implements detailed reports and dashboards using various tools, designs and completes data visualizations to communicate moderately complex data clearly. 
- STATISTICAL ANALYSIS: Supports statistical analysis execution to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data using statistical software and programming languages for data manipulation and analysis. 
- PROCESS IMPROVEMENT: Implements found opportunities to improve data collection and reporting processes and applies standard methodologies for data management and reporting. 
- COLLABORATION: Works closely with multi-functional teams to support data needs, value opportunities and delivers solutions in partnership with digital technology and data engineering teams to help ensuring data integrity and accuracy.

descriptionHtml:
CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Engineer who will serve as our in-house data engineering expert for the BI platform. You’ll build and maintain the transformation layer, data models, and Snowflake environment behind our reporting, working alongside the integrations team that handles sourcing and landing. You’ll partner with finance, sales, and operations leaders to define metrics and deliver trusted reporting end to end. And, as a member of the Data and Business Intelligence team, you’ll also help build the Power BI dashboards when the work calls for it.

What You'll Do

  • Maintain the BI Snowflake environment: schemas, roles and access, performance tuning, warehouse sizing, and cost monitoring
  • Build and optimize Power BI semantic models and dashboards (star schemas, DAX measures, row-level security), tuning DirectQuery and Import models against Snowflake
  • Translate business requirements, KPIs, and metric definitions into technical designs.
  • Set engineering standards for naming, code review, CI/CD, and documentation
  • Partner with the integrations team to define what the BI platform needs from landed data and resolve upstream issues
  • Own data quality in the transformation layer: testing, monitoring, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis
  • Write complex, performant SQL to model, transform, and validate data
  • Develop and maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, marts) with tests, documentation, and version control
  • Set up and tune Snowflake Cortex Analyst and Semantic Views so natural-language questions return accurate answers
  • Evaluate, test, and pilot AI-enabled analytics, such as natural language querying over semantic models, AI-generated commentary, and automated variance explanation.
  • Mentor analysts and stakeholders on data models and self-service
  • Pitch in with PowerBI report and dashboard builds when needed.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or BI engineering
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, IT, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Advanced SQL and dbt, with a solid grasp of dimensional modeling and data warehousing concepts
  • Deep hands-on Snowflake experience, including performance tuning, access control, and cost management
  • Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, data modeling, and publishing and managing workspaces
  • Git and CI/CD experience for analytics code
  • Working fluency with AI tools in analytics or engineering work, with sound judgment about their limits, including inaccurate or ungrounded answers
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and carry them through to deployment with strong attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building ELT pipelines and data ingestion (Fivetran or similar, including API-based sources)
  • Python for scripting and automation
  • Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, or similar)
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or similar) for Snowflake
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex Analyst, semantic views, or similar natural-language-to-SQL tools
  • Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, and lineage tooling
  • Background in finance, FP&A, or sales analytics
  • Exposure to Tableau or other BI tools

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $130,000 - $185,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

Benefits Summary

The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site: https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.

As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.

Wintrust provides community and commercial banking, specialty finance and wealth management services through its 16 bank charters and nine non-bank businesses. Our people are the heart of our business and we are proud to rank consistently as a top place to work. Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our growing team and play a key role in driving data informed decision making across the organization. This individual will lead complex analytics initiatives from problem definition through delivery, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable insights and data driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, data visualization, and data analysis with the business acumen and communication skills needed to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage analytics projects, identify meaningful trends and opportunities within data, and communicate findings that influence business decisions.

What You’ll Do



- Lead complex data analysis initiatives, taking ownership of assignments from initial requirements gathering and problem definition through analysis, mapping, documentation, and delivery.
- Partner directly with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs and translate requirements into detailed technical mappings and specifications.
- Perform comprehensive source-to-target data analysis and mapping, including data profiling, validation, transformation requirements, and identification of data quality issues.
- Query and analyze large, complex datasets using SQL to identify relationships, trends, anomalies, and business rules and support data-driven solutions.
- Apply strong data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables, to support enterprise data initiatives.
- Develop and maintain clear data documentation while supporting data governance standards, data quality, and integrity across assigned projects.
- Collaborate closely with data engineers, data architects, analysts, and business users while developing domain expertise and providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts.

Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Science, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data warehousing, including experience supporting complex enterprise data projects.
- Strong experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, Data Analysis, Data Mapping, and Data Warehousing.
- Strong hands-on SQL expertise with demonstrated experience performing complex data analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target data mapping.
- Strong understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables.
- Demonstrated ability to independently analyze source data, work through ambiguous requirements, and partner with business and development teams to translate business requirements into technical mappings and data solutions.

descriptionHtml:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.

Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor.

How You'll Make An Impact

Owning Power BI dashboards and datasets end to end means tracing data from source systems through Azure Data Factory into Fabric, building the semantic models and DAX measures behind self-service reporting, and making sure what leadership sees is accurate. This is a build-and-maintain role first and ad hoc analysis second, and it calls for sound judgment on AI: knowing where automation genuinely improves a reporting workflow and where it doesn’t.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, data models, and dashboards — not just visuals, but the relationships and measures underneath them
  • Understand and be able to explain how data flows from source systems through Azure Data Factory into Fabric and into Power BI, well enough to diagnose issues independently rather than escalating every anomaly
  • Partner with stakeholders across departments to gather requirements and translate them into technical specs
  • Own data accuracy and quality for reporting outputs — troubleshoot and resolve issues as they surface, not just flag them for someone else
  • Document data models, datasets, and reporting logic for team continuity and QA
  • Actively build AI into the daily workflow — using AI tools to draft queries, DAX/Power Query logic, and documentation, and proactively identifying where AI or automation can replace manual reporting steps — while independently validating correctness before anything reaches a stakeholder
  • Identify and build AI-powered automation for manual reporting workflows, expanding self-service analytics and offsetting capacity constraints without added headcount
  • Grow into Cin7’s broader Customer Operations systems over time — ChurnZero, Salesforce, ZenDesk — with training provided as needed. Not an immediate priority for this role, but baseline ChurnZero configuration is expected of every Customer Ops team member, given how central it is to the function.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (information systems, computer science, business analytics, or similar) — or demonstrated equivalent experience with a track record in BI-specific roles
  • 2+ years of hands-on Power BI experience: building datasets and data models, not just consuming or lightly editing existing dashboards — relationships, DAX measures, Power Query
  • Working knowledge of SQL, framed as a diagnostic/conceptual skill (reading and validating data, understanding joins/keys/grain) rather than daily production querying
  • Demonstrated ability to explain what data means and where it comes from, not just how to reproduce a report
  • AI-native fluency, demonstrated rather than claimed: able to build AI tools into daily BI workflows (query drafting, DAX/Power Query, documentation, automation), independently validate their output before it reaches a stakeholder, and bring a practical sense of what these tools are and aren't good at

It's a Nice To Have If You Bring

  • Direct exposure to Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, dataflows) or Azure Data Factory
  • Experience owning a BI dataset/model end-to-end at a prior job, not just building on top of one someone else designed

In Return, We Offer

  • Competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, and a 401k company match program.
  • A flexible PTO policy, allowing you the time you need to recharge.
  • A diverse team, where everyone helps each other and inclusion is a core value.
  • Remote work flexibility allows you to maintain a work-life balance in a way that suits your needs.
  • Frequent company-sponsored events so you can get to know your coworkers.

$85,000 - $100,000 a year

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the approximate annual base compensation range is listed above. The actual offer, reflecting the total compensation package and benefits, will be determined by a number of factors including the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview:

At Snap Finance, we believe everyone deserves access to the things they need, regardless of credit history. Since 2012, we've used data, machine learning, and a more human approach to create flexible financing solutions that help people move forward. We're proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, built on empowering our customers, partners, and team members alike. When our people thrive, so does our innovation.

If you're looking to make an impact and grow with a team that values you, come join us!

Job Description

Are you passionate about transforming data into insight and impact? Snap Finance is redefining the future of financial technology through innovation, intelligence, and accessibility. We’re looking for a Lead BI Analytics Engineer to drive the next evolution of our analytics ecosystem — empowering teams through exceptional data visualization, robust data modeling, and smart BI platform optimization.

If you live and breathe data, love clean models and beautiful dashboards, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible in business intelligence (including responsible AI adoption), this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of high-impact BI dashboards and data visualizations that drive strategic decision-making across all levels of the business.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical requirements, define meaningful KPIs, and ensure insights align with company goals.
  • Architect and maintain scalable data models, ensuring performance, integrity, and usability across multiple data domains.
  • Write and optimize advanced SQL (Presto, PostgreSQL, or equivalent) for analysis, dashboard feeds, and automation pipelines.
  • Oversee and continuously improve our Tableau ecosystem (or equivalent BI platforms) — including governance, content strategy, performance optimization, and user enablement.
  • Use Python to automate workflows, enrich datasets, and build repeatable analytical frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain advanced Excel models and visualizations, integrating them with BI tools where appropriate for ad-hoc analysis and executive reporting.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, Analytics, and Product teams to align BI architecture with business needs and system capabilities.
  • Champion best practices in visualization design, storytelling, and performance tuning.
  • Evaluate and introduce AI-driven efficiencies within the BI space — from intelligent data preparation to automated insights — while maintaining technical rigor and human oversight.
  • Mentor analysts and BI developers, setting standards for data modeling, dashboard development, and analytical quality.
  • Ensure a culture of data trust, scalability, and continual improvement across the BI environment.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, data analytics, or a related technical field.
  • Deep expertise in SQL — capable of building, optimizing, and mentoring on complex query logic and data modeling.
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and integration workflows.
  • Expert-level skills in Tableau and Excel — capable of creating dynamic dashboards, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros, and interactive visualizations.
  • Proven experience in data modeling for analytics — star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers, and KPI standardization.
  • Strong experience working with business stakeholders to define KPIs, build requirements, and deliver insights that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture principles and how BI fits into the larger data ecosystem.
  • Curiosity and openness to AI and automation — an eagerness to apply emerging tools to make BI faster, smarter, and more scalable.
  • Experience with R or Shiny is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling business insights.
  • A leadership mindset that combines technical excellence with mentoring, collaboration, and the drive to raise team capability.

Why Join Us:

  • Generous paid time off
  • Competitive medical, dental & vision coverage
  • 401K with company match for US
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability
  • Access to mental health and wellness resources
  • Company-paid volunteer time to do good in your community
  • Legal coverage and other supplemental options
  • A value-based culture where growth opportunities are endless

More:

Snap values diversity and all qualified applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Learn more by visiting our website at www.snapfinance.com.

California Residents, please review our California Consumer Privacy Act Notice at https://snapfinance.com/ccpa-notice

The Role

The Senior Business Intelligence and Power Platform Developer is an advanced, hands-on technical specialist who executes the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of end-to-end business intelligence, analytics, governed data collection, and business process automation solutions within the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform ecosystem. The role requires deep proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, data integration, and production reporting, complemented by practical expertise in Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

Working closely with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, the individual translates organizational requirements and collaboratively developed solution concepts into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions. The role extends beyond traditional dashboard development to include defining business processes where none exist, establishing governed data collection methods, integrating and validating data sources, automating workflows, and delivering actionable analytics and executive reporting.

This hands-on individual contributor role requires a self-directed senior technical practitioner capable of navigating ambiguity, exercising strong analytical thinking, sound technical judgment, and independent problem-solving, identifying cross-functional dependencies and data relationships, and taking ownership of solutions throughout their full lifecycle. The individual provides collaborative technical leadership rather than dedicated enterprise architecture or people management and communicates technical designs, analytical findings, risks, and recommendations credibly to business, technical, and executive audiences, including C-suite leadership. The role is accountable for improving organizational decision-making, operational visibility, process control, data quality, compliance, and technology value

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline and 9 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, reporting development, information systems development, or closely related technical work.

Demonstrated hands-on experience delivering, deploying, and sustaining production analytics and Microsoft 365 and Power Platform solutions across the capabilities described above.

Summary

The Senior Enterprise BI and Analytics Analyst serves as the lead analytics partner between advancement leadership, frontline fundraisers, Alumni Relations, Prospect Management and Research, Data Information Services, and MCW enterprise IT. This position combines knowledge of fundraising and advancement operations with advanced skills in data analysis, data modeling, and visualization. The analyst translates advancement business questions into requirements, transformation logic, and functional specifications, then designs and builds dashboards, metrics, and data products that guide fundraising strategy.


The role owns reporting for the Grateful Patient program, fundraiser performance, campaign progress, and donor pipeline, and ensures advancement data is accurate, trusted, and aligned with institutional and industry reporting standards. The analyst collaborates with units across MCW and the clinical enterprise to expand the advancement analytics footprint and supports the transition to a modern CRM platform.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Designs, builds, and maintains dashboards and reports in Tableau or Power BI for advancement leadership, gift officers, and campus partners covering fundraising production, campaign progress, pipeline health, donor retention, and portfolio performance.
  • Leads the design and ongoing development of Grateful Patient program metrics, including patient identification and referral volume, physician and clinician engagement, conversion from identification to solicitation, time to first gift, and revenue attributed to clinical relationships.
  • Partners with clinical enterprise units and compliance staff to define secure, HIPAA compliant data flows that support Grateful Patient screening, referral tracking, and reporting.
  • Builds and implements reports to support fundraising metrics and business rules for gift and pledge counting, soft credit, campaign counting, and fiscal year reporting consistent with CASE Global Reporting Standards.
  • Partners with enterprise units including Business Development and Government Relations to deliver reporting on corporate and foundation relationships, industry partnership pipeline, and sponsorship revenue, along with analysis that connects donors, board members, and community partners to elected officials and government stakeholders in support of advocacy and relationship strategy.
  • Partners with Prospect Management and Research to accelerate prospect identification through reporting and metrics, including identification queues that surface constituents with strong capacity and affinity, pipeline and portfolio coverage analysis, and data quality checks that ensure wealth screening results, research ratings, and relationship data are accurately associated with constituent records.
  • Develops planned giving analytics, including identification models for bequest and legacy prospects, tracking of expectancies and realized gifts, and reporting on legacy society growth.
  • Partners with Alumni Relations to deliver engagement scoring, participation and retention trends, reunion and event performance, and analysis of how alumni engagement converts to giving.
  • Formulates calculations, transformation logic, data analysis, and rapid prototypes for advancement analytics applications, dashboards, and data products.
  • Develops requirement analysis, functional specifications, and solution designs for analytics and data visualization in partnership with the Business Analyst and advancement stakeholders.
  • Writes SQL scripts for data acquisition, transformation, and validation from the CRM, data warehouse, and related advancement and institutional sources.
  • Builds and maintains data models supporting fundraiser performance metrics, prospect and moves management, events, and constituent engagement reporting, and applies predictive modeling, RFM analysis, and donor lifecycle modeling to segment constituents from acquisition through retention, upgrade, and lapse.
  • Serves as the analytics subject matter expert during any advancement platform changes by mapping legacy reports and data structures to the new environment and validating data accuracy.
  • Coordinates quality control and accuracy of information by identifying data issues, recommending corrective action to be in line with data governance and stewardship standards.
  • Produces analysis for board and leadership presentations, annual reporting and executive ad hoc requests.
  • Supports and improves the advancement analytics intake and triage process to increase efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Trains and supports end users to expand adoption of self-service reporting across the Office of Institutional Advancement.
  • Provides guidance and peer mentoring to reporting analysts and data staff.
  • Provides technical and functional documentation on project requirements and deliverables.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Knowledge of fundraising operations in higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit settings, including gift and pledge accounting principles and advancement reporting standards.
  • Advanced proficiency in a business intelligence platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik, including data modeling, predictive modeling, calculated measures, and dashboard design for executive and operational audiences.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses.
  • Experience working with a CRM or constituent database, such as Raiser's Edge NXT, Blackbaud CRM, Salesforce, Slate, Ellucian CRM Advance, or a comparable system.
  • Familiarity with grateful patient fundraising and HIPAA requirements governing the fundraising use of protected health information, or the ability to develop that knowledge quickly.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight for fundraisers and senior leadership.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, strong critical thinking and problem solving, and close attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.


All remote work must be performed within one of the MCW registered payroll states, which currently includes: WI, AZ, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, TN, TX, and UT.


Qualifications

Appropriate experience may be substituted for education on an equivalent basis.

Minimum Required Education: Bachelor's degree

Minimum Required Experience: 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting, including SQL development, data modeling, and dashboard design in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool.

Preferred Education: Bachelor's Degree or Master's degree in data analytics, information systems, statistics, business, or a related field

Preferred Experience: 3 or more years of experience in higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit advancement, including analytics supporting prospect research, planned giving, alumni relations, business development, government relations or grateful patient programs. Experience with predictive modeling, RFM segmentation, or donor lifecycle modeling and with CRM data migration or conversion.

Preferred Certification/Licensure(s): Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Certified Data Analyst, or comparable analytics certification


Physical Requirements

Work requires occasionally lifting moderate weight materials, standing, or walking continuously.

Work Environment

Occasional exposure to dust, noise, temperature changes, or contact with water or other liquids. Work is performed in an environmentally controlled environment.

Sensory Acuity

Ability to detect and translate speech or other communication required. May occasionally require the ability to distinguish colors and perceive relative distances between objects.


Target salary range for this position is between $87,100 and $111,500 annually. The final offered salary will depend on the applicant’s education, experience, skills, and knowledge, as well as considerations of internal equity and market alignment.


Why MCW?

  • Outstanding Healthcare Coverage, including but not limited to Health, Vision, and Dental. Along with Flexible Spending options
  • 403B Retirement Package
  • Competitive Vacation and Paid Holidays offered
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
  • Pet Insurance
  • On campus Fitness Facility, offering onsite classes
  • Additional discounted rates on items such as: Select cell phone plans, local fitness facilities, Milwaukee recreation and entertainment etc.

For a brief overview of our benefits see: Benefits Overview

For a full list of positions see: MCW Careers


At MCW all of our endeavors, from our internal operations to our interactions with our partners, are driven by our shared organizational values: Caring – Collaborative – Curiosity – Inclusive – Integrity – Respect. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values diversity in backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives through merit-based processes and in alignment with all applicable laws. If you believe in embracing individuality and working together according to these principles to improve health for all, then MCW is the place for you. Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Senior Data Analyst / Data Engineer

About Your Role

At Fiserv, we are dedicated to transforming financial services through data-driven innovation and technology. As a Senior Data Analyst / Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimizing enterprise data solutions that support strategic decision-making across the organization. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and technology partners to deliver scalable reporting, data engineering, and AI-enabled solutions that drive operational excellence and business value.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical datasets to support business objectives.
  • Build and enhance Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and self-service analytics solutions for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Develop and optimize Snowflake-based data solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, and performance tuning.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to gather requirements and translate them into robust data models and reporting solutions.
  • Design and implement data integration and ETL/ELT processes leveraging modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, validation, and quality assurance activities to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain dimensional and analytical data models that support enterprise reporting and advanced analytics.
  • Leverage AI and machine learning capabilities, including generative AI solutions, to improve business insights, reporting efficiency, and decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency through data engineering and analytics best practices.
  • Maintain documentation, data lineage, and governance standards to support enterprise data management initiatives.
  • Mentor team members and provide technical guidance on data architecture, modeling, reporting, and analytics best practices.

Experience You'll Need To Have

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, or related fields.
  • 5+ years of experience developing enterprise reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI.
  • 3+ years of experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, performance optimization, and data engineering best practices.
  • 3+ years of experience with SQL and relational database technologies.
  • 3+ years of experience with dimensional data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and semantic model design.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

  • Experience with Power BI administration, deployment pipelines, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience with Python, Spark, or other data engineering and analytics technologies.
  • Experience implementing data governance, metadata management, and data lineage solutions.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, AI-powered analytics, and emerging data technologies.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to present complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

Important Information About This Role

  • You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role
  • This is a full-time, direct-hire position, and no contract options for unsolicited agency submissions will be considered
  • All offers of employment are contingent on standard background checks. Fiserv and certain of its affiliated companies are federal, state, and/or local government contractors. Should this position support a Federal Government contract, now or in the future, the successful candidate will be subject to a background check conducted by the U.S. Government to determine eligibility and suitability for federal contract employment for public trust or sensitive positions. Positions that support state and/or local contracts also may require additional background checks to determine eligibility and suitability

Salary Range

$110,000.00 - $186,000.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in New Jersey and New York. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion.

  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our Commitment To Equal Opportunity

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation in completing a job application or otherwise participating in the overall hiring process, please contact AskHR.US@fiserv.com. Please note our AskHR representatives do not have visibility to your application status. Current associates who require a workplace accommodation should refer to Fiserv’s Disability Accommodation Policy for additional information.

Note To Agencies

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
